exampleZh: 鯊魚高高的背鰭劃破水面，繞著船打轉。

zh: 流暢;流暢的說話(或寫作)
tip: flu 像 flow 流：話像水一樣流出來
example: After a year in Canada, her fluency in English impressed every teacher.
exampleZh: 在加拿大待了一年後，她流利的英語讓每位老師都印象深刻。

tip: foe 諧音「佛」：遇到敵人念佛，與 friend 對比
example: In the old tale, the knight forgave his foe instead of seeking revenge.
exampleZh: 在古老的故事中，騎士原諒了他的敵人，而不是尋求報復。

tip: foil 諧音「佛要」：佛要用金箔，金屬薄片就是箔
example: Wrap the leftover fish in foil before you put it in the oven.
exampleZh: 把剩下的魚用鋁箔紙包好，再放進烤箱。

tip: fowl 跟 owl 貓頭鷹只差 f，都是鳥類
example: Farmers keep ducks, geese, and other fowl in the yard behind the barn.
exampleZh: 農夫在穀倉後面的院子裡養鴨、鵝和其他家禽。

tip: fract 打破：打破後的一小片，也是分數 fraction
example: Only a fraction of the class finished the long quiz before the bell rang.
exampleZh: 只有一小部分學生在鐘響前寫完那份很長的小考。

tip: frame 框 + work 作品：先有框，才能把內容填進去
example: The new law sets a framework for how cities must plan their parks.
exampleZh: 這項新法律為各城市規劃公園的方式訂出了架構。

tip: front 前面 + ier：站在最前面的邊界
example: Early settlers pushed west toward the frontier in covered wagons.
exampleZh: 早期移民乘著篷車向西前進，朝邊疆而去。

tip: fury 諧音「夫瑞」：夫瑞氣到臉紅發燙
example: The crowd listened in fury as the unfair decision was announced.
exampleZh: 當不公平的決定宣布時，群眾怒氣沖沖地聆聽。

tip: garment 諧音「剛門」：剛出門穿的那件衣服
example: She hung each garment carefully in the closet to keep it from wrinkling.
exampleZh: 她小心地把每件衣服掛進衣櫥，以免起皺。

tip: gather 聚集 + ing：人們聚在一起的場合
example: A small gathering of neighbors formed outside the school after the fire drill.
exampleZh: 消防演習後，一小群鄰居聚集在學校外面。

tip: 【大考字根】音節分解 gend - er。核心意義指向「性別」，常出現在篇章閱讀與學術論述中。
example: The suspect's gender is currently unknown.
exampleZh: 嫌疑犯目前性別不明。

tip: geo 土地 + metry 測量：古代用來量土地的學問
example: In geometry class, we learned how to measure the angles of a triangle.
exampleZh: 在幾何課上，我們學會如何測量三角形的角度。

tip: glee 諧音「葛立」：笑到「個哩」個哩的開心
example: The children shouted with glee when they saw the snow covering the playground.
exampleZh: 孩子們看到雪覆蓋了操場，歡欣地大叫。

tip: god 神 + spell 話：神的話語就是福音
example: The choir sang a gospel song that made everyone in the hall clap along.
exampleZh: 合唱團唱了一首福音歌曲，讓大廳裡的每個人都跟著拍手。

tip: greed 諧音「革理的」：什麼都想要，貪心沒完沒了
example: The king's greed made him raise taxes until his people could barely eat.
exampleZh: 國王的貪心讓他不斷加稅，直到人民幾乎吃不飽。

tip: gypsy 諧音「吉普西」：坐吉普車四處走走停停的人
example: Wandering from town to town, the gypsy sold handmade baskets at the market.
exampleZh: 那名流浪者從一個城鎮走到另一個城鎮，在市場賣手編的籃子。

tip: hair 頭髮 + do 做：頭髮做出來的造型
example: Her new hairdo looked fancy, but it took an hour to style each morning.
exampleZh: 她的新髮型看起來很時髦，但每天早上要花一小時整理。

tip: 【大考字根】音節分解 hair - sty - le。核心意義指向「髮型」，常出現在篇章閱讀與學術論述中。
example: Tom said that he liked Mary's new hairstyle.
exampleZh: 湯姆說他喜歡瑪莉的新髮型。

tip: hand 手 + i + craft 工藝：用雙手做出的工藝
example: The village market is famous for handicraft such as woven mats and bamboo baskets.
exampleZh: 這個村落的市集以編織蓆和竹籃等手工藝品聞名。

tip: heir 的 h 不發音，跟 air 同音，錢像空氣降到你頭上
example: When the old king died without a son, his niece became the heir.
exampleZh: 老國王沒有兒子就過世了，他的姪女成了繼承人。

tip: herb 美式 h 不發音，唸起來像「噁」，香草味道獨特
example: Mom grows mint and basil, two herbs that make her soup taste fresh.
exampleZh: 媽媽種了薄荷和羅勒這兩種香草，讓她煮的湯嘗起來很清新。

tip: hermit 諧音「喝蜜」：一個人在山上默默喝蜂蜜
example: The hermit lived alone in a mountain cave and rarely met other people.
exampleZh: 那位隱士獨自住在山洞裡，很少見到別人。

tip: hi 高 + fi 傳真：聲音很高水準地還原
example: Dad saved up for months to buy a hi-fi system for the living room.
exampleZh: 爸爸存了好幾個月的錢，為客廳買了一套高傳真音響。

tip: 【大考字根】音節分解 hoc - key。核心意義指向「曲棍球」，常出現在篇章閱讀與學術論述中。
example: Field hockey is not very popular in China.
exampleZh: 曲棍球在中國不是很流行。

tip: hoof 的兩個 o 像馬蹄的兩個圓印
example: The horse lifted one hoof so the farrier could check the iron shoe.
exampleZh: 那匹馬抬起一隻蹄，讓蹄鐵匠檢查鐵掌。

tip: host 主人 + age：被當成「客人」留在對方手上的人
example: The robbers held a bank clerk hostage until police promised them a getaway car.
exampleZh: 搶匪挾持一名銀行行員當人質，直到警方答應給他們一輛逃逸用車。

tip: house 房子 + ing：集合所有房子的總稱
example: Rising rent has made decent housing hard to find for young workers in the city.
exampleZh: 租金上漲讓都市裡的年輕上班族很難找到像樣的住房。

tip: 【大考字根】音節分解 idiot。核心意義指向「白癡;笨蛋」，常出現在篇章閱讀與學術論述中。
example: You really are an idiot.
exampleZh: 你真的是（一）個笨蛋。

tip: 【大考字根】音節分解 im - pul - se。核心意義指向「衝動;推動力」，常出現在篇章閱讀與學術論述中。
example: He told his wife not to buy on impulse.
exampleZh: 他叫自己的妻子不要衝動購物。

tip: inter 之間 + fere 打：有人插進你們之間亂打亂
example: Without outside interference, the two teams settled the quarrel by themselves.
exampleZh: 沒有外人干涉，兩隊自己解決了爭吵。

tip: interpret 解釋 + ation：把不清楚的意思講明白
example: Each reader gave a different interpretation of the poem's last line.
exampleZh: 每位讀者對這首詩的最後一行都有不同的詮釋。

tip: interpret 翻譯 + er：幫雙方「接通」語言的人
example: An interpreter stood beside the mayor and repeated every sentence in Japanese.
exampleZh: 一位口譯員站在市長旁邊，把每一句話都用日語重述一遍。

tip: isle 的 s 不發音，跟 aisle 走道、I'll 同音
example: Ferries run twice a day from the harbor to the tiny isle off the coast.
exampleZh: 渡輪每天從港口開兩班到近海的那座小島。

tip: ivy 諧音「愛威」：愛爬威風高牆的藤
example: Green ivy crept up the brick wall until it covered the old window.
exampleZh: 綠色的常春藤爬上磚牆，直到蓋住那扇舊窗戶。

tip: jade 諧音「潔的」：潔白溫潤的寶石
example: She wore a smooth jade bracelet that her grandmother had given her.
exampleZh: 她戴著奶奶送給她的一只光滑玉鐲。

tip: 【大考字根】音節分解 ja - nit - or。核心意義指向「清潔工;管理員;看門人」，常出現在篇章閱讀與學術論述中。
example: Tom started as a janitor, but he's now the president of the company.
exampleZh: 湯姆最初是看門人，但現在他是公司的總裁了。

example: Fresh jasmine floating in the cup made the whole tea smell sweet.
exampleZh: 杯中漂浮的新鮮茉莉讓整杯茶都散發甜香。

tip: journal 日報 + ism：與寫日報有關的行業
example: She studied journalism at university because she wanted to report the truth.
exampleZh: 她在大學主修新聞學，因為想要報導真相。

tip: journal 日報 + ist：每天寫新聞的人
example: The journalist interviewed the survivors and wrote a long article by midnight.
exampleZh: 那位記者訪問了倖存者，並在午夜前寫出一篇長篇報導。

tip: 【大考字根】音節分解 ju - ry。核心意義指向「陪審團」，常出現在篇章閱讀與學術論述中。
example: The jury looked shocked.
exampleZh: 陪審團看起來很震驚。

tip: lad 跟 lady 相對，lad 是男孩、lady 是女士
example: The lad from the next village helped carry our bags up the hill.
exampleZh: 隔壁村的那個小伙子幫我們把袋子扛上山丘。

tip: land 土地 + lady 女士：擁有房子土地的女士
example: Our landlady lives downstairs and bakes cookies for the tenants every Sunday.
exampleZh: 我們的女房東住在樓下，每週日都烤餅乾給房客。

tip: land 土地 + lord 主人：土地的主人
example: The landlord promised to fix the leaking roof before the next rainy season.
exampleZh: 房東答應在下個雨季前修好漏水的屋頂。

tip: 【大考字根】音節分解 las - er。核心意義指向「雷射」，常出現在篇章閱讀與學術論述中。
example: Laser printers are generally cheaper to maintain than inkjet printers.
exampleZh: 雷射印表機一般比噴墨印表機用起來更省錢。

zh: 鞭打;(風浪等的)猛烈打擊;斥責
tip: lash 諧音「辣屎」：像鞭子啪一下的猛打
example: A sudden lash of rain stung our faces as we hurried across the bridge.
exampleZh: 當我們匆忙走過橋時，一陣猛烈的雨打在臉上，刺痛我們。

tip: lat 像 flat 平：緯度是橫著畫的平行線
example: Cities at high latitude, such as Oslo, have very short days in winter.
exampleZh: 高緯度的城市如奧斯陸，冬天的白晝非常短。

tip: law 法律 + maker 製造者：訂出法律的人
example: The lawmaker proposed a new rule to protect children from unsafe toys.
exampleZh: 那位立法者提出一項新規定，以保護孩子免於不安全的玩具。

tip: 美式唸 lu-TEN-nant，lieu 是「代替」，替長官出力的人
example: The lieutenant gave the order, and the young soldiers marched out at dawn.
exampleZh: 中尉下達命令，年輕的士兵們在黎明時列隊出發。

tip: 【大考字根】音節分解 li - ke - li - hood。核心意義指向「可能;可能性」，常出現在篇章閱讀與學術論述中。
example: In all likelihood, this means war.
exampleZh: 這很可能意味著戰爭。

tip: live 活 + stock 存貨：活著的存貨，就是家畜
example: Cows, sheep, and other livestock graze on the open grassland all summer.
exampleZh: 牛、羊和其他家畜整個夏天都在遼闊的草原上吃草。

example: A swarm of locusts swept across the field and ate every green leaf.
exampleZh: 一大群蝗蟲掠過田野，吃光每一片綠葉。

tip: logo 諧音「樂購」：看到商標就想買
example: The bakery printed its logo on every paper bag to help customers remember it.
exampleZh: 這家麵包店在每個紙袋上印了商標，幫助顧客記住它。

tip: long 長 + i + tude：沿著地球縱向拉長的線
example: Taipei lies at about 121 degrees east longitude on the world map.
exampleZh: 台北在世界地圖上大約位於東經一百二十一度。

tip: 【大考字根】音節分解 lot - te - ry。核心意義指向「獎券;彩票;抽籤;運氣」，常出現在篇章閱讀與學術論述中。
example: If I won the lottery, I'd buy a new car.
exampleZh: 如果我中了彩票，我會買輛新車。

tip: lotus 諧音「蘿特絲」：池中一朵蘿特絲公主般的花
example: A pink lotus bloomed in the pond, floating above the muddy water.
exampleZh: 一朵粉紅蓮花在池塘中綻放，浮在混濁的水面上。

tip: main 主要 + land 土地：主要的那一大塊陸地
example: Ferries carry tourists from the island to the mainland every hour.
exampleZh: 渡輪每小時載遊客從島上到大陸。

tip: main 主要 + stream 河流：河中最大的那條水流
example: Her ideas were once strange, but now they are part of the mainstream.
exampleZh: 她的想法曾經很奇特，但現在已成為主流的一部分。

tip: major 大 + ty：大到讓人肅然起敬的壯麗
example: Visitors stood silent before the majesty of the snow-covered mountains.
exampleZh: 遊客在白雪覆蓋的群山雄偉氣勢前靜靜站著。

tip: man 人 + sion：大人物住的大房子
example: A stone mansion with forty rooms stands at the top of the hill.
exampleZh: 一棟有四十個房間的石造大宅矗立在山頂。

tip: maple 諧音「妹珀」：妹妹愛的楓糖漿來自它
example: In October, the maple leaves along the road turn bright red and gold.
exampleZh: 十月時，路旁的楓葉轉為鮮紅與金黃。

tip: marshal 諧音「馬修」：騎馬帶隊的馬修指揮官
example: The marshal led the parade on horseback while the crowd waved flags.
exampleZh: 典禮官騎著馬帶領遊行，群眾則揮舞旗幟。

tip: 【大考字根】音節分解 mas - ter - pie - ce。核心意義指向「傑作,名作」，常出現在篇章閱讀與學術論述中。
example: I like this picture, not just because it's famous, but because it really is a masterpiece.
exampleZh: 我喜歡這幅畫，不僅是因為它的名氣，而是因為它真的是一個傑作。

tip: mechanic 機械 + s：研究機械與力運作的學問
example: Students in physics class study the mechanics of falling objects and moving cars.
exampleZh: 物理課的學生研究落體與行駛中汽車的力學。

tip: mer 古字「海」+ maid 少女：海裡的少女
example: In the fairy tale, the mermaid gave up her voice to walk on land.
exampleZh: 在童話故事中，美人魚為了能在陸地行走而放棄了她的聲音。

zh: 總英里數;(每單位燃料的)行駛哩數
tip: mile 英里 + age：跑了多少英里的累積
example: The old truck had a lot of mileage, so Dad sold it before it broke down.
exampleZh: 那輛舊卡車的里程數很高，所以爸爸在它壞掉前就賣掉了。

tip: mint 諧音「命特」：一口涼到命都特別清醒
example: She chewed a mint after lunch to make her breath smell fresh.
exampleZh: 她午餐後嚼了一顆薄荷糖，讓口氣清新。

tip: miser 諧音「Me 守」：只想「我守著」錢的人
example: The miser counted his coins each night and refused to buy new shoes.
exampleZh: 那個吝嗇鬼每天夜裡數他的銅板，卻不肯買新鞋。

tip: mister 先生的女性版，管家的 mistress 就是女主人
example: The mistress of the house greeted every guest at the door with a warm smile.
exampleZh: 這屋子的女主人在門口以溫暖的微笑迎接每位客人。

tip: mode 諧音「磨的」：每種磨法，就是一種模式
example: Airplane mode turns off the phone's signal, so you can use it during a flight.
exampleZh: 飛航模式會關掉手機的訊號，所以你在飛行途中也能使用。

tip: mon 單獨 + arch 統治：獨自一人統治國家
example: The monarch ruled for fifty years and was loved by the common people.
exampleZh: 那位君主統治了五十年，深受平民愛戴。

tip: mother 母親 + hood 狀態：當媽媽這種狀態
example: Many writers have praised motherhood in poems about love and sacrifice.
exampleZh: 許多作家在關於愛與犧牲的詩中讚美母性。

tip: 【大考字根】音節分解 mot - ive。核心意義指向「動機;主旨」，常出現在篇章閱讀與學術論述中。
example: Jealousy was the motive for the murder.
exampleZh: 嫉妒是謀殺的動機。

tip: mow 割 + er：割草的機器，讀音像「摸兒」草
example: Dad pushed the mower back and forth until the whole lawn looked even.
exampleZh: 爸爸來回推著割草機，直到整片草坪看起來平整。

tip: muse 諧音「謬思」：腦中冒出謬妙的思緒
example: After the storm passed, he sat by the window in a quiet muse about his future.
exampleZh: 暴風雨過後，他坐在窗邊，靜靜沉思自己的未來。

tip: mutton 諧音「馬騰」：馬騰草原上的羊肉
example: The restaurant serves roast mutton with mint sauce, a classic English dish.
exampleZh: 這家餐廳供應搭配薄荷醬的烤羊肉，是一道經典的英國菜。

tip: myth 諧音「迷思」：一個迷人的思想故事，不一定真
example: Some people believe the myth that we only use ten percent of our brains.
exampleZh: 有些人相信一種迷思，認為我們只用了百分之十的腦。

tip: news 新聞 + cast 播送：把新聞播送出去
example: The evening newscast began with a report on a typhoon heading toward Taiwan.
exampleZh: 晚間新聞廣播一開始就報導了一個朝台灣前進的颱風。

tip: night 夜 + in + gale 風：夜風中歌唱的鳥
example: Poets have long praised the nightingale for singing sweetly in the dark.
exampleZh: 詩人長久以來讚美夜鶯在黑暗中甜美歌唱。

tip: nose 鼻子 + tril：鼻子上的兩個洞，口訣「no-stril」
example: The dog pressed its wet nose to the door, and its nostril flared at the smell of food.
exampleZh: 那隻狗把濕鼻子貼在門上，聞到食物香味時鼻孔張大。

tip: note 注意 + ion：腦中記下一個想法
example: She had no notion of how far the village was from the station.
exampleZh: 她完全不知道那個村莊離車站有多遠。

tip: nov 新 + ice：像剛結的新冰，還很新手
example: Even a novice can learn to ride a bike after a few careful lessons.
exampleZh: 即使是新手，上過幾堂小心的課之後也能學會騎腳踏車。

tip: oar 諧音「歐」：歐！歐！划船喊著號子
example: He pulled hard on the oar, and the little boat shot across the lake.
exampleZh: 他用力划槳，小船迅速掠過湖面。

tip: 【大考字根】音節分解 oath。核心意義指向「誓言;宣誓」，常出現在篇章閱讀與學術論述中。
example: The knight swore an oath of allegiance to the king.
exampleZh: 騎士宣誓效忠於國王。

tip: observe 觀察 + er：負責看的人
example: An observer from the museum watched the birds nest without disturbing them.
exampleZh: 一位來自博物館的觀察員看著鳥築巢，沒有打擾牠們。

tip: occur 發生 + rence：就是發生的事或發生這回事
example: Earthquakes are a rare occurrence in this quiet part of the country.
exampleZh: 地震在這個國家平靜的地區是罕見的事件。

zh: 機會;可能性;投注賠率;不和
tip: odds 諧音「噁的」：機率低到噁心
example: The odds of winning the lottery are about one in many millions.
exampleZh: 中樂透的機率大約是好幾百萬分之一。

tip: odor 諧音「噢的」：噢，好臭的氣味
example: A strange odor from the fridge told us the milk had gone bad.
exampleZh: 冰箱傳出一股怪味，告訴我們牛奶已經壞掉了。

tip: op 相對 + pon 放：放在對面的人
example: The tennis player shook hands with her opponent after the long match.
exampleZh: 網球選手在漫長的比賽後，與她的對手握手。

tip: optimum 最好 + ism：相信最好的會發生
example: Her optimism helped the team stay calm even when the plan went wrong.
exampleZh: 即使計畫出錯，她的樂觀仍幫助團隊保持冷靜。

tip: or 諧音「喔」+ chard：喔！整片果樹長在一起
example: In spring, the apple orchard behind the farm is covered with white blossoms.
exampleZh: 春天時，農場後面的蘋果園開滿白花。

tip: organize 整理 + r：幫你把事情理順的本子
example: He bought a leather organizer to keep his schedule and notes together.
exampleZh: 他買了一本皮製記事本，把行程和筆記放在一起。

tip: orphan 孤兒 + age：收留孤兒的機構
example: The children at the orphanage were thrilled when volunteers brought them new books.
exampleZh: 當志工帶新書給孤兒院的孩子們時，他們興奮不已。

tip: ostrich 諧音「鴕斯趣」：遇事把頭埋沙裡的鳥
example: The zoo's ostrich can run faster than most cars on a country road.
exampleZh: 動物園的駝鳥跑起來比鄉間公路上的大多數汽車還快。

tip: ounce 諧音「盎司」：直接用音記，一盎司約二十八公克
example: The recipe calls for eight ounces of flour and two ounces of butter.
exampleZh: 食譜需要八盎司的麵粉和兩盎司的奶油。

tip: out 外面 + sider：站在圈子外面的人
example: As an outsider, he felt nervous at the first meeting of the village club.
exampleZh: 身為局外人，他在村裡社團的第一次聚會感到緊張。

tip: 【大考字根】音節分解 out - skirts。核心意義指向「(複數)郊外;郊區」，常出現在篇章閱讀與學術論述中。
example: I live on the outskirts of Tokyo.
exampleZh: 我住在東京郊區。

tip: 【大考字根】音節分解 ozo - ne。核心意義指向「臭氧」，常出現在篇章閱讀與學術論述中。
example: The ozone in the stratosphere absorbs ultraviolet radiation.
exampleZh: 平流層的臭氧會吸收紫外線。

tip: pack 包 + et 小：小小的一包
example: She handed me a packet of seeds and told me to plant them in spring.
exampleZh: 她遞給我一小包種子，叫我春天把它們種下。

tip: pane 跟 pain 同音，但是窗玻璃片，打破它才會 pain
example: A soccer ball cracked the window pane, and glass fell onto the kitchen floor.
exampleZh: 一顆足球打裂了窗玻璃，碎片掉到廚房地板上。

tip: parl 說話 + or：用來說話接待客人的房間
example: Guests waited in the parlor while the family finished setting the table.
exampleZh: 客人在客廳等候，而家人正擺好餐桌。

tip: part 一部分 + icip + ant：成為活動一部分的人
example: Every participant in the race received a small medal and a bottle of water.
exampleZh: 比賽的每位參與者都得到一面小獎牌和一瓶水。

tip: part 一部分 + icle 小：小小的一部分
example: Dust particles floated in the beam of sunlight shining through the curtains.
exampleZh: 灰塵微粒漂浮在穿過窗簾的陽光光束中。

tip: 【大考字根】音節分解 pas - ti - me。核心意義指向「消遣;娛樂」，常出現在篇章閱讀與學術論述中。
example: Playing cards is a popular pastime.
exampleZh: 打牌是一種流行的消遣方式。

tip: pasty 黏糊 + pastry 烤出酥皮，paste 麵糊烤成點心
example: The bakery's flaky pastry is filled with sweet red bean paste.
exampleZh: 這家麵包店的酥皮點心裡包著香甜的紅豆餡。

tip: patr 父親 + iot：父親之地祖國，愛祖國的人
example: The patriot gave a speech urging everyone to love and protect their homeland.
exampleZh: 這位愛國者發表演說，呼籲大家愛護並保衛自己的家園。

tip: peasant 諧音「皮仔特」：種田的皮膚曬黑的人
example: The peasant rose before dawn to plow the field and feed the oxen.
exampleZh: 那位農夫天亮前就起床耕田並餵牛。

tip: ped 腳：用腳走街串巷賣東西的人
example: A peddler pushed his cart through the street, calling out the price of his oranges.
exampleZh: 一名小販推著車走過街道，吆喝橘子的價錢。

tip: perform 表演 + er：上台表演的人
example: The young performer bowed to the audience after finishing her violin piece.
exampleZh: 年輕的演奏者拉完小提琴曲後向觀眾鞠躬。

tip: person 人 + nel：一群人的集合就是人員
example: All airport personnel must wear a badge so travelers can identify them easily.
exampleZh: 所有機場人員都必須佩戴識別證，旅客才能輕易認出他們。

tip: pessimist 悲觀者 + ism，是 optimism 的反義
example: His pessimism made him expect the worst, even when the weather forecast looked fine.
exampleZh: 他的悲觀讓他即使在天氣預報看起來良好時，也預期最糟的情況。

tip: pilgrim 諧音「皮格林」：腳底磨皮還要走去聖地
example: Pilgrims walked for weeks to reach the holy shrine on the hill.
exampleZh: 朝聖者走了好幾週，才抵達山丘上的聖地。

tip: 【大考字根】音節分解 pil - lar。核心意義指向「柱子;棟樑」，常出現在篇章閱讀與學術論述中。
example: A large pillar obstructs the view of the lake.
exampleZh: 巨大的柱子遮住了視線，讓人看不到湖。

tip: pimple 諧音「皮膚破」：青春期皮膚冒出小丘疹
example: Before the school photo, she covered a pimple on her chin with a bit of cream.
exampleZh: 拍學校團體照前，她用一點乳霜遮住下巴上的一顆痘痘。

tip: plague 諧音「普累」：瘟疫讓人普遍累倒
example: In the Middle Ages, a plague spread quickly through crowded towns across Europe.
exampleZh: 中世紀時，瘟疫迅速傳遍歐洲擁擠的城鎮。

tip: plant 種植 + ation：大面積種植作物的地方
example: Workers on the sugar plantation rose early to cut cane under the hot sun.
exampleZh: 糖業大農園的工人很早起床，在烈日下割甘蔗。

tip: play 戲劇 + wright 工匠：打造戲劇的工匠
example: The playwright spent two years writing a comedy that finally opened in Taipei.
exampleZh: 這位劇作家花了兩年寫一齣喜劇，終於在台北上演。

tip: plea 跟 please 很像，懇求時一直 please
example: The child's plea for another chance softened the teacher's strict face.
exampleZh: 孩子懇求再給一次機會，讓老師嚴厲的臉色緩和下來。

tip: pocket 口袋 + book 本子：放口袋裡的本形皮夾
example: He kept a tiny pocketbook in his coat with a few bills and coins.
exampleZh: 他在外套裡放了一個小皮夾，裡面有幾張鈔票和硬幣。

tip: poultry 的 poult 像 pool，家禽在池塘邊長大
example: Chicken and duck are the most common poultry sold at the night market.
exampleZh: 雞肉和鴨肉是夜市最常見的家禽肉。

tip: prairie 諧音「怕瑞」：草原太大，怕你迷路
example: Bison once roamed the vast prairie, where tall grass waved in the wind.
exampleZh: 野牛曾在遼闊的大草原上漫步，那裡的高草隨風搖擺。

tip: pre 先 + fer 帶：先帶走的就是你比較喜歡的
example: Do you have a preference for tea or coffee after dinner?
exampleZh: 晚餐後你比較偏愛茶還是咖啡？

tip: pro 往前 + cess 走：一個接一個往前走的隊伍
example: A long procession of monks walked slowly through the temple gate carrying lanterns.
exampleZh: 一長列僧侶提著燈籠，緩緩走過寺廟大門。

tip: pro 預先 + phet 說：預先說出未來的人
example: In the story, the prophet warned the king that a great flood was coming.
exampleZh: 在故事中，先知警告國王一場大洪水就要來了。

tip: province 諧音「怕萬事」：省分大，要管的事萬般多
example: Alberta is a province of Canada, famous for the Rocky Mountains.
exampleZh: 亞伯達是加拿大的一個省，以落磯山脈聞名。

tip: pyramid 諧音「皮拉米」：皮拉米爬上尖尖的石塔
example: Visitors lined up to climb inside the pyramid and see the ancient tomb.
exampleZh: 遊客排隊爬進金字塔，參觀古老的墓室。

tip: quart 來自 quarter：四分之一加侖就是一夸脫
example: The recipe asked for one quart of milk, which is about a liter.
exampleZh: 食譜要一夸脫的牛奶，大約是一公升。

tip: quest 像 question 問題，帶著問題去追尋
example: Her quest for the truth led her to travel to a dozen countries.
exampleZh: 她對真相的探索使她走訪了十幾個國家。

tip: radius 像 ray 光線：從圓心射向圓周的線
example: Draw a circle with a radius of five centimeters and mark its center.
exampleZh: 畫一個半徑五公分的圓，並標出圓心。

tip: rail 諧音「雷歐」：火車沿著鐵軌雷歐地跑
example: Hold the rail tightly when the bus turns a corner.
exampleZh: 公車轉彎時，請緊握扶手。

example: The little rascal hid my shoes again and ran away laughing.
exampleZh: 那個小淘氣鬼又把我的鞋子藏起來，然後笑著跑掉了。

tip: ratio 跟 ration 配給同源，分比例分配
example: The ratio of boys to girls in our club is three to two.
exampleZh: 我們社團裡男生對女生的比例是三比二。

tip: real 真正 + m：國王眼中，土地才是真正的王國
example: In legends, dragons ruled the realm beneath the sea and guarded its pearls.
exampleZh: 傳說中，龍統治著海底的王國，並守護那裡的珍珠。

tip: reef 諧音「瑞福」：海中暗礁讓船難瑞福
example: Colorful fish swim around the coral reef near the diving boat.
exampleZh: 五彩繽紛的魚在潛水船附近的珊瑚礁周圍游動。

tip: remind 提醒 + er：幫你記住事情的人或物
example: She stuck a reminder note on the fridge so she would not forget the dentist.
exampleZh: 她在冰箱上貼了一張提醒便條，才不會忘記看牙醫。

tip: re 再 + sent 感覺：再一次感到不舒服
example: He felt deep resentment toward the coach who never let him play.
exampleZh: 他對那位從不讓他上場的教練懷有深深的怨恨。

tip: reside 居住 + ence：居住的地方
example: The president's official residence has a large garden open to visitors in spring.
exampleZh: 總統的官邸有座大花園，春天時開放給訪客參觀。

tip: rhino 鼻子 + ceros 角：鼻子上有角的動物
example: A rhinoceros stood still in the grass, with its thick skin and single horn.
exampleZh: 一隻犀牛站在草叢中一動不動，有著厚皮和一根角。

tip: robin 諧音「羅賓」：胸口紅紅的羅賓小鳥
example: A robin hopped across the lawn and pulled a worm out of the soil.
exampleZh: 一隻知更鳥跳過草坪，從土裡拉出一條蟲。

tip: rod 諧音「落」：魚竿一落，等魚上鉤
example: He sat on the riverbank all morning with a fishing rod in his hand.
exampleZh: 他整個早上都坐在河岸邊，手裡握著釣竿。

tip: rub 擦 + bish：擦過的東西沒用了，丟垃圾
example: Please do not throw rubbish on the beach; take it home or use a bin.
exampleZh: 請不要在海灘亂丟垃圾；請帶回家或丟進垃圾桶。

tip: sandal 諧音「沙奴」：海灘沙子裡穿的鞋
example: In summer I wear a pair of leather sandals to walk along the beach.
exampleZh: 夏天時我穿一雙皮涼鞋沿著海邊散步。

tip: 【大考字根】音節分解 scand - al。核心意義指向「醜聞;醜事」，常出現在篇章閱讀與學術論述中。
example: That scandal cost him his reputation.
exampleZh: 醜聞讓他付出了失去聲譽的代價。

tip: sens 感覺 + ation：身體感受到的東西
example: The cold water gave her a tingling sensation in her toes.
exampleZh: 冰涼的水讓她的腳趾有一種刺痛的感覺。

tip: sense 感覺 + itive + ity：感覺反應快慢的程度
example: The camera's sensitivity to light lets it take clear photos even at night.
exampleZh: 這台相機對光的敏感度，讓它在夜晚也能拍出清晰的照片。

tip: sent 感覺 + iment：心裡寄出的感覺，就是情感
example: A feeling of sentiment swept over him when he saw his old school again.
exampleZh: 當他再次看見母校時，一股感傷湧上心頭。

tip: sergeant 諧音「沙爵特」：軍階裡的中間管理，像大哥
example: The sergeant checked that every soldier had packed a water bottle before the march.
exampleZh: 士官長在行軍前檢查每位士兵是否都帶了水壺。

tip: 【大考字根】音節分解 se - ries。核心意義指向「連續;系列」，常出現在篇章閱讀與學術論述中。
example: He has just published an interesting series of articles.
exampleZh: 他剛發表一系列有趣的文章。

tip: sermon 諧音「燒漫」：講到你燒漫的老掉牙說教
example: On Sunday, the priest gave a short sermon about kindness and sharing.
exampleZh: 週日，神父發表了一段關於善良與分享的簡短佈道。

tip: set 放置 + ting：故事被「放」在的時空
example: The film's setting is a small fishing village in the 1920s.
exampleZh: 這部電影的背景是一九二○年代的小漁村。

tip: sheriff 諧音「謝瑞夫」：謝謝瑞夫，鎮上有他安心
example: The sheriff rode into town and asked everyone to stay calm.
exampleZh: 警長騎馬進入小鎮，請大家保持冷靜。

tip: short 短 + age：短到不夠用的狀態
example: A water shortage forced the city to ask residents to take shorter showers.
exampleZh: 缺水迫使市政府要求居民縮短淋浴時間。

tip: short 短 + coming 到達：能力沒到位，就是缺點
example: Being late is his biggest shortcoming, but he is kind and always tries to improve.
exampleZh: 遲到是他最大的缺點，但他很善良，也總是努力改進。

tip: shrine 諧音「聖」：聖地裡的小聖壇
example: Pilgrims left flowers and incense at the small shrine beside the road.
exampleZh: 朝聖者在路旁的小神壇留下花與香。

tip: shrub 諧音「許愛」：矮矮叢叢，躲貓貓的矮樹
example: Rabbits hid under the thick shrub when the hawk flew overhead.
exampleZh: 當老鷹飛過頭頂時，兔子躲在濃密的灌木下。

tip: silk 絲 + worm 蟲：吐絲的蟲
example: The silkworm spins a soft cocoon, which people can unwind into long silk thread.
exampleZh: 蠶吐出柔軟的繭，人們可把它抽成長長的絲線。

zh: 骨骼;骨瘦如柴的人(或動物);概略
example: At the museum, we saw the skeleton of a dinosaur that stretched across the whole hall.
exampleZh: 在博物館，我們看到橫跨整個大廳的恐龍骨架。

tip: 【大考字根】音節分解 skull。核心意義指向「頭骨;骷髏畫」，常出現在篇章閱讀與學術論述中。
example: Tom has a tattoo of a skull on his chest.
exampleZh: 湯姆在胸上有個頭骨文身。

tip: sneak 悄悄走 + er：踩著軟底悄悄走的鞋
example: His white sneaker got stuck in the mud, so he had to pull it out by hand.
exampleZh: 他的白色運動鞋陷在泥巴裡，所以他必須用手拔出來。

tip: space 太空 + craft 飛行器：太空中用的飛行器
example: The spacecraft circled the moon three times before heading back to Earth.
exampleZh: 太空船繞月球三圈，然後返回地球。

tip: special 特別 + ist：專門某一方面的人
example: The family doctor sent her to a heart specialist for a more careful checkup.
exampleZh: 家庭醫師把她轉介給心臟專科醫師做更仔細的檢查。

tip: spect 看 + acle：值得一看的大場面，也有「眼鏡」相近
example: The fireworks over the harbor were a magnificent spectacle that the crowd will never forget.
exampleZh: 港口上空的煙火是壯觀的奇景，群眾永遠不會忘記。

tip: spect 看 + ator：站在旁邊看的人
example: Thousands of spectators cheered from the stands as the runners crossed the finish line.
exampleZh: 數千名觀眾在看台上歡呼，跑者衝過終點線。

example: Tourists were amazed by the splendor of the palace, with its golden halls and mirrors.
exampleZh: 遊客們被宮殿的輝煌所震撼，那裡有金色大廳和鏡子。

tip: stanza 諧音「史丹札」：詩篇史丹札成一小節
example: The poem has four stanzas, and each one ends with the same line.
exampleZh: 這首詩有四節，每一節都以同一行結尾。

tip: 【大考字根】音節分解 sta - tes - man。核心意義指向「政治家」，常出現在篇章閱讀與學術論述中。
example: The boy grew up to be a great statesman.
exampleZh: 這個孩子長大後成為了一個偉大的政治家。

tip: statist 統計 + ic：用來說明事實的一個數字
example: One surprising statistic shows that half of the students walk to school.
exampleZh: 有一項令人驚訝的統計數字顯示，一半的學生走路上學。

tip: steward 諧音「史都華」：史都華管家，替大家張羅一切
example: The steward carried a tray of drinks across the deck of the ship.
exampleZh: 服務員端著一盤飲料穿過船的甲板。

tip: steward 管家 + ess 女性：女管家，機上服務女生
example: The stewardess helped passengers find their seats and showed them how to wear life jackets.
exampleZh: 空服員協助乘客找到座位，並示範如何穿救生衣。

tip: store 儲存 + age：把東西存起來的狀態或地方
example: We put winter coats into storage in the attic after the weather turned warm.
exampleZh: 天氣變暖後，我們把冬季外套放進閣樓儲藏。

tip: 【大考字根】音節分解 suit - ca - se。核心意義指向「小型旅行箱;手提箱」，常出現在篇章閱讀與學術論述中。
example: I'll take your suitcase to your room.
exampleZh: 我會把你的手提箱拿到你的房間。

tip: sulfur 諧音「薩福」：臭雞蛋味的硫，一聞就知道
example: The smell of sulfur filled the air near the hot spring and reminded us of rotten eggs.
exampleZh: 溫泉附近瀰漫著硫磺味，讓我們想起臭雞蛋。

tip: super 超出 + stition 站：站在科學之外的信念
example: Out of superstition, he never walks under a ladder or opens an umbrella indoors.
exampleZh: 出於迷信，他從不走過梯子下，也不在室內撐傘。

tip: tavern 諧音「他萬」：旅人到這家店，萬事都有人招待
example: Travelers stopped at a tavern near the crossroads to eat stew and rest for the night.
exampleZh: 旅人在十字路口附近的小客棧停下來，吃燉肉並過夜休息。

tip: tell 說 + er：古時負責「數」並報告金額的人
example: The bank teller counted the bills twice before handing the money to the customer.
exampleZh: 銀行出納員把鈔票數了兩次，才把錢交給顧客。

tip: 【大考字根】音節分解 tem - pta - tion。核心意義指向「引誘;誘惑;誘惑物」，常出現在篇章閱讀與學術論述中。
example: You shouldn't give in to temptation.
exampleZh: 你不應該屈服在誘惑之下。

tip: 【大考字根】音節分解 thorn。核心意義指向「刺;棘;惱人的事或人」，常出現在篇章閱讀與學術論述中。
example: I have a thorn in my finger.
exampleZh: 我的手指頭有一根刺。

tip: thrill 刺激 + er：讓你心跳加速的故事
example: We stayed up late watching a thriller in which a stranger kept following the hero.
exampleZh: 我們熬夜看了一部驚悚片，片中一名陌生人一直跟蹤主角。

tip: throne 諧音「揉肉」：坐上去後，國王可以任意命令
example: The prince waited in the great hall until the king invited him to sit on the throne.
exampleZh: 王子在大殿中等候，直到國王邀他坐上王座。

tip: 【大考字根】音節分解 toad。核心意義指向「蟾蜍;令人討厭的人」，常出現在篇章閱讀與學術論述中。
example: I cannot distinguish a frog from a toad.
exampleZh: 我無法區分青蛙和蟾蜍。

tip: token 諧音「透肯」：透過小東西肯定你的心意
example: She gave him a small gift as a token of thanks for his help.
exampleZh: 她送他一份小禮物，作為感謝他幫忙的心意。

zh: 洪流;(話語的)連發;(感情的)狂潮
tip: torrent 諧音「偷論特」：洪水一沖，什麼都被偷走
example: A torrent of angry emails poured in after the company announced higher prices.
exampleZh: 公司宣布漲價後，大量憤怒的電子郵件如洪流般湧入。

tip: tourney 競技場 + ment：隊伍輪流較量的比賽
example: Our school will host a basketball tournament this weekend with twelve teams.
exampleZh: 我們學校這個週末將舉辦一場有十二支隊伍的籃球錦標賽。

tip: trai 像 trade 交換：拿朋友換好處的人
example: In the play, a traitor opened the castle gate and let the enemy soldiers in.
exampleZh: 劇中，一名叛徒打開城堡大門，讓敵軍士兵進來。

tip: treasure 寶物 + y：放寶物的地方
example: The old treasury in the castle once held the kingdom's gold and silver.
exampleZh: 城堡裡的舊庫房曾存放王國的金銀。

tip: treat 對待 + y：雙方如何對待彼此的協議
example: The two countries signed a peace treaty to end years of fighting.
exampleZh: 兩國簽署和平條約，結束多年的戰事。

tip: tribute 與 contribute 同源，獻出心意表達敬意
example: Students laid flowers by the statue as a tribute to the brave teacher.
exampleZh: 學生們在雕像旁獻花，向那位勇敢的老師致敬。

tip: trout 諧音「吹勞特」：鱒魚在溪裡吹出水泡泡
example: We caught a trout in the cold mountain stream and grilled it over a fire.
exampleZh: 我們在冰冷的山溪中捉到一條鱒魚，用火烤來吃。

tip: tuna 諧音「土那」：土裡土氣罐頭裡的大魚
example: Mom opened a can of tuna and mixed it with mayonnaise for sandwiches.
exampleZh: 媽媽打開一罐鮪魚，拌上美乃滋做三明治。

tip: under 在下 + graduate 畢業生：還沒畢業的人
example: As an undergraduate, he lived in a dorm and studied biology for four years.
exampleZh: 身為大學生，他住在宿舍，主修生物學四年。

tip: van 空 + ity：空空的內在，只剩外表的驕傲
example: Her vanity showed when she spent an hour in front of the mirror before school.
exampleZh: 她上學前在鏡子前花一小時，顯出了她的虛榮。

tip: vapor 諧音「飛玻」：水變成氣，飛上去啦
example: Water vapor rose from the hot soup and fogged up his glasses.
exampleZh: 水蒸氣從熱湯升起，讓他的眼鏡起霧。

tip: vegetable 蔬菜 + ation：成片長出的各種植物
example: Thick vegetation covered the mountainside, hiding the old path from view.
exampleZh: 濃密的草木覆蓋山坡，使舊小徑看不見。

tip: vein 與 vain 同音，血管細細如樹葉脈絡
example: The nurse found a vein in his arm and gently inserted the needle.
exampleZh: 護理師在他的手臂上找到一條靜脈，輕輕地插入針頭。

tip: view 看 + er：看電視節目的人
example: The program asked each viewer to vote for a favorite song by text message.
exampleZh: 節目請每位觀眾用簡訊投票選出最喜歡的歌曲。

tip: vigor 諧音「威格」：威風又格外有勁的活力
example: Despite his age, the old farmer worked with great vigor from sunrise to sunset.
exampleZh: 儘管年紀大了，這位老農夫仍從日出到日落都充滿活力地工作。

tip: villain 諧音「微籃」：小小籃子裡藏著壞心眼的人
example: Every good movie needs a villain who makes the hero's journey harder.
exampleZh: 每部好電影都需要一個反派角色，讓主角的旅程更艱難。

tip: vine 諧音「萬」：萬條藤蔓纏滿牆
example: Grapes grow on a vine that winds around a wooden frame in the garden.
exampleZh: 葡萄長在園子裡纏繞著木架的藤蔓上。

tip: violin 小提琴 + ist：拉小提琴的人
example: The violinist closed her eyes and played so beautifully that the room fell silent.
exampleZh: 小提琴手閉上眼睛，演奏得如此優美，整個房間都靜了下來。

tip: ware 與 wear 同音，擺出來的東西都是賣貨
example: The potter displayed fine ware at the market, from teacups to large clay jars.
exampleZh: 陶工在市集展示精美的陶器，從茶杯到大陶罐都有。

tip: 【大考字根】音節分解 war - ri - or。核心意義指向「武士;戰士;勇士」，常出現在篇章閱讀與學術論述中。
example: The warrior is conscious of both his strength and his weakness.
exampleZh: 戰士知道自己的力量和弱點。

tip: whiskey 諧音「微斯基」：微微醉的飲料，大人專用
example: He poured a glass of whiskey and sat by the fire to read.
exampleZh: 他倒了一杯威士忌，坐在火邊讀書。

tip: whisky 是蘇格蘭寫法，少一個 e，簡單一些
example: Scotland is famous for its whisky, which is stored in oak barrels for many years.
exampleZh: 蘇格蘭以威士忌聞名，這種酒要在橡木桶裡存放許多年。

tip: widow 寡婦 + er 男性：喪妻的男人
example: The widower raised three children alone after his wife passed away.
exampleZh: 這位鰥夫在妻子過世後獨自撫養三個孩子。

tip: 【大考字根】音節分解 wig。核心意義指向「假髮」，常出現在篇章閱讀與學術論述中。
example: I took off my wig.
exampleZh: 我摘下了假髮。

tip: wild 野 + erness：野生世界，沒有路沒有人
example: Hikers were lost in the wilderness for two days before rescuers found them.
exampleZh: 健行者在荒野中迷路兩天，後來才被救援人員發現。

tip: wild 野生 + life 生命：野外的生命
example: Rangers protect the wildlife in the national park, from deer to tiny insects.
exampleZh: 護管員保護國家公園內的野生生物，從鹿到小昆蟲都在內。

tip: woe 諧音「喔」：遇上悲傷，只能嘆一聲「喔」
example: The farmers told a sad story of woe after the flood destroyed their crops.
exampleZh: 洪水毀掉莊稼後，農夫們訴說著一段悲慘的苦難。

tip: wood 木頭 + pecker 啄的鳥：專門啄木頭的鳥
example: A woodpecker drummed on the old oak, and the sound echoed through the forest.
exampleZh: 一隻啄木鳥在老橡樹上敲擊，聲音在森林裡迴盪。

tip: 【大考字根】音節分解 wreath。核心意義指向「花圈;花冠」，常出現在篇章閱讀與學術論述中。
example: We hung a Christmas wreath on the front door.
exampleZh: 我們在前門上掛了一個聖誕花圈。

tip: yeast 唸起來像「一勢」：一勢發酵，麵包就變大
example: Bread dough rises because yeast makes tiny gas bubbles inside it.
exampleZh: 麵糰會膨脹，是因為酵母在裡面製造出小小的氣泡。

tip: yoga 像「有嘎」：身體有嘎吱聲，趕快練瑜珈伸展
example: My aunt does yoga every morning to stay calm and flexible.
exampleZh: 我阿姨每天早上做瑜珈，讓自己保持平靜又柔軟。

tip: zinc 像「信」：信封外鍍一層銀灰色的鋅
example: The factory covers iron roofs with zinc so they do not rust.
exampleZh: 工廠在鐵屋頂上鍍一層鋅，這樣就不會生鏽。

tip: ab 離開 + normal 正常 → 偏離正常
example: The doctor checked the child because his heartbeat sounded abnormal.
exampleZh: 醫生替這個孩子檢查，因為他的心跳聽起來不正常。

tip: absent 不在 + minded 心思 → 心思不在這裡
example: Grandpa is so absentminded that he often looks for glasses already on his nose.
exampleZh: 爺爺心不在焉，常常在找早就戴在鼻子上的眼鏡。

zh: 可(或易)接近的;可(或易)得到的
tip: access 進入 + ible 可以 → 可以進得去
example: The new library is easily accessible by bus and by bike.
exampleZh: 新圖書館不論搭公車或騎腳踏車都很容易到達。

tip: accessory 是配件：主角旁邊的小幫手
example: The plan has an accessory role in the project, so it can wait.
exampleZh: 這項計畫在專案中只是附屬角色，所以可以先等一等。

tip: administer 管理 + ative → 跟管理有關的
example: She took an administrative job in the school office, handling forms and schedules.
exampleZh: 她在學校辦公室擔任行政工作，處理表格和時間表。

zh: 充滿深情的;溫柔親切的
tip: affection 感情 + ate：滿滿的愛，像抱抱熊
example: Our affectionate puppy licks everyone's hands when they come home.
exampleZh: 我們愛撒嬌的小狗在大家回家時，會舔每個人的手。

tip: alcohol 酒精 + ic：像酒的、含酒的
example: Soft drinks are fine, but alcoholic drinks are not for children.
exampleZh: 汽水沒問題，但含酒精的飲料不適合小孩。

tip: amiable 像「愛咪」：愛咪咪的笑，和藹可親
example: The amiable neighbor greeted every new student with a warm smile.
exampleZh: 那位和藹可親的鄰居用溫暖的微笑迎接每位新同學。

tip: analyze 拆開來看 + tical：愛把事情拆解的
example: A good detective has an analytical mind and checks every clue step by step.
exampleZh: 好偵探有分析的頭腦，會一步一步檢查每個線索。

tip: 【大考字根】音節分解 ano - nym - ous。核心意義指向「匿名的」，常出現在篇章閱讀與學術論述中。
example: You want to remain anonymous.
exampleZh: 你想保持匿名身份。

tip: 【大考字根】音節分解 an - tarct - ic。核心意義指向「南極的;南極區的」，常出現在篇章閱讀與學術論述中。
example: They went on an expedition to the Antarctic.
exampleZh: 他們出發去南極探險。

tip: anti 對抗 + bio 生命 → 對抗細菌的
example: The nurse said antibiotic cream would help the cut heal without infection.
exampleZh: 護理師說抗生素藥膏能幫傷口癒合，避免感染。

tip: apply 套用 + able 可以 → 可以套用上去
example: This safety rule is applicable to every student in the lab.
exampleZh: 這項安全規定適用於實驗室裡的每一位學生。

tip: 【大考字根】音節分解 arct - ic。核心意義指向「北極的;北極區的」，常出現在篇章閱讀與學術論述中。
example: Owing to its landmass, the Antarctic has an air temperature lower than that of the Arctic.
exampleZh: 南極因為有大陸，所以氣溫低於北極。

tip: 【大考字根】音節分解 ar - ro - gant。核心意義指向「傲慢的;自大的」，常出現在篇章閱讀與學術論述中。
example: I couldn't put up with her arrogant behavior.
exampleZh: 我無法忍受她傲慢的態度。

tip: attend 出席，attendant 就是跟在旁邊的
example: Flight attendants and attendant staff stayed to guide the passengers off the plane.
exampleZh: 機組人員與隨行工作人員留下來引導乘客下飛機。

tip: awe 敬畏 + some：讓你「哇」一聲的
example: We stood on the cliff and watched an awesome sunrise over the sea.
exampleZh: 我們站在懸崖上，看著海面上令人讚嘆的日出。

tip: bio 生命 + logical 學問 → 生命的學問
example: Biological science studies plants, animals, and how living things grow.
exampleZh: 生物學研究植物、動物，以及生物如何成長。

tip: bizarre 像「彼扎」：彼此一看，扎眼好奇怪
example: The artist wore a bizarre hat shaped like a giant banana.
exampleZh: 那位藝術家戴著一頂形狀像巨大香蕉的怪帽子。

zh: 荒涼的;陰冷的;無希望的
tip: bleak 像「比力」：冷風比力氣還大，一片荒涼
example: The bleak winter landscape was gray, empty, and very cold.
exampleZh: 那片荒涼的冬日景色灰濛濛、空蕩蕩又冰冷。

zh: 輕快的;興旺的;寒冷而清新的
tip: brisk 像「布里斯克」的快步：清晨腳步輕快不拖延
example: We took a brisk walk around the lake before breakfast.
exampleZh: 早餐前，我們繞著湖邊快步走了一圈。

zh: 畜生的;畜生般的;殘忍的
tip: brute 像「不入」：不入腦只靠力氣的蠻幹
example: Pulling the truck out needed brute force, not clever planning.
exampleZh: 把卡車拖出來需要的是蠻力，而不是聰明的計畫。

tip: cap 抓 (capture) + ive：被抓住的
example: The captive bird beat its wings against the cage door.
exampleZh: 那隻被關住的鳥用翅膀拍打籠門。

tip: charity 慈善 + able：樂於幫助別人的
example: The charitable woman gave warm coats to families who needed them.
exampleZh: 那位善心的女士把保暖外套送給需要的家庭。

tip: chrono 時間：時間拖很久的病，就是慢性
example: Grandma has chronic back pain that keeps coming back for years.
exampleZh: 奶奶有慢性背痛，多年來一直反覆發作。

tip: clinic 診所 + al：在診所裡對真病人做的
example: The new medicine passed a clinical trial with two hundred patients.
exampleZh: 這種新藥通過了兩百位病人參與的臨床試驗。

tip: col 一起 + lect 選取：大家湊在一起
example: It was a collective decision made by the whole class, not by one student.
exampleZh: 那是全班一起做的集體決定，不是某個同學單獨決定的。

tip: col 一起 + loqu 說話 → 大家聊天時說的
example: Saying "gonna" instead of "going to" is colloquial English.
exampleZh: 用「gonna」代替「going to」是口語英文。

tip: communicate 溝通 + ive：愛溝通的
example: Mina is very communicative and chats happily with every classmate.
exampleZh: 米娜很健談，開心地和每位同學聊天。

tip: compare 比較 + able：可以放在一起比
example: The two phones have comparable prices, so choose the one with the better camera.
exampleZh: 這兩支手機價格相近，所以選相機比較好的那支。

tip: compare 比較 + ative：用比較方式做的
example: A comparative study of two teaching methods found small differences.
exampleZh: 一項比較兩種教學方法的研究發現差異很小。

tip: 【大考字根】音節分解 con - tro - ver - si - al。核心意義指向「有爭議的;好議論的」，常出現在篇章閱讀與學術論述中。
example: This theory is very controversial.
exampleZh: 這個理論很有爭議。

zh: 同等重要的;座標的;對等的
tip: co 一起 + ordin 順序 → 排在同一級
example: In the grammar lesson, "and" joins two coordinate clauses of equal importance.
exampleZh: 在文法課中，「and」連接兩個同等重要的對等子句。

zh: 化妝用的;裝飾性的;表面的
tip: cosmetic 像「口試美的」：只改外表的美
example: She had cosmetic surgery to fix only the shape of her nose.
exampleZh: 她動了美容手術，只為修飾鼻子的形狀。

tip: cosmo 宇宙 + polite：全世界都是我家
example: Taipei is a cosmopolitan city where people from many countries live and work.
exampleZh: 台北是一座國際化城市，來自許多國家的人在此生活工作。

zh: 彎曲的;欺詐的;不正派的
tip: crooked 像鉤子 hook：彎彎像鉤
example: The old fence was crooked after the strong typhoon.
exampleZh: 強烈颱風過後，那道舊圍籬歪歪曲曲的。

zh: 未經加工的;粗野的;粗糙的
tip: crude 像「苦路」：沒加工的原油又黑又苦
example: Crude oil must be refined before it can be used as fuel.
exampleZh: 原油必須先精煉才能當作燃料使用。

tip: custom 習俗 + ary：照習俗來的
example: It is customary to take off your shoes before entering a Taiwanese home.
exampleZh: 進入台灣人的家之前先脫鞋是慣例。

zh: 致命的,致死的;非常的,極度的
example: The tip of the spear was dipped in a deadly poison.
exampleZh: 矛尖浸在一種致命的毒藥裡。

tip: decent 像「滴神」：滴一滴汗換來體面的生活
example: He earned a decent salary, enough to rent a clean room and eat well.
exampleZh: 他領的薪水還算像樣，足夠租一間乾淨的房間並吃得好。

zh: 決定性的;確定的;果斷的
tip: de 切斷 + cis 切 → 一刀切定勝負
example: A decisive goal in the last minute won the match for our school.
exampleZh: 最後一分鐘的決定性進球讓我們學校贏得比賽。

zh: 怠忽職守的;拖欠的;犯法的
tip: delinquent 像「得了寬」：得了寬鬆卻愈放愈野
example: The delinquent teenager skipped school and broke several neighborhood rules.
exampleZh: 那名行為不良的青少年蹺課，還違反了好幾項社區規定。

tip: dent 牙齒：dentist 牙醫、dental 牙齒的
example: Brush twice a day, and visit the dentist for a dental checkup every six months.
exampleZh: 一天刷兩次牙，並且每六個月去牙醫那裡做牙齒檢查。

tip: de + sign 記號：做上記號，指定就是你
example: The teacher designated Amy as the team leader.
exampleZh: 老師指定 Amy 擔任組長。

zh: 命中注定的;(場所)預定的
tip: destiny 命運 + ed：命運已經寫好的
example: Many believe the young pianist is destined for fame.
exampleZh: 許多人相信這位年輕鋼琴家註定會成名。

tip: 【大考字根】音節分解 dip - lo - mat - ic。核心意義指向「外交的;有外交手腕的」，常出現在篇章閱讀與學術論述中。
example: There must be a way to arrive at a diplomatic solution.
exampleZh: 必須有外交解決的途徑。

tip: disaster 災難 + ous：會帶來災難的
example: The flood was disastrous for the farmers and ruined their rice fields.
exampleZh: 這場洪水對農民來說是災難性的，毀掉了他們的稻田。

zh: 謹慎的;謙虛的;不引人注意的
tip: discreet 低調謹慎；discrete 是分開的，別混淆
example: Please be discreet and keep my birthday surprise a secret.
exampleZh: 請謹慎一點，替我保守生日驚喜的祕密。

tip: dis 失去 + grace 優雅 → 失了面子
example: Cheating on the exam was a disgraceful act for a student leader.
exampleZh: 對學生領袖來說，考試作弊是可恥的行為。

tip: dispense 分發出去 + able：可以放掉的
example: In a tight budget, extra decorations are dispensable, but food is not.
exampleZh: 預算吃緊時，額外的裝飾可有可無，但食物不行。

zh: 可任意處理的;用完即丟棄的
tip: dispose 丟掉 + able：用完可以丟的
example: At the picnic we used disposable plates, so washing up was easy.
exampleZh: 野餐時我們用拋棄式盤子，所以清洗很輕鬆。

tip: di 分開 + verse 轉 → 往各種方向轉，各不相同
example: Our school has a diverse group of students from many different countries.
exampleZh: 我們學校有來自許多不同國家的多元學生。

zh: 文件的;(電影、電視等)記錄的
tip: document 文件 + ary：記錄真實的
example: We watched a documentary about whales swimming across the Pacific Ocean.
exampleZh: 我們看了一部關於鯨魚橫越太平洋的紀錄片。

tip: dreary 像「大力」：烏雲大力壓下來，一整天沉悶
example: It was a dreary Monday, with gray skies and rain all day.
exampleZh: 那是個沉悶的星期一，整天都是灰濛濛的天空和雨。

tip: dual 像 duo 二重奏：兩個一起
example: The car has a dual purpose: it carries people and cargo.
exampleZh: 這輛車有雙重用途：既載人也載貨。

tip: ed 吃 (eat) + ible 可以 → 可以吃
example: Not all wild mushrooms are edible, so never eat one without asking an expert.
exampleZh: 並非所有野生菇類都能吃，沒問過專家絕對不要吃。

tip: editor 編輯 + ial：編輯寫的評論
example: The editorial in today's paper argues that cities should plant more trees.
exampleZh: 今天報紙的社論主張城市應該多種樹。

tip: 【大考字根】音節分解 elig - ible。核心意義指向「有資格當選的;合格的」，常出現在篇章閱讀與學術論述中。
example: He's eligible for the presidency.
exampleZh: 他有資格當選總統。

tip: elite 像「伊力特」：選出來最強的一群
example: Only the elite athletes of the country can enter this training camp.
exampleZh: 全國只有頂尖運動員才能進入這個訓練營。

tip: emphasis 強調 + tic：強力表達的
example: Dad gave an emphatic no when I asked to stay up all night.
exampleZh: 我問能不能熬夜一整晚時，爸爸斬釘截鐵地說不行。

zh: 流行性的;傳染的;極為流行的
tip: epi 在上面 + dem 人民 → 蓋在人群上的
example: An epidemic flu spread through the city, and many schools closed for a week.
exampleZh: 一場流行性感冒席捲全市，許多學校停課一週。

tip: equi 相等 + val 價值 → 價值一樣
example: One kilometer is equivalent to one thousand meters.
exampleZh: 一公里等於一千公尺。

tip: 【大考字根】音節分解 et - hic - al。核心意義指向「倫理的;道德的」，常出現在篇章閱讀與學術論述中。
example: Would it be ethical to sacrifice one person to save many?
exampleZh: 為了救許多人犧牲一個人是否道德？

tip: ethnic 像「一熟你可」：同族人互相熟悉
example: Taiwan is home to many ethnic groups, each with its own songs and festivals.
exampleZh: 台灣有許多族群，每個族群都有自己的歌曲和節慶。

tip: ex 超出 + cess 走 → 走過頭了
example: Excessive screen time can make your eyes tired and your sleep worse.
exampleZh: 過度使用螢幕會讓眼睛疲勞，睡眠變差。

tip: ex 外面 + clude 關 → 把別人關在外面
example: This exclusive club accepts only members who are invited by a current member.
exampleZh: 這個高級俱樂部只收現任會員邀請的人。

tip: exquisite 像「一個細絲」：細絲般精緻
example: The tea shop serves exquisite cakes decorated like tiny flowers.
exampleZh: 這家茶店供應裝飾得像小花朵般的精緻蛋糕。

tip: extra 額外 + curricular 課程的 → 課表以外
example: I joined the chess club as an extracurricular activity after school.
exampleZh: 我放學後參加西洋棋社，當作課外活動。

tip: fable 寓言故事 + ous：像童話一樣不可思議
example: We had a fabulous holiday on the island, with sunny beaches every day.
exampleZh: 我們在島上度過了極棒的假期，每天都有晴朗的海灘。

tip: fin 結束 (final) + ite：有盡頭的
example: Earth's oil supply is finite, so we must find clean energy.
exampleZh: 地球的石油供應是有限的，所以我們必須找到乾淨能源。

tip: fire 火 + proof 防得住 → 火燒不壞
example: The firefighters wore fireproof suits when they entered the burning house.
exampleZh: 消防員進入著火的房子時穿著防火衣。

tip: fluid 像「福路」：福氣像水路一樣流動
example: Water is a fluid, so it takes the shape of any glass.
exampleZh: 水是流體，所以會變成任何杯子的形狀。

tip: formidable 像「佛咪的包」：佛都怕的強敵
example: The champion team faced a formidable opponent in the final match.
exampleZh: 冠軍隊在決賽中遇到了一位難以對付的對手。

tip: forth 向前 + coming 來 → 往前來到
example: The author's forthcoming book will be published in the spring.
exampleZh: 這位作家即將出版的新書將在春天上市。

tip: frail 像「福瑞兒」：福氣瑞氣都像易碎的玻璃
example: The frail old man held the railing as he climbed the stairs.
exampleZh: 那位虛弱的老先生爬樓梯時扶著欄杆。

tip: 【大考字根】音節分解 gloo - my。核心意義指向「陰暗的;憂鬱的」，常出現在篇章閱讀與學術論述中。
example: The future looked very gloomy.
exampleZh: 前途一片陰暗。

tip: graph 圖 + ic：像圖畫一樣清楚生動
example: The movie contained graphic scenes of a flood, so it was not for young kids.
exampleZh: 這部電影有洪水的寫實畫面，所以不適合小孩。

zh: (學位等)名譽上的;名譽職位的
tip: honor 榮譽 + ary：給你面子而不用修課
example: The university gave the famous writer an honorary degree.
exampleZh: 大學頒給那位著名作家榮譽學位。

tip: hospital 醫院本是招待客人的地方；好客
example: The villagers were hospitable and offered us tea and fruit.
exampleZh: 村民非常好客，請我們喝茶吃水果。

tip: human 人 + itarian：重視人、幫助人
example: The charity sent humanitarian aid, such as food and blankets, to the earthquake area.
exampleZh: 慈善機構把食物和毯子等人道援助送到地震災區。

example: The crowd was hysterical with joy when the singer walked onto the stage.
exampleZh: 歌手走上舞台時，群眾興奮到失控。

tip: 【大考字根】音節分解 im - mu - ne。核心意義指向「免疫的;免於...的」，常出現在篇章閱讀與學術論述中。
example: Everybody is immune to smallpox nowadays.
exampleZh: 現今每個人都對天花免疫了。

tip: im 在裡面 + plic 摺 → 意思摺在裡面沒說出來
example: His silence was an implicit yes; nobody needed to say the word aloud.
exampleZh: 他的沉默是不言明的同意，沒有人需要把話說出口。

zh: 壯觀的;氣勢宏偉的;莊嚴的
tip: impose 強加 + ing：氣勢壓過來，讓人肅然
example: The imposing castle on the hill made every visitor stop and stare.
exampleZh: 山丘上氣勢宏偉的城堡讓每位訪客都停下來凝視。

tip: incident 事件 + al：順便跟著發生的小事
example: The hotel charges a small incidental fee for towels, besides the room price.
exampleZh: 除了房價，旅館還額外收取一筆毛巾的附帶小額費用。

tip: in 在裡面 + clude 關 → 全關在範圍裡
example: The ticket price is all inclusive, so lunch and the museum visit are covered.
exampleZh: 票價是全包的，所以午餐與博物館參觀都包含在內。

tip: 【大考字根】音節分解 in - fec - ti - ous。核心意義指向「傳染的;有感染力的」，常出現在篇章閱讀與學術論述中。
example: Tom's laughter is infectious.
exampleZh: 湯姆的笑聲很有感染力。

tip: in 不 + valuable 但意思是「貴到無法估價」
example: Her grandmother's advice proved invaluable when she started her first job.
exampleZh: 她開始第一份工作時，祖母的建議被證明極為寶貴。

tip: irritate 惹惱 + able：一惹就生氣
example: Hungry and sleepy, the toddler became irritable and cried at everything.
exampleZh: 又餓又睏的幼兒變得易怒，什麼都哭。

tip: joy 快樂 + ous：充滿歡樂的
example: The joyous sound of children singing filled the school hall.
exampleZh: 孩子們快樂的歌聲充滿了學校大廳。

tip: legend 傳說 + ary：像傳說一樣的
example: Taiwan's legendary night markets are famous for fried chicken and bubble tea.
exampleZh: 台灣傳奇的夜市以炸雞排和珍珠奶茶聞名。

zh: 合法的;合法婚姻所生的;合理的
tip: leg 法律 (legal) + itimate：合乎法律的
example: The shop owner showed a legitimate license to prove the business was legal.
exampleZh: 店主出示合法的執照，證明這門生意是合法的。

tip: length 長度 + y：長得讓人想睡
example: The meeting was lengthy, and by the end everyone was yawning.
exampleZh: 會議冗長，到結束時每個人都在打呵欠。

zh: 照字面的;原義的;如實的
tip: liter 字母 (letter)：照字母逐字讀
example: Don't take the idiom literally; "raining cats and dogs" has no real animals.
exampleZh: 別照字面理解這句成語；「raining cats and dogs」並沒有真的動物。

zh: 能讀寫的;有文化修養的
tip: liter 字母 + ate：認得字母的
example: By the age of seven, most children in the city are literate and can read stories.
exampleZh: 城裡的大多數孩子到七歲就能讀寫，可以讀故事了。

tip: 【大考字根】音節分解 lu - nat - ic。核心意義指向「瘋的;瘋狂的」，常出現在篇章閱讀與學術論述中。
example: He acted like a lunatic.
exampleZh: 他表現的像個瘋子。

tip: lush 像「啦許」：啦～許多綠葉長出來
example: After the rainy season, the hills turned lush and green.
exampleZh: 雨季過後，山丘變得蒼翠茂盛。

zh: 中世紀的;中古風的;守舊的
tip: medi 中間 + ev 年代 → 中間的時代
example: Knights in armor lived in stone castles in medieval Europe.
exampleZh: 在中世紀的歐洲，穿盔甲的騎士住在石造城堡裡。

tip: mellow 像「妹囉」：妹妹一囉嗦，水果就熟透變軟
example: The mellow peach was sweet and soft, ready to be eaten.
exampleZh: 那顆熟透的桃子又甜又軟，可以吃了。

tip: metro 捷運：有捷運的大城市
example: The metropolitan area around Tokyo is home to millions of people.
exampleZh: 東京周邊的大都會區住著數百萬人。

tip: milit 軍隊 (military)：像軍隊般積極進攻
example: A militant group demanded quick change and refused to wait any longer.
exampleZh: 一個激進團體要求盡快改變，並拒絕再等下去。

tip: mini 小：迷你加 ature，整個小小的
example: He builds miniature ships and puts them inside glass bottles.
exampleZh: 他製作迷你小船，並把它們放進玻璃瓶裡。

tip: miracle 奇蹟 + ous：像奇蹟的
example: The tiny baby's miraculous recovery surprised even the experienced doctors.
exampleZh: 那個小嬰兒神奇的康復連經驗豐富的醫生都感到驚訝。

tip: mischief 惡作劇 + ous：愛搗蛋的
example: The mischievous kitten hid my socks and then watched me look for them.
exampleZh: 那隻調皮的小貓把我的襪子藏起來，然後看著我到處找。

zh: 傳教的;教會的;傳教士的
tip: mission 任務 + ary：帶著任務去傳播信仰
example: A missionary school was built in the village by a church group long ago.
exampleZh: 很久以前，一個教會團體在村裡蓋了一所教會學校。

example: The municipal library is run by the city government and is free to use.
exampleZh: 市立圖書館由市政府營運，可免費使用。

tip: mute 像「謬」：不說話，謬一個字都沒有
example: The shy boy stayed mute during class, even when the teacher called his name.
exampleZh: 那個害羞的男孩上課時一直不吭聲，連老師叫他的名字也不說話。

tip: naval 像「奈芙」：navy 海軍的形容詞
example: The naval base keeps warships ready to protect the island's coast.
exampleZh: 海軍基地隨時備妥軍艦，保護島嶼的海岸。

zh: 中立的;中立國的;空檔的
tip: 【大考字根】音節分解 neutr - al。核心意義指向「中立的;中立國的;空檔的」，常出現在篇章閱讀與學術論述中。
example: Switzerland is a neutral country.
exampleZh: 瑞士是一箇中立的國家。

tip: not 知名 (note)：出名，但是壞名
example: The city was notorious for its heavy traffic and crowded streets.
exampleZh: 這座城市因塞車嚴重、街道擁擠而惡名昭彰。

tip: nutri 滋養，和 nutrition 同家族：滋養身體的東西
example: Plants take in nutrients from the soil through their roots.
exampleZh: 植物透過根部從土壤吸收養分。

tip: nutri 養分 + tious：滿滿養分的食物
example: Beans, fish, and vegetables make a nutritious dinner for growing children.
exampleZh: 豆類、魚和蔬菜為成長中的孩子做成營養的晚餐。

tip: operate 運作 + ional：能夠開動的
example: The factory is now operational and produces two hundred bikes a day.
exampleZh: 工廠現在已經可以運作，每天生產兩百輛腳踏車。

tip: option 選擇 + al：可選可不選
example: Wearing a school jacket is optional on warm days.
exampleZh: 天氣暖和的日子，穿學校外套是自由選擇的。

tip: order 秩序 + ly：井然有序
example: The students formed an orderly line and walked quietly into the hall.
exampleZh: 學生們排成整齊的隊伍，安靜地走進大廳。

zh: 可恥的;無法無天的;令人吃驚的
tip: out 超出 + rage 怒氣 → 太超過讓人氣憤
example: It is outrageous that the tiny cup of tea costs one hundred dollars.
exampleZh: 這小小一杯茶竟要一百元，真是離譜。

tip: out 外 + right 對：一開口就直接了當
example: The coach made an outright ban on phones during practice, with no exceptions.
exampleZh: 教練全面禁止練習時使用手機，沒有任何例外。

tip: path 感受 (sympathy)：讓人心疼的
example: The old dog looked so pathetic, soaked in rain, that we took him home.
exampleZh: 那隻老狗淋了雨看起來好可憐，所以我們把牠帶回家。

tip: patriot 愛國者 + ic：像愛國者一樣的
example: Thousands of patriotic citizens sang the national anthem together at the stadium.
exampleZh: 數千名愛國的公民在體育場一起唱國歌。

zh: 堅持不懈的;固執的;持續的
tip: per 一直 + sist 站著 → 一直站著不走
example: She was persistent and called the shop five times until they fixed her bike.
exampleZh: 她很有毅力，打了五次電話給店家，直到他們修好她的腳踏車。

tip: photo 光 + graph 畫 → 用光畫下來的
example: She has a photographic memory and remembers every page she has read.
exampleZh: 她有過目不忘的好記憶，記得讀過的每一頁。

tip: picture 圖畫 + esque 像 → 美得像畫
example: We stayed in a picturesque village with red roofs and a stone bridge.
exampleZh: 我們住在一個有紅屋頂和石橋、美如圖畫的村莊。

tip: pollute 污染 + ant 表示東西：造成污染的東西
example: Factories must reduce the pollutants they release into the river.
exampleZh: 工廠必須減少排入河流的污染物。

tip: pre 之前 + limin 門檻 → 還在門檻前，還沒進門
example: The preliminary results show that the new method may work, but we need more tests.
exampleZh: 初步結果顯示新方法可能有效，但我們需要更多測試。

tip: pre 之前 + mature 成熟 → 還沒成熟就來了
example: The baby was born premature, so the doctors kept her warm in a special bed.
exampleZh: 那個寶寶是早產兒，所以醫生讓她待在特殊的保溫床裡。

tip: premier 像「普里米耳」：排第一的主角
example: Taipei is a premier travel spot, with the best food and the best museums.
exampleZh: 台北是首屈一指的旅遊景點，有最棒的美食和最棒的博物館。

tip: 【大考字根】音節分解 pre - si - den - ti - al。核心意義指向「總統的;總統選舉的」，常出現在篇章閱讀與學術論述中。
example: Everyone held their breath to see who would win the presidential election.
exampleZh: 所有人都屏住呼吸關注著誰會贏得總統競選。

tip: 【大考字根】音節分解 pre - vent - ive。核心意義指向「預防的;防病的」，常出現在篇章閱讀與學術論述中。
example: Preventive measures are much more effective than the actual treatment.
exampleZh: 預防措施比真正的治療更有效。

tip: pro 向前 + gress 走 → 一步一步往前走
example: Her piano skills showed progressive improvement, getting a little better each month.
exampleZh: 她的鋼琴技巧逐步進步，每個月都比上個月好一點。

tip: prone 像「潑」：一潑水就容易滑倒
example: This old road is prone to flooding after heavy rain.
exampleZh: 這條舊路大雨後容易淹水。

zh: 預期的;盼望中的;未來的
tip: pro 向前 + spect 看 → 往前看，看未來的
example: The company met with prospective customers to explain its new phone plan.
exampleZh: 公司和潛在客戶見面，說明新的手機方案。

tip: province 省份 + ial：離大城市遠的省分味
example: Her provincial town had only one cinema and one small bookstore.
exampleZh: 她所在的地方小鎮只有一間電影院和一家小書店。

tip: quarrel 吵架 + some：愛吵的
example: The quarrelsome brothers argued over who should wash the dishes.
exampleZh: 那對愛吵架的兄弟為了誰該洗碗而爭吵。

zh: 光芒四射的;容光煥發的;發熱的
tip: ray 光線，radiant 像光線一樣放射出來
example: The bride looked radiant in her white dress, smiling at everyone.
exampleZh: 新娘穿著白紗容光煥發，對大家微笑。

tip: radi 是光線，和 radio 同源：像光線一樣向四周散開
example: Heat radiates from the old stove and warms the whole room.
exampleZh: 熱氣從老爐子散發出來，讓整個房間都暖了。

tip: radic 根：從根部徹底改
example: The mayor planned a radical change to bring cars out of the old town.
exampleZh: 市長計畫徹底的改變，把車輛移出老城區。

tip: random 像「蘭頓」：蘭花頓時散落，沒有規則
example: The teacher called on a random student by drawing a card from a box.
exampleZh: 老師從盒子裡抽一張卡片，隨機點了一位學生。

tip: rash 像「來吸」：來吸一口氣就衝，沒想清楚
example: It was rash to jump into the cold river without checking how deep it was.
exampleZh: 沒檢查水深就跳進冰冷的河裡，實在太輕率了。

tip: re 再 + create 創造 → 讓人重新充滿活力
example: The city built a recreational park with a pond, bike paths, and picnic tables.
exampleZh: 市政府蓋了一座有池塘、自行車道和野餐桌的休閒公園。

tip: reflect 反射/反思 + ive：像鏡子映照自己
example: In a reflective mood, he sat by the window and thought about his year.
exampleZh: 他心情沉思，坐在窗邊回想這一年。

zh: 不注意的,不留心的;不關心的
tip: regard 看重 + less 不：不看重那件事，所以不管它
example: The game continued regardless of the heavy rain.
exampleZh: 不管雨下得多大，比賽還是繼續進行。

tip: 【大考字根】音節分解 re - le - vant。核心意義指向「有關的;切題的」，常出現在篇章閱讀與學術論述中。
example: That would be relevant.
exampleZh: 那可能有關係。

tip: re 再 + nown 名字 → 名字被一再提起
example: The renowned scientist gave a talk about how stars are born.
exampleZh: 那位著名的科學家發表了一場關於恆星如何誕生的演講。

tip: reside 居住 + ential：給人住的地方
example: We live in a quiet residential area, far from shops and factories.
exampleZh: 我們住在安靜的住宅區，遠離商店和工廠。

tip: resist 抵抗 + ant：不被打倒的
example: Some bacteria have become resistant to common medicines.
exampleZh: 有些細菌已經對常見藥物產生抗藥性。

tip: resolve 下定決心 + ute：心意不動搖
example: Though tired, the climbers were resolute and kept going toward the summit.
exampleZh: 雖然累了，登山者仍意志堅決，繼續朝山頂前進。

tip: respect 看回去 + ive：各看各的，各自
example: After the game, the players went back to their respective homes.
exampleZh: 比賽結束後，球員們各自回到自己的家。

tip: rhythm 節奏 + ic：鼓點有規律的
example: The rhythmic beat of the drums made everyone clap along.
exampleZh: 有節奏的鼓聲讓大家跟著拍手。

tip: ruby 像「入鼻」：入鼻都是紅寶石的深紅色
example: She wore a ruby dress that sparkled under the stage lights.
exampleZh: 她穿著紅寶石色的洋裝，在舞台燈光下閃閃發亮。

zh: 神志正常的;頭腦清楚的
tip: sane 與 insane 相反：in 是不，所以 sane 是頭腦正常
example: After a long rest, the patient felt sane again and could think clearly.
exampleZh: 好好休息很久後，病人又覺得頭腦清楚，可以清晰思考。

tip: 【大考字根】音節分解 scen - ic。核心意義指向「風景的;景色秀麗的」，常出現在篇章閱讀與學術論述中。
example: Switzerland is famous for its scenic beauty.
exampleZh: 瑞士以它的風景優美而聞名。

tip: select 挑選 + ive：愛挑選的
example: Cats are selective eaters and often refuse food they do not like.
exampleZh: 貓是挑食的動物，常常拒絕不喜歡的食物。

zh: 情深的;情感;多愁善感的
tip: sent 感覺 + mental：情感上的
example: He kept his late father's watch for sentimental reasons.
exampleZh: 他因為感情因素而保留已故父親的手錶。

tip: serene 像「西林」：西邊樹林裡一片安詳
example: The lake was serene at dawn, with no wind and no sound.
exampleZh: 黎明時湖面寧靜安詳，沒有風也沒有聲音。

zh: 全然的;(紡織物)極薄的;陡峭的
tip: sheer 像「吸耳」：陡到耳朵都被風吸
example: The sheer cliff dropped straight down to the sea.
exampleZh: 那面陡峭的懸崖筆直落入海中。

tip: shrewd 像「蘇路」：蘇路上精打細算的人
example: The shrewd shopkeeper noticed that the buyer wanted the vase very much and raised the price.
exampleZh: 那位精明的店主注意到買家非常想要那只花瓶，於是漲了價。

tip: sneaky 像 snake 蛇：悄悄溜過去
example: The sneaky cat crept onto the table and took a piece of fish.
exampleZh: 那隻鬼鬼祟祟的貓偷偷爬上桌子，叼走一塊魚。

tip: social 社交 + able：很能與人往來
example: Ben is sociable, and he made friends with everyone on the first day of camp.
exampleZh: 阿班很擅長交際，在營隊第一天就和每個人交上朋友。

zh: 老於世故的;精通的;精密的
tip: soph 智慧 (philosophy)：高度智慧的
example: The sophisticated machine can sort thousands of letters in a few minutes.
exampleZh: 這台精密的機器能在幾分鐘內分類好幾千封信。

tip: space 空間 + ious：空間很多的
example: The spacious living room had plenty of room for the whole family.
exampleZh: 寬敞的客廳有足夠的空間容納全家人。

tip: 【大考字根】音節分解 spec - ta - cu - lar。核心意義指向「壯觀的;壯麗的」，常出現在篇章閱讀與學術論述中。
example: These fireworks are spectacular!
exampleZh: 這些焰火真壯觀！

tip: spiral 像蚊香：一圈一圈繞上去
example: We climbed the spiral staircase to the top of the lighthouse.
exampleZh: 我們爬上螺旋樓梯，來到燈塔頂端。

tip: stationary 的 a 像站著不動；stationery 文具的 e 像 pen
example: The train stayed stationary at the platform while passengers got on.
exampleZh: 乘客上車時，火車靜止地停在月台上。

tip: sub 在下面 + sequ 跟隨 → 緊跟在後面
example: In the subsequent days, the weather turned warm and the snow melted.
exampleZh: 隨後的幾天，天氣轉暖，積雪也融化了。

tip: subtle 的 b 不發音，輕輕的、不易察覺
example: There was a subtle smell of lemon in the quiet room.
exampleZh: 安靜的房間裡有一股淡淡的檸檬味。

tip: sub 下面/附近 + urb 城市 → 靠近城市的地方
example: We moved to a suburban town where each house has a small garden.
exampleZh: 我們搬到郊區小鎮，那裡每間房子都有小花園。

tip: success 接連 + ive：一個接著一個
example: Our team won three successive games and reached the final.
exampleZh: 我們隊連贏三場比賽，打進決賽。

zh: 宏偉的;華麗的;上乘的,一流的
tip: super 超級 + b：超級棒
example: The orchestra gave a superb performance, and the audience stood to clap.
exampleZh: 管弦樂團演出極為精彩，觀眾起立鼓掌。

tip: super 超過 + sonic 聲音 → 比聲音還快
example: The supersonic jet crossed the ocean in a few hours.
exampleZh: 那架超音速噴射機幾小時就飛越了海洋。

tip: super 超過 + stit 站 → 站在科學之外的信念
example: Some superstitious people never walk under a ladder because they think it brings bad luck.
exampleZh: 有些迷信的人從不從梯子底下走過，因為他們認為會帶來壞運。

tip: symbol 符號 + ic：用一個東西代表另一個意思
example: A dove is a symbolic bird that stands for peace.
exampleZh: 鴿子是象徵和平的鳥。

zh: 冗長乏味的;使人厭煩的
tip: tedious 像「踢地獄」：無聊到像被踢進地獄般的長
example: Copying the long list by hand was a tedious job that took the whole afternoon.
exampleZh: 用手抄寫那份長清單是件乏味的差事，花掉整個下午。

tip: text 編織 (texture)：把線織成布的
example: Taiwan's textile industry makes cloth for sportswear and fashion brands.
exampleZh: 台灣的紡織業替運動服和時尚品牌製造布料。

tip: thrift 節儉，二手店叫 thrift shop：省錢買好物
example: My thrifty mother saves leftover rice and turns it into fried rice.
exampleZh: 我節儉的媽媽把吃剩的飯留起來，做成炒飯。

tip: tranquil 像「穿過裡」：穿過安靜裡面，心很平靜
example: The tranquil garden was a perfect place to read in the afternoon.
exampleZh: 那座寧靜的花園是午後讀書的絕佳地點。

tip: triumph 勝利 + ant：贏了得意的
example: The triumphant team lifted the trophy and waved to the cheering crowd.
exampleZh: 得意洋洋的球隊舉起獎盃，向歡呼的群眾揮手。

tip: tri 三 + via 路 → 三條路口閒聊的小事
example: Don't argue over trivial things like who sat in which seat.
exampleZh: 別為了誰坐哪個座位這種瑣事爭吵。

tip: tropic 像「吹太陽」：吹著太陽的熱帶
example: Palm trees and coral reefs are found in tropic regions near the equator.
exampleZh: 靠近赤道的熱帶地區可以看到棕櫚樹和珊瑚礁。

tip: truant 像「出狼」：出走不去上學的小狼
example: The truant student spent the afternoon at the arcade instead of going to class.
exampleZh: 那個逃學的學生整個下午泡在遊樂場，沒有去上課。

tip: 【大考字根】音節分解 ul - tim - ate。核心意義指向「最後的;最終的」，常出現在篇章閱讀與學術論述中。
example: What is the ultimate purpose of education?
exampleZh: 教育的最終目的是什麼？

tip: ut 外 + most 最 → 已經是最外面、最極致
example: She made the utmost effort to finish the race despite the sore leg.
exampleZh: 儘管腿很痛，她仍竭盡全力跑完比賽。

tip: val 力量 (value)：有力量的，勇敢
example: The valiant firefighter ran into the smoke to rescue a trapped kitten.
exampleZh: 勇敢的消防員衝進濃煙，救出受困的小貓。

tip: 【大考字根】音節分解 va - lid。核心意義指向「有根據的;有效的」，常出現在篇章閱讀與學術論述中。
example: It's valid until March thirty-first, nineteen-ninety-seven.
exampleZh: 有效期到1997年3月31日為止。

tip: vers 轉 (reverse)：容易轉換角色的
example: A versatile actor can play a funny clown, a king, or a quiet teacher.
exampleZh: 多才多藝的演員可以演搞笑小丑、國王，或是安靜的老師。

tip: vice 惡行 + ious：滿是惡意的
example: The vicious rumor hurt her feelings and spread all over the school.
exampleZh: 那則惡毒的謠言傷了她的心，還傳遍了整個學校。

tip: 【大考字根】音節分解 vic - to - ri - ous。核心意義指向「勝利的」，常出現在篇章閱讀與學術論述中。
example: Tom was victorious.
exampleZh: 湯姆勝利了。

tip: virtual 像「微秋」：微縮在螢幕裡的虛擬世界
example: We held a virtual meeting online because everyone lived in a different city.
exampleZh: 因為大家住在不同城市，所以我們在線上開了虛擬會議。

tip: voc 聲音 (voice)：跟聲音有關的
example: Singing needs good vocal control, so the choir teacher trains our voices daily.
exampleZh: 唱歌需要良好的聲音控制，所以合唱團老師天天訓練我們的聲音。

tip: voc 召喚 + ational：被職業召喚去學技能
example: After junior high, Leo entered a vocational school to learn to cook.
exampleZh: 國中畢業後，阿里歐進入職業學校學習烹飪。

tip: vulgar 像「瓦格」：瓦格貨，沒水準、粗俗
example: The teacher asked him to stop using vulgar words in the playground.
exampleZh: 老師要求他在操場上別再說粗俗的字眼。

tip: 【大考字根】音節分解 wa - ter - proof。核心意義指向「防水的」，常出現在篇章閱讀與學術論述中。
example: This watch is waterproof.
exampleZh: 這手錶是防水的。

tip: water 水 + tight 緊 → 水一滴也進不去
example: The explorers kept their supplies in a watertight bag during the boat trip.
exampleZh: 探險隊在划船旅程中把補給品放在防水袋裡。

zh: 不管什麼樣的;無論怎麼的
tip: what 什麼 + so + ever：不管是什麼都一樣
example: I have no interest whatsoever in joining the school's cooking contest.
exampleZh: 我對參加學校的烹飪比賽完全沒有興趣。

tip: witty 像「Wit 威提」：頭腦轉得快的機智人
example: Her witty reply made the whole class laugh and the teacher smile.
exampleZh: 她風趣的回答讓全班大笑，老師也笑了。

tip: ab 向 + brev 短 → 弄短
example: Please abbreviate "Wednesday" as "Wed." so the schedule fits on one page.
exampleZh: 請把「Wednesday」縮寫成「Wed.」，這樣時間表才放得進一頁。

tip: ab 離開 + use 用 → 用錯了路
example: Some customers abuse the free refill rule by pouring drinks into big bottles.
exampleZh: 有些顧客濫用免費續杯規定，把飲料倒進大瓶子裡。

tip: addict 像「愛點」：愛點個不停就上癮了
example: Don't let video games addict you; take breaks and go outside.
exampleZh: 別讓電玩使你沉迷；要休息並出去走走。

tip: ad 向 + minister 服務 → 把東西送上
example: The nurse will administer the medicine to the patient every four hours.
exampleZh: 護理師每四小時會給病人用一次藥。

tip: administrate 與 administer 同族，指管理運作
example: A committee will administrate the school fund and report its spending each month.
exampleZh: 一個委員會將管理學校基金，並每月報告支出。

tip: af 向 + firm 堅固 → 說得很堅定
example: The captain affirmed that the ship would leave on time despite the storm.
exampleZh: 船長斷言這艘船即使有暴風雨也會準時出發。

tip: ambush 的 bush 是灌木叢：躲在灌木叢裡等
example: Hunters in the forest planned to ambush the bear near the stream.
exampleZh: 森林裡的獵人計畫在溪邊埋伏那頭熊。

tip: ample 寬大 + ify 使 → 使變大
example: A microphone can amplify your voice so the whole hall can hear it.
exampleZh: 麥克風可以放大你的聲音，讓整個大廳都聽得到。

tip: assassinate 前面 ass + ass：兩個 ass 重疊，記雙 s 雙 s
example: In the history book, a group of men plotted to assassinate the king, but failed.
exampleZh: 在歷史書裡，一群人密謀暗殺國王，但失敗了。

tip: as 向 + sess 坐 → 坐在旁邊評量
example: A teacher will assess your essay and give you a score and advice.
exampleZh: 老師會評估你的作文，並給你分數與建議。

tip: at 向 + tain 觸及 → 伸手摸到目標
example: With daily practice, she attained the highest score in the spelling contest.
exampleZh: 每天練習，使她在拼字比賽中獲得最高分。

tip: auction 像「喔喜」：喔，喜歡就舉手出價
example: The museum will auction a rare painting to raise money for the school.
exampleZh: 博物館將拍賣一幅罕見的畫，為學校籌款。

tip: auto 自己 + graph 寫 → 自己寫下名字
example: The author autographed my copy of her book at the book fair.
exampleZh: 作家在書展上於我的那本書上簽了名。

tip: beckon 像「必空」：必須空出手來向人招呼
example: The coach beckoned the player to the sideline with a wave of his hand.
exampleZh: 教練揮手示意球員到場邊來。

tip: be 加強 + siege 圍城 → 團團圍住
example: Fans besieged the singer's car, hoping for a photo.
exampleZh: 歌迷包圍了歌手的車，希望能拍到一張照片。

tip: 【大考字根】音節分解 bet - ray。核心意義指向「背叛;出賣」，常出現在篇章閱讀與學術論述中。
example: A true gentleman would not betray his friends.
exampleZh: 一個真正的紳士不會出賣他的朋友。

tip: blunder 像「搬動」：搬錯東西，犯下大錯
example: He blundered by sending the private message to the whole group.
exampleZh: 他把私人訊息傳給整個群組，犯了大錯。

zh: 砲擊;不斷攻擊;連續提出問題
tip: bomb 炸彈 + ard：像丟炸彈般一個接一個
example: Reporters bombard the mayor with questions after every press conference.
exampleZh: 每次記者會結束後，記者都不斷向市長丟出問題。

example: A warm cup of soup can boost your mood on a rainy day.
exampleZh: 下雨天一杯熱湯能提振你的心情。

tip: boycott 的 boy 男孩 + cot 小床：大家不躺在他的床
example: Many shoppers decided to boycott the brand after it polluted the river.
exampleZh: 許多消費者在該品牌汙染河川後，決定聯合抵制它。

tip: brew 像「布魯」：布魯布魯冒泡，在煮茶或釀啤酒
example: Dad likes to brew a pot of green tea every evening.
exampleZh: 爸爸喜歡每天傍晚泡一壺綠茶。

tip: buckle 是皮帶扣：扣緊或被壓彎
example: The old chair began to buckle under the heavy bag, then fell apart.
exampleZh: 那張舊椅子在沉重的袋子壓力下開始垮掉，然後散開。

tip: cap 頭 (capital)：放在照片頭上的文字
example: Please caption each photo in the album with the date and place.
exampleZh: 請替相簿裡的每張照片加上日期與地點的標題。

example: She gently caressed the sleeping kitten's soft fur.
exampleZh: 她輕輕撫摸熟睡小貓柔軟的毛。

zh: 證明;保證;發證書(或執照等)
tip: cert 確定 + ify 使 → 使確定是真的
example: The school will certify that you completed the swimming course.
exampleZh: 學校將證明你已完成游泳課程。

tip: char 和 car 同源：古代的 car，就是馬拉的戰車
example: In ancient races, each chariot was pulled by fast horses.
exampleZh: 在古代賽事中，每輛戰車都由快馬拉動。

tip: chuckle 像「掐可」：被搔癢時掐不住的輕笑
example: The little girl chuckled when the puppy tried to catch its own tail.
exampleZh: 小狗想抓自己的尾巴，小女孩咯咯笑了起來。

tip: civil 是「公民的」，把野孩子變成有禮的公民就是 civilize
example: Teachers hoped the new school rules would civilize the noisy, wild playground.
exampleZh: 老師希望新的校規能讓吵鬧又瘋野的操場變得有規矩。

zh: 鉗緊;夾住;強行實施;取締
tip: clamp 像「卡郎」兩個音，卡住郎(東西)就夾緊了
example: The mechanic clamped the pipe to the table before cutting it.
exampleZh: 技師在切割水管前，先把它夾緊在桌上。

tip: clean 加 se：把東西變乾淨的動作，臉也能被 cleanse
example: Before breakfast, she cleanses her face with warm water and mild soap.
exampleZh: 早餐前，她用溫水和溫和的肥皂清洗臉部。

tip: clench 的 ch 像用力「擠」，手握緊緊擠出力氣
example: He clenched his fists and tried to stay calm during the argument.
exampleZh: 爭吵時他握緊拳頭，努力保持冷靜。

tip: 克隆(clone)就是諧音：複製出一模一樣的「克隆」羊
example: Scientists cloned a sheep named Dolly in 1996 from a single cell.
exampleZh: 科學家在 1996 年用一顆細胞複製出一隻名叫桃莉的羊。

tip: col 一起 + lide 像 slide 滑：滑到一起就撞上了
example: Two scooters collided at the corner, but nobody was hurt badly.
exampleZh: 兩輛機車在轉角相撞，但沒有人傷得嚴重。

tip: com 一起 + memor 記憶：大家一起記住某件大事
example: Every April, our town holds a parade to commemorate its founding.
exampleZh: 每年四月，我們鎮上舉行遊行來紀念建鎮。

zh: 匯編;收集(資料等);編譯(程式)
tip: com 一起 + pile 堆：把資料堆在一起編成一份
example: She compiled a list of useful websites for her classmates.
exampleZh: 她為同學整理了一份實用網站清單。

tip: comprise 用「包住」想：整體把各部分包起來，不加 of
example: The team comprises five students, two teachers, and one coach.
exampleZh: 這個隊伍由五名學生、兩位老師和一位教練組成。

tip: con 一起 + fer 帶：把學位帶給你，就是授予
example: The university will confer an honorary degree on the famous writer.
exampleZh: 大學將頒授榮譽學位給這位知名作家。

tip: cover 蓋住：看到別人的好東西，想拿來蓋上自己的名字
example: The little boy covets his cousin's shiny new bicycle.
exampleZh: 小男孩很眼紅表哥那輛閃亮的新腳踏車。

tip: 抽筋 cramp 讓你動彈不得，空間太小也一樣被限制
example: Tiny apartments cramp families who need more space to live comfortably.
exampleZh: 狹小的公寓限制了需要更多空間舒適生活的家庭。

tip: crook 像鉤子 hook 的樣子，手指彎成一個鉤
example: The old man crooked his finger to call the children closer.
exampleZh: 老先生彎起手指，招呼孩子們靠近一點。

tip: cruise 諧音「裘伊絲」，想像裘伊絲悠閒開船慢慢逛
example: Our boat cruised slowly along the coast while we watched dolphins.
exampleZh: 我們的船沿著海岸緩緩航行，我們一邊看海豚。

tip: crumb 是碎屑，加 le 變動詞：變成碎屑
example: The old cookie crumbled into tiny pieces when she squeezed it.
exampleZh: 她一捏，那塊舊餅乾就碎成小塊。

zh: 下降,下跌,衰退,婉拒,謝絕
tip: de 往下 + cline 傾斜：往下斜，所以是下降
example: The shop's sales declined sharply after the new mall opened nearby.
exampleZh: 附近新商場開幕後，這家店的銷售量大幅下降。

zh: 奉獻;獻身於;舉行落成典禮
tip: dedicate 像「嫡弟 kate」，最親的人才會全心投入
example: She dedicated her whole life to helping children learn to read.
exampleZh: 她把一生都奉獻給幫助孩子學習閱讀。

tip: de 去除 + prive 像 private 私有：把你的東西拿走
example: The storm deprived the village of electricity for three whole days.
exampleZh: 暴風雨讓村子整整三天沒有電可用。

tip: de 往下 + scend 爬：往下爬，與 ascend 相反
example: The hikers slowly descended the mountain before the sun went down.
exampleZh: 登山客趁日落前慢慢走下山。

tip: de 分開 + tach 像 attach 黏上：把黏上的拆開
example: Press the button to detach the handle from the vacuum cleaner.
exampleZh: 按下按鈕就能把握把從吸塵器上拆下來。

tip: de 向下 + tain 抓住：抓住不放，所以留住
example: Police detained the driver for two hours to ask more questions.
exampleZh: 警方扣留這名駕駛兩小時，詢問更多問題。

tip: de 減少 + value 價值：價值變少
example: The government decided not to devalue its currency this year.
exampleZh: 政府今年決定不讓貨幣貶值。

tip: dia 透過 + gnose 知道：看透症狀才知道病因
example: The doctor diagnosed her cough as a mild case of the flu.
exampleZh: 醫生診斷她的咳嗽是輕微的流感。

tip: diagram 名詞是圖表，當動詞就是畫成圖
example: The teacher diagrammed the sentence on the board for the class.
exampleZh: 老師在黑板上為全班用圖解表示這個句子。

tip: dict 說：dictionary 字典就是說明字的書
example: The boss dictated a short letter while his secretary typed it.
exampleZh: 老闆口述一封短信，秘書就邊聽邊打字。

tip: dis 不 + able 能：變成不能運作
example: A strong storm disabled the radio tower, so people lost the signal.
exampleZh: 強烈風暴讓無線電塔無法運作，人們因此收不到訊號。

tip: dis 不 + approve 贊成，後面常接 of
example: My parents disapprove of staying up late on school nights.
exampleZh: 我爸媽不贊成在上學日的夜晚熬夜。

tip: dis 不 + comfort 舒適：讓人不舒服
example: The loud construction noise discomforted the patients in the nearby clinic.
exampleZh: 嘈雜的施工聲讓附近診所的病人很不舒服。

tip: dis 失去 + grace 優雅：失去體面，所以丟臉
example: His cheating on the test disgraced the whole class.
exampleZh: 他考試作弊讓全班都丟了臉。

tip: dis 離開 + place 位置：把人擠離原位
example: New machines have displaced many workers in the old factory.
exampleZh: 新機器取代了老工廠裡的許多工人。

tip: dis 不 + please 取悅：不能讓人開心
example: Nothing displeases my grandmother more than wasting good food.
exampleZh: 沒有什麼比浪費好食物更讓我奶奶不高興了。

tip: dis 不 + regard 看重：不看在眼裡
example: Some drivers disregard the speed limit when the road is empty.
exampleZh: 有些駕駛在路上沒車時會無視速限。

tip: dis 反對 + suade 勸說，與 persuade 說服相反
example: We tried to dissuade him from swimming in the cold river.
exampleZh: 我們想勸他不要到冰冷的河裡游泳。

tip: dis 分開 + tract 拉：把注意力拉走
example: Don't let your phone distract you while you are doing homework.
exampleZh: 寫功課時別讓手機使你分心。

tip: dis 不 + trust 信任
example: After being lied to twice, she began to distrust her old friend.
exampleZh: 被騙兩次後，她開始不信任這位老朋友。

tip: di 分開 + vert 轉：轉到別的方向
example: Because of the accident, police diverted traffic onto a smaller road.
exampleZh: 由於發生事故，警方把車流引導到較小的路上。

tip: donate 諧音「都那」，都拿出來給別人
example: Many students donated their old books to the village library.
exampleZh: 許多學生把舊書捐給村裡的圖書館。

tip: doom 像「度姆」，想像命運的門早已關上，改不了
example: The lack of rain doomed the farmers' crops to failure.
exampleZh: 缺雨使農民的作物注定歉收。

tip: drizzle 的 zzle 聽起來像細雨沙沙沙
example: It drizzled all morning, so we took our umbrellas to the park.
exampleZh: 整個早上都下著毛毛雨，所以我們帶傘去公園。

tip: dynamite 諧音「搭那邁」，邁出大步炸開山
example: Workers dynamited the huge rock to make a tunnel through the hill.
exampleZh: 工人用炸藥炸開巨石，好在山裡開隧道。

tip: ebb 諧音「欸」，潮水一退，大家欸了一聲
example: By evening the tide began to ebb, leaving shells on the sand.
exampleZh: 傍晚潮水開始退去，在沙灘上留下貝殼。

tip: em 進入 + bark 像 barge 駁船：走進船裡
example: The family embarked at dawn and watched the harbor slip away.
exampleZh: 一家人黎明時登船，看著港口漸漸遠去。

tip: e 出去 + migrate 遷移：從自己國家移出去
example: Her uncle emigrated from Taiwan to Canada when he was twenty.
exampleZh: 她的叔叔二十歲時從台灣移居加拿大。

tip: en 使成為 + act 行動：讓法案變成有效行動
example: The city council enacted a law that bans plastic bags in markets.
exampleZh: 市議會制定了一項法律，禁止在市場使用塑膠袋。

tip: en 使 + hance 高：讓某事物變得更高更好
example: Reading every day can enhance your vocabulary and your writing skills.
exampleZh: 每天閱讀能提升你的字彙量和寫作能力。

tip: en 使 + light 光：讓腦袋亮起來
example: The museum visit enlightened us about how ancient farmers lived.
exampleZh: 參觀博物館讓我們明白了古代農夫是怎麼生活的。

tip: en 使 + rich 富有：讓變得更豐富
example: Travel enriches our lives by showing us new foods and cultures.
exampleZh: 旅行讓我們認識新的食物與文化，豐富了我們的生活。

tip: e 外 + rode 像 rodent 齧齒動物：一點一點啃掉
example: Over centuries, the river eroded the soft rock into a deep canyon.
exampleZh: 經過數百年，河流把軟岩侵蝕成深谷。

tip: 【大考字根】音節分解 eva - cu - ate。核心意義指向「撤離;避難;疏散」，常出現在篇章閱讀與學術論述中。
example: We have less than five minutes to evacuate the whole building.
exampleZh: 我們有不到五分鐘來疏散整棟樓的人。

tip: e 出 + volve 轉動：慢慢轉出新模樣
example: Over millions of years, small sea animals evolved into land creatures.
exampleZh: 數百萬年間，小型海洋動物逐漸演變成陸地生物。

tip: ex 外 + cerpt 取：從書裡取出一小段
example: The magazine excerpted three pages from her new novel.
exampleZh: 雜誌從她的新小說中摘錄了三頁。

tip: ex 向外 + pel 推：向外推出學校
example: The school expelled two students for bringing fireworks to class.
exampleZh: 學校因兩名學生帶煙火到教室而將他們退學。

tip: ex 向外 + tract 拉：向外拉出來
example: The dentist extracted a loose tooth from the little girl's mouth.
exampleZh: 牙醫從小女孩嘴裡拔出一顆鬆動的牙齒。

zh: 閃耀;(搖曳不定地)燃燒;閃亮
tip: flare 像 flame 加 air：火遇到空氣就亮起來
example: The campfire flared suddenly when Dad added a dry log.
exampleZh: 爸爸添了一根乾柴，營火突然竄亮起來。

tip: flicker 的 fl 像飄動，ker 像打火機喀一下閃光
example: Candles flickered on the table as a cool wind slipped through the window.
exampleZh: 涼風從窗縫吹進來，桌上的蠟燭搖曳閃動。

tip: fling 諧音「忽鈴」，一甩忽地飛出去
example: Don't fling your bag on the floor when you get home.
exampleZh: 回到家時，別把書包隨手往地上一扔。

zh: 振翼;飄動;(心臟等)不規則跳動
tip: flutter 想成 flat + utter：薄薄翅膀快速拍動
example: A small butterfly fluttered above the flowers in our garden.
exampleZh: 一隻小蝴蝶在我們花園的花朵上空振翅飛舞。

tip: fore 前面 + see 看：先看到未來
example: Nobody could foresee how quickly the small shop would grow famous.
exampleZh: 沒有人能預見這家小店會多快變得出名。

tip: for 離開 + sake 緣故：不管緣故離你而去
example: He promised never to forsake his friends, even in hard times.
exampleZh: 他承諾即使在艱難時期也絕不拋棄朋友。

tip: fort 堡壘 + ify 使：把地方變成堡壘
example: The villagers fortified their walls before the fierce winter arrived.
exampleZh: 村民在嚴冬來臨前加固了城牆。

tip: frac 打破：fraction 分數就是把整體打破成小塊
example: She fell off her bike and fractured her wrist in two places.
exampleZh: 她從腳踏車上摔下來，手腕有兩處骨折。

tip: frag 打破：fragile 易碎，fragment 碎片
example: The strong wind fragmented the thin ice into small floating pieces.
exampleZh: 強風把薄冰打成漂浮的小碎片。

tip: freak 諧音「福利克」，嚇得整個人失常
example: The sudden thunder freaked the puppy out, and it hid under the bed.
exampleZh: 突然的雷聲把小狗嚇壞了，牠躲到床底下。

tip: fret 諧音「福瑞」，福瑞天天為小事操心
example: Mom fretted over every little noise while Dad was driving home.
exampleZh: 爸爸開車回家的路上，媽媽為每個小聲響煩躁不安。

tip: 【大考字根】音節分解 ge - ner - ate。核心意義指向「產生;發生(熱;電;光等)」，常出現在篇章閱讀與學術論述中。
example: An electric current can generate magnetism.
exampleZh: 電流可以產生磁性。

tip: glisten 的 listen 藏在裡面：靜靜聽，雨滴閃閃發亮
example: Raindrops glistened on the leaves after the morning shower.
exampleZh: 早晨的陣雨過後，雨滴在葉子上閃閃發亮。

tip: graph 本身就是圖，當動詞就是畫成圖
example: The students graphed the temperature changes over the whole week.
exampleZh: 學生把整週的氣溫變化畫成圖表。

tip: grope 像 rope 繩子，手像摸繩子一樣一點一點找
example: In the dark room, he groped for the light switch on the wall.
exampleZh: 在黑暗的房間裡，他摸索牆上的電燈開關。

tip: hack 諧音「黑克」，手一揮黑克黑克砍下去
example: The farmer hacked at the thick weeds with a sharp tool.
exampleZh: 農夫用一把利器猛砍濃密的雜草。

tip: hail 與 hello 同發音開頭，用來向人招呼
example: Fans hailed the young singer as the hero of the night.
exampleZh: 粉絲們歡呼稱讚這位年輕歌手是今晚的英雄。

tip: harass 諧音「哈啦絲」，一直找你哈啦很煩人
example: Some online users harass others by sending mean messages every day.
exampleZh: 有些網路使用者每天傳惡意訊息來騷擾別人。

tip: hospital 醫院 + ize 使：被送進醫院
example: The boy was hospitalized for a week after the bike accident.
exampleZh: 男孩在腳踏車意外後住院治療了一星期。

tip: 【大考字根】音節分解 hu - mi - li - ate。核心意義指向「羞辱;使丟臉」，常出現在篇章閱讀與學術論述中。
example: I didn't want to humiliate you.
exampleZh: 我不是想要羞辱你。

tip: hunch 像 bunch 一團：身體縮成一團
example: The cat hunched its back when it saw the big dog.
exampleZh: 貓看到大狗時把背拱成弓形。

tip: hurdle 諧音「憨豆」，憨豆跳過欄杆
example: The runner hurdled the fence and kept chasing the bus.
exampleZh: 跑者跨過圍欄，繼續追著公車跑。

tip: im 進入 + prison 監獄：把人放進監獄
example: The king imprisoned his enemies in a tall tower for many years.
exampleZh: 國王把敵人關在高塔裡許多年。

tip: in 往 + cline 傾斜，和 decline 是同一家族
example: The tall tree inclines toward the east because of the strong wind.
exampleZh: 那棵高樹因強風而向東傾斜。

tip: in 在裡面 + habit 習慣居住：住在裡面成習慣
example: Red-crowned cranes inhabit the wetlands along the northern coast.
exampleZh: 丹頂鶴棲息在北方海岸的濕地一帶。

tip: in 進入 + ject 丟：把藥丟進身體裡
example: The nurse injected the medicine into my arm and smiled kindly.
exampleZh: 護士把藥液注射進我的手臂，並親切地微笑。

tip: integr 完整：把部分合成完整的一體
example: Our school plans to integrate music and math in one project.
exampleZh: 我們學校計畫在同一個專題中結合音樂和數學。

tip: 【大考字根】音節分解 inter - ve - ne。核心意義指向「介入;干預;調停」，常出現在篇章閱讀與學術論述中。
example: We must intervene.
exampleZh: 我們必須介入。

tip: in 進入 + trude 推擠：硬擠進別人的地方
example: A stranger intruded into the garden and frightened our dog.
exampleZh: 一個陌生人闖進花園，嚇到了我們的狗。

tip: irritate 諧音「愛瑞特」，蚊子叮得人愛瑞特煩
example: The constant buzzing of mosquitoes irritated everyone in the tent.
exampleZh: 蚊子不停的嗡嗡聲讓帳篷裡每個人都很煩躁。

tip: kid 小孩 + nap 小睡：把孩子偷偷帶走
example: The criminals kidnapped the businessman and asked his family for money.
exampleZh: 歹徒綁架那位商人，向他的家人勒索金錢。

tip: lounge 像 lunch 加 ounce：吃飽午餐就賴著不動
example: On Sunday afternoons my uncle lounges on the sofa with a good book.
exampleZh: 星期天下午，我叔叔懶洋洋地靠在沙發上看一本好書。

tip: lure 諧音「魯兒」，餌一放，魚就魯進來
example: The smell of fresh bread lured customers into the tiny bakery.
exampleZh: 剛出爐麵包的香味把顧客吸引進這間小麵包店。

zh: 操作;運用;操縱;對...做手腳
tip: mani 手 + pulate：用手去擺弄
example: The magician manipulated the cards so fast that nobody saw the trick.
exampleZh: 魔術師操弄紙牌的速度快到沒人看出把戲。

tip: mar 諧音「馬」：馬一腳踩過去，漂亮的草地就毀了
example: A few scratches marred the surface of the new wooden table.
exampleZh: 幾道刮痕損壞了新木桌的表面。

tip: 這裡是比賽中的慘敗，把 mass 一大群想成壓倒性的比分
example: The home team massacred their rivals, winning the game by thirty points.
exampleZh: 主隊徹底擊潰對手，以三十分之差贏得比賽。

tip: medi 中間：讓心回到平靜的中間
example: Every morning she meditates quietly for ten minutes before school.
exampleZh: 她每天早上上學前都會安靜地沈思十分鐘。

tip: mi 諧音「米」，鳥為了找米吃飛去別處
example: Swallows migrate south every autumn to find warmer weather.
exampleZh: 燕子每年秋天遷徙到南方尋找較暖的天氣。

tip: 【大考字根】音節分解 mim - ic。核心意義指向「模仿;與...極相似」，常出現在篇章閱讀與學術論述中。
example: A parrot can mimic a person's voice.
exampleZh: 鸚鵡會模仿人的聲音。

zh: 使減到最少(或最小);低估
tip: mini 迷你 + ize 使：使變迷你
example: We should minimize waste by bringing our own bottles and bags.
exampleZh: 我們應該自備瓶子和袋子，把浪費減到最少。

tip: mobile 能動的 + ize：讓大家動起來
example: The mayor mobilized hundreds of volunteers to clean up after the flood.
exampleZh: 市長動員數百名志工在水災後清理環境。

tip: mold 像模具：把軟東西壓進模子成形
example: The potter molded the soft clay into a round bowl.
exampleZh: 陶藝家把軟黏土塑成一個圓碗。

tip: narr 述說，narrator 就是旁白者
example: Grandpa narrates the old folk tales in a slow, gentle voice.
exampleZh: 爺爺用緩慢溫和的聲音講述古老的民間故事。

tip: nour 像 nurse 護士：護士照顧讓人長壯
example: Plenty of sleep and fresh vegetables nourish growing teenagers.
exampleZh: 充足的睡眠和新鮮蔬菜能滋養成長中的青少年。

tip: nurture 看到 nurse：像護士一樣照顧，慢慢養大
example: Good teachers nurture curiosity in young children with patience and praise.
exampleZh: 好老師用耐心和稱讚培養幼童的好奇心。

tip: ob 向 + lig 綁：被綁住，不做不行
example: The heavy rain obliged us to cancel the picnic.
exampleZh: 大雨迫使我們取消野餐。

tip: origin 起源 + ate 動詞：從起點出發
example: Tea originated in southwest China thousands of years ago.
exampleZh: 茶起源於數千年前的中國西南部。

tip: outfit 衣著裝備：從頭到腳準備好
example: The school outfitted every team member with a bright new uniform.
exampleZh: 學校為每位隊員配發一套鮮豔的新制服。

tip: out 外 + law 法律：放到法律外，不准做
example: The city outlawed fireworks near the forest to prevent fires.
exampleZh: 為預防火災，市府禁止在森林附近放煙火。

tip: out 超過 + number 數量：數字比對方大
example: Girls outnumber boys two to one in our school choir.
exampleZh: 我們學校合唱團的女生人數是男生的兩倍。

tip: out 超出 + rage 憤怒：怒氣衝出來
example: The cruel treatment of the stray dogs outraged the whole neighborhood.
exampleZh: 對流浪狗的殘忍對待激怒了整個社區。

tip: over 在上面 + lap 部分覆蓋：蓋在上面
example: Our lunch breaks overlap, so we can eat together on Fridays.
exampleZh: 我們的午休時間有部分重疊，所以星期五可以一起吃飯。

tip: over 翻過 + turn 轉：整個轉過來
example: A strong wave overturned the small fishing boat near the dock.
exampleZh: 一道大浪在碼頭附近把小漁船打翻。

tip: para 旁邊 + lyze 鬆開：身體鬆垮不能動
example: The fear of failing paralyzed him, and he could not speak on stage.
exampleZh: 對失敗的恐懼使他動彈不得，在台上說不出話。

tip: ped 腳：用腳走街串巷叫賣
example: Street sellers peddle cold drinks and fruit to tourists along the beach.
exampleZh: 小販沿著海灘向遊客兜售冷飲和水果。

zh: 使定相;使同步;分階段實行
tip: phase 階段，一階一階慢慢來
example: The city will phase out gasoline buses over the next five years.
exampleZh: 市府將在未來五年內分階段淘汰汽油公車。

example: A sharp nail pierced the tire, and the air quickly leaked out.
exampleZh: 一根尖釘刺穿輪胎，空氣很快漏光了。

tip: poach 像 pocket 口袋：偷偷放進自己口袋
example: Hunters poached rare animals in the park until the rangers stopped them.
exampleZh: 獵人在公園裡偷獵稀有動物，直到巡守員阻止他們。

tip: pond 池塘：望著池塘慢慢想事情
example: She pondered the question for a long time before answering.
exampleZh: 她思考了這個問題很久才作答。

tip: popul 人口：pop 一群人住進去
example: Several kinds of fish populate the clear river near our village.
exampleZh: 有好幾種魚棲息在我們村子附近的清澈河流裡。

tip: posture 名詞是姿勢，當動詞是裝出某種姿態
example: The candidate postured as a friend of farmers during the campaign.
exampleZh: 這位候選人在競選期間擺出農民之友的姿態。

tip: pre 前 + cede 走：走在前面
example: A short film precedes the main show at the theater.
exampleZh: 劇院裡正式演出之前會先放映一部短片。

tip: pre 前 + face 面：放在書前面的臉面
example: The author prefaced her book with a short thank-you to her readers.
exampleZh: 作者在書前加了一段對讀者的簡短致謝。

tip: pre 事先 + scribe 寫：先寫好藥方
example: The doctor prescribed rest and plenty of water for the cold.
exampleZh: 醫生針對感冒開了休息和多喝水的處方。

tip: pro 在前 + hibit 抓住：擋在前面不准通過
example: The library prohibits eating and drinking near the computers.
exampleZh: 圖書館禁止在電腦區附近飲食。

tip: pro 向前 + pel 推：向前推
example: Strong engines propelled the ship across the ocean at high speed.
exampleZh: 強力引擎推動船隻高速橫越海洋。

tip: pro 向前 + secute 追：一路追到法院
example: The city decided to prosecute the company for dumping waste into the river.
exampleZh: 市政府決定起訴這家公司向河裡傾倒廢棄物。

tip: pro 向前 + voke 叫：往前叫囂挑起事端
example: Teasing the dog only provoked it, and it began to bark loudly.
exampleZh: 逗那隻狗只會激怒牠，牠開始大聲吠叫。

tip: prowl 諧音「泡肉」，餓了到處找肉
example: A hungry fox prowled around the farm looking for chickens at night.
exampleZh: 一隻飢餓的狐狸夜裡在農場周圍徘徊尋找雞。

tip: pur 純 + ify 使：使變純
example: This machine purifies water so that families can drink it safely.
exampleZh: 這台機器淨化水質，讓家人能安心飲用。

tip: quench 諧音「誇奇」，誇它一口喝下去，渴就解了
example: After the hike, a glass of cold water quenched his thirst.
exampleZh: 健行後，一杯冰水解了他的口渴。

tip: query 和 question 都有 qu：都是發問
example: Several parents queried the new homework rule at the school meeting.
exampleZh: 好幾位家長在學校會議上對新的功課規定提出疑問。

tip: raid 諧音「瑞得」，瑞得很快衝進去搶了就跑
example: Pirates raided the harbor town at night and took gold from the market.
exampleZh: 海盜在夜裡襲擊港口小鎮，從市場搶走黃金。

tip: ransom 像 random 加 s：用錢換回人，不是隨便給
example: The family paid a large sum to ransom their kidnapped son.
exampleZh: 這家人付了一大筆錢贖回被綁架的兒子。

tip: rav 像 rave 狂亂，狂風掃過一片荒蕪
example: Years of war ravaged the countryside, leaving fields empty and homes broken.
exampleZh: 多年戰爭蹂躪了鄉村，田地荒蕪，房屋殘破。

tip: re 再 + cur 跑：跑回來再一次
