example: The museum keeps its oldest letters in a climate-controlled archive and will archive new documents every month.
exampleZh: 博物館把最古老的信件放在恆溫檔案庫中，而且每個月都會將新文件歸檔保存。

tip: micro 微小 + fiche 卡片：微小的卡片
example: Before digital scanning, librarians stored old newspapers on microfiche, tiny sheets that had to be read with a viewer.
exampleZh: 數位掃描出現之前，圖書館員把舊報紙存在縮微膠片上，得用閱讀機才看得到。

tip: mono 單一 + graph 寫：只寫一個主題的書
example: Her monograph on Roman roads, published by a university press, became the standard reference on the subject.
exampleZh: 她那本關於羅馬道路的專題著作由大學出版社出版，成為此主題的標準參考書。

tip: period 週期 + ical：每隔一段週期就出版
example: The library subscribes to hundreds of periodicals, from monthly science magazines to quarterly journals.
exampleZh: 圖書館訂閱數百種期刊，從月刊科學雜誌到季刊學術期刊都有。

tip: anth 花 + ology：像把一朵朵花摘成一束，選集就是精選作品
example: The poetry anthology collects works by thirty writers from the nineteenth century.
exampleZh: 這本詩選集收錄了十九世紀三十位作家的作品。

tip: com 一起 + pend 掛：把重點全掛在一本小冊子裡
example: The compendium summarizes the entire field of marine biology in a single, concise volume.
exampleZh: 這本綱要手冊把整個海洋生物學領域濃縮在簡明的一冊中。

tip: treat 處理：認真處理一個主題的長篇專論
example: Locke's famous treatise on government shaped political thinking in Europe and North America for generations.
exampleZh: 洛克那篇著名的政府論專著影響歐洲與北美的政治思想達數個世代。

tip: dis 分開 + course 跑：話題四處跑開，就是論述
example: Public discourse on artificial intelligence has shifted from excitement to careful debate about ethics.
exampleZh: 關於人工智慧的公共論述，已從興奮轉為對倫理的審慎辯論。

tip: 【托福學術】音節 col - lea - gue。常見於學術演講聽力與自然社科篇章，掌握核心字義「同事」能快速理解講者論述。
example: I'm a colleague of Tom's.
exampleZh: 我是湯姆的一位同事。

tip: intern 實習生 + ship 身分：當實習生的那段期間
example: During her summer internship at a hospital, Kim learned how nurses organize patient records.
exampleZh: 金在醫院的暑期實習中，學到護理師如何整理病患紀錄。

tip: mentor 像「門頭」：站在門口給你指路的人
example: A senior engineer agreed to mentor the new graduates and teach them how to solve real problems.
exampleZh: 一位資深工程師同意指導新進畢業生，教他們如何解決實際問題。

tip: protege 像「普羅特傑」：被保護(protect)的得意弟子
example: The famous painter proudly introduced his protege, a teenager who had already won two national art prizes.
exampleZh: 這位著名畫家驕傲地介紹他的門生，一位已經拿過兩次全國美術獎的少年。

tip: laurel 月桂葉：古人用桂冠獎勵勝利者
example: The Nobel laureate returned to her hometown school to inspire students with stories of her experiments.
exampleZh: 這位諾貝爾獎得主回到家鄉的學校，用自己的實驗故事激勵學生。

tip: e 出 + merit 功績：功績滿滿、光榮退下
example: Professor Emeritus Chang still visits the lab each week, though he retired from teaching ten years ago.
exampleZh: 張榮譽教授雖然十年前就退休不再授課，仍每週到實驗室走走。

tip: chancellor 像「千Sir-拉」：千位師生的大老闆
example: The chancellor announced that the university would freeze tuition for the next two academic years.
exampleZh: 大學校長宣布，未來兩個學年學費將凍漲。

example: As provost, she oversees all academic programs and works closely with each college's dean.
exampleZh: 身為教務長，她監督所有學術課程，並與各學院院長密切合作。

tip: dean 像「頂」：一個學院的頂頭人物
example: The dean of the medical college welcomed the new class and reminded them of their responsibilities.
exampleZh: 醫學院院長歡迎新生，並提醒他們肩負的責任。

tip: 【托福學術】音節 chair - per - son。常見於學術演講聽力與自然社科篇章，掌握核心字義「系主任」能快速理解講者論述。
example: She was appointed chairperson.
exampleZh: 她被任命為主席。

tip: advise 建議 + or 人：給你建議的人
example: My academic advisor helped me choose courses that fit both my interests and graduation requirements.
exampleZh: 我的學術指導老師幫我選了既符合興趣又滿足畢業要求的課。

tip: council 議會＋ lor：你可以找他商量的人
example: When Leo felt overwhelmed by exams, the school counselor taught him simple ways to manage stress.
exampleZh: 當里歐被考試壓得喘不過氣，學校輔導員教他幾個管理壓力的簡單方法。

tip: library 圖書館 + an 人：圖書館裡的人
example: The librarian showed us how to search the database for peer-reviewed articles about renewable energy.
exampleZh: 圖書館員教我們如何在資料庫中搜尋關於再生能源的同儕審查文章。

tip: cure 照料：照料展品的人，所以是館長或策展人
example: The curator selected twenty paintings for the exhibition and wrote a short description beside each one.
exampleZh: 策展人為展覽挑選了二十幅畫，並在每幅旁寫下簡短說明。

tip: bursar 像「爆煞」：錢一爆煞，就找管錢的人
example: A student who forgot to pay on time was told to visit the bursar to arrange a payment plan.
exampleZh: 一名忘了準時繳費的學生被告知要找出納主任安排分期付款。

tip: ombuds 代表 + person 人：替你說話的公正第三人
example: She filed a complaint with the campus ombudsperson, who investigated the dispute fairly and confidentially.
exampleZh: 她向校園申訴專員提出投訴，專員公正且保密地調查了這起爭議。

tip: proctor 像「怕客特」：怕你作弊，一直盯著你
example: A proctor walked between the desks to make sure no one looked at a classmate's paper.
exampleZh: 一位監考員在座位間走動，確保沒有人偷看同學的考卷。

tip: in + vigil 警醒：醒著看守考場的人
example: The invigilator collected the answer sheets as soon as the bell rang and counted them twice.
exampleZh: 鈴聲一響，監考人員立刻收回答案卷並清點了兩次。

tip: audi 聽：用耳朵聽課但不考試
example: Because he was curious about philosophy, Ben decided to audit the course without taking the exams.
exampleZh: 因為對哲學好奇，班決定旁聽這門課而不參加考試。

tip: waive 與 wave 同音：揮揮手，要求就免了
example: The college agreed to waive the language requirement for students who had studied abroad for two years.
exampleZh: 學院同意免除在國外讀過兩年書的學生的語言要求。

tip: de 離開 + fer 帶：把日期帶到後面去
example: Nina chose to defer her admission for a year so she could volunteer in a rural clinic.
exampleZh: 妮娜選擇延後一年入學，好到偏鄉診所當志工。

tip: with 向後 + draw 拉：把自己從課裡往後拉出來
example: If you withdraw from a class before the deadline, you will not receive a failing grade.
exampleZh: 如果你在截止日之前退選一門課，就不會得到不及格的成績。

tip: in 向內 + quire 尋求：往裡尋求答案
example: Several students wrote to inquire about the scholarship deadline and the documents required.
exampleZh: 幾位學生來信詢問獎學金截止日期與所需文件。

tip: clar 清楚（clear）+ ify 使成為：使變清楚
example: The teacher drew a diagram to clarify the difference between weather and climate.
exampleZh: 老師畫了一張圖，釐清天氣與氣候之間的差別。

tip: re 再 + iterate 重複：再重複一次
example: At the end of class, the instructor reiterated that the final essay must cite at least five sources.
exampleZh: 下課前，講師再次強調期末論文至少要引用五個來源。

tip: sum 總和：把內容加總成短短一段
example: Please summarize the main argument of the article in three sentences for tomorrow's discussion.
exampleZh: 請為明天的討論，用三句話歸納這篇文章的主要論點。

tip: para 旁邊 + phrase 語句：在旁邊換個說法
example: To avoid copying, Hana learned to paraphrase each source by restating its ideas in her own words.
exampleZh: 為了避免抄襲，哈娜學會用自己的話重述每個來源的想法，也就是改寫。

tip: example 例子 + ify 使成為：成為一個好例子
example: The ant colony exemplifies how simple individual behavior can create complex group organization.
exampleZh: 蟻群是個典範，說明簡單的個體行為如何形成複雜的群體組織。

example: The lecturer used a map of ancient trade routes to illustrate how ideas spread between cultures.
exampleZh: 講師用古代貿易路線圖來說明思想如何在不同文化間傳播。

tip: e 出 + lucid 明亮：把話說到發光，讓人看懂
example: Could you elucidate the second step? I understood the first but got lost afterward.
exampleZh: 你能把第二步講清楚嗎？第一步我懂，但之後就迷路了。

tip: de 完全 + monstr 顯示（monster 怪獸給人看）：秀出來給大家看
example: In the lab, the teacher will demonstrate how to measure the acidity of a liquid with indicator paper.
exampleZh: 在實驗室裡，老師會示範如何用試紙測量液體的酸度。

tip: de 向下 + line 線：一筆一筆畫出線條
example: In her opening chapter, the historian delineates the borders of the empire and the groups living inside them.
exampleZh: 歷史學家在開篇章節中精確描繪出帝國的疆界與居住其中的各個群體。

tip: ex 往外 + pound 放：把想法一件件擺出來講
example: The professor expounded on the causes of the French Revolution for nearly an hour without notes.
exampleZh: 教授不看筆記，花了將近一小時詳細闡述法國大革命的成因。

tip: spec 看 + ulate：像在看遠處猜測
example: Scientists can only speculate about what caused the dinosaurs' sudden decline, since direct evidence is scarce.
exampleZh: 由於直接證據稀少，科學家只能推測恐龍突然衰退的原因。

tip: con 一起 + ject 丟：把想法一起丟出去，沒證據的猜測
example: Early astronomers could only conjecture that the moon was far larger than it appeared in the sky.
exampleZh: 早期的天文學家只能猜想月亮比天空中看起來大得多。

tip: post 前面放 + late：先把前提放出來，當作假定
example: Einstein postulated that nothing travels faster than light, a claim that later experiments supported.
exampleZh: 愛因斯坦假定沒有任何東西比光速更快，後來的實驗支持了這項主張。

tip: syn 一起 + thesis 放置：把不同資料放在一起整合
example: Good researchers synthesize information from interviews, surveys, and old records into a single clear conclusion.
exampleZh: 優秀的研究者會把訪談、調查與舊紀錄的資訊綜合成一個清楚的結論。

tip: cor 一起 + robor 力量（robust 強壯）：加強力量支持
example: New fossil discoveries corroborate the theory that birds evolved from small dinosaurs.
exampleZh: 新的化石發現證實了鳥類由小型恐龍演化而來的理論。

tip: substance 實質：給論點添上實質內容
example: The author failed to substantiate her claim with data, so the committee asked for stronger proof.
exampleZh: 作者沒能用數據證實她的主張，所以委員會要求更有力的證據。

tip: re 回 + fute 打：把對方論點打回去
example: In her paper, Dr. Rao tried to refute the old belief that heavier objects always fall faster.
exampleZh: 拉奧博士在論文中試圖駁斥較重物體總是掉得較快的舊觀念。

tip: contra 相反 + dict 說：說出相反的話
example: The new survey results contradict earlier reports, which had claimed that sleep has no effect on memory.
exampleZh: 新的調查結果與先前主張睡眠對記憶沒有影響的報告相矛盾。

tip: re 回 + but 但是：用「但是」頂回去
example: The defense lawyer stood up to rebut each point the prosecutor had just made.
exampleZh: 辯護律師站起來，逐一反駁檢察官剛才提出的每個論點。

tip: con 完全 + cede 讓：退一步讓出來，承認對方說得對
example: After reviewing the data, the researcher had to concede that her original hypothesis was wrong.
exampleZh: 檢視數據後，這位研究者不得不承認她最初的假設是錯的。

tip: ac 朝向 + knowledge 知識：認可對方有知識貢獻
example: In the preface, the author acknowledges her advisor and the librarians who helped her find rare documents.
exampleZh: 作者在序言中致謝指導教授，以及幫她找到珍貴文件的圖書館員。

tip: dis 否 + claim 宣稱：不再宣稱屬於我
example: The company disclaimed any responsibility for errors in the data that were provided by outside sources.
exampleZh: 公司否認對外部來源提供的資料錯誤負有任何責任。

tip: inter 之間 + ject 丟：把話丟進別人談話中間
example: A student tried to interject during the lecture to ask whether the formula also applied to liquids.
exampleZh: 一名學生在講課中途想插話，問這個公式是否也適用於液體。

tip: di 離開 + gress 走：走離了原本的路
example: The speaker began with solar power but digressed into a long story about her grandfather's farm.
exampleZh: 講者從太陽能開始談起，卻離題講了很長一段關於祖父農場的故事。

tip: tangent 像「談讚」：越談越讚，卻離題了
example: When a student asked about ancient music, the lecture went off on a tangent about musical instruments.
exampleZh: 有學生問起古代音樂，課程便岔到樂器的話題上。

tip: re 再 + capit 頭（capital）：再回到頭部重點說一次
example: Before the quiz, the teacher recapitulated the three main causes of the war in two minutes.
exampleZh: 小考前，老師用兩分鐘扼要重述了戰爭的三個主要原因。

tip: over 在上方 + view 看：從高處俯瞰全貌
example: The first lecture gave an overview of the course, covering topics from ancient trade to modern markets.
exampleZh: 第一堂課概述整門課程，涵蓋從古代貿易到現代市場的主題。

tip: break 打破 + down 下來：把整體拆成小項目
example: The professor gave us a breakdown of the final grade: forty percent exams, thirty percent essays.
exampleZh: 教授向我們分項說明期末成績：考試占百分之四十，論文占百分之三十。

tip: as 朝向 + sign 簽名：被簽發給你的任務
example: Our biology assignment is to observe a pond for a week and record every animal we see.
exampleZh: 我們的生物作業是觀察池塘一週，並記錄看到的每種動物。

example: The deadline for submitting the research proposal is midnight on Friday; late papers will lose points.
exampleZh: 研究計畫書的繳交期限是週五午夜，遲交會被扣分。

tip: extend 延伸 → extension 就是延長出來的時間
example: Because she was sick for a week, Mia asked the instructor for an extension on her essay.
exampleZh: 因為生病一個星期，米亞向講師申請延長論文繳交期限。

tip: rubric 像「入布里克」：入榜前先看的分數表
example: The rubric explains exactly how many points each part of the presentation is worth.
exampleZh: 評分標準表清楚說明簡報的每個部分各占多少分。

tip: feed 餵 + back 回來：把意見餵回給作者
example: Her teacher's feedback on the draft pointed out unclear sentences and suggested better examples.
exampleZh: 老師對初稿的回饋指出了不清楚的句子，並建議更好的例子。

tip: criterion 像「快來錯里安」：評判對錯的標尺，複數是 criteria
example: One key criterion for the scholarship is a student's financial need rather than test scores alone.
exampleZh: 這項獎學金的一個關鍵準則，是學生的經濟需求，而不只看考試分數。

tip: e 出 + value 價值：把價值評估出來
example: At the end of the term, students fill out an evaluation of the course and the instructor.
exampleZh: 學期末，學生會填寫對課程和講師的評鑑表。

tip: as 旁邊 + sess 坐：坐在旁邊打分數的人
example: The final assessment includes a written test, a group project, and an oral presentation.
exampleZh: 期末評量包括一份筆試、一項小組專題和一場口頭報告。

zh: 形成性評量的、建構性的
tip: form 形成：學習還在成形中，邊學邊檢查
example: Weekly quizzes serve as formative assessment, helping teachers see which topics students still find confusing.
exampleZh: 每週小考屬於形成性評量，幫助老師了解學生仍覺得困惑的主題。

tip: sum 總和：學完之後加總成績
example: The final exam is a summative test that measures what students have learned during the whole semester.
exampleZh: 期末考是總結性測驗，衡量學生整個學期學到了什麼。

tip: cumulus 積雲：一朵朵堆起來，越堆越高
example: Studying a little every day produces cumulative progress, so small efforts eventually add up to major gains.
exampleZh: 每天讀一點會帶來累積的進步，所以小小的努力終究會匯聚成大成果。

tip: com 全部 + prehend 抓住：把全部都抓住
example: The comprehensive exam covers everything taught in the program, from basic theory to advanced methods.
exampleZh: 這場綜合考試涵蓋課程裡教過的一切，從基礎理論到進階方法。

tip: rigid 僵硬：標準硬邦邦，毫不放水
example: Admission to the medical program is rigorous, requiring top grades, long interviews, and years of volunteer work.
exampleZh: 醫學學程的入學標準嚴格，需要頂尖成績、冗長面試和多年的志工服務。

example: The historian was meticulous, checking every date and footnote twice before sending the book to the printer.
exampleZh: 這位歷史學家一絲不苟，把書送印前每個日期和註腳都檢查了兩遍。

tip: cur 跑（current 水流）：一路跑過去，看得很快
example: Running late, he gave the report only a cursory glance and missed the mistake in the table.
exampleZh: 他趕時間，只匆匆瞥了報告一眼，沒發現表格裡的錯誤。

tip: pro 向前 + found 底：往底部深處挖
example: Her lecture offered a profound insight into how language shapes the way people think.
exampleZh: 她的演講對語言如何塑造人們的思考方式提出了深刻的見解。

tip: shallow 像「蝦漏」：蝦子只在淺水裡漏出來，不夠深
example: The essay was shallow, repeating well-known facts without exploring why they matter.
exampleZh: 這篇文章很膚淺，只重複眾所周知的事實，卻沒探討它們為何重要。

tip: per 徹底 + suade 勸：徹底勸動別人
example: The lawyer gave such a persuasive speech that most of the jury changed their minds.
exampleZh: 律師的演說非常有說服力，大部分陪審員都改變了想法。

zh: 令人信服的、引人入勝的
tip: compel 強迫：逼你不得不相信
example: The documentary presents compelling evidence that the river's pollution came from a nearby factory.
exampleZh: 這部紀錄片提出令人信服的證據，顯示河川汙染來自附近的工廠。

zh: 令人信服的、論證嚴密的
tip: cogent 像「夠江特」：夠硬的論證，讓人無從反駁
example: Her cogent argument for building a new bridge convinced even the most skeptical council members.
exampleZh: 她主張興建新橋的論證嚴密有力，連最懷疑的議員都被說服了。

tip: flaw 裂縫 + ed：杯子有裂縫，就是有缺陷
example: The experiment was flawed because the sample was too small to give reliable results.
exampleZh: 這項實驗有缺陷，因為樣本太小，無法得到可靠的結果。

tip: fall 跌倒：邏輯一腳踩空，跌倒出錯
example: The argument is fallacious, since it assumes that because two events happened together, one must have caused the other.
exampleZh: 這個論證是謬誤的，因為它假定兩件事同時發生，就必定一個造成另一個。

zh: 語無倫次的、條理不清的
tip: in 不 + cohere 黏合：話黏不起來，一團亂
example: His answer was so incoherent that the committee could not tell what he was trying to argue.
exampleZh: 他的回答語無倫次，委員會聽不出他想主張什麼。

tip: lucid 與 lux 光有關：像打開燈，一切看得清楚
example: The textbook gives a lucid explanation of how vaccines teach the body to fight disease.
exampleZh: 這本教科書清楚說明疫苗如何教導身體對抗疾病。

tip: art 藝術 + i + culate：像藝術品一樣把話一節節說清楚
example: An articulate speaker, Jenna explained the complex theory so clearly that everyone understood, and she could articulate each step.
exampleZh: 珍娜口才清晰，把複雜的理論講得讓大家都聽懂，也能清楚說出每個步驟。

tip: e 出 + loqu 說話：話語自然流瀉而出
example: The senator gave an eloquent speech about education that brought many listeners to tears.
exampleZh: 參議員發表了一場關於教育的雄辯演說，讓許多聽眾落淚。

zh: 表達不清的、不能自圓其說的
tip: in 不 + articulate 表達清楚：反過來，說不清楚
example: Nervous and inarticulate, the young scientist struggled to explain his own results to the audience.
exampleZh: 這位年輕科學家緊張又表達不清，努力想向聽眾解釋自己的結果。

zh: 逐字逐句地、一字不差的
tip: 【托福學術】音節 ver - ba - tim。常見於學術演講聽力與自然社科篇章，掌握核心字義「逐字逐句地」能快速理解講者論述。
example: Sales of electric vehicles have grown verbatim over the past five years.
exampleZh: 電動車的銷量在過去五年間逐字逐句地成長。

tip: parlance 與 parlor 客廳：聊天時用的特定說法
example: In legal parlance, a minor is anyone under the age of eighteen.
exampleZh: 用法律術語來說，未成年人指的是任何未滿十八歲的人。

tip: jargon 像「雜根」：一堆雜亂的行話像草根亂長
example: The article was so full of technical jargon that ordinary readers could hardly follow it.
exampleZh: 這篇文章充滿專業術語，一般讀者幾乎看不懂。

tip: term 術語 + inology：一整套術語的體系
example: Biologists use precise terminology to name each species so that scientists everywhere understand each other.
exampleZh: 生物學家用精確的術語為每個物種命名，讓各地科學家能彼此理解。

tip: tecton 建造：研究地殼如何被建造與移動
example: Plate tectonics, the study of Earth's moving crust, helps geologists explain why earthquakes strike certain regions.
exampleZh: 板塊構造學研究會移動的地殼，幫助地質學家解釋為什麼某些地區容易發生地震。

tip: sediment 像「沙地門」：沙一點點沉下來，就是沉積物
example: Over millions of years, layers of sediment settled at the bottom of the lake and hardened into rock.
exampleZh: 數百萬年來，一層層沉積物沉到湖底，逐漸硬化成岩石。

tip: strat 層：一層一層穩定分開的大氣層
example: Airplanes often cruise in the stratosphere, where the air is thin and storms are rare.
exampleZh: 飛機常在平流層巡航，那裡空氣稀薄，也很少有風暴。

tip: trop 翻轉：空氣上下翻轉對流，天氣在這一層
example: Clouds, rain, and wind all occur in the troposphere, the lowest layer of Earth's atmosphere.
exampleZh: 雲、雨和風都發生在對流層，也就是地球大氣最底層。

tip: meso 中間 + sphere 球：位在大氣層中間那一層
example: Most meteors burn up in the mesosphere, which is why shooting stars appear high above the clouds.
exampleZh: 大多數流星在中氣層燃燒殆盡，所以流星會出現在雲層上方很高的地方。

tip: thermo 熱（thermos 保溫瓶）+ sphere：熱呼呼的大氣層
example: The space station orbits within the thermosphere, where temperatures can climb above a thousand degrees.
exampleZh: 太空站在熱層中運行，那裡的溫度可升到超過一千度。

tip: magma 像「馬格馬」：地下滾燙的馬路熱到融化
example: Deep below the volcano, magma slowly collects in a huge chamber before it erupts.
exampleZh: 在火山深處，岩漿在一個巨大的腔室中緩慢聚集，然後才噴發。

tip: lava 像「拉瓦」：火山一噴，大家快「拉」跑「瓦」
example: Once magma reaches the surface and flows out of a volcano, it is called lava and cools into black rock.
exampleZh: 岩漿一旦到達地表並從火山流出，就稱為熔岩，冷卻後變成黑色岩石。

tip: glacier 像「葛雷西爾」：冰河是「格外冷」的大冰塊
example: A glacier moves only a few centimeters a day, yet over centuries it can carve a deep valley.
exampleZh: 冰河每天只移動幾公分，但歷經數世紀卻能刻出一條深谷。

tip: glacier 冰河 + ation 過程：冰河形成與擴張的過程
example: Scientists study glaciation to learn how huge sheets of ice once covered much of North America.
exampleZh: 科學家研究冰河作用，以了解巨大冰層曾經如何覆蓋北美大部分地區。

tip: e 出 + rode 啃咬：一口一口把土啃走
example: Heavy rain and strong wind caused serious erosion along the coast, carrying away tons of soil each year.
exampleZh: 大雨與強風造成沿海嚴重侵蝕，每年帶走數噸泥土。

tip: weather 天氣 + ing：天氣日積月累把石頭弄碎
example: Weathering breaks large cliffs into small pieces through frost, rain, and the slow growth of plant roots.
exampleZh: 風化作用藉由霜凍、雨水和植物根部緩慢生長，把大型懸崖分解成小碎塊。

tip: crater 像「克雷特」：像大碗，一個圓形大洞
example: A huge crater in the desert shows where a meteorite struck the Earth thousands of years ago.
exampleZh: 沙漠裡一個巨大的隕石坑，顯示數千年前有一顆隕石撞擊地球。

zh: 破火山口、巨型火山陷落池
tip: caldera 像西班牙語「鍋」caldero：像一個大鍋子
example: When the volcano's magma chamber emptied, the ground collapsed and formed a vast caldera ten kilometers wide.
exampleZh: 火山的岩漿庫被掏空後，地面塌陷，形成一個寬十公里的巨大破火山口。

tip: celestial 像「誰雷斯提歐」：誰在天上？是星星
example: Ancient sailors used celestial bodies such as the sun, moon, and stars to find their way across the sea.
exampleZh: 古代水手利用太陽、月亮和星星等天體在海上辨明方向。

tip: terra 土地：站在泥土地上的，就是陸地的
example: Earth, Mars, and Venus are terrestrial planets, meaning they have solid, rocky surfaces rather than gaseous ones.
exampleZh: 地球、火星和金星是類地行星，意思是它們擁有固態岩石表面，而非氣態表面。

tip: extra 之外 + terrestrial 地球的：地球之外的
example: Some scientists believe that extraterrestrial life, if it exists, may be as simple as bacteria.
exampleZh: 有些科學家相信，外星生命如果存在，可能只像細菌一樣簡單。

tip: meteor 流星 + ite 石頭：掉到地上的流星石
example: Researchers examined a meteorite found in Antarctica and discovered it was older than the Earth itself.
exampleZh: 研究人員檢查了在南極洲發現的一顆隕石，發現它比地球本身還要古老。

tip: meteor 像「米提歐」：米粒大的光點在夜空飛過
example: We stayed up late to watch a bright meteor streak across the night sky.
exampleZh: 我們熬夜看一顆明亮的流星劃過夜空。

tip: aster 星 + oid 像：長得像星星的小石頭
example: An asteroid about the size of a city bus passed safely between the Earth and the moon last week.
exampleZh: 上週一顆約有城市公車大小的小行星安全地從地球與月球之間飛過。

tip: comet 像「康姆」：comb 梳子般的長長尾巴
example: Halley's comet returns to the inner solar system roughly every seventy-six years, trailing a long, glowing tail.
exampleZh: 哈雷彗星大約每七十六年回到內太陽系，拖著一條長長的發光尾巴。

tip: con 一起 + stella 星：星星聚在一起排成圖案
example: Orion is a winter constellation that people have recognized for thousands of years because of its three bright belt stars.
exampleZh: 獵戶座是冬季星座，由於三顆明亮的腰帶星，人們已辨認它數千年。

zh: 運行軌道；環繞軌道運行
tip: orbit 像「歐必特」：哦，必須轉一圈
example: The Moon takes about twenty-seven days to orbit the Earth, while the Earth itself orbits the sun.
exampleZh: 月球環繞地球一圈約需二十七天，而地球本身則環繞太陽運行。

tip: 【托福學術】音節 el - lip - tic - al。常見於學術演講聽力與自然社科篇章，掌握核心字義「橢圓形的」能快速理解講者論述。
example: Since the orbits are elliptical, the planets do not always have the same distance from the Sun.
exampleZh: 由於軌道是橢圓形的，行星和太陽之間的距離不會總是相同。

tip: nebula 拉丁文「雲」：天上的一團氣體雲
example: Inside the nebula, clouds of gas and dust slowly collapse and form new stars.
exampleZh: 在星雲內部，氣體與塵埃雲慢慢塌縮並形成新恆星。

tip: super 超級 + nova 新星：一顆突然超亮的新星
example: When a giant star runs out of fuel, it may collapse and explode as a supernova brighter than a whole galaxy.
exampleZh: 當巨大恆星耗盡燃料，可能塌縮並爆發成亮過整個星系的超新星。

tip: pulse 脈搏 + ar：像心跳一樣一下一下閃
example: A pulsar spins hundreds of times per second, sending out a regular beam like a cosmic lighthouse.
exampleZh: 脈衝星每秒旋轉數百次，像宇宙燈塔一樣發出規律光束。

tip: quasi 類似 + stellar 恆星：長得像恆星，其實超亮
example: Astronomers believe each quasar is powered by a supermassive black hole at the center of a distant galaxy.
exampleZh: 天文學家相信，每個類星體的能量都來自遙遠星系中心的超大質量黑洞。

tip: 黑洞像吸塵器，把光都吸進去，連光也逃不掉
example: Nothing, not even light, can escape from a black hole once it crosses the boundary near the center.
exampleZh: 一旦越過靠近中心的邊界，連光也無法從黑洞逃脫。

tip: galaxy 與 galaktos 牛奶有關：像灑出的一道牛奶河
example: Our solar system sits inside the Milky Way, a galaxy containing hundreds of billions of stars.
exampleZh: 我們的太陽系位於銀河系內，這個星系包含數千億顆恆星。

tip: solar 太陽 + flare 閃光：太陽突然「閃」出一道光
example: A powerful solar flare can disturb radio signals and even knock out power grids on Earth.
exampleZh: 強大的太陽閃焰可能干擾無線電訊號，甚至使地球上的電網停擺。

tip: sun 太陽 + spot 斑點：太陽臉上的小黑點
example: Galileo observed a dark sunspot moving across the sun and concluded that the sun rotates.
exampleZh: 伽利略觀察到一個暗色太陽黑子橫過太陽表面，因此推斷太陽會自轉。

tip: eclipse 像「一蹺立」：月亮一翹，把太陽擋住
example: During a total solar eclipse, the moon passes in front of the sun and turns day into twilight.
exampleZh: 日全食期間，月球走到太陽前方，使白晝變得像黃昏。

tip: lumin 光（illuminate 照亮）+ osity：發光的程度
example: Astronomers estimate a star's distance by comparing its luminosity with how bright it appears from Earth.
exampleZh: 天文學家比較恆星的光度與它在地球上看起來的亮度，來估算其距離。

tip: topo 地點 + graph 畫：把地方的高低畫成地圖
example: Satellite images revealed the topography of the island, showing steep mountains in the north and flat plains in the south.
exampleZh: 衛星影像顯示出島上的地形，北部是陡峭山脈，南部則是平坦平原。

tip: basalt 像「白色鹽」顛倒：黑黑的火山岩，不是白鹽
example: Hawaii's islands are made mostly of basalt, a dark rock formed when lava cools quickly.
exampleZh: 夏威夷群島主要由玄武岩構成，這種深色岩石是熔岩快速冷卻而成。

tip: gran 顆粒 + ite 石：由一粒粒晶體組成的石頭
example: Kitchen counters made of granite resist scratches and heat, so many people choose them for their homes.
exampleZh: 花崗岩廚房檯面耐刮又耐熱，所以許多人選它裝潢家裡。

tip: lime 石灰 + stone 石頭：由石灰質組成的石頭
example: Caves often form in limestone because rainwater slowly dissolves the soft rock over thousands of years.
exampleZh: 洞穴常在石灰岩中形成，因為雨水經過數千年慢慢溶解這種軟岩。

tip: sand 沙 + stone 石：沙子壓成的石頭
example: The old church was built of golden sandstone, a rock made of tiny grains pressed together over time.
exampleZh: 這座古老教堂以金黃色砂岩建成，這種岩石由細小沙粒經長時間壓實而成。

tip: shale 像 shell：像貝殼一片片剝開的薄岩
example: Fossils of fish were found in a thin layer of shale that once lay at the bottom of an ancient sea.
exampleZh: 魚類化石出現在一層薄薄的頁岩中，這些頁岩曾位於古海海底。

tip: strata 是 stratum 的複數，像一層層「史塔塔」疊起來
example: Geologists read the strata in the canyon wall like pages of a book, each layer marking a different age.
exampleZh: 地質學家像讀書頁一樣讀取峽谷壁上的地層，每一層代表不同的年代。

tip: strat 層 + ification 形成：一層一層分開的過程
example: The stratification of the lake water, with warm water floating above cold, prevents oxygen from reaching the bottom.
exampleZh: 湖水的成層現象使溫水浮在冷水上方，阻止氧氣到達湖底。

tip: 【托福學術】音節 fos - sil。常見於學術演講聽力與自然社科篇章，掌握核心字義「化石」能快速理解講者論述。
example: What I have in my hand is a fossil seashell.
exampleZh: 在我手裡的是一個貝殼化石。

tip: paleo 古老 + ology 學問：研究古老生物的學問
example: Paleontology uses fossils to reconstruct how ancient animals looked, lived, and changed over millions of years.
exampleZh: 古生物學利用化石重建古代動物的外貌、生活方式及數百萬年的演變。

tip: pre 先 + cip 頭：水從雲頭往下掉成降水
example: Annual precipitation in the rainforest exceeds three meters, mostly falling as heavy afternoon rain.
exampleZh: 雨林的年降水量超過三公尺，多半是午後的大雨。

tip: aqua 水 + fer 攜帶：帶著水的地層
example: Farmers in the dry region pump water from a deep aquifer, but the underground supply is slowly shrinking.
exampleZh: 乾燥地區的農民從深層含水層抽水，但地下水供應正慢慢減少。

tip: ground 地面 + water 水：藏在地面下的水
example: Rainwater slowly soaks into the soil and becomes groundwater, which many towns pump up for drinking.
exampleZh: 雨水慢慢滲入土壤成為地下水，許多城鎮把它抽上來飲用。

tip: per 穿過 + meable 走：水能一路穿過去
example: Sandy soil is highly permeable, so rainwater drains through it quickly instead of forming puddles.
exampleZh: 沙質土壤非常容易透水，所以雨水很快排掉，而不會形成水坑。

tip: im 不 + permeable 可滲透：水穿不過去
example: Clay is nearly impermeable, which is why ponds lined with it can hold water for months.
exampleZh: 黏土幾乎不透水，所以鋪了黏土的池塘能把水留住好幾個月。

tip: per 穿過 + colate 過濾：像咖啡濾杯慢慢滴下去
example: Percolation through layers of sand and gravel removes dirt, giving the city clean drinking water.
exampleZh: 水穿過沙層與礫石層的滲濾作用能去除髒汙，為城市提供乾淨的飲用水。

tip: seismic 像「賽絲米克」：賽，絲絲震動就知道
example: The seismic waves from the earthquake traveled through the planet and were recorded on the other side of the world.
exampleZh: 地震的震波穿過地球，在世界另一端被記錄下來。

tip: seismo 地震 + graph 畫：把地震畫成線的儀器
example: A seismograph in the basement drew a jagged line on paper whenever the ground shook.
exampleZh: 地下室裡的地震儀每當地面晃動，就在紙上畫出鋸齒狀的線。

tip: epi 在上 + center 中心：正好在震源上方的中心
example: The epicenter of the quake was located ten kilometers beneath a small farming town.
exampleZh: 這次地震的震央位在一個小農鎮地下十公里處。

tip: fault 與 fall 相近：地層裂開，一邊往下掉
example: The San Andreas fault runs for hundreds of kilometers, and the rocks on either side slowly slide past each other.
exampleZh: 聖安地列斯斷層綿延數百公里，兩側的岩石緩慢地相互滑動。

tip: fiss 裂開：像把魚刀切開（fish 發音）的長縫
example: After the earthquake, a long fissure opened in the road, and steam began to rise from it.
exampleZh: 地震之後，路面裂開一道長長的縫，蒸氣開始從中冒出。

tip: dorm 睡覺（dormitory 宿舍）：火山正在睡覺
example: Scientists consider the volcano dormant because it has not erupted in two hundred years, but it could wake up.
exampleZh: 科學家認為這座火山處於休眠狀態，因為它兩百年來未噴發，但仍可能甦醒。

tip: ex 出 + tinct 熄：火焰熄滅，不再活動
example: Unlike an active volcano, an extinct volcano will never erupt again because its magma supply has disappeared.
exampleZh: 與活火山不同，死火山永遠不會再噴發，因為它的岩漿來源已消失。

tip: geyser 像「蓋噎舍」：蓋子噎住，一下噴出水柱
example: Every ninety minutes, the geyser shoots boiling water thirty meters into the air, delighting tourists.
exampleZh: 這座間歇泉每九十分鐘就把沸水噴向三十公尺高空，讓遊客非常開心。

tip: c 是 ceiling 天花板：tite 緊緊（tight）掛在頂上
example: A stalactite hangs from the cave ceiling like an icicle, formed drop by drop from dissolved minerals.
exampleZh: 鐘乳石像冰柱一樣從洞頂垂下，由溶解的礦物一滴一滴形成。

tip: g 是 ground 地面：mite 從地面往上爬
example: Beneath each dripping stalactite, a stalagmite slowly grows upward from the cave floor.
exampleZh: 每一根滴水的鐘乳石下方，都有石筍從洞底緩緩向上生長。

tip: tundra 像「吞的拉」：凍得讓人吞口水的荒原
example: Few trees can grow in the tundra, where the ground stays frozen and winters last most of the year.
exampleZh: 苔原上幾乎長不出樹，因為地面一直結凍，冬天占了一年的大部分時間。

tip: perma 永久（permanent）+ frost 霜：永遠不化的霜
example: As permafrost thaws in Siberia, it releases gases that were trapped in the frozen ground for thousands of years.
exampleZh: 隨著西伯利亞的永凍層融化，它釋放出被困在冰凍土中數千年的氣體。

tip: hydro 水 + thermal 熱：熱水
example: Scientists found strange shrimp living near hydrothermal vents, where hot water gushes out of the ocean floor.
exampleZh: 科學家發現奇特的蝦子住在熱液噴口附近，那裡的熱水從海底湧出。

tip: geo 地球 + magnetic 磁性：地球像一塊大磁鐵
example: Birds may use the geomagnetic field to navigate, sensing Earth's magnetism the way a compass does.
exampleZh: 鳥類可能利用地磁場來導航，像指南針一樣感測地球的磁性。

tip: atmo 蒸氣 + sphere 球：包著地球的氣體球
example: Earth's atmosphere contains about twenty-one percent oxygen, which makes life possible on the surface.
exampleZh: 地球的大氣層含有約百分之二十一的氧氣，使地表生命得以存在。

tip: crust 是麵包硬皮：地球最外面那層硬殼
example: The crust under the oceans is thinner than the crust under the continents, averaging only seven kilometers.
exampleZh: 海洋下方的地殼比大陸下方的薄，平均只有七公里。

tip: mantle 是披風：披在地核外面的厚厚一層
example: Heat in the mantle causes slow, churning currents that push the plates of the crust across the planet.
exampleZh: 地函中的熱量引起緩慢的翻攪流動，推動地殼板塊在地球上移動。

tip: core 是蘋果芯：地球最裡面的核心
example: Earth's core, made mostly of iron and nickel, is almost as hot as the surface of the sun.
exampleZh: 地球的地核主要由鐵與鎳組成，溫度幾乎和太陽表面一樣高。

tip: continent 大陸 + drift 漂流：大陸像船一樣慢慢漂
example: Alfred Wegener proposed continental drift after noticing that the coasts of Africa and South America seemed to fit together.
exampleZh: 魏格納注意到非洲與南美洲的海岸線似乎能拼合，因而提出大陸漂移學說。

tip: plate 盤子 + tectonics 構造：地殼像一塊塊盤子在移動
example: Plate tectonics explains why mountains rise, volcanoes erupt, and earthquakes occur along the edges of moving slabs of rock.
exampleZh: 板塊構造學說解釋了為何山脈隆起、火山噴發，以及地震發生在移動岩板的邊緣。

tip: sub 下面 + duct 引導：被引到下面去
example: At the Japan Trench, the Pacific Plate sinks beneath another plate in a process called subduction.
exampleZh: 在日本海溝，太平洋板塊沉入另一塊板塊下方，此過程稱為隱沒作用。

tip: delta 是希臘字母 Δ：三角形的河口
example: Where the river meets the sea, it drops its sand and mud and builds a fertile delta.
exampleZh: 河流入海處會沉積沙泥，形成肥沃的三角洲。

tip: tribute 進貢：小河向大河進貢河水
example: The Missouri is a major tributary of the Mississippi, adding huge amounts of water as it joins the main river.
exampleZh: 密蘇里河是密西西比河的一條主要支流，匯入幹流時帶來大量的水。

tip: al 朝向 + luv 洗（lavatory 洗手間）：被水沖來的土
example: Farmers prize the alluvial plains because floods deposit rich, dark soil there each spring.
exampleZh: 農民珍視沖積平原，因為每年春天洪水都會在那裡留下肥沃的黑土。

tip: silt 像「西爾特」：水退後沉下去的細軟泥
example: After the flood receded, a thick layer of silt covered the fields and fertilized the soil.
exampleZh: 洪水退去後，一層厚厚的淤泥覆蓋了田野，也使土壤更肥沃。

tip: bed 床 + rock 岩石：所有土層下面的那張石床
example: Engineers drilled down to the bedrock before building the tower, so the foundations would not sink.
exampleZh: 工程師在蓋塔前先鑽到基岩，讓地基不會下沉。

tip: moraine 像「摸壤」：冰河退去後摸到的碎石堆
example: The long ridge of boulders and gravel is a moraine, left behind when the glacier melted and retreated.
exampleZh: 那道由巨石與礫石組成的長脊是冰磧，是冰河融化退去時留下的。

tip: fjord 像「飛喔」：船在峽灣中飛過，兩邊山壁高聳
example: Cruise ships glide between steep cliffs in the Norwegian fjord, a deep inlet carved by an ancient glacier.
exampleZh: 郵輪在挪威峽灣陡峭的懸崖間滑行，那是遠古冰河切出來的深海灣。

tip: archi 主要 + pelago 海：以海為主體，島嶼散布其中
example: Indonesia is an archipelago of more than seventeen thousand islands scattered across warm tropical seas.
exampleZh: 印尼是一個群島國家，有一萬七千多座島嶼散布在溫暖的熱帶海域。

tip: pen 幾乎 + insula 島：幾乎是島，只差一邊連陸
example: Italy is a long peninsula, surrounded by sea on three sides and joined to Europe by land on the fourth.
exampleZh: 義大利是一個狹長半島，三面環海，一面與歐洲相連。

tip: isthmus 的 th 不發音 th：像「艾斯母斯」，兩邊是海夾著細腰
example: The Isthmus of Panama is a narrow strip of land that links North and South America.
exampleZh: 巴拿馬地峽是連結北美洲與南美洲的一條狹長陸地。

tip: strait 與 straight 近：兩塊陸地夾出一條直直的水路
example: Ships bound for the Black Sea must pass through the narrow Bosphorus strait near Istanbul.
exampleZh: 前往黑海的船隻必須經過伊斯坦堡附近狹窄的博斯普魯斯海峽。

tip: plateau 像「破樓」：爬上破樓頂，平平的一片大平台
example: Few crops grow on the high plateau, where the air is thin and the winters are cold.
exampleZh: 高原上很少作物能生長，因為那裡空氣稀薄，冬天又冷。

tip: canyon 像「肯楊」：肯定很深，楊起頭才看到頂
example: Over millions of years, the Colorado River carved a vast canyon with walls over a mile high.
exampleZh: 數百萬年來，科羅拉多河切出一道壁高逾一英里的巨大峽谷。

tip: gorge 像「過去」：夾在高崖間一過去就是深谷
example: Hikers crossed a narrow bridge over the gorge, where a river rushed far below between steep rock walls.
exampleZh: 登山客走過峽谷上的窄橋，河水在陡峭岩壁之間於遠遠下方奔流。

tip: a 無 + byss 底：沒有底的地方
example: Deep-sea cameras revealed strange fish living in the abyss, thousands of meters below the sunlit ocean surface.
exampleZh: 深海攝影機拍到奇特的魚類生活在深淵中，位於陽光照得到的海面下數千公尺處。

tip: trench 像海底被大湯匙挖出一條又窄又長的深溝
example: The submarine mapped a deep ocean trench where two tectonic plates meet.
exampleZh: 潛水艇繪製了兩塊板塊交會處的深海海溝。

tip: ridge 諧音「瑞吉」，想像貓咪沿著屋頂的脊線散步
example: Hikers followed the narrow ridge to the summit, with steep slopes falling away on both sides.
exampleZh: 登山客沿著狹窄的山脊走向山頂，兩側都是陡坡。

tip: rift 像 gift 的 g 換成 r，禮物盒被撕開一道裂縫
example: A widening rift in East Africa may one day split the continent into two landmasses.
exampleZh: 東非不斷擴大的裂谷，有一天可能把大陸分成兩塊陸地。

tip: sediment 沉澱物 + ary，一層層疊起來像千層蛋糕
example: Fossils are usually found in sedimentary rock, which forms when layers of mud and sand are pressed together.
exampleZh: 化石通常出現在沉積岩中，它由層層泥沙壓實而成。

tip: meta 改變 + morph 形狀，像卡通角色變身後換了模樣
example: Intense heat and pressure deep underground turned the limestone into metamorphic marble.
exampleZh: 地底深處的高溫與壓力把石灰岩變成了變質的大理石。

tip: ig 像 ignite 點火，火變出來的岩石就是 igneous
example: Granite is an igneous rock, formed when molten magma cools slowly beneath the surface.
exampleZh: 花崗岩是火成岩，由熔融岩漿在地表下慢慢冷卻形成。

tip: mine 礦坑 + ral，從礦坑裡挖出來的就是 mineral
example: Salt is a mineral that miners dig out of ancient underground deposits.
exampleZh: 鹽是一種礦物，礦工從古老的地下礦床中開採出來。

tip: quartz 諧音「誇茲」，誇一誇這顆亮晶晶的水晶
example: Most of the sand on this beach is tiny grains of quartz worn down from mountain rock.
exampleZh: 這片海灘的沙大多是由山岩磨碎而成的細小石英顆粒。

tip: feld 田野 + spar 閃亮的石頭，田野裡閃亮的岩石就是長石
example: Pink feldspar gives this granite its color, and the mineral makes up much of Earth's crust.
exampleZh: 粉紅色的長石讓這塊花崗岩有了顏色，這種礦物也構成地殼的大部分。

tip: mica 諧音「麥咖」，像一頁頁可以撕開的亮片書頁
example: Thin sheets of mica peel off easily and shine like tiny mirrors inside the rock.
exampleZh: 薄薄的雲母片很容易剝落，在岩石裡像小鏡子一樣閃閃發亮。

tip: calc 石灰、鈣 + ite 礦物，含鈣的礦物就是方解石
example: Stalactites in the cave are made of calcite left behind by dripping water.
exampleZh: 洞穴中的鐘乳石是由滴水留下的方解石構成的。

tip: carbon 碳 + dating 約會，跟古物約會，問它幾歲了
example: Archaeologists used carbon dating to show that the wooden tool was about nine thousand years old.
exampleZh: 考古學家用碳定年法證明這件木製工具大約有九千年歷史。

tip: half 一半 + life 壽命，剩下一半所需的時間
example: Uranium has such a long half-life that billions of years pass before half of it decays.
exampleZh: 鈾的半衰期非常長，要經過數十億年才有一半衰變掉。

tip: iso 相同 + tope 位置，在週期表上占同一個格子
example: Carbon-14 is a radioactive isotope of carbon with the same protons but extra neutrons.
exampleZh: 碳14是碳的放射性同位素，質子數相同但多了中子。

tip: 像溫室玻璃把熱氣關住，地球被氣體蓋上了棉被
example: Without the greenhouse effect, heat would escape into space and Earth would be too cold for life.
exampleZh: 沒有溫室效應，熱量會散逸到太空，地球會冷到無法生存。

tip: global 全球 + warming 變暖，整個地球蓋了太厚的棉被
example: Scientists link global warming to melting glaciers and rising sea levels along low coasts.
exampleZh: 科學家把全球暖化與冰川融化及低窪海岸的海平面上升聯繫起來。

tip: ozone 諧音「喔鬆」，臭氧層是地球的防曬傘，破洞就要補
example: Chemicals once used in refrigerators damaged the ozone layer, which blocks harmful ultraviolet light from the sun.
exampleZh: 冰箱曾使用的化學物質破壞了臭氧層，而臭氧層能擋住太陽有害的紫外線。

tip: 【托福學術】音節 ul - tra - vio - let。常見於學術演講聽力與自然社科篇章，掌握核心字義「紫外線的」能快速理解講者論述。
example: Ultraviolet rays can cause skin cancer.
exampleZh: 紫外線可導致皮膚癌。

tip: 【托福學術】音節 in - frar - ed。常見於學術演講聽力與自然社科篇章，掌握核心字義「紅外線的」能快速理解講者論述。
example: People show up bright on an infrared camera because of their body heat.
exampleZh: 人會因為體溫而在紅外線攝影機上顯現。

tip: radi 像 radio 和 ray 射線，向四面八方放射出去
example: Doctors cover your body with a lead apron to limit exposure to radiation during an X-ray.
exampleZh: 做X光檢查時，醫生會用鉛衣蓋住你的身體，減少輻射的暴露。

tip: albedo 來自拉丁文 albus 白色，越白的東西越反光
example: Fresh snow has a high albedo, so it reflects most sunlight back into space instead of absorbing it.
exampleZh: 新雪的反照率很高，所以會把大部分陽光反射回太空而不是吸收。

tip: 熱水往上冒、冷水往下沉，像旋轉木馬一直轉圈
example: In a pot of boiling soup, convection carries hot liquid upward while cooler liquid sinks.
exampleZh: 在滾燙的湯鍋裡，對流把熱的液體往上帶，較冷的液體則下沉。

tip: con 一起 + duct 引導，熱沿著物體像水管一樣被送過去
example: A metal spoon left in hot tea soon feels hot because heat travels along it by conduction.
exampleZh: 放在熱茶裡的金屬湯匙很快變燙，是因為熱經由傳導沿著湯匙傳過來。

tip: monsoon 諧音「夢筍」，大雨一下，竹筍都冒出來了
example: The summer monsoon brings heavy rain to South Asia, and rice farmers depend on it.
exampleZh: 夏季季風為南亞帶來豪雨，種稻的農民都仰賴它。

tip: 【托福學術】音節 typ - hoon。常見於學術演講聽力與自然社科篇章，掌握核心字義「颱風」能快速理解講者論述。
example: super typhoon
exampleZh: The powerful typhoon brought heavy rain and strong gusts.

tip: hurricane 諧音「哈利肯」，哈利用力一吹，屋頂全飛走
example: Hurricane winds tore roofs off houses along the Florida coast before the storm weakened inland.
exampleZh: 颶風的強風掀掉了佛羅里達海岸房屋的屋頂，之後才在內陸減弱。

tip: tornado 諧音「偷那都」，龍捲風像小偷把東西全捲走
example: A tornado formed beneath the dark cloud and cut a narrow path through the farmland.
exampleZh: 一場龍捲風在烏雲下形成，在農地上劃出一條狹窄的路徑。

tip: cyc 像 cycle 腳踏車輪，一圈圈旋轉的風暴
example: Meteorologists tracked the cyclone as it spun across the Indian Ocean toward Bangladesh.
exampleZh: 氣象學家追蹤這個氣旋橫越印度洋、朝孟加拉移動的路徑。

tip: drought 裡有 out，雨都 out 了，天空沒水可下
example: After two years of drought, the reservoir was nearly empty and farmers lost most of their crops.
exampleZh: 連續兩年乾旱後，水庫幾乎見底，農民損失了大部分作物。

tip: a + rid，rid 是擺脫，把水全擺脫掉就乾透了
example: Cacti thrive in arid regions where less than ten inches of rain falls each year.
exampleZh: 仙人掌在每年降雨不到十吋的乾旱地區生長得很好。

tip: semi 一半，像 semicircle 半圓，再加 arid 乾旱
example: Much of the American Great Plains is semi-arid, so wheat farmers must use water carefully.
exampleZh: 美國大平原大部分地區屬半乾旱，所以種小麥的農民必須小心用水。

tip: desert 沙漠 + ification 變成，像 purification 一樣的變化過程
example: Overgrazing and tree cutting led to desertification, turning once-green pastures into dry, sandy land.
exampleZh: 過度放牧和砍樹造成沙漠化，使曾經翠綠的牧場變成乾燥的沙地。

tip: oasis 諧音「喔唉西絲」，旅人看到水，喔～唉～鬆了口氣
example: After days of walking, the caravan reached an oasis with palm trees and a clear spring.
exampleZh: 走了好幾天後，駝隊抵達一處有棕櫚樹和清泉的綠洲。

tip: dune 諧音「丟」，風把沙子一把一把丟成小山
example: Wind pushed the loose sand into a tall dune that slowly crept across the road.
exampleZh: 風把鬆散的沙子推成一座高高的沙丘，慢慢蓋過了馬路。

tip: photo 光 + synthesis 合成，用光合成出糖
example: Through photosynthesis, leaves use sunlight, water, and carbon dioxide to make sugar and release oxygen.
exampleZh: 葉子透過光合作用，利用陽光、水和二氧化碳製造糖並釋出氧氣。

tip: sym 一起 + bio 生命，大家一起生活
example: Clownfish and sea anemones live in symbiosis: the fish gets protection while the anemone stays clean.
exampleZh: 小丑魚與海葵共生：魚得到保護，海葵則保持乾淨。

tip: mutual 彼此的 + ism，互相幫忙的好朋友關係
example: In mutualism, bees gain nectar from flowers while the flowers gain a way to spread pollen.
exampleZh: 在互利共生中，蜜蜂從花得到花蜜，花則得到傳播花粉的方法。

tip: com 一起 + mensa 餐桌，同桌吃飯，但只有一方佔便宜
example: Barnacles on a whale illustrate commensalism: they get a free ride, and the whale is neither helped nor hurt.
exampleZh: 鯨魚身上的藤壺是片利共生的例子：藤壺免費搭便車，鯨魚既沒好處也沒傷害。

tip: parasite 寄生蟲 + ism，賴在別人身上白吃白住的關係
example: Tapeworm infection is a form of parasitism, since the worm feeds on its host and gives nothing back.
exampleZh: 絛蟲感染屬於寄生，因為蟲吸取宿主的養分卻毫無回報。

tip: camo 是迷彩服，穿上就和葉子混在一起，看不見你
example: The stick insect's camouflage is so good that it looks exactly like a twig on the branch.
exampleZh: 竹節蟲的偽裝太完美，看起來和樹枝上的小枝一模一樣。

tip: mimic 模仿 + ry，像默劇演員 mime 在模仿別人
example: The harmless hoverfly gains protection through mimicry, since its yellow stripes imitate those of a stinging wasp.
exampleZh: 無害的食蚜蠅靠擬態獲得保護，因為牠的黃色條紋模仿了會螫人的黃蜂。

tip: species 物種 + ation，產生新 species 的過程
example: Isolation on separate islands can lead to speciation, as each finch population slowly evolves into a distinct species.
exampleZh: 被隔離在不同島嶼上可能導致物種形成，因為每群雀鳥慢慢演化成不同的物種。

tip: bio 生命 + diversity 多樣，生命花樣越多越豐富
example: Rainforests hold extraordinary biodiversity, sheltering millions of plant, insect, and animal species in a small area.
exampleZh: 雨林擁有驚人的生物多樣性，在小範圍內庇護了數百萬種植物、昆蟲和動物。

tip: plume 羽毛 + age 總稱，一整身的羽毛打扮
example: The male peacock displays brilliant blue plumage to attract a mate.
exampleZh: 雄孔雀展示亮麗的藍色羽毛來吸引配偶。

tip: hibernate 諧音「嗨伯內」，冬天來了先打招呼再鑽進被窩睡
example: Bears hibernate through the winter, living off stored body fat inside a sheltered den.
exampleZh: 熊在冬天冬眠，靠儲存的體脂肪躲在隱蔽的洞穴裡過冬。

tip: hibernate 的名詞，冬天那一整段長長的睡眠
example: During hibernation, a ground squirrel's heart rate drops to only a few beats per minute.
exampleZh: 冬眠期間，地松鼠的心跳降到每分鐘只剩幾下。

tip: est 來自拉丁文「夏天」，與冬眠 hibernation 剛好相反
example: Some snails undergo estivation, sealing themselves inside their shells to survive a hot, dry summer.
exampleZh: 有些蝸牛會夏眠，把自己封在殼裡熬過炎熱乾燥的夏天。

tip: micro 微小 + bial 生物的，小小生物的
example: Microbial activity in the soil breaks down dead leaves and returns nutrients to the ground.
exampleZh: 土壤中的微生物活動會分解落葉，並把養分還給土地。

tip: organ 器官 + ism，由器官組成的完整生命
example: A single-celled amoeba is the simplest kind of living organism in this pond.
exampleZh: 單細胞的變形蟲是這座池塘裡最簡單的生物。

tip: habit 習慣 + at，動物習慣待著的地方
example: Wetlands provide a vital habitat for migrating ducks, frogs, and dragonflies.
exampleZh: 濕地為遷徙的鴨子、青蛙和蜻蜓提供重要的棲息地。

zh: 生態棲位、特定生態定位
tip: niche 諧音「你吸」，你吸這邊的蟲，我吸那邊的，各有角落
example: Each warbler species feeds in a different part of the tree, so every one fills its own niche.
exampleZh: 每種林鶯在樹的不同部位覓食，所以各自占有自己的生態棲位。

tip: adapt 適應 + ation，長出剛好合用的工具來配合環境
example: The thick fur of the Arctic fox is an adaptation that helps it survive freezing winters.
exampleZh: 北極狐濃密的毛皮是一種適應特徵，幫助牠熬過嚴寒的冬天。

tip: adapt 適應 + ive 有...性質，讓生物活得更好的
example: A long neck was an adaptive trait for giraffes that fed on tall acacia trees.
exampleZh: 長脖子對以高大金合歡樹為食的長頸鹿來說，是一項具適應優勢的特徵。

tip: forage 諧音「佛瑞居」，松鼠老是出門找吃的，不在家
example: Squirrels forage on the forest floor for acorns to store before winter arrives.
exampleZh: 松鼠在林地上四處尋找橡實，趁冬天來臨前儲存起來。

tip: pred 像 prey 獵物，predator 就是追獵物的角色
example: The wolf, a skilled predator, stalks elk herds for hours before choosing a weak animal.
exampleZh: 狼是技巧高明的掠食者，會跟蹤麋鹿群好幾個小時，才挑出虛弱的目標。

tip: predator 掠食者的名詞，掠食者所做的事
example: Heavy predation by cats has reduced the number of ground-nesting birds on the island.
exampleZh: 貓的大量捕食使島上在地面築巢的鳥類數量減少。

tip: prey 與 pray 同音，獵物在祈禱：拜託別抓我
example: Owls prey on mice, hunting silently in the dark with sharp hearing.
exampleZh: 貓頭鷹以老鼠為食，憑著靈敏的聽覺在黑暗中悄悄獵捕。

tip: Flora 是羅馬的花神，花神管所有的植物
example: The island's flora includes rare orchids found nowhere else on Earth.
exampleZh: 島上的植物群包括世界上別處找不到的稀有蘭花。

tip: Fauna 是羅馬傳說的森林女神，管所有的動物
example: Marine fauna on the reef includes sea turtles, rays, and thousands of colorful fish.
exampleZh: 這座珊瑚礁的海洋動物群包括海龜、魟魚和數千種色彩繽紛的魚。

tip: 【托福學術】音節 mamm - al。常見於學術演講聽力與自然社科篇章，掌握核心字義「哺乳動物」能快速理解講者論述。
example: A dolphin is a kind of mammal.
exampleZh: 海豚是一種哺乳動物。

tip: rept 有爬行的意思，像蛇和蜥蜴貼著地面爬
example: A lizard is a reptile, so it relies on warm sunlight to heat its scaly body.
exampleZh: 蜥蜴是爬行動物，需要靠溫暖的陽光讓有鱗片的身體暖起來。

tip: amphi 雙重 + bio 生命，過兩種生活：水裡和陸地
example: The frog is an amphibian: it begins life in water as a tadpole and later lives on land.
exampleZh: 青蛙是兩棲動物：牠一開始以蝌蚪的樣子在水中生活，後來住在陸地上。

tip: in 沒有 + vertebra 脊椎，沒有背骨的軟軟動物
example: An octopus is an invertebrate with no backbone, yet it solves puzzles remarkably well.
exampleZh: 章魚是沒有脊骨的無脊椎動物，卻很會解謎。

tip: vertebra 脊椎骨的骨節可以轉動，背上一串可彎的骨頭
example: Fish, birds, and humans are all vertebrates, each with a spine that supports the body.
exampleZh: 魚、鳥和人類都是脊椎動物，各有一條支撐身體的脊柱。

tip: para 旁邊 + site 食物，賴在別人旁邊白吃白喝
example: A tick is a parasite that attaches itself to a dog and drinks its blood.
exampleZh: 蜱是會附著在狗身上吸血的寄生蟲。

tip: host 是請客的主人，寄生蟲把你當成請它吃飯的主人
example: Mosquitoes spread malaria by carrying the parasite from one host to another.
exampleZh: 蚊子攜帶寄生蟲從一個宿主傳到另一個宿主，因而傳播瘧疾。

tip: pollen 花粉 + ation，把花粉送到另一朵花的過程
example: Bees carry pollen between blossoms, and this pollination allows apple trees to produce fruit.
exampleZh: 蜜蜂在花朵間帶著花粉，這項授粉讓蘋果樹得以結果。

tip: pollen 花粉 + ator 做事的人，花粉快遞員
example: Hummingbirds are the main pollinators of the red tubular flowers growing on this mountain.
exampleZh: 蜂鳥是這座山上紅色管狀花的主要傳粉者。

tip: germ 有「胚芽」的意思，小芽從種子裡冒出來
example: Bean seeds germinate within a week if the soil stays warm and moist.
exampleZh: 只要土壤保持溫暖濕潤，豆種一星期內就會發芽。

tip: germinate 的名詞，種子醒來伸出小芽的過程
example: Cold temperatures delay the germination of many seeds until spring arrives.
exampleZh: 低溫使許多種子延後到春天才發芽。

tip: chloro 綠色 + phyll 葉子，字面就是綠葉
example: Chlorophyll gives leaves their green color and captures the sunlight needed to make food.
exampleZh: 葉綠素使葉子呈現綠色，並捕捉製造養分所需的陽光。

tip: chloro 綠 + plast 小體，綠色的小工廠
example: Each chloroplast inside a plant cell is a tiny green factory where photosynthesis takes place.
exampleZh: 植物細胞裡的每個葉綠體，都是進行光合作用的綠色小工廠。

tip: cell 細胞 + ular 的，像手機 cell phone 一格一格的小單位
example: Cellular damage from too much sun can eventually lead to skin problems.
exampleZh: 曬太陽過度造成的細胞損傷，最後可能導致皮膚問題。

tip: gene 基因 + tics 學問，專門研究基因的學科
example: Her interest in genetics began when she noticed that every child in the family had red hair.
exampleZh: 她對遺傳學的興趣，始於注意到家裡每個孩子都是紅頭髮。

tip: mutation 像 X 戰警的 mutant 突變人，身體密碼改變了
example: A single mutation in one gene can change the color of a flower's petals.
exampleZh: 單一基因的突變就能改變花瓣的顏色。

tip: allele 諧音「阿里歐」，同一個位置上不同版本的兄弟
example: Brown eyes depend on a dominant allele, while blue eyes result from a recessive one.
exampleZh: 棕色眼睛取決於顯性等位基因，藍色眼睛則來自隱性等位基因。

tip: chromo 顏色 + some 小體，能被染上顏色的小東西
example: Humans normally have forty-six chromosomes, tightly coiled strands of DNA found inside each cell.
exampleZh: 人類通常有四十六條染色體，是每個細胞內緊緊纏繞的DNA長鏈。

tip: en 在裡面 + zyme 酵母，酵母裡的催化小幫手
example: An enzyme in saliva starts breaking down starch as soon as you chew bread.
exampleZh: 唾液中的酵素在你一咀嚼麵包時就開始分解澱粉。

tip: pro 第一 + tein，蛋白質是身體第一重要的建材
example: Eggs, beans, and fish supply the protein your muscles need to grow after exercise.
exampleZh: 蛋、豆類和魚提供肌肉在運動後生長所需的蛋白質。

tip: carbo 碳 + hydr 水 + ate，碳加水組成的東西
example: Rice and bread are rich in carbohydrate, which the body converts into quick energy.
exampleZh: 米飯和麵包富含碳水化合物，身體會將它轉化為快速的能量。

tip: meta 改變 + bol 像 ball，食物不斷被轉成能量
example: Because teenagers have a fast metabolism, they often feel hungry soon after eating a meal.
exampleZh: 因為青少年新陳代謝快，所以常在吃完飯不久後就覺得餓。

tip: metabolism 的形容詞，跟新陳代謝有關的
example: A metabolic disorder can prevent the body from turning food into usable energy.
exampleZh: 代謝疾病可能使身體無法把食物轉成可用的能量。

tip: re 再 + spir 呼吸，像 spirit，一吸一呼反覆進行
example: Cellular respiration in muscle cells releases energy from glucose and produces carbon dioxide and water.
exampleZh: 肌肉細胞中的細胞呼吸從葡萄糖釋放能量，並產生二氧化碳和水。

tip: eco 家園 + system 系統，大家同住一個家的系統
example: A pond ecosystem depends on the balance among algae, fish, insects, and the water itself.
exampleZh: 池塘生態系取決於藻類、魚、昆蟲與水本身之間的平衡。

zh: 生物群系（沙漠、熱帶雨林等）
tip: bio 生命 + ome 整體，一大片同類型的生命區域
example: Tundra is a cold biome with few trees, where the ground stays frozen most of the year.
exampleZh: 苔原是樹木稀少的寒冷生物群系，地面一年中大半時間都結凍。

tip: de 往下 + cid 落下，葉子一片片掉下來
example: Maple trees are deciduous, dropping their bright red leaves every autumn.
exampleZh: 楓樹是落葉性的，每年秋天都會掉落鮮紅的葉子。

tip: cone 毬果 + fer 帶著，會帶毬果的樹
example: Pine and fir are coniferous trees that bear cones and keep their needles through winter.
exampleZh: 松樹和冷杉是針葉樹，會結毬果，冬天也保有針葉。

tip: ever 永遠 + green 綠色，永遠都是綠的
example: Holly is an evergreen shrub whose glossy leaves stay bright even in snowy December.
exampleZh: 冬青是常綠灌木，即使在下雪的十二月，光亮的葉子依然翠綠。

tip: canopy 像床上的天篷，樹頂撐起一片綠色大傘
example: Sunlight barely reaches the ground because the dense canopy of the rainforest blocks it.
exampleZh: 因為雨林濃密的樹冠層擋住了陽光，陽光幾乎照不到地面。

tip: under 下面 + story 樓層，森林的一樓
example: Ferns and young saplings grow in the understory, where only dim light filters through.
exampleZh: 蕨類和幼樹長在林下層，那裡只有微弱的光線透進來。

tip: floor 是地板，森林的地板鋪滿了落葉
example: Fallen leaves and rotting logs cover the forest floor, feeding insects, fungi, and worms.
exampleZh: 落葉和腐木覆蓋著森林地表，餵養昆蟲、真菌和蚯蚓。

zh: 有毒液的主動分泌毒素的
tip: venom 是用咬的注入毒液，主動出擊才叫 venomous
example: A venomous snake injects poison through its fangs when it bites its prey.
exampleZh: 毒蛇咬住獵物時，會透過毒牙注入毒液。

zh: 含有毒素的被動食用有毒的
tip: poison 是吃下肚才中毒，被動的毒；咬人注毒則是 venom
example: Never eat wild mushrooms, because some are poisonous and can make you very sick.
exampleZh: 千萬別吃野生菇類，因為有些有毒，會讓你病得很重。

tip: noct 夜晚，像 nocturne 夜曲，夜晚才活躍
example: Owls are nocturnal, sleeping all day and hunting only after the sun goes down.
exampleZh: 貓頭鷹是夜行性動物，整天睡覺，太陽下山後才出去獵食。

tip: di 日子，像 diary 日記，白天活動的
example: Butterflies are diurnal insects, so you will see them only in daytime sunshine.
exampleZh: 蝴蝶是日行性昆蟲，所以你只會在白天的陽光下看到牠們。

tip: 想成薄如可麗餅 crepe 的晨昏微光，這時才出門
example: Deer are crepuscular, grazing at dawn and dusk when the light is soft and dim.
exampleZh: 鹿是晨昏活動的動物，在光線柔和昏暗的黎明與黃昏吃草。

example: Male robins are fiercely territorial and chase away any rival that enters their garden.
exampleZh: 雄知更鳥領域性很強，會趕走任何闖入花園的對手。

tip: dis 分開 + perse 灑，把種子分開灑出去
example: Wind assists the dispersal of dandelion seeds, carrying them far from the parent plant.
exampleZh: 風協助蒲公英種子的散播，把它們帶到離母株很遠的地方。

tip: herb 草本植物 + vore 吃，吃草的動物
example: A cow is a herbivore, grinding grass and leaves with its flat back teeth.
exampleZh: 牛是草食動物，用扁平的後牙磨碎青草和樹葉。

tip: carn 肉，像 chili con carne 墨西哥肉醬，+ vore 吃
example: The lion is a carnivore that eats only meat, mostly zebras and antelope it has caught.
exampleZh: 獅子是只吃肉的肉食動物，主要吃自己捕到的斑馬和羚羊。

tip: omni 全部 + vore 吃，什麼都吃
example: Humans are omnivores, so a balanced meal can include vegetables, grains, and meat.
exampleZh: 人類是雜食動物，所以均衡的一餐可以包含蔬菜、穀物和肉。

tip: detritus 碎屑 + vore 吃，專吃碎屑的清潔工
example: An earthworm is a detritivore, feeding on dead leaves and other bits of decaying matter in the soil.
exampleZh: 蚯蚓是食碎屑生物，以土壤中的落葉和其他腐爛碎屑為食。

tip: de 分開 + compose 組成，把組成的東西拆開
example: Warm, wet weather speeds up the decomposition of food scraps in a compost pile.
exampleZh: 溫暖潮濕的天氣加快了堆肥堆中廚餘的分解。

tip: decompose 分解 + er 者，大自然的回收員
example: Bacteria act as decomposers, turning a fallen log into rich soil over many years.
exampleZh: 細菌扮演分解者的角色，經過多年把倒下的木頭變成肥沃的土壤。

tip: fun 好玩 + gi，潮濕角落冒出一堆好玩的蘑菇
example: Fungi such as mushrooms and molds absorb nutrients from the dead plants they grow on.
exampleZh: 蘑菇和黴菌等真菌從所生長的枯死植物中吸收養分。

tip: spore 像 spray 噴灑，一噴出去就長出新菇
example: A single mushroom can release millions of microscopic spores that drift away on the wind.
exampleZh: 一朵蘑菇能釋放數百萬個微小的孢子，隨風飄走。

tip: algae 念「艾吉」，像池塘水面一層綠色毯子
example: Green algae floating on the lake surface produce oxygen, just as land plants do.
exampleZh: 漂浮在湖面的綠藻像陸地植物一樣會產生氧氣。

zh: 地衣（藻類與真菌共生體）
tip: lichen 念起來像 liken 比喻，一半像藻一半像菌
example: Lichen, a partnership between algae and fungus, grows slowly on bare rock in cold places.
exampleZh: 地衣是藻類與真菌的合作結合體，在寒冷的地方慢慢長在裸岩上。

tip: moss 諧音「貓絲」，像貓咪軟軟的綠毛毯
example: A soft carpet of moss covered the stones beside the stream in the damp forest.
exampleZh: 柔軟如地毯的苔蘚覆蓋著潮濕森林裡溪邊的石頭。

tip: vas 容器、管子，像 vase 花瓶和血管 vessel
example: Ferns and trees are vascular plants, with tube-like tissues that carry water up from the roots.
exampleZh: 蕨類與樹木是維管束植物，具有管狀組織把水從根部往上運送。

zh: 木質部（輸送水分與無機鹽）
tip: xylo 是木頭，xylophone 木琴；木頭做的水管
example: Water rises through the xylem from the roots to the leaves, much like through a thin straw.
exampleZh: 水經由木質部從根部升到葉片，就像通過一根細吸管。

tip: phloem 的 phlo 像 flow 流動，糖水往下流
example: Sugar made in the leaves travels down through the phloem to feed the roots and fruit.
exampleZh: 葉片製造的糖經由韌皮部往下運送，養活根部和果實。

tip: trans 穿過 + spire 呼吸，水氣從葉片呼出去
example: On a hot afternoon, transpiration lets a tree lose hundreds of liters of water through its leaves.
exampleZh: 炎熱的午後，蒸散作用讓一棵樹的葉子散失數百公升的水。

zh: 植物氣孔（呼吸蒸散調節）
tip: stoma 在希臘文是嘴巴，葉子上有無數張小嘴
example: Tiny stomata on the underside of a leaf open to take in carbon dioxide and let out water vapor.
exampleZh: 葉子背面的微小氣孔會打開，吸入二氧化碳並排出水蒸氣。

tip: epi 在上面 + derm 皮膚，皮膚最上面那一層
example: The epidermis is the thin outer layer of skin that shields the body from dirt and germs.
exampleZh: 表皮是皮膚薄薄的最外層，保護身體不受髒汙和細菌侵害。

tip: cut 像 cutis 皮膚 + icle 小，小小的一層外皮
example: A waxy cuticle covers the leaf surface and keeps the plant from drying out.
exampleZh: 蠟質的角質層覆蓋葉面，避免植物乾枯。

tip: carapace 諧音「卡拉背司」，背上卡著一個硬殼
example: A turtle can pull its head into its hard carapace whenever danger approaches.
exampleZh: 每當危險靠近時，烏龜就能把頭縮進堅硬的背甲裡。

tip: exo 外面 + skeleton 骨骼，骨頭長在身體外面
example: A crab's exoskeleton protects its soft body, but it must be shed as the animal grows.
exampleZh: 螃蟹的外骨骼保護柔軟的身體，但隨著成長必須脫掉。

tip: endo 內部 + skeleton 骨骼，骨頭藏在身體裡面
example: Unlike insects, a dog has an endoskeleton of bone that grows along with its body.
exampleZh: 與昆蟲不同，狗有骨頭構成的內骨骼，會隨身體一起成長。

tip: molt 像 melt 融化，舊衣服掉了，換上新裝
example: Molting birds drop their old feathers in late summer and grow a fresh set before winter.
exampleZh: 換羽期的鳥在夏末脫落舊羽毛，並在冬天前長出一批新的。

tip: meta 改變 + morph 形狀 + osis 過程，變形記
example: A caterpillar undergoes complete metamorphosis, changing into a winged butterfly in a few weeks.
exampleZh: 毛毛蟲經歷完全變態，在幾週內變成有翅膀的蝴蝶。

tip: larva 拉丁文有「面具」之意，幼蟲還戴著面具，不是成蟲的樣子
example: The larva of a beetle lives underground, feeding on roots until it is ready to change.
exampleZh: 甲蟲的幼蟲生活在地下，吃著根部，直到準備好變態。

tip: pupa 拉丁文是「娃娃」，包得像小娃娃一動也不動
example: Inside the pupa, the caterpillar's body is completely rebuilt into its adult form.
exampleZh: 在蛹裡面，毛毛蟲的身體被完全重建成成蟲的形態。

tip: cocoon 中間兩個 oo 像蟲寶寶睜大的眼睛，躲在繭裡看外面
example: The silkworm spins a cocoon of fine thread and waits inside until it emerges as a moth.
exampleZh: 蠶用細絲吐出一個繭，在裡面等待，直到變成蛾破繭而出。

tip: chrys 是金色，像 chrysanthemum 菊花，有些蝶蛹閃著金光
example: The green chrysalis hung beneath the leaf until the monarch butterfly finally broke free.
exampleZh: 綠色的蝶蛹掛在葉子底下，直到帝王斑蝶終於破蛹而出。

tip: juven 是年輕，像 rejuvenate 回春，還年輕的
example: Juvenile salmon spend months in the river before swimming out to the ocean.
exampleZh: 幼年的鮭魚在游向大海前，會在河裡度過好幾個月。

zh: 野生化的、野生未馴化的
tip: feral 諧音「非熱」，被丟棄後對人不再熱情，回到野外
example: Feral cats living in the alley hunt rats and avoid all contact with people.
exampleZh: 住在小巷裡的野化貓會獵捕老鼠，並避免和人接觸。

tip: dom 家，像 domestic 家庭的，被帶回家養的
example: Dogs were domesticated thousands of years ago, when wolves began following hunters to eat their scraps.
exampleZh: 狗在數千年前被馴化，當時狼開始跟著獵人吃他們剩下的食物。

tip: selective 挑選 + breeding 繁殖，人挑最好的來生下一代
example: Through selective breeding, farmers produced sweeter corn by planting only the best kernels each year.
exampleZh: 透過選育，農民每年只種最好的玉米粒，培育出更甜的玉米。

tip: 大自然當裁判，不合適的被淘汰，合適的留下來
example: Under natural selection, moths with darker wings survived on soot-covered trees because birds could not see them.
exampleZh: 在天擇之下，翅膀較深色的蛾能在被煤煙覆蓋的樹上存活，因為鳥看不到牠們。

tip: fittest 是最合身，衣服最合身的才能活下來
example: Darwin's idea of survival of the fittest means animals best matched to their environment leave the most offspring.
exampleZh: 達爾文的適者生存概念是指，最適應環境的動物會留下最多的後代。

tip: drift 是漂流，基因像小船隨機漂，沒有人在划槳
example: In a tiny island population, genetic drift can make a rare trait common purely by chance.
exampleZh: 在小島的小族群中，遺傳漂變能純粹靠機率讓罕見性狀變得普遍。

tip: pool 是游泳池，全族群的基因都泡在同一個池子裡
example: Bringing in a few outside animals enlarged the gene pool of the isolated wolf population.
exampleZh: 引進幾隻外來動物，擴大了這群孤立狼群的基因庫。

tip: en 使成為 + danger 危險 + ed，被推進危險裡的
example: The giant panda was once endangered, with only a few hundred left in the wild.
exampleZh: 大貓熊曾經瀕臨絕種，野外只剩下幾百隻。

tip: vuln 是傷口，身上有傷口，更容易再受傷
example: Newly hatched sea turtles are vulnerable to birds as they crawl across the open beach.
exampleZh: 剛孵化的海龜爬過空曠的海灘時，很容易遭到鳥類攻擊。

tip: poach 是偷偷闖進別人的地盤抓動物，像小偷偷蛋
example: Poaching has pushed the rhino to the brink, since hunters sell its horn on the black market.
exampleZh: 盜獵把犀牛逼到了滅絕邊緣，因為獵人把牠的角賣到黑市。

tip: con 一起 + serve 保存，大家一起把它保存好
example: Wildlife conservation groups work with villagers to protect elephants and their forest homes.
exampleZh: 野生動物保育團體與村民合作，保護大象和牠們的森林家園。

zh: 自然保護區、野生庇護所
tip: sanct 是神聖，像 saint 聖人，神聖而不可侵犯的安全地
example: The marsh was declared a bird sanctuary, so hunting there is now forbidden.
exampleZh: 這片沼澤被宣布為鳥類保護區，所以現在禁止在那裡狩獵。

tip: carry 承載 + capacity 容量，環境這輛卡車最多能載多少
example: The meadow's carrying capacity is about fifty deer; beyond that number, they will run short of food.
exampleZh: 這片草地的承載量約為五十頭鹿，超過這個數量，牠們就會缺乏食物。

tip: troph 是營養，像一層層吃東西的階梯
example: A hawk sits at a higher trophic level than a mouse because it eats animals that eat plants.
exampleZh: 老鷹的營養階層比老鼠高，因為牠吃的是吃植物的動物。

tip: web 是蜘蛛網，誰吃誰連成一張網而不是一條線
example: Remove one species and the whole food web, with its tangled feeding links, can shift.
exampleZh: 拿走一個物種，整張交錯著取食關係的食物網就可能改變。

zh: 關鍵物種（決定生態穩定）
tip: keystone 是拱門頂端的楔石，一抽掉整座拱門就垮
example: Sea otters are a keystone species: by eating urchins, they keep kelp forests from disappearing.
exampleZh: 海獺是關鍵物種：牠們吃海膽，讓海帶森林不致消失。

tip: invade 入侵 + ive，闖進別人家搶地盤的物種
example: Zebra mussels, an invasive species, clog pipes and crowd out native shellfish across the Great Lakes.
exampleZh: 斑馬貽貝是入侵物種，堵塞管線，並排擠五大湖各地的原生貝類。

tip: native 是本地人，從小就在這裡長大的物種
example: Planting native species helps local birds, because they already depend on those plants for food.
exampleZh: 種植原生物種對本地鳥類有益，因為牠們本來就靠這些植物當食物。

tip: en 在裡面 + dem 地方人民，只在這個地方才有
example: Lemurs are endemic to Madagascar, meaning they live wild nowhere else in the world.
exampleZh: 狐猴是馬達加斯加特有的，意思是世界上其他地方都沒有野生的牠們。

tip: mono 單一 + culture 栽培，一整片只種一種
example: Planting wheat across one vast monoculture lets a single disease wipe out the entire harvest.
exampleZh: 把小麥種滿一大片單一栽培的田，一種病害就可能毀掉整季收成。

tip: poly 多 + culture 栽培，一塊田種很多種
example: In a polyculture, farmers grow beans, corn, and squash together so each crop helps the others.
exampleZh: 在多元間作中，農民把豆、玉米和南瓜種在一起，讓每種作物互相幫助。

example: Spraying a pesticide on the cabbages removed the caterpillars but also harmed nearby bees.
exampleZh: 在高麗菜上噴殺蟲劑除掉了毛毛蟲，卻也傷害了附近的蜜蜂。

example: Farmers use herbicide to clear weeds from the field before planting soybeans.
exampleZh: 農民在種大豆前，用除草劑清除田裡的雜草。

tip: fertile 肥沃 + izer 使成為，讓土地變肥沃的東西
example: Adding fertilizer to poor soil gives plants the nitrogen they need to grow tall.
exampleZh: 在貧瘠的土壤中加肥料，能提供植物長高所需的氮。

tip: eu 好 + troph 營養，營養太好了，反而出事
example: Fertilizer runoff caused eutrophication in the lake, and the water slowly turned murky green.
exampleZh: 肥料流失造成湖泊優養化，湖水慢慢變成混濁的綠色。

tip: bloom 是花開，藻像花一樣突然大量綻放
example: A thick algal bloom spread across the bay in summer and turned the water bright green.
exampleZh: 夏天一大片藻華在海灣擴散，把海水染成鮮綠色。

tip: bleach 是漂白水，珊瑚被漂白成了雪白
example: Warmer seas triggered coral bleaching, leaving the once-colorful reef a pale, ghostly white.
exampleZh: 海水變暖引發珊瑚白化，讓曾經繽紛的珊瑚礁變成蒼白的白色。

tip: acid 酸 + ify 變成，海水一點一點變酸
example: Ocean acidification occurs when seawater absorbs extra carbon dioxide, making it harder for shellfish to build shells.
exampleZh: 海洋酸化發生在海水吸收過多二氧化碳時，使貝類更難形成外殼。

tip: condition 條件，在某個條件下就做出固定反應
example: Through conditioning, the dog learned to drool whenever it heard the sound of its food bowl.
exampleZh: 透過制約，那隻狗學會了每次聽到食盆的聲音就流口水。

tip: 巴夫洛夫的鈴聲加口水：鈴一響，就流口水
example: Pavlov demonstrated classical conditioning when dogs began salivating at a bell that always came before food.
exampleZh: 巴夫洛夫示範了古典制約：狗開始對總在食物之前響起的鈴聲流口水。

tip: operate 操作，動物自己動手操作，結果決定下次還做不做
example: Operant conditioning explains why a rat presses a lever more often when each press delivers a food pellet.
exampleZh: 操作制約說明了為什麼老鼠在每按一次拉桿就得到一顆食物時，會更常按拉桿。

tip: re 再 + inforce 加強，獎勵讓行為再被加強一次
example: Praise from the teacher served as reinforcement, encouraging the shy student to speak up again.
exampleZh: 老師的稱讚成了強化，鼓勵害羞的學生再次發言。

tip: positive 像加號 +，加上好東西讓行為增加
example: Giving a puppy a treat each time it sits is positive reinforcement that makes sitting more likely.
exampleZh: 小狗每次坐下就給牠點心，是讓坐下更常發生的正向強化。

zh: 負向強化消除厭惡刺激
tip: negative 像減號 −，拿走討厭的東西，行為反而增加，不是處罰
example: Fastening the seat belt stops the annoying alarm, so the beeping is a case of negative reinforcement.
exampleZh: 繫上安全帶就會停止惱人的警報聲，所以那個嗶嗶聲屬於負向強化。

tip: co + gnit 知道，像 recognize 認出，腦中理解的過程
example: Studies of infant cognition show that babies notice patterns long before they can speak.
exampleZh: 嬰兒認知的研究顯示，寶寶在會說話之前很久就能察覺規律。

tip: dissonance 是不和諧的音，腦中兩個想法唱反調，像走音
example: Cognitive dissonance made him uneasy: he cared about the planet, yet he drove a gas-guzzling truck every day.
exampleZh: 認知失調讓他很不安：他關心地球，卻天天開著耗油的卡車。

tip: per 透過 + cept 接收，像 receive，透過感官接收再理解
example: Our perception of color depends on how the brain interprets the light that enters the eye.
exampleZh: 我們對顏色的感知，取決於大腦如何詮釋進入眼睛的光線。

tip: sense 感覺 + ory 的，跟感覺有關的
example: Sensory neurons in the fingertips send signals to the brain whenever something feels hot or rough.
exampleZh: 指尖的感覺神經元在東西摸起來燙或粗糙時，會把訊號送往大腦。

tip: stimulus 像 stimulate 刺激，貼心地戳一下讓你有反應
example: A sudden loud noise is a stimulus that makes a baby's arms fly outward.
exampleZh: 突然的巨響是一種刺激，會讓嬰兒的雙臂向外彈開。

tip: re 回 + spond 承諾，別人問一下就回一下
example: The patient's response to the medicine was quick: her fever dropped within an hour.
exampleZh: 病人對藥物的反應很快：她的燒在一小時內就退了。

tip: sub 在下面 + conscious 有意識的，意識底下的地下室
example: Subconscious fears can shape our choices even when we are not aware of them.
exampleZh: 潛意識的恐懼，即使我們沒有察覺，也能左右我們的選擇。

tip: un 沒有 + conscious 有意識的；sub 是在下面，un 是完全沒有
example: After the fall, the cyclist lay unconscious on the road until paramedics arrived.
exampleZh: 摔倒後，那位自行車騎士昏迷地躺在路上，直到救護人員抵達。

zh: 捷思法啟發式規則；啟發的
tip: heuristic 念起來像 Eureka 找到了，用小竅門快速找到答案
example: Choosing the restaurant with the longest line is a simple heuristic that often saves time.
exampleZh: 選擇排隊最長的餐廳是個簡單的捷思法，常能省下時間。

tip: in 內心 + tuit 看，不用推理，內心直接看見答案
example: Her intuition told her the deal was too good to be true, and she was right.
exampleZh: 她的直覺告訴她這筆交易好得不像真的，結果她說對了。

zh: 原型典範、心理集體原型
tip: arche 最初 + type 類型，最原始的那個模板
example: The wise old mentor is a common archetype that appears in myths, fairy tales, and modern films.
exampleZh: 睿智的老導師是常見的原型，出現在神話、童話和現代電影中。

tip: in 裡面本來就有的衝動，不用人教就會做
example: A newborn sea turtle follows its instinct and heads straight for the ocean.
exampleZh: 剛出生的海龜憑著本能直奔大海。

zh: 從眾行為、順從團體規範
tip: con 一起 + form 形狀，大家變成同一個形狀
example: Peer pressure encourages conformity, as teenagers dress alike to avoid standing out from the group.
exampleZh: 同儕壓力助長從眾行為，青少年為了不在團體中顯得突出而穿得一樣。

tip: comply 照辦 + ance，老師說完，你回答：好，我照辦
example: Strict compliance with safety rules is required before anyone may enter the laboratory.
exampleZh: 任何人進入實驗室之前，都必須嚴格遵守安全規定。

tip: ob 朝向 + ey 聽，朝著權威的方向乖乖聽話
example: In Milgram's experiment, many volunteers showed surprising obedience to an authority figure in a lab coat.
exampleZh: 在米爾格蘭的實驗中，許多受試者對穿著實驗袍的權威人物表現出令人驚訝的服從。

tip: alien 外星人，覺得自己像外星人，和大家格格不入
example: Moving to a huge city alone left her with a deep sense of alienation from those around her.
exampleZh: 獨自搬到大城市，使她對周遭的人產生深深的疏離感。

tip: anthrop 人 + ology 學問，研究人類的學問
example: Anthropology students spend years comparing how different cultures raise children and honor their ancestors.
exampleZh: 人類學的學生花好幾年比較不同文化如何養育孩子、尊崇祖先。

tip: ethno 民族 + graph 書寫，把一個民族寫下來
example: Her ethnography was based on two years of living in a fishing village and recording daily life.
exampleZh: 她的民族誌建立在兩年的漁村生活和日常記錄之上。

tip: dia 穿過 + spora 撒種子，族群像種子被撒到世界各地
example: The Armenian diaspora includes millions who live outside their homeland, from Paris to Los Angeles.
exampleZh: 亞美尼亞人的離散社群包括數百萬居住在家鄉之外的人，從巴黎到洛杉磯都有。

tip: hier 神聖 + arch 統治，一層層往上，像金字塔
example: In a medieval hierarchy, kings ranked above nobles, and nobles above peasants.
exampleZh: 在中世紀的階級體系中，國王高於貴族，貴族又高於農民。

tip: egal 來自 equal 平等，人人都一樣高
example: The tribe had an egalitarian culture in which every adult had an equal voice in decisions.
exampleZh: 這個部落有平等主義的文化，每位成人在決策上都有同等的發言權。

zh: 定居的；久坐活動量少的
tip: sed 是坐，像 session 開會要坐著，一直坐著不動
example: A sedentary lifestyle, spent mostly sitting at a desk, raises the risk of heart disease.
exampleZh: 大部分時間坐在桌前的久坐生活方式，會增加罹患心臟病的風險。

tip: nomadic 諧音「諾馬迪克」，逐水草而居、四處搬家的人
example: The nomadic herders move their sheep to new grassland each season, carrying their tents with them.
exampleZh: 游牧的牧民每季都把羊群趕到新的草地，並隨身帶著帳篷。

tip: pastor 原意是牧羊人，帶領羊群的人，+ al 的
example: Pastoral societies raise herds of cattle and goats instead of growing crops.
exampleZh: 畜牧社會飼養牛群和山羊，而不是種植作物。

tip: agr 是田地，像 agriculture 農業，+ arian 的
example: The agrarian economy of the valley depended on wheat, barley, and the yearly flooding of the river.
exampleZh: 這個河谷的農業經濟依賴小麥、大麥和河水每年的氾濫。

zh: 採集狩獵部落原始族群
tip: hunter 獵人 + gatherer 採集者，又打獵又撿果子
example: As hunter-gatherers, early humans moved with the seasons to find animals to hunt and plants to collect.
exampleZh: 身為採集狩獵者，早期人類隨季節遷移，尋找可獵捕的動物和可採集的植物。

tip: forage 覓食 + er 做事的人，到處撿食物的人
example: Each morning the forager wandered the woods, filling a basket with berries, nuts, and wild herbs.
exampleZh: 採集者每天早上在樹林裡漫步，把野莓、堅果和野生香草裝滿一籃子。

tip: kin 親人 + ship 關係，像 friendship，親人之間的連結
example: Among the islanders, kinship determines who may marry whom and who inherits the family land.
exampleZh: 在島民之間，親屬關係決定誰可以嫁娶誰，以及誰繼承家族土地。

tip: matri 母親，像 maternal，lineal 血統線，沿著媽媽這條線傳下去
example: In a matrilineal society, a child belongs to the mother's clan and inherits through her family.
exampleZh: 在母系社會裡，孩子屬於母親的氏族，並透過母親的家族繼承財產。

tip: patri 父親，像 paternal，lineal 血統線，沿著爸爸這條線傳下去
example: The family name passes along a patrilineal line, from father to son across many generations.
exampleZh: 姓氏沿著父系一脈傳承，世世代代由父親傳給兒子。

tip: matri 母親 + archy 統治，像 monarchy，媽媽當家作主
example: In a matriarchy, women hold the main positions of power and leadership in the community.
exampleZh: 在母權社會中，女性擔任社群裡主要的權力與領導職位。

tip: patri 父親 + archy 統治，爸爸當家作主
example: Historians describe ancient Rome as a patriarchy, since only men could vote or hold high office.
exampleZh: 歷史學家把古羅馬描述為父權社會，因為只有男性能投票或擔任高官。

tip: mono 單一 + gamy 婚姻，只有一位伴侶
example: Swans are known for monogamy, often staying with a single partner for life.
exampleZh: 天鵝以一夫一妻聞名，常終生只守著一個伴侶。

tip: poly 多 + gamy 婚姻，像 polygon 多邊形，伴侶有好幾位
example: Polygamy, in which a man has several wives, is illegal in most countries today.
exampleZh: 一夫多妻制，即一名男子有數位妻子，在現今大多數國家是違法的。

tip: clan 和 plan 只差一個字母，家族大事大家一起商量
example: Each Scottish clan had its own tartan pattern and a chief who led its members.
exampleZh: 蘇格蘭的每個氏族都有自己的格紋圖案，以及領導族人的族長。

tip: tribe 和 bribe 只差一個字母，部落裡大家是一家，不用賄賂
example: Members of the tribe gather around a fire to share stories and celebrate the harvest.
exampleZh: 部落成員圍著營火分享故事，並慶祝豐收。

tip: chief 首領 + tain，領頭的那個人
example: The chieftain settled disputes between families and led warriors whenever a neighboring tribe threatened the village.
exampleZh: 酋長調解家族之間的糾紛，並在鄰近部落威脅村莊時率領戰士。

tip: ritual 諧音「瑞求有」，一步一步固定重複的神聖儀式
example: Lighting a candle and bowing is a daily ritual at the temple.
exampleZh: 點蠟燭並鞠躬，是寺廟裡每天的儀式。

tip: rite 儀式 + passage 通過，穿過一道人生的大門
example: Receiving a driver's license is a rite of passage for many American teenagers.
exampleZh: 拿到駕照是許多美國青少年的成年儀式。

tip: myth 神話 + ology 學問，一整套神話故事集
example: Greek mythology tells how Zeus ruled the gods from Mount Olympus.
exampleZh: 希臘神話敘述宙斯如何從奧林帕斯山統治眾神。

tip: folk 民眾 + lore 知識傳說，老百姓口耳相傳的故事
example: According to local folklore, a friendly spirit lives in the old oak tree at the edge of the village.
exampleZh: 根據當地的民間傳說，一位友善的精靈住在村莊邊那棵老橡樹裡。

tip: taboo 諧音「踏不」，不能踏進去的禁區
example: In some cultures, eating beef is taboo, so no one serves it at community feasts.
exampleZh: 在某些文化中，吃牛肉是禁忌，所以社區的宴席上沒有人供應。

tip: totem 諧音「頭停」，柱子最上頭停著動物守護家族
example: The eagle carved on the totem pole represents the family's guardian spirit.
exampleZh: 圖騰柱上雕刻的老鷹，象徵這個家族的守護靈。

tip: shaman 諧音「沙滿」，沙地上圍著營火唱歌擊鼓的巫醫
example: The village shaman chanted and beat a drum to call the spirits for healing.
exampleZh: 村裡的薩滿一邊吟唱一邊擊鼓，召喚靈魂來幫忙治病。

tip: anima 是「靈魂」，animal 動物有靈，animism 就是萬物皆有靈
example: Anthropologists describe animism as the belief that rivers, rocks, and trees all possess spirits.
exampleZh: 人類學家將泛靈信仰描述為相信河流、岩石與樹木都擁有靈魂。

tip: pan 全部 + theon 神：全部的神都住在同一座神殿
example: The Roman pantheon included Jupiter, Mars, and dozens of lesser gods.
exampleZh: 羅馬的諸神包含朱比特、瑪爾斯和數十位次要神祇。

tip: ac 朝向 + culture 文化：慢慢靠向新的文化
example: Immigrant children often go through acculturation, adopting local customs while keeping parts of their heritage.
exampleZh: 移民兒童常經歷文化涵化，在採納當地習俗的同時保留部分傳統。

tip: as + similar 相似：慢慢變得跟大家一樣
example: Over several generations, assimilation led the immigrant community to adopt the main language and drop many old customs.
exampleZh: 歷經數個世代，同化使這個移民社群採用主流語言，並放棄許多舊習俗。

tip: in 裡面 + gen 出生：在這片土地出生長大的
example: Indigenous peoples of the Arctic have hunted seals for thousands of years.
exampleZh: 北極的原住民族已獵捕海豹數千年。

tip: ab 從 + origin 起源：從最初起源就住在那裡
example: Aboriginal rock paintings in northern Australia are among the oldest artworks on Earth.
exampleZh: 澳洲北部的原住民岩畫是地球上最古老的藝術品之一。

tip: art 手工 + fact 做成：人親手做出來的東西
example: Archaeologists dated the clay bowl, a handmade artifact, to about three thousand years ago.
exampleZh: 考古學家將這只陶碗這件手工製品，定年在大約三千年前。

tip: relic 像 relax 之後留下：被時間留在後面的老東西
example: The monastery guards a relic, a scrap of cloth said to be centuries old.
exampleZh: 修道院保管著一件遺物，據說是有數百年歷史的一小塊布。

tip: ex 向外 + cave 洞：挖個洞把土運出來
example: Workers excavated the hillside to uncover the foundations of a Roman villa.
exampleZh: 工人挖掘山坡，以找出一座羅馬別墅的地基。

tip: excavate 挖洞加 tion 變名詞：挖出來的工程
example: The excavation lasted six summers and revealed an entire marketplace beneath the farmland.
exampleZh: 這次發掘持續了六個夏天，在農田底下挖出整座市集。

tip: antiquity 和 antique 古董同家族，都是很久以前
example: Greek theaters from antiquity still host performances because of their remarkable acoustics.
exampleZh: 古代的希臘劇場因音響效果出色，至今仍舉辦演出。

tip: ruin 是毀壞，ruins 是毀壞後剩下的一堆石頭
example: Tourists walked among the ruins of the temple, where only a few columns still stood.
exampleZh: 遊客在神殿的廢墟間漫步，那裡只剩幾根石柱仍然矗立。

tip: mon 提醒 + ument：立起來提醒大家別忘記
example: The city built a white marble monument to honor the soldiers who defended the bridge.
exampleZh: 市政府建了一座白色大理石紀念碑，以紀念守衛這座橋的士兵。

tip: hiero 神聖 + glyph 雕刻：神廟牆上刻的神聖符號
example: Scholars could read Egyptian hieroglyphics only after the Rosetta Stone showed the same text in three scripts.
exampleZh: 直到羅塞塔石碑以三種文字呈現相同內容，學者才讀懂古埃及象形文字。

zh: 楔形文字（美索不達米亞）
tip: cune 楔子 + form 形狀：字痕像一顆顆小楔子
example: Sumerian scribes pressed a reed into wet clay to write cuneiform, one of the earliest writing systems.
exampleZh: 蘇美的書記員把蘆葦桿壓進濕黏土來書寫楔形文字，這是最早的書寫系統之一。

tip: picture 圖畫 + graph 書寫：用圖畫來寫字
example: The cave wall bears a pictograph of a deer, drawn to show what hunters hoped to find.
exampleZh: 洞穴牆壁上有一幅鹿的象形圖畫，描繪獵人希望找到的獵物。

tip: phone 聲音 + logy 學問：像 telephone 電話的聲音
example: In phonology class, students learned why English speakers hear "pat" and "bat" as different words.
exampleZh: 在音韻學課堂上，學生學到為什麼說英語的人會把 pat 和 bat 聽成不同的字。

tip: syn 一起 + tax 排列：把字排在一起成句子
example: In English syntax, adjectives usually come before the nouns they describe.
exampleZh: 在英語句法中，形容詞通常放在所描述的名詞之前。

tip: sem 像 sign 記號：研究記號背後的意思
example: Semantics explains why "cheap" and "inexpensive" mean nearly the same thing yet sound different to buyers.
exampleZh: 語意學解釋了為什麼「cheap」與「inexpensive」意思幾乎相同，卻讓買家感受不同。

tip: pragma 行動，像 practical 實用：看話語在場合中做了什麼
example: Pragmatics helps explain why "Can you pass the salt?" is a request, not a question about ability.
exampleZh: 語用學能解釋為什麼「你能把鹽遞過來嗎？」是請求，而不是在問能力。

tip: dia 之間 + lect 說：同一語言裡各地不同的說法
example: People from the northern valley speak a dialect whose vowels sound unfamiliar to city residents.
exampleZh: 北部山谷的人說一種方言，其母音對城市居民來說聽起來很陌生。

tip: lingua 像 language 語言，franca 是共通：大家都能溝通
example: English serves as a lingua franca at international science conferences, where speakers share no other language.
exampleZh: 英語是國際科學研討會上的通用語，因為與會者沒有其他共同語言。

zh: 洋涇浜混雜商務接觸語
tip: pidgin 唸起來像 pigeon 鴿子：簡單的咕咕話也能做生意
example: Traders created a pidgin, a simplified blend of two languages, to bargain at the harbor.
exampleZh: 商人創造了一種洋涇浜，也就是兩種語言簡化後的混合，用來在港口討價還價。

zh: 克里奧爾母語化混合語
tip: creole 像 create 創造：孩子創造出來的新母語
example: Children who grew up hearing a pidgin turned it into a creole with fixed grammar.
exampleZh: 從小聽洋涇浜長大的孩子，把它發展成語法固定的克里奧爾語。

tip: bi 二 + lingual 語言：bicycle 兩輪，bilingual 兩語
example: Our bilingual teacher explains each science lesson in both English and Mandarin.
exampleZh: 我們的雙語老師用英語和華語講解每一堂自然課。

tip: mono 單一 + lingual 語言：像 monorail 單軌
example: Monolingual speakers of English can struggle in places where few people understand the language.
exampleZh: 只會單一語言的英語使用者，在很少人懂英語的地方可能會很吃力。

tip: neuro 神經 + sis 病狀：神經緊繃過頭的毛病
example: Freud used the word neurosis for long-lasting anxiety that disturbs daily life without breaking contact with reality.
exampleZh: 佛洛伊德用「精神官能症」一詞，指干擾日常生活但沒有脫離現實的長期焦慮。

tip: psycho 心靈 + sis 病：心靈整個離開了現實
example: Unlike neurosis, psychosis involves a break with reality, and patients may see or hear things that are not there.
exampleZh: 與官能症不同，精神病性障礙會脫離現實，患者可能看到或聽到不存在的事物。

tip: 哈路西內申：明明沒有東西，卻「哈」地看到了
example: The patient's hallucination was so vivid that she insisted she could hear music in the silent room.
exampleZh: 病患的幻覺非常逼真，她堅稱自己在安靜的房間裡聽得到音樂。

tip: de 向下 + lude 玩弄：被自己的想法騙了還深信不疑
example: He lived under the delusion that he was a famous inventor, though he had never built anything.
exampleZh: 他活在自己是知名發明家的妄想中，儘管他從未造出任何東西。

tip: a 無 + mnes 記憶：沒有記憶，像 mnemonic 記憶術
example: After the accident, he had amnesia and could not remember his own address.
exampleZh: 意外之後他罹患失憶症，連自己的住址都想不起來。

tip: a 無 + phasia 言語：失去說話的能力
example: After the stroke, aphasia left the former teacher unable to find the words she wanted.
exampleZh: 中風之後，失語症讓這位前教師無法找到她想說的字詞。

tip: de 離開 + ment 心智：心智一點一點離開
example: Her grandfather's dementia slowly erased his memory of familiar faces and places.
exampleZh: 她祖父的失智症慢慢抹去他對熟悉面孔與地方的記憶。

tip: phobia 諧音「佛比啊」：一看到就大喊「佛啊」想躲開
example: Her phobia of heights made even a second-floor balcony feel terrifying.
exampleZh: 她的懼高症讓她連二樓陽台都覺得很可怕。

tip: 想像心裡被重重撞出一塊大瘀青，久久不消
example: Years after the flood, the villagers still carried the trauma of losing their homes.
exampleZh: 洪水過後多年，村民仍背負著失去家園的心理創傷。

tip: cathar 是乾淨：哭完像洗過澡，心裡變乾淨了
example: After weeping through the tragic play, the audience felt a catharsis, as if their tension had been washed away.
exampleZh: 看完悲劇哭了一場後，觀眾感到情緒宣洩，彷彿緊張都被沖走了。

zh: 昇華防衛機制將本能轉化
tip: 和 sublime 崇高同家族：把壞情緒提升成美好的事
example: Freud described sublimation as turning an unacceptable urge, such as anger, into a productive activity like painting.
exampleZh: 佛洛伊德把昇華描述為將不被接受的衝動，例如憤怒，轉為像繪畫這類有益的活動。

tip: intro 向內 + vert 轉：往內轉的人
example: As an introvert, Mia recharges by reading alone after a long day of group projects.
exampleZh: 身為內向者，米雅在一整天的小組專題後，靠獨自閱讀來恢復精力。

tip: extro 向外 + vert 轉：往外轉向人群的人
example: An extrovert like Leo gets energy from meeting new people at parties.
exampleZh: 像里歐這樣的外向者，會從派對上認識新朋友的過程中獲得活力。

tip: em 進入 + path 感受：走進別人的感受裡
example: A good nurse shows empathy by imagining how frightened the patient must feel.
exampleZh: 好護理師會設想病患有多害怕，藉此表現同理心。

tip: alter 是「其他人」，altruism 就是心裡想著別人的主義
example: Donating a kidney to a stranger is an act of altruism, not a search for reward.
exampleZh: 把腎臟捐給陌生人是利他的行為，而不是在追求回報。

tip: Narcissus 是愛上水中倒影的少年，倒影就是自己
example: His narcissism showed whenever he steered every conversation back to his own achievements.
exampleZh: 每當他把每段對話都拉回自己的成就上，他的自戀就顯露無遺。

tip: ego 在拉丁文就是「我」，e-go：我要走我的路
example: Psychologists say the ego balances the demands of instinct against the rules of the outside world.
exampleZh: 心理學家說，自我在本能的要求與外在世界的規則之間取得平衡。

zh: 超我良心道德規範審查
tip: super 在上 + ego 我：站在自我頭上的良心
example: The superego acts like an inner judge, making a child feel guilty after lying to a friend.
exampleZh: 超我像內心的法官，讓孩子對朋友說謊後感到內疚。

tip: id 讀起來像 it「它」：心裡最原始的那個「它」
example: According to Freud, the id demands immediate pleasure, like a baby crying for food.
exampleZh: 依佛洛伊德的說法，本我要求立刻得到滿足，就像嬰兒哭著要吃東西。

zh: 潛抑防衛壓抑心理痛苦
tip: re 向後 + press 壓：把痛苦壓到心底去
example: Through repression, she pushed the painful memory so deep into her mind that she forgot it.
exampleZh: 透過潛抑，她把痛苦的記憶壓進心底深處，以致於忘了它。

zh: 投射作用將缺點推給他人
tip: 像投影機：把自己的缺點投到別人身上
example: Through projection, a student who feels jealous may accuse a classmate of being jealous.
exampleZh: 透過投射作用，感到嫉妒的學生可能會指責同學很嫉妒。

tip: rational 合理 + ize：幫自己找出聽起來合理的理由
example: His rationalization for skipping practice was that the coach did not like him anyway.
exampleZh: 他逃避練習的合理化說法是：反正教練也不喜歡他。

tip: dis 離開 + place 位置：怒氣被移到別的地方
example: A man angry at his boss may shout at his dog, a pattern psychologists call displacement.
exampleZh: 對老闆生氣的人可能對自己的狗大吼，心理學家稱這種模式為移位作用。

tip: placebo 拉丁文是「我會讓你高興」，糖丸也有療效
example: In the trial, the placebo effect made many patients feel better after taking only a sugar pill.
exampleZh: 在試驗中，安慰劑效應使許多病人只服用糖丸就覺得好轉。

example: Everyone has a blind spot, such as overlooking their own mistakes while quickly noticing those of others.
exampleZh: 每個人都有盲點，例如忽略自己的錯誤，卻很快注意到別人的錯誤。

zh: 確認偏誤只看吻合信念者
tip: confirm 確認 + bias 偏見：只找「對對對」的證據
example: Confirmation bias leads voters to read only articles that agree with what they already believe.
exampleZh: 確認偏誤使選民只閱讀與自己既有信念一致的文章。

zh: 事後聰明事後諸葛偏誤
tip: hind 後面 + sight 看見：事後才看清，就說「我早知道」
example: After the game ended, hindsight bias made fans claim they had known all along which team would win.
exampleZh: 比賽結束後，事後聰明的偏誤使球迷宣稱自己早就知道哪隊會贏。

zh: 月暈效應以偏概全好評
tip: halo 是天使頭上的光圈：一圈光讓人覺得樣樣都好
example: Because the singer was charming on stage, the halo effect led fans to assume she was also kind and honest.
exampleZh: 因為歌手在台上很迷人，月暈效應讓粉絲以為她也善良又誠實。

zh: 旁觀者效應責任分散不救
tip: by 在旁邊 + stand 站：大家都站著，以為別人會幫忙
example: The bystander effect explains why no one helped for several minutes when dozens of people watched the accident.
exampleZh: 旁觀者效應解釋了，為什麼數十人目睹事故時，好幾分鐘都沒有人出手幫忙。

zh: 團體盲思追求表面和諧盲從
tip: group 團體 + think 想：大家想成一樣，沒人敢說不
example: Groupthink led the committee to approve the plan quickly, because no one wanted to disturb the harmony.
exampleZh: 團體盲思使委員會迅速通過計畫，因為沒有人想破壞和諧。

zh: 社會怠惰團體中偷懶混水
tip: loaf 是一條麵包：像麵包一樣躺平，讓別人去拉車
example: Social loafing appears in group projects when one student expects teammates to do the work.
exampleZh: 當某位學生指望隊友完成工作時，小組專題中就會出現社會怠惰。

zh: 同儕群體壓力同儕認同
tip: peer 像 pair 一對：同輩夥伴一施壓，你就想跟著做
example: Teenagers often feel peer pressure to wear the same brands as their friends.
exampleZh: 青少年常感受到同儕壓力，要穿和朋友相同的品牌。

zh: 自證預言信念驅動成真
tip: self 自己 + fulfill 實現 + prophecy 預言：你信了，就親手做成真
example: A teacher's low expectations can become a self-fulfilling prophecy when students stop trying.
exampleZh: 當學生停止努力時，老師的低期待可能變成自證預言。

zh: 文藝復興人文主義運動
tip: re 再 + naiss 出生：文化再次誕生的時代
example: The Renaissance began in Italy, where wealthy families paid artists to revive ideas from ancient Greece and Rome.
exampleZh: 文藝復興始於義大利，富裕的家族出資請藝術家復興古希臘與古羅馬的思想。

zh: 透視法繪畫三度空間深淺
tip: per 穿過 + spect 看：穿過畫面看到遠方的深度
example: Using perspective, the painter made the road appear to narrow into the distance.
exampleZh: 畫家運用透視法，讓道路看起來越遠越窄。

zh: 繪畫顏料天然色彩粉末
tip: pig 小豬 + ment：小豬踩進顏料，全身都是色
example: Artists once ground blue stones into pigment to make the sky in their paintings.
exampleZh: 藝術家過去會把藍色石頭磨成顏料粉，用來畫出畫中的天空。

tip: 用厚麻布或棉布做成：畫布和帆布是同一個字
example: She stretched a blank canvas across a wooden frame before beginning her oil painting.
exampleZh: 她在開始畫油畫之前，把空白畫布繃緊在木框上。

tip: fresco 在義大利文是「新鮮」，像 fresh：趁灰泥新鮮時畫
example: Michelangelo painted the ceiling as a fresco, applying pigment to wet plaster so the colors would last.
exampleZh: 米開朗基羅把天花板畫成濕壁畫，將顏料塗在濕灰泥上，使色彩得以持久。

tip: 法文 mur 是牆：畫在牆上的大畫就是 mural
example: Students painted a colorful mural of local birds on the school's outer wall.
exampleZh: 學生在學校外牆畫了一幅當地鳥類的彩色壁畫。

tip: 馬賽克：馬賽的客人一格一格拼出一幅畫
example: The floor of the Roman villa was a mosaic made of thousands of tiny colored stones.
exampleZh: 羅馬別墅的地板是由數千顆彩色小石塊拼成的馬賽克。

tip: 巴洛克：爸爸樂客，滿屋金飾華麗到眼花撩亂
example: Baroque churches are famous for gold decoration, dramatic light, and curved, richly detailed ceilings.
exampleZh: 巴洛克教堂以金色裝飾、戲劇性光線，以及弧形且細節豐富的天花板聞名。

zh: 洛可可優雅纖細裝飾風格
tip: 洛可可諧音「羅可可」：像撒滿糖霜的可可蛋糕，甜美精緻
example: Rococo rooms feature pale colors, delicate curves, and decorations shaped like shells and flowers.
exampleZh: 洛可可風格的房間以淡色、纖細曲線，以及貝殼與花朵形的裝飾為特色。

zh: 新古典主義回歸理性崇高
tip: neo 新 + classic 古典 + ism：新的古典風
example: Neoclassicism arose in the 1700s as painters rejected fancy decoration and returned to the order of ancient Greece.
exampleZh: 新古典主義興起於一七〇〇年代，畫家摒棄華麗裝飾，回歸古希臘的秩序。

zh: 浪漫主義強調激情想像
tip: romantic 浪漫 + ism：心動的情緒比理智大
example: Romanticism valued deep emotion and imagination over strict reason, inspiring poets to write about storms and wild nature.
exampleZh: 浪漫主義重視深刻情感與想像勝過嚴格理性，啟發詩人書寫風暴與荒野自然。

zh: 寫實主義如實刻畫現實
tip: real 真實 + ism：照著真實的樣子畫、照著真實的樣子寫
example: In literature, realism shows ordinary workers and their daily struggles instead of heroes and fantasy.
exampleZh: 在文學中，寫實主義描寫普通工人及其日常掙扎，而不是英雄與幻想。

zh: 印象派捕捉瞬間光影變化
tip: impression 印象：快速抓住眼睛一瞬間的印象
example: Impressionism captured how sunlight changed the look of a pond from morning to evening.
exampleZh: 印象派捕捉了陽光如何從早到晚改變池塘的樣貌。

zh: 後印象派追求結構精神
tip: post 之後 + impressionism：印象派之後，更重結構
example: Post-impressionism, led by artists like Cézanne, kept bright color but added structure and personal feeling.
exampleZh: 以塞尚等藝術家為首的後印象派保留了明亮色彩，卻加入結構與個人情感。

zh: 表現主義主觀強烈扭曲情緒
