example: Wet leaves adhere to the windshield and blur the driver's view.
exampleZh: 濕葉子黏在擋風玻璃上，模糊了駕駛的視線。

tip: adhere 黏住 + ence：黏著規則不放，就是堅守
example: Strict adherence to the safety checklist prevented any accidents on the site.
exampleZh: 嚴格遵守安全檢查表，使工地未發生任何事故。

tip: ad 靠近 + jacent 躺著：兩棟房子並排躺在一起，緊鄰
example: The campground is adjacent to a quiet lake, so mornings begin with birdsong.
exampleZh: 營地緊鄰一座寧靜的湖，所以早晨在鳥鳴中展開。

tip: ad 朝 + verse 轉：迎面頂著逆風，處處不利
example: Adverse weather forced the airline to cancel all evening flights.
exampleZh: 惡劣天候迫使航空公司取消所有晚間班機。

tip: adverse 逆向 + ity：長年迎面逆風的處境就是逆境
example: Through years of adversity, the family kept their humor and their hope.
exampleZh: 歷經多年逆境，這家人始終保持幽默與希望。

tip: adverse 逆向：坐在棋盤對面的那個人，就是對手
example: The chess champion respected her adversary, who had studied every one of her old games.
exampleZh: 這位西洋棋冠軍敬重她的對手，對方研究過她的每一盤舊棋譜。

tip: ad 朝 + voc 聲音：朝大家大聲喊出支持
example: Teachers advocate daily reading as the surest way to build vocabulary.
exampleZh: 老師倡導每天閱讀，認為這是累積字彙最穩當的方法。

tip: ag 朝 + greg 羊群：把羊趕成一群，合計在一起
example: The aggregate score from all five judges determined the final ranking.
exampleZh: 五位評審的總分決定了最終排名。

tip: aggregate 的名詞：把羊趕在一起的那一群
example: The aggregation of tiny ice crystals gradually forms snowflakes in the cloud.
exampleZh: 微小冰晶在雲中逐漸聚集，形成雪花。

zh: 使疏遠使格格不入轉讓
tip: alien 是外星人：把人當外星人，就會使他疏遠
example: Constant bragging can alienate even your closest friends.
exampleZh: 不斷吹噓可能讓連最親近的朋友也漸漸疏遠你。

tip: alien 外星人 + ation：覺得自己像外星人，和大家格格不入
example: Moving to a new city left her with a deep sense of alienation.
exampleZh: 搬到新城市讓她深深感到疏離。

tip: al 朝 + loc 地點：把東西放到各個地點去，就是分配
example: The council voted to allocate more funds to repairing the old bridge.
exampleZh: 市議會投票決定撥更多經費修繕老橋。

tip: allocate 的名詞：每樣東西放到各自的位置
example: The allocation of seats was decided by a random draw.
exampleZh: 座位的分配是以隨機抽籤決定的。

tip: al 朝 + lud 玩：跟你玩文字遊戲，話不明說
example: In her speech, the mayor seemed to allude to last year's scandal without naming it.
exampleZh: 市長在演說中似乎影射去年的醜聞，卻沒有點名。

zh: 典故暗指影射間接提及
tip: allude 的名詞：詩裡偷偷藏的典故小梗
example: The poem's allusion to a Greek myth escaped most of the students.
exampleZh: 這首詩對希臘神話的影射，多數學生都沒看出來。

tip: alter 源自「另一個」：改成另一個樣子，就是更動
example: The tailor made a small alteration to the sleeves so the jacket fit perfectly.
exampleZh: 裁縫師稍微修改袖子，讓外套完全合身。

tip: alter 源自「另一個」：變成另一個樣子
example: Wearing a wig can dramatically alter a person's appearance.
exampleZh: 戴假髮能大幅改變一個人的外貌。

tip: altru 像 alter 另一個人：先想別人，無私利他
example: Her altruistic decision to donate a kidney to a stranger astonished the town.
exampleZh: 她把腎臟捐給陌生人的無私決定讓全鎮驚訝。

tip: 諧音「啊美利哦」：啊，情況變美好了
example: New drainage ditches helped ameliorate flooding in the low-lying neighborhood.
exampleZh: 新的排水溝有助於減輕低窪社區的淹水。

tip: ameliorate 的名詞：「啊美利哦」，越變越好
example: Gradual amelioration of working conditions followed years of union pressure.
exampleZh: 工會多年施壓後，工作條件逐步改善。

zh: 類似可類比結構相似的
tip: analogy 類比 + ous：可以拿來類比，就是類似的
example: The heart's role in the body is analogous to a pump in a water system.
exampleZh: 心臟在身體中的角色，類似水系統裡的幫浦。

tip: 拿水管比喻電線，一說就懂的比喻
example: The teacher drew an analogy between the electric current and flowing water.
exampleZh: 老師拿電流與流水做類比。

tip: an 朝 + nihil 無：變成零，什麼都不剩
example: The invading swarm of locusts threatened to annihilate the entire wheat crop.
exampleZh: 入侵的蝗蟲群眼看就要把整片小麥作物徹底毀掉。

zh: 異常現象反常奇特事物
tip: an 不 + omal 平整：不平整、不合群的怪現象
example: Scientists puzzled over the anomaly: one balmy day in the middle of a frozen January.
exampleZh: 科學家對這個異常現象感到困惑：在冰封的一月中出現一個暖和的日子。

tip: anti 對抗 + agon 競賽：站到對面去惹毛別人
example: Shouting at the referee will only antagonize the crowd further.
exampleZh: 對裁判大吼只會更加激怒群眾。

tip: anti 對 + agon 競賽：專跟主角對打的那個人
example: In the novel, the cold-hearted landlord is the main antagonist.
exampleZh: 小說中，冷酷的房東是主要反派。

tip: antagonist + ism：互相對抗的狀態
example: Years of antagonism between the two villages ended when a shared flood brought them together.
exampleZh: 兩村多年的敵意，在共同面對洪水後化解。

tip: ante 先 + cip 拿：搶先一步拿到消息，就是預料
example: Experienced chess players anticipate their opponent's next three moves.
exampleZh: 經驗老道的棋手能預料對手接下來的三步棋。

tip: anticipate 的名詞：搶先在心裡等著好事發生
example: With rising anticipation, the villagers gathered at dawn to watch the eclipse.
exampleZh: 村民懷著越來越高的期待，在黎明聚集觀看日蝕。

tip: a-pex 像「阿佩斯」爬到最頂端，插一面旗
example: At the apex of the pyramid, a single gold-tipped stone caught the first sunlight.
exampleZh: 金字塔頂端有一塊鑲金的石頭，最先接住了陽光。

zh: 儀器設備機構組織運作
tip: a-ppa-ra-tus：一整套準備好的器材，就是儀器設備
example: The laboratory's breathing apparatus had to be tested before every dive.
exampleZh: 實驗室的呼吸裝置在每次潛水前都必須先測試。

tip: ap 朝 + pend 掛：把東西掛在後面，附加上去
example: Please append a short note to the report explaining the missing figures.
exampleZh: 請在報告後面附上一則簡短說明，解釋缺漏的數字。

tip: append 掛在後面：掛在書尾的就是附錄，身體裡掛在腸子旁的是闌尾
example: The maps and charts were collected in an appendix at the back of the book.
exampleZh: 地圖和圖表都收在書末的附錄中。

tip: 像 praise 稱讚，但先看這東西值多少錢才評價
example: An expert was hired to appraise the antique clock before it went up for auction.
exampleZh: 古董鐘拍賣前，他們請專家來估價。

tip: appraise 的名詞：估價師寫的那張鑑定書
example: A professional appraisal put the old farmhouse at twice its purchase price.
exampleZh: 專業估價顯示這棟老農舍值買價的兩倍。

tip: ap 朝 + proxim 近：靠得很近但不完全一樣，就是近似
example: The approximate distance to the summit is about six kilometers.
exampleZh: 到山頂的大約距離是六公里左右。

tip: approximate 的名詞：靠近真實，但不是剛剛好
example: Her quick approximation of the cost turned out to be within five dollars.
exampleZh: 她快速估算出的費用，最後誤差在五美元以內。

tip: arbi 像「啊比」：啊，隨便比一比就決定了，沒有道理
example: The king's arbitrary ruling, made on a whim, angered the entire court.
exampleZh: 國王憑一時興致做出的武斷裁決，激怒了整個朝廷。

zh: 原型典型範本原始意象
tip: arche 最初 + type 類型：最原始的模板
example: Cinderella is the archetype of the kind person who is rewarded after hardship.
exampleZh: 灰姑娘是善良的人歷經苦難後獲得回報的典型。

example: After an arduous climb through knee-deep snow, they finally reached the hut.
exampleZh: 歷經在及膝積雪中艱苦的攀登，他們終於抵達山屋。

zh: 歷史人工製品文物史料
tip: arti 技藝 + fact 做成：人做出來的東西
example: Archaeologists catalogued every artifact found in the ancient burial chamber.
exampleZh: 考古學家為古代墓室中發現的每件文物編目。

tip: as 朝 + certain 確定：弄到確定為止，就是查明
example: Investigators worked through the night to ascertain exactly how the fire began.
exampleZh: 調查人員徹夜工作，要查明火災究竟如何開始。

tip: a 朝 + spire 呼吸：朝著夢想用力吸氣、往上衝
example: As a child in a fishing village, he aspired to become an astronaut.
exampleZh: 他小時候住在漁村，立志成為太空人。

tip: aspire 的名詞：呼吸著夢想往上衝的心願
example: Her aspiration to teach had been growing since her first volunteer summer.
exampleZh: 自從第一個志工暑假起，她想當老師的志向就一直增長。

zh: 吸收消化同化融入群體
tip: as 朝 + simil 相似：吃進去變成和自己一樣
example: Plants assimilate nutrients from the soil and turn them into new leaves.
exampleZh: 植物從土壤吸收養分，並把它們轉化成新葉子。

zh: 文化同化吸收融合過程
tip: assimilate 的名詞：慢慢變得跟大家一樣的過程
example: The cultural assimilation of immigrants often takes more than a single generation.
exampleZh: 移民的文化同化往往需要不只一個世代。

tip: at 朝 + tribute 給予：把功勞或過錯給到某個原因
example: Historians attribute the empire's collapse to a combination of drought and heavy taxes.
exampleZh: 歷史學家將帝國的崩潰歸因於乾旱與重稅雙重打擊。

tip: attribute 的名詞：把作品或原因歸給某人
example: The attribution of the painting to a famous master was later proved false.
exampleZh: 這幅畫被歸為名家之作，後來證明是錯的。

tip: aug 是「增加」，像拿放大鏡把東西越變越大
example: The tiny pill is an augmentation of the standard dose, not a replacement.
exampleZh: 這顆小藥丸是標準劑量的加強，不是替代品。

zh: 真實道地真確非仿造的
tip: au-then-tic：「喔，真的啦」，確實是真貨
example: The restaurant serves authentic Thai noodles made from a grandmother's recipe.
exampleZh: 這家餐廳供應用阿嬤食譜做的道地泰式麵。

tip: authentic 真的 + ate 動詞：把它驗成是真的
example: Experts used a special lamp to authenticate the signature on the old letter.
exampleZh: 專家用特殊燈光鑑定這封舊信上的簽名真偽。

tip: authentic 真的 + ity：是不是真貨的程度
example: Scholars questioned the authenticity of the diary after finding modern ink in its pages.
exampleZh: 學者在日記頁面發現現代墨水後，質疑它的真實性。

tip: auto 自己 + nom 規則：自己訂規則自己管
example: Autonomous vehicles use cameras and sensors to steer themselves through traffic.
exampleZh: 自動駕駛車輛利用鏡頭和感測器，自己在車流中行駛。

tip: auto 自己 + nom 規則：自己的事自己決定
example: Teenagers crave more autonomy as they begin making their own decisions.
exampleZh: 青少年開始自己做決定時，會渴望更多自主權。

tip: a 離開 + vert 轉：轉個方向躲開
example: A quick turn of the wheel was enough to avert a collision with the truck.
exampleZh: 方向盤快速一轉，就足以避免與卡車相撞。

zh: 使困惑難倒使不知所措
tip: 諧音「爸佛」：爸爸看了也佛了，一頭霧水
example: The riddle was so tricky that it baffled even the oldest villagers.
exampleZh: 這個謎語太刁鑽，連最年長的村民也被難倒。

tip: bar 是柵欄，加上 -ier 像一堵擋路的牆
example: A language barrier made it hard for the new students to join the conversation.
exampleZh: 語言隔閡讓新來的學生難以加入對話。

tip: 諧音「不真」：一夜萌芽，快得不真實
example: Small cafes began to burgeon along the riverbank once the new bridge opened.
exampleZh: 新橋啟用後，小咖啡館開始在河岸邊迅速冒出。

tip: cali 像 caliber 口徑：量準尺寸，把儀器調整到對
example: Technicians must calibrate the scale each morning to keep the weights accurate.
exampleZh: 技術人員每天早上都必須校準磅秤，讓重量保持準確。

tip: calibrate 的名詞：每次校準，讀數才會準
example: Regular calibration keeps the thermometer from drifting away from the true temperature.
exampleZh: 定期校準能避免溫度計漸漸偏離真實溫度。

tip: 諧音「看到」：看到什麼就說什麼，坦率
example: With refreshing candor, the coach admitted that the team had played poorly.
exampleZh: 教練坦率承認球隊表現不佳，令人耳目一新。

zh: 催化劑促成改變的誘因
tip: 像小火苗，一點就讓整個反應快速進行，促成改變
example: The invention of the printing press was a catalyst for the spread of knowledge.
exampleZh: 印刷術的發明促成了知識的傳播。

tip: cata 往下 + strophe 轉：事情急轉直下，一敗塗地
example: The earthquake was a catastrophe that destroyed most of the harbor town.
exampleZh: 那場地震是一場大災難，摧毀了港口小鎮的大半。

tip: catastrophe 大災難 + ic：像大災難一樣嚴重的
example: The storm caused catastrophic flooding that swept away roads and bridges.
exampleZh: 風暴造成毀滅性的洪水，沖走了道路與橋梁。

zh: 嚴厲指責公開譴責批判
tip: 大家都覺得你做錯了，當眾嚴厲指責你
example: The committee voted to censure the senator for misusing campaign funds.
exampleZh: 委員會投票通過公開譴責那位參議員濫用競選經費。

tip: chrono 時間 + logy 學問：把事情照時間排好的學問
example: A careful chronology of the war helped students see how each battle led to the next.
exampleZh: 詳細的戰爭年表幫助學生看出每場戰役如何連到下一場。

tip: chrono 時間：像時鐘一樣照時間先後排好
example: The museum arranged the tools in chronological order, from the oldest to the newest.
exampleZh: 博物館把工具依時間順序排列，從最古老的到最新的。

zh: 限制劃定界限限制活動
tip: circum 圍繞 + scribe 寫：用筆畫一圈，圈住範圍
example: Strict rules circumscribe what the apprentices are allowed to do in the workshop.
exampleZh: 嚴格規定限制了學徒在工坊裡可以做的事。

tip: clar 清楚 + ify 使：讓模糊的東西變清楚，像 clear
example: Could you clarify which date the manager meant for the final review?
exampleZh: 你可以澄清經理說的期末檢討是指哪一天嗎？

tip: clarify 的名詞：把疑點講清楚的那一段說明
example: The professor's clarification cleared up the confusion about the exam format.
exampleZh: 教授的說明消除了大家對考試形式的困惑。

zh: 最高峰高潮極致達到巔峰
tip: climax 像 climb（爬）：爬到最高那一格就是高潮
example: The film reaches its climax when the hero finally confronts the storm at sea.
exampleZh: 電影在主角終於在海上面對風暴時達到高潮。

zh: 聯合凝聚融合聚為一體
tip: co 一起 + alesce 成長：一起長成一體
example: Separate rescue efforts began to coalesce into one coordinated relief operation.
exampleZh: 各自為政的救援行動開始融合成一個協調一致的救災行動。

zh: 凝聚力內聚性緊密黏合
tip: co 一起 + hes 黏：像膠水一樣黏在一起
example: Shared meals built strong cohesion among the new employees.
exampleZh: 一起用餐讓新進員工之間凝聚出強烈的向心力。

tip: cohesion 的形容詞：大家像膠水般黏在一起
example: A cohesive team trusts one another and shares the workload without complaint.
exampleZh: 團結緊密的團隊彼此信任，毫無怨言地分擔工作。

tip: col 一起 + labor 工作：大家一起工作
example: Two schools agreed to collaborate on a joint science fair this spring.
exampleZh: 兩所學校同意今年春天合辦一場聯合科展。

tip: collaborate 的名詞：大家一起 labor 流汗的成果
example: The album is the product of close collaboration between a poet and a composer.
exampleZh: 這張專輯是詩人與作曲家緊密合作的成果。

tip: com 加強 + mence 開始：像 come 來了就要開始
example: The concert will commence at seven o'clock sharp.
exampleZh: 音樂會將在七點整準時開始。

tip: 畢業不是結束，是新生活的開始：commence 開始
example: Proud parents filled the stadium for the university's commencement ceremony.
exampleZh: 驕傲的父母擠滿體育場，參加大學畢業典禮。

zh: 相稱相當等比例符合的
tip: com 一起 + mensur 測量：用同一把尺量出來一樣大
example: The salary should be commensurate with the experience and skills of the applicant.
exampleZh: 薪資應與應徵者的經驗與技能相稱。

tip: commodious 像 comfortable：舒服又寬敞
example: The commodious living room easily held the whole family and their guests.
exampleZh: 寬敞的客廳輕鬆容納了全家人和客人。

tip: com 一起 + pat 承受：能一起相處、不吵架
example: Not every printer is compatible with older laptops.
exampleZh: 並非每台印表機都能和舊筆電相容。

tip: compatible 的名詞：能不能順利一起用的程度
example: Before buying the game, check its compatibility with your console.
exampleZh: 買遊戲前，先確認它與你的主機相容。

tip: com 一起 + pens 秤重：兩邊秤到一樣重，補到平衡
example: The airline will compensate passengers whose flights were canceled by the storm.
exampleZh: 航空公司將賠償因風暴而航班被取消的乘客。

tip: compensate 的名詞：補回來的錢就是補償金
example: She received generous compensation for the injury she suffered on the job.
exampleZh: 她因工作時受傷而獲得優渥的賠償。

zh: 補充互補相得益彰；補語
tip: complement 多一個 e，補上缺少的那一塊拼圖；compliment 是稱讚
example: The sweet dessert will complement the spicy main dish perfectly.
exampleZh: 甜甜的甜點將與辛辣的主菜完美搭配，相得益彰。

tip: complement 補上拼圖，形容詞 complementary 就是互補
example: Their skills are complementary: she plans the trips and he handles the budget.
exampleZh: 他們的技能互補：她規劃行程，他管預算。

tip: comply 照做 + ant：乖乖照規定的
example: Factories that are not compliant with the new rules will be fined.
exampleZh: 未遵守新規定的工廠將被罰款。

tip: comply 照做 + ance：照規定做的狀態
example: Full compliance with the health code is required before the restaurant can reopen.
exampleZh: 餐廳要重新開張，必須完全遵守衛生法規。

tip: com 一起 + plic 折疊：一層又一層折在一起，亂成一團
example: Adding a second rule will only complicate the game for the younger players.
exampleZh: 多加第二條規則只會讓這個遊戲對年紀較小的玩家變複雜。

tip: complicate 的名詞：事情變得更複雜，多出一個麻煩
example: A rare complication set in after the surgery, so the patient stayed an extra week.
exampleZh: 手術後出現罕見的併發症，所以病人多住了一週。

tip: com 完全 + prehend 抓住：全部都抓進來，無一遺漏
example: The comprehensive guidebook covers every trail, campsite, and picnic spot in the park.
exampleZh: 這本全面的指南涵蓋公園裡每條步道、營地和野餐點。

zh: 妥協折衷危害損害；和解
tip: com 一起 + promise 承諾：各讓一步，一起答應
example: Neither side was willing to compromise, so the talks collapsed.
exampleZh: 雙方都不願妥協，談判因此破裂。

tip: con 一起 + ceive 拿取：把點子抓在腦中，成形
example: The architect conceived a bridge that would curve like a ribbon over the bay.
exampleZh: 建築師構想出一座像緞帶般橫跨海灣的橋。

tip: conceive 的名詞：腦中形成的想法
example: His conception of freedom changed after he spent a year traveling abroad.
exampleZh: 他出國旅行一年後，對自由的概念改變了。

tip: con 一起 + cur 跑：一起跑，同時發生
example: The festival will run concurrent with the school holiday, so streets will be crowded.
exampleZh: 慶典與學校假期同時舉行，所以街上會很擁擠。

tip: con 一起 + dense 濃密：全部擠在一起，變濃變小
example: Boil the juice slowly to condense it into a thick syrup.
exampleZh: 把果汁慢慢煮，使它濃縮成濃稠的糖漿。

tip: condense 的名詞：水蒸氣遇冷凝成小水珠
example: Drops of condensation ran down the cold glass on the humid afternoon.
exampleZh: 潮濕的午後，水珠沿著冰涼的玻璃往下滑。

tip: con 一起 + done 完成：假裝沒事，放過去了
example: A teacher who condones cheating teaches students that rules do not matter.
exampleZh: 縱容作弊的老師，會讓學生以為規則無所謂。

tip: con 一起 + duc 引導：把你引向好結果
example: A quiet room with good light is conducive to studying.
exampleZh: 安靜又光線好的房間有助於念書。

zh: 限制監禁侷限範圍界限
tip: con 一起 + fine 界線：關在界線裡
example: Heavy fog confined the hikers to the cabin for two days.
exampleZh: 濃霧把健行者限制在小屋裡兩天。

zh: 順從遵從符合大眾標準
tip: con 一起 + form 形狀：變成跟大家同一個形狀
example: New students often feel pressure to conform to the habits of the group.
exampleZh: 新生常感到壓力，必須順從團體的習慣。

zh: 遵從順從一致性體制化
tip: conform 順從 + ity：大家一個樣的狀態
example: Strong conformity in the village made it hard for new ideas to take root.
exampleZh: 村子裡強烈的從眾風氣，讓新想法難以扎根。

zh: 正面迎擊面臨對質抗衡
tip: con 一起 + front 前面：面對面站在前面
example: Instead of avoiding the problem, the captain chose to confront it directly.
exampleZh: 船長沒有躲避問題，而是選擇直接面對。

tip: confront 面對面的名詞，面對面就容易起衝突
example: The argument ended in a bitter confrontation outside the meeting room.
exampleZh: 爭論在會議室外演變成一場激烈衝突。

tip: con 一起 + ject 丟：把想法丟在一起猜，沒證據
example: Without hard evidence, any theory about the missing ship is mere conjecture.
exampleZh: 沒有確切證據，任何關於失蹤船隻的理論都只是臆測。

tip: con 一起 + sec 跟隨：一個接一個跟著來
example: It rained for five consecutive days, and the river rose higher each morning.
exampleZh: 連續下了五天的雨，河水每天早上都更高。

tip: con 一起 + sequ 跟隨：做了事情後跟著來的結果
example: Skipping breakfast every day can have serious consequences for a growing child.
exampleZh: 每天不吃早餐，對成長中的孩子可能造成嚴重後果。

zh: 隨之發生的作為結果的
tip: con 一起 + sequ 跟隨：緊跟著前一件事發生的
example: The factory closure and the consequent loss of jobs shocked the small town.
exampleZh: 工廠關閉與隨之而來的失業，讓這個小鎮大為震驚。

zh: 隨後發生的重大的要緊的
tip: consequence 後果 + al：後果很大的，所以重要
example: The treaty was a consequential moment that reshaped the borders of three nations.
exampleZh: 這項條約是個影響重大的時刻，重新劃定了三個國家的邊界。

tip: con 一起 + stit 站立：大家站在一起，組成一個整體
example: Twelve players constitute a team in this tournament.
exampleZh: 在這場錦標賽中，十二名球員組成一支隊伍。

tip: constitute 組成，所以 constituent 是組成的一份子
example: Water is the main constituent of the human body, making up about sixty percent.
exampleZh: 水是人體的主要成分，約占百分之六十。

tip: con 一起 + strain 拉緊：緊緊綁住，不能亂動
example: Limited funds constrain how many books the library can buy each year.
exampleZh: 有限的經費限制了圖書館每年能買的書量。

zh: 束縛限制約束條件限制
tip: constrain 的名詞：把你綁住的限制條件
example: Time was the biggest constraint on the project, which had to finish by Friday.
exampleZh: 時間是這個專案最大的限制，因為它必須在週五前完成。

zh: 沉思深思仔細考量凝視
tip: con 加強 + templ 神殿：在神殿裡靜靜凝神思考
example: She sat by the window to contemplate whether to accept the job in Paris.
exampleZh: 她坐在窗邊，仔細考慮要不要接下巴黎的工作。

tip: contemplate 的名詞：安靜坐著的默想
example: Monks spend the early hours in quiet contemplation before breakfast.
exampleZh: 僧侶們在早餐前的清晨時分靜靜沉思。

zh: 當代現代同時代的；同輩
tip: con 一起 + tempor 時間：和我們同一個時間的
example: Contemporary artists often use recycled materials to comment on modern life.
exampleZh: 當代藝術家常用回收材料來評論現代生活。

zh: 上下文語境背景情境脈絡
tip: con 一起 + text 編織：句子和前後文織在一起
example: Without the context, the single quoted sentence seemed much harsher than intended.
exampleZh: 缺少上下文，那句被單獨引用的話看起來比原意嚴厲許多。

tip: context 上下文 + ual：和前後文有關的
example: The tutor gave contextual clues so the students could guess the new word.
exampleZh: 家教給了語境線索，讓學生可以猜出新單字。

zh: 視...而定的依附的；代表團
tip: con 一起 + tang 碰觸：要碰到某條件才成立
example: Payment is contingent on the successful delivery of all items.
exampleZh: 付款取決於所有貨品是否成功送達。

zh: 應變措施突發意外偶發性
tip: contingent 視情況而定：萬一發生，就拿出備案
example: The hikers carried spare batteries as a contingency in case the lights failed.
exampleZh: 健行者帶了備用電池當應變措施，以防燈光故障。

zh: 連貫性連續不間斷持續
tip: continue 繼續 + ity：一直接下去不斷線
example: Continuity between the old and new chapters keeps the story easy to follow.
exampleZh: 新舊章節之間的連貫性，讓故事容易跟上。

tip: continue 繼續 + ous：一直繼續、中間不停的
example: A continuous hum from the old refrigerator kept him awake all night.
exampleZh: 舊冰箱持續不斷的嗡嗡聲讓他整夜睡不著。

zh: 匯聚匯合趨於一致集合
tip: con 一起 + verge 彎向：大家都彎向同一點
example: Three small streams converge near the town and form a wide river.
exampleZh: 三條小溪在小鎮附近匯合，形成一條寬闊的河。

tip: converge 的名詞：大家匯聚到同一點
example: The convergence of trade routes at the harbor made the city rich.
exampleZh: 貿易路線在港口交會，使這座城市富裕。

zh: 交談；反向相反的；逆向命題
tip: con 一起 + verse 轉：你一句我一句輪流轉著說話
example: The two old friends sat on the porch to converse for hours.
exampleZh: 兩位老朋友坐在門廊，聊了好幾個小時。

zh: 轉變轉換皈依信仰變換
tip: convert 轉變的名詞：轉成另一種樣子
example: The conversion of old warehouses into apartments has revived the downtown area.
exampleZh: 把舊倉庫改建為公寓，讓市中心重新活絡起來。

zh: 轉換改裝改變立場；皈依者
tip: con 全部 + vert 轉：整個轉成另一個樣子
example: The workshop will convert the van into a mobile library.
exampleZh: 工坊將把這輛廂型車改裝成行動圖書館。

zh: 傳達傳遞表達運送運載
tip: con 一起 + vey 路：把話沿著路帶過去
example: A single smile can convey friendliness even when two people share no common language.
exampleZh: 即使兩人沒有共同語言，一個微笑也能傳達友善。

zh: 堅定信念定罪判刑宣告有罪
tip: con 完全 + vict 征服：說服自己到完全相信
example: Her conviction that every child can learn kept her teaching through difficult years.
exampleZh: 她堅信每個孩子都能學習，這份信念支撐她度過艱難的教學歲月。

zh: 大量的豐富充沛豐盛的
tip: 想像滿滿一籃水果多到溢出來，數量非常多
example: The garden gave a copious harvest of tomatoes, more than the family could eat.
exampleZh: 花園結出大量番茄，比一家人吃得完的還多。

zh: 相互關聯對應相符；相關物
tip: co 一起 + relate 關聯：兩件事互相牽連
example: Researchers found that hours of sleep correlate with exam scores.
exampleZh: 研究者發現睡眠時數與考試成績相關。

zh: 相關性相互關係關聯度
tip: correlate 的名詞：兩件事一起升降的關係
example: The study showed a strong correlation between reading habits and vocabulary size.
exampleZh: 研究顯示閱讀習慣與字彙量有很強的相關性。

zh: 可信度信譽可靠性真實性
tip: cred 相信 + ibility：值得被相信的程度
example: The newspaper lost its credibility after printing several false stories.
exampleZh: 這家報紙刊登了幾則假新聞後，失去了公信力。

tip: cred 相信 + ible 能夠：值得相信的
example: Nobody found his excuse credible, since the dog had never touched homework before.
exampleZh: 沒人覺得他的藉口可信，因為那隻狗從來沒碰過作業。

zh: 評判標準評量規準衡量指標
tip: criteria 是複數，單數是 criterion，a 結尾換 on
example: The judges announced the criteria for the competition before the first contestant entered.
exampleZh: 評審在第一位參賽者進場前，就公布了比賽的評分標準。

zh: 單一標準準則準繩判據
tip: 單數 criterion，複數 criteria，on 換成 a
example: Honesty is the main criterion by which the club chooses its new members.
exampleZh: 誠實是社團挑選新成員的主要準則。

zh: 至關重要決定性關鍵的
tip: crux 是十字路口：站在十字路口做決定，最關鍵
example: Early sleep is crucial for athletes who compete at dawn.
exampleZh: 早睡對在清晨比賽的運動員來說至關重要。

zh: 終極頂峰高潮結晶成就
tip: culmin 山頂：爬了二十年，終於到山頂
example: The new library was the culmination of twenty years of fundraising by neighbors.
exampleZh: 新圖書館是鄰居們二十年募款努力的終極成果。

zh: 達到頂點終告完結以...告終
tip: culmin 山頂：一路爬到最高點
example: The long climb will culminate in a breathtaking view from the summit.
exampleZh: 漫長的攀登將以山頂令人屏息的景色作結。

zh: 耕種栽培培養陶冶人脈
tip: cult 耕耘：把心田也當田地來培養
example: Farmers cultivate rice in flooded fields across the plains.
exampleZh: 農夫在平原上被灌水的田裡栽種稻米。

zh: 耕作培育涵養養成修養
tip: cultivate 的名詞：耕耘土地也耕耘品格
example: The cultivation of tea requires cool nights and misty mornings.
exampleZh: 茶葉的栽培需要涼爽的夜晚和多霧的早晨。

zh: 抑制克制控制約束；路緣石
tip: curb 像馬的韁繩，拉緊就停住
example: The government introduced new taxes to curb the sale of sugary drinks.
exampleZh: 政府推出新稅制，以抑制含糖飲料的銷售。

zh: 縮減削減縮減經費縮短
tip: curtain 窗簾拉上來，把東西縮短遮掉
example: The school had to curtail its field trips because of rising bus costs.
exampleZh: 由於巴士費用上漲，學校不得不縮減校外教學。

tip: curtail 縮短 + ment 名詞：被砍短後的結果
example: The curtailment of evening bus service left many night-shift workers stranded.
exampleZh: 夜間公車班次的縮減，讓許多夜班工人無法返家。

zh: 憤世嫉俗者犬儒批判者
tip: cyn 狗：像愛亂吠的狗，覺得誰都不可信
example: Nobody could convince the cynic that the stranger had returned the wallet out of kindness.
exampleZh: 沒人能說服那位憤世嫉俗的人，相信陌生人歸還皮夾是出於善意。

zh: 破譯解讀辨識辨讀出密碼
tip: de 解開 + cipher 密碼：把密碼解開
example: Linguists worked for decades to decipher the ancient script carved on the tablet.
exampleZh: 語言學家花了數十年破譯刻在石板上的古老文字。

zh: 演繹推論推知由此導出
tip: de 向下 + duc 引導：從線索一路引導到結論
example: From the muddy footprints, the detective could deduce that the visitor had come through the garden.
exampleZh: 從泥濘的腳印，偵探推論訪客是穿過花園進來的。

zh: 演繹推論扣除減除扣除額
tip: deduce 向下引導，名詞 deduction 是從總額往下扣
example: Tax deduction on charitable gifts encourages people to donate more.
exampleZh: 慈善捐贈的稅額扣除鼓勵人們多捐款。

tip: deduce 推論 + ive：用推論從大規則得出小結論的
example: Deductive reasoning moves from a general rule to a specific conclusion.
exampleZh: 演繹推理是從一般規則推導到特定結論。

tip: deem 像 dream 少一個 r：心裡認為，就當成真的
example: The judges deem the first dance too risky to score highly.
exampleZh: 評審認為第一支舞太冒險，無法拿高分。

zh: 推遲延期聽從順從遵從意見
tip: de 遠離 + fer 帶：把事情帶到後面去，延後
example: We should defer the picnic until the weather clears up.
exampleZh: 我們應該把野餐延到天氣放晴再辦。

zh: 順從恭敬敬重聽從之意
tip: defer 順從 + ence：對長輩順從的恭敬
example: The students listened with deference as the elderly scientist described his journey.
exampleZh: 學生們恭敬地聆聽年長科學家講述他的旅程。

zh: 缺乏不足缺點營養匱乏
tip: de 向下 + fic 做：做得不夠，少了東西
example: A deficiency of vitamin C can cause weak gums and slow healing.
exampleZh: 缺乏維生素 C 可能導致牙齦虛弱和傷口癒合緩慢。

tip: deficiency 缺乏的形容詞：少了什麼的
example: The soil here is deficient in iron, so the crops grow pale.
exampleZh: 這裡的土壤缺鐵，所以作物長得蒼白。

zh: 赤字虧損逆差短缺額度
tip: de 向下 + fic 做：差了一截的金額，就是赤字
example: The city closed a budget deficit by cutting spending and raising parking fees.
exampleZh: 市府削減支出並提高停車費，以填補預算赤字。

zh: 委派授權代表；代表代表團員
tip: de 離開 + leg 派遣：把任務派出去給別人
example: The principal will delegate the planning of the field day to the student council.
exampleZh: 校長會把運動會的規劃委派給學生會。

zh: 代表團委派授權權限下放
tip: delegate 派出的人，名詞 delegation 就是一群被派出去的代表
example: A delegation of farmers traveled to the capital to explain their concerns about water prices.
exampleZh: 一個農民代表團前往首都說明他們對水價的擔憂。

zh: 深思熟慮蓄意蓄謀的；商議研商
tip: de 完全 + liber 秤：在天平上仔細秤過才決定
example: The thief made a deliberate choice to leave through the window, not the door.
exampleZh: 小偷刻意選擇從窗戶離開，而不是走大門。

zh: 商議深思熟慮深審研討
tip: deliberate 的名詞：仔細秤量後才決定的商議
example: After long deliberation, the jury agreed on a verdict late that night.
exampleZh: 經過長時間商議，陪審團在當晚稍晚達成裁決。

zh: 拆除拆毀推翻破除論點
tip: de 向下 + mol 巨大石塊：把大石頭砸下來拆掉
example: Workers will demolish the old stadium next month to make room for a park.
exampleZh: 工人下個月將拆除舊體育場，騰出空間蓋公園。

zh: 論證示範證明遊行示威展示
tip: de 完全 + monstr 顯示：完整展示給你看，一看就信
example: A short experiment can demonstrate how plants bend toward the light.
exampleZh: 一個簡短的實驗就能展示植物如何朝向光源彎曲。

zh: 示範證明示威遊行論證展示
tip: demonstrate 的名詞：完整展示給你看的過程
example: Her demonstration of the new software impressed everyone in the audience.
exampleZh: 她對新軟體的示範讓全場觀眾印象深刻。

zh: 稠密茂密濃密密度高的
tip: 諧音「燈斯」：點燈也穿不透，因為太濃密
example: Dense fog hid the lighthouse from the fishing boats all morning.
exampleZh: 濃霧整個早晨讓漁船看不見燈塔。

zh: 密度稠密度比重人口密度
tip: dense 濃密 + ity：濃密的程度就是密度
example: The density of the metal made it sink at once when dropped into the tank.
exampleZh: 這種金屬的密度很大，丟進水槽立刻下沉。

zh: 調派部署配置有效展開運用
tip: de 解開 + ploy 折：把折好的部隊攤開，部署出去
example: The coach decided to deploy three fast runners at the front of the relay.
exampleZh: 教練決定把三位跑得快的選手配置在接力賽的前段。

zh: 軍力部署資源配置佈署調度
tip: deploy 的名詞：把人力、物資攤開派出去
example: Rapid deployment of rescue boats saved dozens of families from the rising water.
exampleZh: 救援船隻的迅速部署，使數十戶家庭脫離上漲的洪水。

zh: 源自導出獲取衍生起源
tip: de 向下 + riv 河流：像河水從源頭流下來
example: Many English words derive from Latin, such as library and student.
exampleZh: 許多英文單字源自拉丁文，例如 library 和 student。

zh: 字源由來衍生導出起源
tip: derive 源頭的名詞：單字流下來的來歷
example: A dictionary entry often shows the derivation of a word from older languages.
exampleZh: 字典條目常顯示單字從古老語言演變而來的由來。

zh: 衍生無原創性的；衍生金融商品
tip: derive 源自別處，所以不是自己原創的
example: Critics called the film derivative, since it copied scenes from earlier classics.
exampleZh: 評論家稱這部電影缺乏原創，因為它抄襲了早期經典的場景。

zh: 嚇阻阻止遏止防止犯罪
tip: de 離開 + terr 恐嚇：嚇得他往後退，不敢做
example: A bright light on the porch may deter burglars from approaching the house.
exampleZh: 門廊上的一盞亮燈可能嚇阻竊賊靠近房子。

zh: 威嚇力遏止物；具威懾效果的
tip: deter 嚇阻 + rent 的名詞：一個擺在那裡嚇人的東西
example: Strict penalties act as a deterrent to anyone thinking of dumping waste in the river.
exampleZh: 嚴格的處罰對任何想把廢棄物倒進河裡的人，都具有嚇阻作用。

zh: 損害傷害受損不利地位
tip: de 向下 + trit 磨損：一點一點磨掉，受損
example: Staying up late every night was to the detriment of her studies.
exampleZh: 每晚熬夜對她的課業造成損害。

zh: 有害損害性不利健康的
tip: detriment 損害 + al：會磨損東西的
example: Smoking is detrimental to the lungs, even in small amounts.
exampleZh: 吸菸對肺有害，即使量很少也一樣。

zh: 設計發明想出策劃擬定
tip: device 是名詞「裝置」，devise 是動詞，用 s 想出新點子
example: The students devised a clever game to memorize the planets in order.
exampleZh: 學生們設計了一個巧妙的遊戲，用來依序背熟行星。

zh: 毫無缺乏完全沒有空的
tip: de 離開 + void 空：空空如也，什麼都沒有
example: The desert island was devoid of trees, so the sailors had no shade.
exampleZh: 這座沙漠小島沒有一棵樹，所以水手們沒有遮蔭處。

zh: 二分法對立二元分裂二分狀態
tip: di 兩個 + chot 切：一刀切成兩半
example: The old dichotomy between work and play is disappearing in many modern offices.
exampleZh: 工作與玩樂之間的舊二分法，在許多現代辦公室中正逐漸消失。

zh: 傳播擴散擴充；散漫冗長的
tip: dif 分開 + fuse 倒：往四面八方倒出去，散開
example: Smoke began to diffuse through the hallway, so the staff opened every window.
exampleZh: 煙霧開始在走廊裡擴散，所以工作人員打開所有窗戶。

zh: 擴散傳播滲透擴散現象
tip: diffuse 的名詞：墨水一圈圈散開的現象
example: The diffusion of a drop of ink in water happens slowly without stirring.
exampleZh: 一滴墨水在水中的擴散，若不攪拌就進行得很緩慢。

zh: 尊嚴高貴莊嚴端莊體面
tip: dign 值得：值得被尊重的樣子
example: Even in poverty, the old man carried himself with quiet dignity.
exampleZh: 即使生活貧困，老人仍帶著沉靜的尊嚴行事。

zh: 兩難進退維谷尷尬抉擇窘境
tip: di 兩個 + lemma 前提：兩個選項都有麻煩
example: The coach faced a dilemma: play the injured star or risk losing the final.
exampleZh: 教練面臨兩難：是讓受傷的明星上場，還是冒著輸掉決賽的風險。

zh: 減少削弱縮小降低嚴重性
tip: di 加強 + minish 小：越變越小
example: Medicine will diminish the pain, though it may not remove it entirely.
exampleZh: 藥物會減輕疼痛，不過可能無法完全消除。

zh: 微小極小的；指小詞暱稱
tip: diminish 縮小 + ive：小到不行的
example: The diminutive pony was barely taller than the fence rail.
exampleZh: 那匹迷你小馬幾乎沒比柵欄橫木高多少。

zh: 排放解職履行職責釋放；流出物
tip: dis 解開 + charge 負擔：卸下負擔，放他走
example: The hospital will discharge the patient on Friday if his fever stays down.
exampleZh: 如果病人持續退燒，醫院將在週五讓他出院。

zh: 學術領域專業紀律懲處；管教約束
tip: disciple 門徒，門徒要守紀律，也要學一門學問
example: Medicine is a demanding discipline that requires years of study.
exampleZh: 醫學是一門要求嚴格、需要多年學習的學科。

zh: 紀律懲戒學科專業門類的
tip: discipline 紀律 + ary：和管教有關的
example: The school took disciplinary action against students who cheated on the test.
exampleZh: 學校對考試作弊的學生採取懲戒措施。

zh: 揭露透露公開揭開機密
tip: dis 打開 + close 關：把關著的門打開，秘密公開
example: The company must disclose all risks to investors before selling its shares.
exampleZh: 公司在出售股份前，必須向投資人揭露所有風險。

zh: 資訊揭露公開揭發聲明書
tip: disclose 打開秘密的名詞：公開的資訊
example: Full financial disclosure is required of every candidate for public office.
exampleZh: 每位公職候選人都必須完整揭露財務。

zh: 分離的分立各別不相關的
tip: discrete 的 t 把兩個 e 隔開，是分開的；discreet 兩個 e 相連，是謹慎
example: The report is divided into three discrete sections that can be read in any order.
exampleZh: 報告分成三個各自獨立的部分，可以任意順序閱讀。

zh: 謹慎判斷力自由裁量決定權
tip: dis 分開 + creet 辨別：能分辨輕重，才有資格自己決定
example: The judge used her discretion to reduce the fine for a first-time offender.
exampleZh: 法官運用她的裁量權，減輕了初犯者的罰款。

tip: discretion 是決定權，加 ary 變成「可自己決定的」
example: Managers may spend discretionary funds without asking the board for approval.
exampleZh: 經理可以動用可自由支配的經費，不必請董事會批准。

zh: 鄙視輕蔑不屑一顧傲慢
tip: dis 否定 + dain 值得：覺得不值得理會，所以鄙視
example: She glanced at the cheap copy with open disdain and walked away.
exampleZh: 她帶著毫不掩飾的輕蔑瞥了那件廉價仿品一眼，轉身走開。

tip: dis 去掉 + illusion 幻想：美夢被戳破，人就醒了
example: Years of broken promises began to disillusion even the president's strongest supporters.
exampleZh: 多年的背信棄義，開始讓連總統最堅定的支持者也幻想破滅。

zh: 拆卸廢除拆散逐漸瓦解
tip: dis 拆掉 + mantle 披風：把外衣一件件脫下來
example: Workers began to dismantle the old stage as soon as the final show ended.
exampleZh: 最後一場演出一結束，工人就開始拆除舊舞台。

zh: 截然不同的迥異的無可比性的
tip: dis 不 + par 相等：兩個東西不成對，差很大
example: The museum placed disparate objects, from clay pots to radios, side by side in one hall.
exampleZh: 博物館把從陶罐到收音機等截然不同的物品，並排擺在同一個展廳。

zh: 懸殊落差巨大差異不平等
tip: dis 不 + par 同等（像高爾夫標準桿）：沒在同一桿數就是差距
example: A wide disparity in school funding left poorer districts struggling to hire teachers.
exampleZh: 學校經費的巨大落差，讓較貧困的地區難以聘到老師。

zh: 不帶感情冷靜客觀公正的
tip: dis 沒有 + passion 激情：沒有激情，就能冷靜公正
example: A dispassionate historian weighs both sides before she draws any conclusion.
exampleZh: 冷靜客觀的歷史學家在下結論之前，會先權衡雙方的說法。

zh: 驅散掃除消除疑慮消除恐懼
tip: dis 離開 + pel 推：把疑慮用力推走
example: Her calm, honest answer helped dispel the villagers' fear of the new bridge.
exampleZh: 她冷靜而誠實的回答，幫助消除了村民對新橋的恐懼。

zh: 分配分發配藥免除豁免
tip: dis 分開 + pens 秤重：把藥秤好分給每個人
example: The pharmacist will dispense the medicine once the doctor confirms the correct dose.
exampleZh: 醫生確認正確劑量後，藥師就會配發這種藥。

zh: 驅散疏散散開消散傳播
tip: dis 分開 + perse 撒：像蒲公英的種子被風吹散
example: When the bell rang, the crowd began to disperse across the sunlit square.
exampleZh: 鈴聲一響，人群開始散開，湧向陽光灑落的廣場各處。

zh: 散布分散色散統計離散
tip: disperse 是動詞散開，dispersion 是名詞散布
example: The dispersion of seeds by wind helps plants colonize bare, distant ground.
exampleZh: 風傳播種子，幫助植物在遙遠的裸地上長出新族群。

zh: 不成比例的過大的不相稱的
tip: dis 不 + proportion 比例：比例不對，不相稱
example: Critics said the punishment was disproportionate to such a small mistake.
exampleZh: 批評者說，這樣的處罰對於這麼小的過錯來說太重了。

zh: 解剖切細細分剖析仔細分析
tip: dis 分開 + sect 切（像 section 區段）：切成一段段
example: In botany class, we dissect a lily to study its petals and stamens.
exampleZh: 在植物學課上，我們解剖一朵百合來研究它的花瓣和雄蕊。

zh: 解剖分析仔細剖析精闢解構
tip: dissect 切開，dissection 就是切開後的分析
example: A close dissection of the poem reveals how every image supports its theme.
exampleZh: 對這首詩的細緻剖析顯示，每個意象都在支撐它的主題。

zh: 傳播散播散發理念廣為傳播
tip: dis 四散 + semin 種子：像撒種子一樣把消息撒出去
example: The charity works to disseminate health information in remote mountain villages.
exampleZh: 這個慈善組織致力於在偏遠山村傳播健康資訊。

tip: disseminate 的名詞：把種子般的知識撒向四方
example: Printing presses sped up the dissemination of new scientific ideas across Europe.
exampleZh: 印刷機加快了新科學思想在歐洲各地的傳播。

zh: 異議不同意持反對意見
tip: dis 分開 + sent 感覺：大家感覺不同，所以持反對意見
example: Only one senator dared to dissent from the party's plan to raise taxes.
exampleZh: 只有一位參議員敢對黨內提高稅收的計畫表示異議。

zh: 持不同政見者反對派抗爭者
tip: dis 分開 + sid 坐：坐到對面去，站在不同陣營
example: After criticizing censorship, the poet was labeled a dissident by the government.
exampleZh: 這位詩人批評審查制度後，被政府貼上異議人士的標籤。

zh: 消散驅散揮霍浪費消失
tip: 想像太陽一出來，霧氣一下子散得無影無蹤
example: By noon, the morning fog had begun to dissipate over the quiet bay.
exampleZh: 到了中午，晨霧開始在寧靜的海灣上空消散。

tip: dissolve 溶解的名詞：整個組織像糖一樣化掉
example: The dissolution of the empire left dozens of small, rival states along its borders.
exampleZh: 帝國的瓦解，在邊境一帶留下數十個彼此敵對的小國。

zh: 溶解解散消除解除合約
tip: dis 分開 + solve 鬆開：糖粒鬆開散進水裡
example: Stir the sugar until it dissolves completely in the warm water.
exampleZh: 攪拌糖直到它完全溶解在溫水裡。

zh: 扭曲曲解曲解事實使走樣
tip: dis 離開 + tort 扭：從原樣扭歪離開
example: Cheap window glass can distort the view of the street outside.
exampleZh: 廉價的窗玻璃會讓窗外的街景變形。

tip: distort 扭曲的名詞，想像哈哈鏡裡歪掉的影像
example: Funhouse mirrors create a comic distortion of your reflection.
exampleZh: 哈哈鏡會讓你的倒影產生滑稽的變形。

zh: 分歧分道揚鑣分叉偏離
tip: di 分開 + verge 轉向：往不同方向轉出去
example: At the fork, the two trails diverge, one climbing and the other dropping to a stream.
exampleZh: 在岔路口，兩條小徑分開，一條向上爬，另一條下到溪邊。

zh: 分歧偏離差異分離現象
tip: diverge 分叉的名詞：路越走越分開
example: A growing divergence between the partners' goals finally ended the deal.
exampleZh: 合夥人之間日益擴大的目標分歧，最終讓這筆交易破局。

tip: diverge 分叉 + ent：各走各的路的
example: The siblings held divergent views on how to spend their inheritance.
exampleZh: 兄弟姊妹對如何使用遺產抱持相異的看法。

tip: di 分開 + vers 轉：朝各種不同方向，所以多樣
example: Rain forests are prized for their remarkable diversity of insects and birds.
exampleZh: 雨林因為昆蟲與鳥類種類驚人的多樣性而備受珍視。

zh: 多樣化多角化經營分散風險
tip: diversity 多樣 + ify 使：使變得多樣
example: Farmers who diversify their crops lose less when a single harvest fails.
exampleZh: 種植多樣作物的農民，在某一種收成失敗時損失較少。

zh: 教條主義學說信條法理
tip: doc 教（像 doctor 博士）：被教導的內容就是教義
example: The party clung to a rigid doctrine that rejected every compromise.
exampleZh: 該黨死守一套拒絕任何妥協的僵硬教條。

zh: 死板教條式的空談理論的
example: His doctrinaire approach ignored every fact that contradicted the theory.
exampleZh: 他死板的教條式作法，無視了所有與理論相矛盾的事實。

tip: juxta 靠近 + pose 放置：擺在旁邊好互相比較
example: The photographer chose to juxtapose a gleaming tower with a crumbling hut.
exampleZh: 攝影師選擇把一座閃亮的高塔與一間傾頹的小屋並置在一起。

tip: juxtapose 的名詞：兩樣東西並排站
example: The poem's juxtaposition of joy and grief makes both feelings sharper.
exampleZh: 這首詩把歡樂與悲傷並置，讓兩種情感都更加鮮明。

tip: re 再 + iter 再次：再說一遍，說了又說
example: The coach had to reiterate the rules before the match could begin.
exampleZh: 教練必須在比賽開始前再次重申規則。

tip: e 出來 + voke 叫（像 vocal 聲音）：把回憶叫出來
example: The smell of baked bread can evoke memories of a grandmother's kitchen.
exampleZh: 烤麵包的香味能喚起人對外婆廚房的回憶。

zh: 喚起回憶的、深具感染力的
tip: evoke 喚起 + ative：有本事喚起感受的
example: With its evocative score, the film brings a lonely seaside town vividly to mind.
exampleZh: 這部電影以極具感染力的配樂，把一座孤寂的海邊小鎮鮮明地帶入腦海。

tip: dis 否定 + parage 等級：把人貶到低等級去
example: Constant disparagement from his rivals never shook the young chef's confidence.
exampleZh: 對手不斷的貶低，從未動搖這位年輕主廚的自信。

tip: 想像大家安安靜靜，不說也都懂，心照不宣
example: Their tacit agreement was never written down, yet everyone followed it.
exampleZh: 他們的默契協議從未寫下來，但每個人都遵守。

zh: 沈默寡言的、不苟言笑的
tip: tacit 默不作聲 + urn：像個蓋著蓋子不出聲的罐子
example: The taciturn farmer answered every question with a single nod.
exampleZh: 那位沉默寡言的農夫用一個點頭回答所有問題。

zh: 居高臨下的、傲慢屈尊的
tip: con 一起 + descend 下降：從高處降下來跟你說話
example: He gave a condescending smile and explained the obvious as if to a child.
exampleZh: 他露出居高臨下的微笑，像對小孩說話一樣解釋顯而易見的事。

tip: condescend 屈尊俯就 + sion：名詞就是那副高高在上的神態
example: She accepted the compliment, but his condescension made the praise sting.
exampleZh: 她接受了讚美，但他那種居高臨下的態度讓這番稱讚刺耳。

zh: 無所不在的、普遍蔓延的
tip: per 穿過 + vas 走：到處穿行，哪裡都走得到
example: A pervasive sense of dread hung over the town before the storm.
exampleZh: 暴風雨來臨前，一股揮之不去的恐懼籠罩著整座小鎮。

tip: per 穿過 + meate 走：像水一樣穿過縫隙滲進去
example: Rainwater slowly began to permeate the thin soil and reach the roots.
exampleZh: 雨水慢慢開始滲入薄薄的土壤，到達根部。

tip: e 出 + lucid 清楚（像 lucky 運氣的光）：講到完全明白
example: The textbook's elucidation of the theory finally made the proof clear.
exampleZh: 教科書對這個理論的闡明，終於讓證明變得清楚易懂。

tip: co 一起 + alesc 成長：小東西長在一起變成一個
example: The coalescence of small streams into one river carved the broad valley.
exampleZh: 小溪匯聚成一條大河，切出了寬闊的山谷。

tip: 想像放大鏡底下，連最小的細節都逃不掉
example: The new bridge design came under intense scrutiny from independent engineers.
exampleZh: 新橋的設計受到獨立工程師的嚴格審視。

tip: syn 一起 + thesis 放置：把各部分放在一起
example: Her essay offers a synthesis of three rival theories in one clear model.
exampleZh: 她的文章把三種互相競爭的理論統整成一個清楚的模型。

tip: prag 做事（像 practice 實踐）：只看行不行得通
example: Pragmatism, not ideology, guided the mayor when she repaired the city's budget.
exampleZh: 市長整頓市府預算時，指引她的是務實精神，而非意識形態。

zh: 仁慈仁厚的、慈善善良的
tip: bene 好 + vol 意願（像 volunteer 志願者）：心懷善意
example: A benevolent donor quietly paid for the village school's new library.
exampleZh: 一位仁慈的捐款者默默出錢，替村裡的學校蓋了新圖書館。

tip: bene 好 + vol 意願：願望是善良的，就是仁愛
example: Visitors remembered the old doctor's benevolence long after he retired.
exampleZh: 來訪者在老醫生退休很久之後，仍記得他的仁慈。

zh: 可疑存疑的、半信半疑的
tip: du 二（像 double）：心裡有兩個想法，半信半疑
example: Scientists stayed dubious about the claim because no lab could repeat the test.
exampleZh: 由於沒有實驗室能重做這項測試，科學家對這個說法仍存疑。

zh: 具獨特怪癖的、特異特質的
tip: idio 自己（像 idiom 慣用語）：只屬於自己的怪特色
example: Her idiosyncratic teaching style included singing the periodic table to the class.
exampleZh: 她獨具個人特色的教學風格，包括對全班唱出元素週期表。

zh: 獨特性格、個人特異習慣
tip: idio 自己：只有他自己才有的小習慣
example: Wearing mismatched socks was one of the professor's harmless idiosyncrasies.
exampleZh: 穿不成對的襪子是教授無傷大雅的怪癖之一。

zh: 發自內心直覺的、腑臟深處的
tip: 想像肚子深處一緊，不用腦袋想就先有感覺
example: The film triggered a visceral reaction of fear in the audience before they could think.
exampleZh: 這部電影在觀眾還來不及思考之前，就引發了發自本能的恐懼反應。

zh: 教條武斷的、自以為是的
example: The dogmatic editor refused to consider any view but his own.
exampleZh: 那位固執武斷的編輯拒絕考慮自己以外的任何看法。

example: Galileo challenged old dogma when he argued that Earth moves around the sun.
exampleZh: 伽利略主張地球繞著太陽轉，挑戰了舊有的教條。

zh: 可塑易變的、具延展性的
tip: mall 槌子（像 mallet 木槌）：一敲就能變形
example: Gold is so malleable that it can be hammered into paper-thin sheets.
exampleZh: 黃金延展性極佳，可以被搥打成薄如紙的金屬片。

tip: malleable 可塑的 + ity：名詞就是可塑的程度
example: The malleability of young minds makes early education especially powerful.
exampleZh: 年輕心智的可塑性，使早期教育格外有力量。

zh: 可行可實施的、能存活的
tip: vi 生命（像 vital）+ able：能活下去，就行得通
example: Engineers need a viable plan that fits both the budget and the schedule.
exampleZh: 工程師需要一個同時符合預算與時程的可行計畫。

tip: viable 能活的 + ity：事業活不活得下去
example: Investors doubted the viability of a business that lost money every month.
exampleZh: 投資人懷疑一家每月虧損的企業是否有生存發展的能力。

zh: 不受影響的、無法滲透的
tip: im 不 + per 穿過 + via 路：沒有路能穿過去
example: The duck's oily feathers are impervious to rain.
exampleZh: 鴨子油亮的羽毛不受雨水影響，水滲不進去。

tip: ubi 在哪裡：問哪裡有，答案是哪裡都有
example: With the ubiquity of smartphones, almost anyone can record an event instantly.
exampleZh: 由於智慧型手機無所不在，幾乎任何人都能立刻記錄事件。

tip: defer 聽從 + ential：低頭聽從長輩的
example: Students stayed deferential to the elderly professor and rose when he entered.
exampleZh: 學生對年長的教授十分恭敬，他一進來就起立。

tip: disdain 鄙視 + ful：充滿鄙視的樣子
example: She gave a disdainful sniff at the plain, handmade gift.
exampleZh: 她對那份樸素的手作禮物不屑地哼了一聲。

zh: 顯赫傑出的、聲名遠播的
tip: e 出 + min 突出（像 prominent）：高高突出人群的人
example: An eminent physicist was invited to give the opening lecture.
exampleZh: 一位傑出的物理學家受邀發表開場演講。

zh: 顯赫崇高地位、卓越成就
tip: eminent 顯赫 + ce：站上高處的地位
example: The architect rose to eminence after designing the city's famous concert hall.
exampleZh: 這位建築師在設計了該市著名的音樂廳之後聲名大噪。

zh: 短暫飛逝的、飄忽即逝的
tip: flee 逃走：一下子就逃掉、溜走了
example: She caught only a fleeting glimpse of the fox before it vanished.
exampleZh: 她只匆匆瞥見那隻狐狸一眼，牠就消失了。

zh: 懷有敵意的、不利艱難的
tip: hostile 長得像 host 主人，卻是不歡迎你的主人
example: Travelers crossed the hostile desert, where water and shade were almost impossible to find.
exampleZh: 旅人橫越嚴酷的沙漠，那裡幾乎找不到水和遮蔭。

tip: hostile 敵對的 + ity：名詞就是敵意
example: Open hostility between the two families made the wedding awkward.
exampleZh: 兩個家族之間公然的敵意，讓婚禮氣氛尷尬。

zh: 錯綜複雜精細的、繁複的
tip: 想像一團細密交織的蕾絲，每條線都纏在一起
example: An intricate pattern of tiny birds covered the silk.
exampleZh: 細小鳥兒交織成的錯綜精細圖案覆蓋了整塊絲綢。

zh: 錯綜複雜之處、繁複細節
tip: intricate 的名詞，一堆小齒輪層層交錯
example: Students admired the intricacy of the antique clock's tiny gears.
exampleZh: 學生們讚嘆古董鐘裡小齒輪的繁複精細。

tip: mal 壞（像 malfunction 故障）+ ous：壞心眼的
example: A malicious rumor spread through the school and hurt her reputation.
exampleZh: 一則惡意的謠言在學校傳開，傷害了她的名聲。

tip: mal 壞：壞念頭，想害人的心
example: He felt no malice toward his rival and even shook her hand.
exampleZh: 他對對手毫無惡意，甚至和她握了手。

zh: 廢棄過時淘汰的、老舊的
tip: 想像傳呼機被丟進博物館，被時代淘汰
example: Floppy disks are now obsolete because cloud storage replaced them.
exampleZh: 軟碟如今已經過時，因為雲端儲存取代了它們。

tip: obsolete 過時 + escence：漸漸變得過時的過程
example: Rapid obsolescence of phones leads many people to replace them every two years.
exampleZh: 手機快速過時，使許多人每兩年就換新機。

zh: 多產富創造力的、大量的
tip: pro 向前 + lific 生產：不斷生出新作品
example: The prolific novelist published nearly two books every year.
exampleZh: 這位多產的小說家幾乎每年出版兩本書。

tip: 想像把說法退回去並大喊「我不認！」
example: The senator moved to repudiate the claim, calling it completely false.
exampleZh: 那位參議員出面駁斥這項說法，稱它完全不實。

tip: repudiate 的名詞，把說法退回去的動作
example: The company's swift repudiation of the rumor calmed its investors.
exampleZh: 公司迅速駁斥謠言，安撫了投資人。

zh: 莊嚴莊重的、肅穆沉重的
tip: 結尾 mn 的 n 不發音，和 column 一樣
example: The soldiers stood in solemn silence as the flag was lowered.
exampleZh: 旗幟降下時，士兵們在莊嚴的靜默中肅立。

tip: solemn 的 n 不發音，但 solemnity 的 n 要唸出來
example: The solemnity of the ceremony silenced even the youngest children.
exampleZh: 典禮的莊嚴肅穆，連最小的孩子也安靜下來。

tip: sur 在上面 + mount 爬：一步步爬過障礙
example: With her coach's help, she managed to surmount every obstacle on the course.
exampleZh: 在教練的幫助下，她設法克服了賽道上的每一個障礙。

tip: in 不 + surmount 爬過 + able：爬不過去的
example: The cost of digging the tunnel proved an insurmountable barrier to the project.
exampleZh: 挖隧道的成本成了這項計畫無法克服的障礙。

zh: 溫和克制的、溫帶適中的
tip: temper 調節：氣溫調得剛剛好，不極端
example: Temperate forests lose their leaves in autumn and rest through cool winters.
exampleZh: 溫帶森林在秋天落葉，並在涼爽的冬季休息。

tip: temper 調節 + ance：把自己調到不過量
example: Temperance in eating and drinking kept the old sailor healthy into his nineties.
exampleZh: 飲食上的節制讓這位老水手到九十多歲仍然健康。

tip: 想像對年長智者恭敬鞠躬，滿心景仰
example: Villagers venerate the ancient oak as a living symbol of their ancestors.
exampleZh: 村民崇敬這棵古老的橡樹，視它為祖先的活象徵。

tip: venerate 崇敬 + tion：心中充滿敬意的狀態
example: The old statue was an object of veneration for generations of pilgrims.
exampleZh: 這座古老的雕像是世世代代朝聖者崇敬的對象。

zh: 證明清白平反、證實正確
tip: 想像法官敲槌，宣布「你是清白的、你是對的」
example: New evidence helped vindicate the engineer who had warned about the cracks.
exampleZh: 新證據證明了那位曾警告裂縫問題的工程師是對的。

tip: vindicate 證明正確 + tion：名詞就是平反的結果
example: The test results brought vindication to the scientist whose theory had been mocked.
exampleZh: 測試結果為那位理論曾被嘲笑的科學家平反。

tip: an + ec + dote：一段沒寫進正史的小故事
example: The speaker opened her talk with a funny anecdote about her first day at school.
exampleZh: 講者以一則關於她上學第一天的有趣軼事開場。

zh: 軼事傳聞的、非系統實證的
tip: anecdote 小故事 + al：只有故事，沒有系統數據
example: Anecdotal stories about miracle cures are not enough to prove a drug works.
exampleZh: 關於神奇療法的軼事傳聞，不足以證明藥物有效。

zh: 嚴峻簡樸無裝飾的、苦行的
tip: 想像空蕩蕩、沒有裝飾、冷冷清清的房間
example: The monk lived in an austere room furnished with only a mat and a lamp.
exampleZh: 那位僧人住在只有一張蓆子和一盞燈的簡樸房間裡。

zh: 簡樸節衣縮食、嚴厲緊縮
tip: austere 嚴苛簡樸 + ity：勒緊褲帶過日子
example: Years of austerity forced the town to close its library and cut bus routes.
exampleZh: 多年的緊縮政策迫使小鎮關閉圖書館並減少公車路線。

tip: belli 戰爭（像 rebellion 反叛）：一副要開戰的樣子
example: The belligerent neighbor shouted at anyone who parked near his gate.
exampleZh: 那位好鬥的鄰居對任何把車停在他門口附近的人大吼。

tip: belligerent 好戰的 + ce：名詞就是那股好鬥勁
example: His belligerence in meetings made colleagues avoid any open debate.
exampleZh: 他在會議中的好鬥態度，讓同事們避免任何公開辯論。

zh: 編年史記事；按年代記錄
tip: chron 時間（像 chronic 長期的）：照時間順序記下來
example: A monk wrote a chronicle that recorded every harvest and flood for fifty years.
exampleZh: 一位僧人寫了一部編年史，記錄了五十年間每一次豐收與水災。

tip: co 一起 + her 黏（像 adhere 黏貼）：黏在一起不散
example: The essay lacked coherence because its paragraphs jumped from topic to topic.
exampleZh: 這篇文章缺乏連貫性，因為各段落在不同主題間跳來跳去。

zh: 自滿自鳴得意、安於現狀
tip: com 完全 + plac 滿意（像 please）：自己滿意就不再進步
example: Complacency after early success cost the team the championship.
exampleZh: 早期成功之後的自滿，讓球隊丟掉了冠軍。

tip: com 完全 + plac 滿意：滿意到躺平不想努力
example: The champion grew complacent and stopped practicing, so a younger rival beat him.
exampleZh: 那位冠軍變得自滿而停止練習，結果被較年輕的對手擊敗。

tip: con 一起 + found 倒：全部攪在一起，頭腦打結
example: The strange results continued to confound researchers for years.
exampleZh: 這些奇怪的結果多年來一直讓研究人員困惑不已。

zh: 顯眼引人注目的、突出的
tip: con 全部 + spic 看（像 spectator 觀眾）：一眼就被看到
example: Her bright red coat was conspicuous against the gray winter crowd.
exampleZh: 她鮮紅的外套在灰撲撲的冬日人群中格外顯眼。

tip: convey 運送 + ance：負責運送的東西
example: The cart was the only conveyance available to carry the harvest to market.
exampleZh: 那輛推車是唯一可以把收成運到市集的運輸工具。

tip: crypt 地下密室：藏在暗處，看不懂意思
example: He left a cryptic note on the desk that nobody could decode.
exampleZh: 他在桌上留下一張沒人能破解的神祕字條。

tip: de 向下 + nounce 說：大聲說出它的不對
example: Leaders from every party gathered to denounce the attack and demand justice.
exampleZh: 各黨派的領袖齊聚，公開譴責這起攻擊並要求正義。

tip: denounce 譴責 + tion：名詞就是譴責的聲明
example: The newspaper's fierce denunciation of the plan stirred public protest.
exampleZh: 報紙對該計畫的嚴厲譴責引發了民眾抗議。

tip: de + pict 畫（像 picture 圖畫）：畫出來的樣子
example: The painting's depiction of a stormy harbor feels almost alive.
exampleZh: 這幅畫對暴風雨港口的描繪幾乎栩栩如生。

tip: de 向下 + rid 笑（像 ridiculous 可笑的）：笑到對方抬不起頭
example: Critics would deride the inventor's flying machine as a foolish toy.
exampleZh: 評論家會嘲笑這位發明家的飛行器只是愚蠢的玩具。

tip: deride 嘲笑 + sion：名詞就是嘲弄的態度
example: The crowd met his boast with laughter and derision.
exampleZh: 群眾以笑聲和嘲弄回應他的自誇。

tip: de 完全 + sol 單獨（像 solo）：只剩孤零零一片
example: The desolate island had no trees, no people, and only wind.
exampleZh: 那座荒涼的島上沒有樹，沒有人，只有風。

tip: desolate 荒涼 + tion：名詞就是那片孤寂荒蕪
example: A feeling of desolation settled over the empty village after the flood.
exampleZh: 洪水過後，一股淒涼的感覺籠罩著空蕩蕩的村莊。

zh: 狡詐彎曲不正當迂迴的
tip: de 離開 + via 路：不走正路，專走歪路
example: The devious clerk took an indirect route to hide the mistake.
exampleZh: 那位狡詐的店員繞了一條迂迴的路來掩蓋錯誤。

tip: di 分開 + lute 洗：加水沖淡，味道變弱
example: Dilute the juice with water so the little ones don't get too much sugar.
exampleZh: 把果汁加水稀釋，小朋友就不會攝取太多糖。

tip: dilute 稀釋 + tion：名詞就是被沖淡的過程
example: Dilution of the cleaner made it safer to use on delicate surfaces.
exampleZh: 清潔劑經過稀釋後，用在脆弱的表面上更安全。

tip: dimin 像 minus 減：一直減少變小
example: The diminution of the glacier over fifty years alarmed local scientists.
exampleZh: 冰河五十年間的縮減令當地科學家警覺。

tip: dis 失去 + may 力量：嚇到全身沒力氣
example: To their dismay, a sudden storm canceled the picnic they had planned for weeks.
exampleZh: 令他們沮喪的是，一場突來的暴風雨取消了他們籌劃數週的野餐。

zh: 迅速派遣發送；敏捷處置
tip: 想像快遞員一聲令下，馬上被派出去
example: The captain will dispatch a rescue boat as soon as the storm calms.
exampleZh: 風暴一平息，船長就會立刻派出救援船。

tip: dispute 爭論 + atious：愛挑起爭論的人
example: A disputatious uncle turned every family dinner into a lively argument.
exampleZh: 一位好爭辯的叔叔，把每場家庭聚餐都變成熱烈的爭論。

zh: 古怪特異的；特立獨行者
tip: ex 外 + centric 中心：偏離中心、不走尋常路的人
example: The eccentric inventor wore a cape and talked to his tomato plants.
exampleZh: 那位古怪的發明家披著斗篷，還會對他的番茄苗說話。

tip: eccentric 古怪 + ity：名詞就是那個小怪癖
example: Her only eccentricity was serving every guest soup in a teacup.
exampleZh: 她唯一的怪癖，就是用茶杯為每位客人盛湯。

tip: e 外 + greg 群（像 gregarious 合群的）：離群到過分的壞
example: The report exposed an egregious error that cost the company millions.
exampleZh: 這份報告揭露了一個讓公司損失數百萬的極其離譜的錯誤。

zh: 難以捉摸難以界定捕捉的
tip: 想像抓泥鰍，一伸手就滑走了，抓不住
example: The elusive snow leopard is rarely seen, even by those who study it.
exampleZh: 難以捉摸的雪豹連研究牠的人也很少見到。

tip: e 出 + lude 玩把戲：玩著把戲從你手中溜出去
example: The meaning of the ancient inscription continued to elude even expert scholars.
exampleZh: 這段古老銘文的意思，連專家學者也始終無法理解。

tip: 想著模仿偶像，還要努力追上甚至超越他
example: Young players try to emulate the champion's calm focus and daily discipline.
exampleZh: 年輕球員努力效法那位冠軍的冷靜專注與每日自律。

tip: emulate 仿效 + tion：向榜樣看齊的行動
example: Her success inspired emulation among classmates, who began keeping similar study journals.
exampleZh: 她的成功激起同學的仿效，大家也開始寫類似的學習日誌。

tip: en 使 + dur 硬（像 during、durable）：撐得久，不倒
example: The old stone bridge has endured a hundred years of floods and storms.
exampleZh: 這座古老的石橋已經經受了一百年的洪水與風暴。

tip: endure 撐住 + ance：名詞就是撐得住的力量
example: Marathon runners build endurance through months of slow, steady training.
exampleZh: 馬拉松跑者透過數月緩慢而穩定的訓練來累積耐力。

tip: en 使 + force 力量：用力量讓規定真的生效
example: Police officers enforce the speed limit near the school every morning.
exampleZh: 警察每天早上在學校附近執行速限規定。

tip: enforce 執行 + ment：名詞就是落實規定的動作
example: Stricter enforcement of fishing rules helped the lake's trout recover.
exampleZh: 更嚴格地執行捕魚規定，幫助湖裡的鱒魚數量恢復。

tip: enigma 謎 + tic：像謎一樣的
example: Her enigmatic smile gave no hint of what she was thinking.
exampleZh: 她那神祕難解的微笑，完全看不出她在想什麼。

tip: 諧音「一你個嗎」：這是什麼？一個謎！
example: The origin of the stone circles remains an enigma to historians.
exampleZh: 這些石圈的起源對歷史學家來說仍是一個謎。

tip: 結尾是 ice：冰淇淋的誘惑讓你走進店
example: Bright posters entice shoppers into the bakery with promises of free cookies.
exampleZh: 鮮豔的海報用免費餅乾的承諾，把顧客引誘進烘焙坊。

tip: entice 引誘 + ment：名詞就是那個誘餌
example: Free tickets were the main enticement for students to attend the lecture.
exampleZh: 免費入場券是吸引學生來聽演講的主要誘因。

tip: e 出 + numer 數字（像 number）：一個個數出來
example: The guide began to enumerate the island's birds, naming each one in turn.
exampleZh: 導覽員開始逐一列舉島上的鳥類，依序說出每一種的名字。

tip: enumerate 一個個數 + tion：名詞就是條列清單
example: The enumeration of the contract's duties filled three full pages.
exampleZh: 合約職責的逐項列舉就佔了整整三頁。

tip: equi 相等（像 equal）+ able：人人分得一樣合理
example: An equitable plan divides the river water fairly among all the farms.
exampleZh: 一個公平的方案會把河水公平地分配給所有農田。

tip: equi 相等（像 equal）：大家得到一樣的公平對待
example: Activists called for greater equity in how public parks are funded.
exampleZh: 活動人士呼籲在公園經費的分配上有更大的公平性。

zh: 不穩定飄忽古怪反常的
tip: err 漫遊（像 error）：亂跑亂走，沒有規律
example: The robot's erratic movements made it impossible to predict where it would turn next.
exampleZh: 機器人飄忽不定的動作，讓人無法預測它下一步會轉向哪裡。

zh: 錯誤不正確存在偏差的
tip: error 錯誤 + ous：充滿 error 的
example: Erroneous data led the team to draw the wrong conclusion.
exampleZh: 錯誤的數據使團隊得出了錯誤的結論。

zh: 升級加劇迅速擴大衝突
tip: escalator 電扶梯：一階一階往上升級
example: Minor insults can escalate into a full-blown quarrel within minutes.
exampleZh: 小小的冒犯可能在幾分鐘內升級成一場大爭吵。

zh: 緊張升級全面加劇擴大
tip: escalate 升級 + tion：電扶梯越爬越高
example: Diplomats worked hard to prevent the escalation of the border dispute.
exampleZh: 外交官努力防止邊境爭端升級。

zh: 使極其惱火激怒激起憤慨
tip: ex 出 + asper 粗糙：被粗糙地磨得心煩
example: The toddler's endless questions began to exasperate his tired father.
exampleZh: 幼兒沒完沒了的問題，開始讓他疲憊的父親惱火。

tip: exasperate 惹火 + tion：名詞就是那股惱怒
example: With a sigh of exasperation, she handed back the broken printer.
exampleZh: 她氣惱地嘆了一口氣，把壞掉的印表機退了回去。

tip: example 例子 + ary：值得拿來當例子的
example: Her exemplary behavior earned praise from teachers and classmates alike.
exampleZh: 她堪稱模範的行為贏得了老師和同學一致的讚美。

tip: example 例子的人物版：可以當標竿的楷模
example: The city is an exemplar of clean and efficient public transport.
exampleZh: 這座城市是乾淨又高效率大眾運輸的典範。

zh: 施加發揮運用力量影響
tip: ex 出 + ert 連接：把力氣使出來，作用到別人身上
example: The moon exerts a steady pull on Earth's oceans, producing the tides.
exampleZh: 月球對地球海洋施加穩定的引力，造成潮汐。

tip: exert 使出力氣 + ion：名詞就是花力氣
example: Sweat covered the climbers after hours of exertion on the steep trail.
exampleZh: 爬山者在陡峭小徑上辛苦攀爬數小時後滿身是汗。

zh: 異國風情的外來奇異的
tip: exo 外面（像 exit 出口）：從外面來的，很新奇
example: Exotic fruits from distant tropical islands filled the market stalls.
exampleZh: 來自遙遠熱帶島嶼的異國水果擺滿了市集攤位。

tip: ex 外 + plic 折：攤開沒折起來，講得明明白白
example: The manual gives explicit instructions, leaving no room for guessing.
exampleZh: 說明書給出明確的指示，沒有任何猜測的餘地。

zh: 利用剝削開發；英勇功績
tip: ex 出 + ploit 折：把價值攤開，榨取利用
example: Early settlers began to exploit the river's power to run their mills.
exampleZh: 早期移民開始利用河水的力量來推動他們的磨坊。

zh: 開發利用不當剝削濫用
tip: exploit 榨取 + ation：名詞就是不當的榨取
example: Reformers fought against the exploitation of children in nineteenth-century factories.
exampleZh: 改革者奮力對抗十九世紀工廠中對兒童的剝削。

tip: facil 容易（像 facility 設施）+ ate 使：使事情變容易
example: Clear signs facilitate travel for visitors who do not speak the language.
exampleZh: 清楚的標示讓不懂當地語言的旅客更容易旅行。

tip: facilitate 使容易 + ion：名詞就是推一把的作業
example: The mediator's facilitation of the talks helped both sides reach agreement.
exampleZh: 調解人對會談的推動，幫助雙方達成協議。

tip: fea 做（像 fact 事實）+ ible：做得成的
example: Building a bridge here is feasible only if the budget doubles.
exampleZh: 只有在預算加倍的情況下，在這裡建橋才是可行的。

tip: feasible 做得成 + ity：名詞就是做不做得成
example: A feasibility study will show whether the new train line is realistic.
exampleZh: 可行性研究將顯示這條新鐵路線是否切合實際。

tip: fluct 流動（像 fluid 液體）：像海浪一起一伏
example: Prices of fresh vegetables fluctuate with the weather and the season.
exampleZh: 新鮮蔬菜的價格會隨天氣和季節而波動。

tip: fluctuate 波動 + ion：名詞就是起伏的幅度
example: Daily fluctuations in temperature were small, so the seedlings grew steadily.
exampleZh: 每日氣溫的波動很小，所以幼苗穩定生長。

zh: 制定規劃明確系統表達
tip: formula 公式 + ate：整理成一套明確的說法
example: Scientists must formulate a clear hypothesis before they design an experiment.
exampleZh: 科學家在設計實驗之前，必須先擬定清楚的假設。

tip: formula 公式 + tion：名詞就是配方或系統說法
example: The formulation of the new medicine took years of careful testing.
exampleZh: 這款新藥的配方研發花了好幾年的仔細測試。

zh: 培養撫育促進健康發展
tip: foster 像 forest：在森林裡細心滋養小樹苗
example: Good teachers foster curiosity by letting students ask their own questions.
exampleZh: 好老師讓學生提出自己的問題，藉此培養好奇心。

tip: Frank 是人名，叫 Frank 的人有話直說
example: To be frank, the first draft needs a lot of work.
exampleZh: 坦白說，初稿還需要大幅修改。

tip: frank 坦率 + ness：名詞就是那份直言不諱
example: Her frankness surprised the committee, but they respected her honest answers.
exampleZh: 她的坦率讓委員會很驚訝，但他們尊重她誠實的回答。

zh: 輕浮不嚴肅無關緊要的
tip: 想像輕飄飄的羽毛，一點分量都沒有，不嚴肅
example: The judge dismissed the frivolous lawsuit over a spilled cup of tea.
exampleZh: 法官駁回了這件為了一杯打翻的茶而提起的無聊訴訟。

tip: frivolous 輕浮 + ity：名詞就是胡鬧玩笑的氣氛
example: A little frivolity at the party lifted everyone's mood after the long exams.
exampleZh: 派對上一點輕鬆嬉鬧，讓大家在漫長考試後心情好轉。

zh: 根本基礎根本性的；基本原則
tip: fund 底部（像 foundation 地基）：蓋房子最底下那一層
example: Fundamental changes to the tax system will take years to complete.
exampleZh: 稅制的根本性改變需要數年才能完成。

tip: gener 種類（像 general 一般的）：不分特定品牌，大家通用
example: Generic medicines cost less because they are not sold under a famous brand name.
exampleZh: 通用型藥品比較便宜，因為不是以知名品牌名稱銷售。

zh: 藝術文類文學體裁類型
tip: gen 種類（像 gender 性別）：把作品分成一類一類
example: Science fiction is a popular genre among teenage readers.
exampleZh: 科幻小說是青少年讀者之間很受歡迎的文類。

tip: grace 優雅 + ious：舉止優雅又和藹的
example: The gracious host welcomed every guest warmly and offered a cup of tea.
exampleZh: 親切的主人熱情歡迎每位客人，並奉上一杯茶。

tip: grieve 悲痛 + ance：心裡的委屈憋久了要申訴
example: Workers presented a formal grievance about unpaid overtime to the manager.
exampleZh: 員工就未支付加班費一事，向經理提出正式申訴。

tip: gull 當動詞是「欺騙」，gullible 就是容易被騙的
example: A gullible tourist bought a worthless "ancient" coin from a street seller.
exampleZh: 一位輕信別人的遊客，向路邊小販買了一枚毫無價值的「古幣」。

tip: gullible 易受騙 + ity：名詞就是容易上當的弱點
example: Scammers depend on the gullibility of people who trust every message they read.
exampleZh: 詐騙者倚賴那些相信所讀到每則訊息的人的輕信。

tip: hamper 也是有蓋的籃子，大籃子擋路，走不動
example: Heavy snow hampered rescue teams trying to reach the village.
exampleZh: 大雪阻礙了設法抵達村莊的救援隊。

tip: haughty 像 high：把頭抬得高高的看不起人
example: The haughty duke looked past the servants as if they were not there.
exampleZh: 那位高傲的公爵越過僕人往前看，彷彿他們不存在。

tip: haughty 高傲 + ness：名詞就是那副目中無人的樣子
example: Her haughtiness made classmates feel she thought herself better than everyone.
exampleZh: 她的傲慢讓同學覺得她自認比大家都強。

tip: homo 相同 + gen 種類：全都是同一種
example: The sample was homogeneous: every spoonful held the same mix of sand and salt.
exampleZh: 樣本是均質的：每一匙裡的沙與鹽混合比例都相同。

tip: homogeneous 同質的 + ity：名詞就是大家都一樣
example: Critics worry about the cultural homogeneity that global brands can create.
exampleZh: 批評者擔心全球品牌可能造成文化的同質化。

tip: hetero 不同 + gen 種類：什麼種類都有
example: The city's heterogeneous population speaks dozens of languages.
exampleZh: 這座城市混雜多元的人口使用數十種語言。

tip: hetero 不同：結構混雜、各處都不一樣
example: Biologists study the heterogeneity of the forest, from wet valleys to dry ridges.
exampleZh: 生物學家研究森林的異質性，從潮濕山谷到乾燥山脊。

tip: 想像火柴「易」點著，在夜晚 night 點亮
example: A single spark can ignite dry grass on a windy afternoon.
exampleZh: 在有風的午後，一顆火星就能點燃乾草。

tip: ignite 點燃 + ion：車子啟動的那個點火處
example: Turn the key in the ignition, and the engine starts.
exampleZh: 轉動點火開關裡的鑰匙，引擎就會發動。

tip: il 在內 + lumin 光（像 lumen 流明）：把光照進去
example: The new study helps illuminate how bees find their way home.
exampleZh: 這項新研究有助於闡明蜜蜂如何找到回家的路。

tip: illuminate 照亮 + tion：名詞就是光亮或啟發
example: The illumination in the old hall came from a hundred flickering candles.
exampleZh: 老禮堂裡的照明來自一百根搖曳的蠟燭。

tip: im 不 + mut 變（像 mutate 突變）：不會變的
example: The laws of physics seem immutable, the same in every corner of the universe.
exampleZh: 物理定律似乎是不可改變的，在宇宙每個角落都一樣。

tip: immutable 不變的 + ity：名詞就是永遠固定
example: Philosophers debated the immutability of truth, asking whether it could ever change.
exampleZh: 哲學家爭論真理的不可變性，探問它是否可能改變。

zh: 公正無私不偏袒客觀的
tip: im 不 + partial 偏袒：不站在任何一邊
example: A good referee must stay impartial, even when the home crowd roars.
exampleZh: 好裁判即使主場觀眾大聲吼叫，也必須保持公正。

tip: impartial 公正 + ity：名詞就是不偏袒的立場
example: The court's impartiality was never questioned, even by those who lost their cases.
exampleZh: 法院的公正從未受到質疑，連敗訴的人也不例外。

tip: ped 腳（像 pedal 踏板）：腳被絆住，走不動
example: Fallen trees impede traffic on the narrow mountain road.
exampleZh: 倒下的樹木阻礙了狹窄山路上的交通。

zh: 阻礙妨礙障礙物絆腳石
tip: impede 絆住 + ment：名詞就是那塊絆腳石
example: A speech impediment never stopped him from becoming a gifted storyteller.
exampleZh: 語言障礙從未阻止他成為一位有天賦的說書人。

zh: 迫切必要命令性的；極重要要求
tip: imper 命令（像 emperor 皇帝）：皇帝下令，非做不可
example: It is imperative that students submit the form before Friday's deadline.
exampleZh: 學生務必在星期五截止日之前交出表格，這是當務之急。

tip: im 不 + perceive 察覺 + ible：沒辦法被發現的
example: The change was imperceptible: the plant grew only a hair's width each day.
exampleZh: 這個變化難以察覺：那株植物每天只長一根頭髮那麼寬。

tip: im 在內 + plic 折：把某人折進事件裡
example: The documents seem to implicate two officials in the cover-up.
exampleZh: 這些文件似乎牽連了兩名官員涉入掩蓋行動。

tip: impose 強加 + ition：硬把負擔壓在別人身上
example: The sudden imposition of new fees angered local business owners.
exampleZh: 突然強加新的費用，激怒了當地的商家。

tip: im 不 + prudent 謹慎：不夠小心，草率行動
example: It would be imprudent to hike the ridge without checking the weather first.
exampleZh: 沒先確認天氣就走上山脊是不謹慎的。

zh: 衝動由一時興起驅動的
tip: impulse 衝動 + ive：一時興起就下手
example: An impulsive shopper bought three umbrellas on a sunny day.
exampleZh: 一位衝動型的購物者在大晴天買了三把雨傘。

tip: in 不 + access 通道：沒有通道可進去
example: Heavy snow left the mountain village inaccessible to ambulances for two days.
exampleZh: 大雪使這座山村兩天內救護車無法到達。

tip: in 向 + clin 傾斜：身體往喜歡的那一邊傾
example: She showed little inclination to join the club, preferring to read alone.
exampleZh: 她幾乎沒有加入社團的意願，寧可獨自閱讀。

zh: 不協調不相容不一致的
tip: in 不 + con 一起 + gru 一致：湊在一起很彆扭
example: A neon sign looked incongruous on the front of the ancient stone church.
exampleZh: 霓虹招牌掛在古老石造教堂的正面，顯得格格不入。

tip: incongruous 不協調 + ity：名詞就是那股彆扭
example: The incongruity between his cheerful words and tearful eyes puzzled everyone.
exampleZh: 他開朗的話語與含淚的雙眼之間的矛盾，讓大家困惑。

tip: in 裡面 + corpor 身體：融進同一個整體
example: The chef will incorporate fresh herbs into the sauce at the last minute.
exampleZh: 主廚會在最後一刻把新鮮香草加入醬汁中。

tip: in 不 + dign 值得（像 dignity 尊嚴）：覺得不該被這樣對待
example: Public indignation grew when the mayor refused to explain the missing funds.
exampleZh: 市長拒絕說明短少的經費時，民眾的義憤日益高漲。

tip: indignation 義憤 → 形容詞 indignant：滿肚子不平的
example: She was indignant when the waiter blamed her for his own mistake.
exampleZh: 服務生把自己的錯怪到她身上，她感到憤慨。

tip: in 不 + dispense 免除 + able：怎麼也免不掉、一定要有
example: Clean water is indispensable for any healthy community.
exampleZh: 乾淨的水對任何健康的社區都是不可或缺的。

tip: in 進入 + duce 引導，把人引進某種狀態
example: Certain medications can induce drowsiness, so drivers should read the label first.
exampleZh: 某些藥物會引發嗜睡，所以駕駛人應該先閱讀標籤。

tip: 看了一個個例子，再歸納整理成一條規則
example: Scientists rely on induction, moving from many observed cases to a general rule.
exampleZh: 科學家仰賴歸納法，從許多觀察到的個案推出一般規則。

zh: 沉溺放任縱容滿足愛好
tip: 媽媽對撒嬌的孩子說「好啦好啦都給你」，就是縱容
example: She indulged her sweet tooth with a second slice of chocolate cake.
exampleZh: 她放縱自己愛吃甜食的嗜好，又多吃了一片巧克力蛋糕。

zh: 難以言喻無可言表神聖的
tip: in 不 + ef 說出 + able 能夠，話到嘴邊說不出口
example: The sunrise over the canyon filled her with an ineffable sense of peace.
exampleZh: 峽谷上的日出讓她心中充滿難以言喻的平靜。

zh: 惰性無生氣不活動遲鈍的
tip: 想像一塊石頭躺平一動也不動，什麼反應都沒有
example: Helium is an inert gas, so it does not react with most other elements.
exampleZh: 氦是惰性氣體，所以不會與大部分其他元素起反應。

tip: 公車急煞時你的身體還往前衝，就是慣性在作用
example: Inertia keeps a rolling ball moving until friction slowly brings it to a stop.
exampleZh: 慣性讓滾動的球持續前進，直到摩擦力慢慢使它停下。

tip: ingenious 的名詞版，腦中叮一聲冒出妙點子
example: The villagers showed great ingenuity, building a water pump from scrap bicycle parts.
exampleZh: 村民展現了極高的巧思，用廢棄的腳踏車零件做出抽水機。

tip: 裡面藏著 genius 天才，天才才想得出妙點子
example: The ingenious design let the tiny apartment fold into three different rooms.
exampleZh: 這個巧妙的設計讓小公寓能折疊成三個不同的房間。

tip: in 裡面 + her 黏住，天生就黏在裡面拿不掉
example: Risk is inherent in mountain climbing, no matter how well prepared you are.
exampleZh: 無論準備得多周全，登山本身就帶有風險。

tip: 想像把水龍頭扭緊，水就流不出來，被擋住了
example: Cold temperatures inhibit the growth of bacteria on stored food.
exampleZh: 低溫會抑制儲存食物上細菌的生長。

zh: 抑制壓抑拘束心理阻抗
tip: 心裡有個煞車踩著不放，所以不敢放開來做
example: After a glass of wine, his inhibition faded and he began to sing loudly.
exampleZh: 喝了一杯酒後，他的拘束感消失，開始大聲唱歌。

tip: in 帶入 + nov 新（novel 新穎），把新東西帶進來
example: Small firms must innovate constantly, or larger rivals will copy their products and win customers.
exampleZh: 小公司必須不斷創新，否則大型對手會抄襲他們的產品並搶走客戶。

zh: 高深莫測難以捉摸解讀的
tip: in 不 + scrut 細查 + able 可以，沒辦法被看透
example: The judge's inscrutable expression gave the nervous witness no hint of what he was thinking.
exampleZh: 法官高深莫測的表情，讓緊張的證人看不出他在想什麼。

zh: 深刻洞見洞察力真知灼見
tip: in 裡面 + sight 看，眼睛看進事情的裡面
example: Reading her diary gave historians a rare insight into daily life during the siege.
exampleZh: 閱讀她的日記，讓歷史學家得以難得地洞察圍城期間的日常生活。

zh: 具深刻洞察力見解獨到的
tip: insight 洞察 + ful 充滿，滿腦子都是洞見
example: Her insightful essay explained why the old trade routes collapsed so suddenly.
exampleZh: 她見解深刻的文章解釋了舊貿易路線為何會突然崩潰。

zh: 暗示旁敲側擊漸漸滲入
tip: in 進 + sinu 彎曲，話彎彎繞繞地悄悄滲進別人耳裡
example: He insinuated that his rival had cheated, though he never said so directly.
exampleZh: 他暗示對手作弊，雖然他從未直接這麼說。

tip: in 不 + tact 觸碰，沒被碰壞所以完整
example: Remarkably, the ancient vase arrived intact after its long journey across the ocean.
exampleZh: 令人驚訝的是，這只古代花瓶橫渡大洋的長途運送後仍完好無損。

tip: 想成 integer 整數，整個人完整不缺角，言行一致
example: The mayor's integrity was never doubted, even by people who opposed her policies.
exampleZh: 即使是反對她政策的人，也從不懷疑市長的正直。

tip: in 使 + timid 膽小，使人變得膽小
example: Bullies often try to intimidate classmates by blocking the hallway and shouting.
exampleZh: 霸凌者常堵住走廊大聲吼叫，想嚇唬同學。

tip: intimidate 的名詞版，timid 膽小就藏在裡面
example: Voters reported intimidation at several polling stations, and officials promised an investigation.
exampleZh: 選民表示數個投票所出現恐嚇行為，官員承諾展開調查。

tip: in 不 + temperate 有節制，像溫度計失控衝破頂
example: His intemperate outburst at the meeting embarrassed everyone and ruined the careful negotiations.
exampleZh: 他在會議上情緒過激的爆發讓大家尷尬，也毀了謹慎的協商。

tip: intrigue 勾起好奇心，像魚鉤把你的注意力勾住
example: The archaeologists found an intriguing pattern of symbols carved beneath the temple floor.
exampleZh: 考古學家在神廟地板下發現一組耐人尋味的雕刻符號。

zh: 直覺直觀憑直覺感知的
tip: in 裡面 + tui 看，不用想、心裡一看就懂
example: The app is so intuitive that even young children can use it without instructions.
exampleZh: 這個應用程式非常直觀，連小朋友不看說明也會用。

tip: in 不 + vulnerable 易受傷，穿上盔甲不會受傷
example: The castle seemed invulnerable, with thick walls, deep moats, and only one narrow gate.
exampleZh: 那座城堡看似堅不可摧，有厚牆、深護城河，只有一道窄門。

zh: 暴怒極其憤怒火冒三丈的
tip: 字裡有 ire 怒氣，加 ate 就是滿肚子火
example: The irate customer slammed the receipt on the counter and demanded to see the manager.
exampleZh: 暴怒的顧客把收據拍在櫃檯上，要求見經理。

zh: 不相關無關緊要不相干的
tip: ir 不 + relevant 相關，兩件事搭不上線
example: Your height is irrelevant to whether you can learn to play the violin well.
exampleZh: 你的身高和你能不能學好小提琴毫無關係。

zh: 援引召喚祈求庇護法令
tip: in 向 + voke 聲音（voice），出聲呼喚或引用它
example: The lawyer invoked an old statute to argue that the fine was illegal.
exampleZh: 律師援引一條舊法規，主張這筆罰款不合法。

tip: invoke 加 ation 變名詞，開場先出聲呼喚神明
example: The ceremony began with an invocation, asking the gods to bless the harvest.
exampleZh: 典禮以一段祈禱開場，祈求眾神保佑收成。

tip: 諧音「久怕大賊」，一直怕壞人來，處境危險
example: Skipping safety checks could jeopardize the whole mission and endanger the crew.
exampleZh: 省略安全檢查可能危及整個任務，並使組員陷入險境。

zh: 危險危難險境存亡關頭
tip: 諧音「久怕地」，久久都怕的地方就是險境
example: With funding cut, the small museum was in jeopardy and might close within a year.
exampleZh: 資金被削減後，這間小博物館岌岌可危，一年內可能關門。

tip: 想到 jubilee 慶典，一聽到就想跳起來歡呼
example: Jubilant fans poured into the streets after their team won the championship.
exampleZh: 球隊奪冠後，歡欣鼓舞的球迷湧上街頭。

tip: jud 判斷（judge 法官）+ ious，會做判斷的人
example: A judicious investor spreads her savings across several accounts instead of betting everything on one.
exampleZh: 明智的投資人會把積蓄分散在幾個帳戶，而不是全押在同一個。

tip: 諧音「來悶」，心裡悶得想哭出來
example: Villagers lamented the loss of the old bridge, which had stood for three centuries.
exampleZh: 村民為那座屹立了三百年的古橋消失而哀嘆。

tip: laud 讚美 + able 可以，applaud 鼓掌也有 laud
example: Her laudable effort to clean the riverbank won praise from neighbors and the city council.
exampleZh: 她清理河岸的值得嘉許的努力，贏得了鄰居與市議會的稱讚。

zh: 仁慈寬大寬鬆不嚴厲的
tip: 諧音「憐你」，憐惜你所以從輕發落
example: The teacher was lenient about late homework, giving students an extra day without penalty.
exampleZh: 老師對遲交作業很寬鬆，多給學生一天而且不扣分。

zh: 萎靡昏昏欲睡倦怠無力的
tip: 諧音「累瑟雞」，累到像沒精神的小雞
example: After the heavy holiday meal, the whole family felt lethargic and dozed on the sofa.
exampleZh: 吃完豐盛的節日大餐後，全家人都昏昏欲睡，在沙發上打盹。

tip: liber 自由（liberty 自由女神）+ ate 使，使得到自由
example: Allied troops liberated the town after months of occupation, and residents cheered in the streets.
exampleZh: 盟軍在占領數月後解放了小鎮，居民在街頭歡呼。

zh: 獲利豐厚賺錢收益大的
tip: 諧音「路可賺」，這條路可以賺大錢
example: Selling handmade furniture online turned out to be a lucrative business for the young carpenter.
exampleZh: 線上販售手工家具，對這位年輕木匠來說是門賺錢的生意。

zh: 發光發亮光明照耀清楚的
tip: lumin 光（illuminate 照亮），自己會發光
example: The luminous jellyfish drifted through the dark water like tiny floating lanterns.
exampleZh: 發光的水母像小小的漂浮燈籠，飄過黑暗的海水。

tip: medi 中間，爬到半山腰，不好也不壞
example: The restaurant looked grand, but the food was mediocre and the service was slow.
exampleZh: 這家餐廳看起來氣派，但食物平庸，服務也慢。

tip: 諧音「沒藍可理」，藍色心情沒人理，好憂鬱
example: A gentle melancholy settled over her as she watched the last leaves fall from the trees.
exampleZh: 看著最後幾片葉子從樹上飄落，一股淡淡的憂鬱籠罩了她。

tip: mis 錯 + conception 想法，想法想錯了
example: A common misconception is that lightning never strikes the same place twice.
exampleZh: 一個常見的誤解是，閃電不會劈中同一個地方兩次。

zh: 重大關鍵深具歷史意義的
tip: moment 時刻 + ous，值得記一輩子的那個時刻
example: The signing of the treaty was a momentous occasion that reshaped the borders of Europe.
exampleZh: 條約的簽署是個重大時刻，重新劃定了歐洲的邊界。

tip: mono 單一 + tone 音調，同一個調子聽到想睡
example: The long drive across the flat desert was monotonous, with nothing to see but sand.
exampleZh: 穿越平坦沙漠的長途駕駛很單調，除了沙子什麼也看不到。

tip: mourn 哀悼 + ful 充滿，諧音「摸你」安慰你
example: A mournful bell tolled across the valley as villagers gathered to remember the lost sailors.
exampleZh: 村民聚在一起追思失蹤的水手時，哀傷的鐘聲迴盪在山谷間。

zh: 天真幼稚缺乏世故歷練的
tip: 想像剛出社會、什麼話都信的小白兔
example: He was naive enough to believe the stranger's promise of easy money.
exampleZh: 他天真到相信陌生人輕鬆賺錢的承諾。

zh: 敘事故事敘述體；敘事的
tip: narr 講述（narrator 旁白），把事情一段段講成故事
example: Her memoir is less a list of dates than a gripping narrative of survival.
exampleZh: 她的回憶錄與其說是日期的清單，不如說是一則扣人心弦的求生敘事。

tip: neglect 忽略的形容詞，忘了關瓦斯就是 negligent
example: The company was found negligent for ignoring repeated warnings about the cracked bridge supports.
exampleZh: 公司因無視橋墩裂縫的多次警告，被認定有疏忽。

tip: neutral 中性 + ize 使，把它變成不酸不鹼
example: Adding a base can neutralize an acid, producing water and a harmless salt.
exampleZh: 加入鹼可以中和酸，產生水和無害的鹽。

zh: 名義上微不足道象徵性的
tip: nomin 名字（name），只有名字掛著，實際上很少
example: He paid only a nominal fee, just enough to make the contract legally binding.
exampleZh: 他只付了象徵性的費用，剛好足以讓合約具有法律效力。

tip: nov 新（novel 新穎的），新到讓人好奇的感覺
example: The novelty of the robot toy wore off after a week, and the children stopped playing with it.
exampleZh: 機器人玩具的新鮮感一週後就消退了，孩子們不再玩它。

tip: null 零 + ify 使成為，把效力歸零
example: The court's ruling nullified the contract, so neither company had to honor its terms.
exampleZh: 法院的判決使合約無效，兩家公司都不必遵守其條款。

tip: ob 擋在前面 + struct 建造，築起一道牆擋路
example: Fallen trees obstructed the road, forcing the ambulance to take a longer route.
exampleZh: 倒下的樹木擋住了道路，迫使救護車繞較遠的路。

zh: 全能全權掌控無所不能的
tip: omni 全部 + potent 有力，什麼力量都在他手上
example: In the myth, the omnipotent king could command the seas, the winds, and the stars.
exampleZh: 在神話中，無所不能的國王能號令海洋、風與星辰。

tip: or 口（oral 口頭的）+ ator 人，靠一張嘴打動人
example: The famed orator held the crowd silent for an hour with her stirring speech on justice.
exampleZh: 這位著名的演說家以一場激勵人心的正義演說，讓群眾安靜聽了一小時。

zh: 華麗繁複過度裝飾雕琢的
tip: orn 裝飾（ornament 小飾品），裝飾多到滿出來
example: The ornate ceiling of the old theater was covered in gold leaf and carved flowers.
exampleZh: 老劇院華麗繁複的天花板貼滿金箔，雕著一朵朵花。

zh: 放逐排擠排斥放逐社會外
tip: 古希臘人用陶片（ostrakon）投票，把人趕出城
example: Classmates ostracized the new student after a rumor spread, leaving her alone at lunch.
exampleZh: 謠言傳開後，同學們排擠這位新生，讓她午餐時獨自一人。

zh: 至高無上最為核心重要的
tip: mount 山頭，登上最高的山頭，位置至高無上
example: Patient safety is paramount in any hospital, taking priority over cost and convenience.
exampleZh: 在任何醫院裡，病人安全都是最重要的，優先於成本與方便。

tip: 字裡有 peril 危險，加 ous 就是充滿危險
example: The perilous mountain path wound along a cliff with no railing and loose gravel.
exampleZh: 險惡的山路沿著沒有欄杆、滿是碎石的懸崖蜿蜒而上。

tip: 想像放太久的水果壞掉，perishable 就是易腐壞
example: Many seedlings perished during the frost because the farmers had no way to keep them warm.
exampleZh: 霜凍期間許多幼苗枯死，因為農民沒辦法替它們保暖。

tip: perpetual 永久的 + ate 使，讓它永遠繼續
example: Repeating old stereotypes only perpetuates unfair ideas about who can succeed in science.
exampleZh: 一再重複舊的刻板印象，只會讓「誰能在科學上成功」的不公平觀念延續下去。

tip: per 徹底 + plex 編織（complex），線纏成一團
example: She looked perplexed as she studied the map, unable to tell which road led home.
exampleZh: 她研究地圖時一臉困惑，分不清哪條路通往回家。

zh: 迫害迫害宗教族群殘害
tip: per 一路 + secute 追趕，一路追著欺負人
example: The regime persecuted religious minorities, forcing many families to flee across the border.
exampleZh: 該政權迫害宗教少數群體，迫使許多家庭逃過邊界。

tip: per 徹底 + severe 嚴格，對自己嚴格到底
example: Though the first ten attempts failed, the inventor persevered and finally built a working engine.
exampleZh: 雖然前十次嘗試都失敗，發明家仍堅持下去，終於做出能運轉的引擎。

tip: pessimistic 想最糟；optimistic 想最好
example: He felt pessimistic about the weather and expected rain to ruin the picnic.
exampleZh: 他對天氣很悲觀，預期下雨會毀掉野餐。

zh: 瑣碎微小不重要氣量狹小的
tip: petty 像 pet 小寵物，小小的、不重要的小事
example: It seems petty to argue over a few cents when the whole group is raising money for charity.
exampleZh: 整個團體都在為慈善募款時，還為了幾分錢爭吵，顯得很小氣。

zh: 先驅開拓拓荒者；開闢倡導
tip: 諧音「派你兒」，派你先去探路的人
example: Marie Curie was a pioneer in radioactivity research, opening doors for later scientists.
exampleZh: 居禮夫人是放射性研究的先驅，為後來的科學家開了路。

tip: pious 唸起來像「派」，派去禮拜的人很虔誠
example: The pious farmer prayed every morning before sunrise and gave a share of his harvest to the poor.
exampleZh: 虔誠的農夫每天日出前禱告，並把一部分收成分給窮人。

zh: 深刻淒切令人心酸動容的
tip: poign 像 point 尖，像小刺扎進心裡酸酸的
example: The old soldier's poignant letter to his family brought many readers to tears.
exampleZh: 老兵寫給家人的動人書信讓許多讀者落淚。

zh: 反覆無常的、善變任性的
tip: 【GRE 孿生同義詞】：capricious = fickle = mercurial！在 Sentence Equivalence 六選二中並列正解！
example: Throughout his turbulent tenure, the autocratic monarch was infamous for his capricious governance.
exampleZh: 在動盪的統治任期內，該專制君主以其反覆無常的治理風格而聲名狼藉。

zh: 易變無常的、搖擺不定的
tip: 【GRE 孿生同義詞】：fickle = capricious！修飾命運、人心與天候。
example: Politicians often discover that public adulation is utterly fickle and rapidly evaporates.
exampleZh: 政治人物常發現公眾的崇拜完全是變幻無常的，很快便煙消雲散。

zh: 繁重艱鉅的、沉重的、費力的
tip: 【GRE 孿生同義詞】：onerous = burdensome。拉丁語 onus (沉重負擔)。
example: Translating ancient cuneiform clay tablets proved to be an extraordinarily onerous undertaking.
exampleZh: 翻譯殘破的古代楔形文字泥板被證明是一項極其繁重艱鉅的事業。

tip: 【GRE 孿生同義詞】：burdensome = onerous。burden (負擔) + -some (充滿)。
example: Small business entrepreneurs often lament the burdensome paperwork required by state agencies.
exampleZh: 小型企業創業者經常抱怨政府機構所要求的繁複沉重的文書作業。

zh: 清澈透亮的、清晰明瞭的
tip: 【GRE 孿生同義詞】：pellucid = limpid。pel- (透徹) + luc (光亮/清晰)。
example: The theoretical physicist was renowned for her pellucid exposition of complex gravitational theory.
exampleZh: 該理論物理學家因其對複雜重力理論清晰透徹的闡述而享譽學界。

zh: 清澈透明的、明白通暢的
tip: 【GRE 孿生同義詞】：limpid = pellucid。修飾文風「清澈無晦澀」。
example: The mountain lake was so limpid that pebbles on the bedrock twelve meters below were visible.
exampleZh: 高山湖泊是如此清澈見底，以至於水下十二公尺岩床上的鵝卵石都清晰可辨。

tip: 【GRE 孿生四姐妹】：mitigate = abate = attenuate = alleviate (減輕緩和)。等價題極高頻！
example: Massive coastal mangrove reforestation projects are designed to mitigate hurricane storm surges.
exampleZh: 大規模的沿海紅樹林造林計畫旨在緩解颶風引發的風暴潮。

tip: 【GRE 孿生同義詞】：alleviate = mitigate = abate。lev (輕，同 elevate) ➔ 使變輕。
example: The humanitarian NGO provided emergency rations to alleviate acute famine in the drought sector.
exampleZh: 人道救援非政府組織提供了緊急口糧以緩解乾旱災區嚴重的饑荒。

zh: 短暫的、轉瞬即逝的、朝生暮死的
tip: 【GRE 孿生三胞胎】：ephemeral = transient = evanescent (短暫的)。
example: Viral internet fame frequently proves to be ephemeral, vanishing as swiftly as it appeared.
exampleZh: 網路爆紅的知名度往往被證明是轉瞬即逝的，消逝得如同當初竄紅時那般迅速。

zh: 短暫的、瞬息即逝的、過客的
tip: 【GRE 孿生同義詞】：transient = ephemeral。trans- (通過) + i (走) ➔ 走過即逝。
example: The psychologist observed that material wealth generates only a transient surge in happiness.
exampleZh: 心理學家觀察到，物質財富帶來的幸福感往往只是轉瞬即逝的短暫提升。

zh: 簡潔的、說話言簡意賅的、寡言的
tip: 【GRE 孿生同義詞】：laconic = terse = curt。源自斯巴達拉哥尼亞 (Laconia) 人說話極簡之典故。
example: Famous for his laconic temperament, the general responded to the enemy ultimatum with one word: 'Never.'
exampleZh: 將軍以其言簡意賅的寡言脾性聞名，他對敵軍的最後通牒只回敬了一個字：「休想。」

tip: 【GRE 孿生同義詞】：terse = laconic。ters- (擦乾淨/去除多餘) ➔ 去除贅字。
example: The CEO issued a terse statement denying all allegations of insider stock trading.
exampleZh: 執行長發表了一份措辭簡短生硬的聲明，全盤否認內線交易指控。

zh: 似是而非的、華而不實的、虛假的
tip: 【GRE 孿生同義詞】：specious = spurious = fallacious。spec (看) ➔ 僅表面好看而已！
example: Under rigorous scrutiny, the lobbyist's plausible rhetoric was unmasked as entirely specious.
exampleZh: 在嚴格審視之下，說客看似合理的修辭被揭穿完全是似是而非的詭辯。

zh: 偽造的、虛假的、站不住腳的
tip: 【GRE 孿生同義詞】：spurious = specious = counterfeit (偽造虛假的)。
example: The scientific journal retracted the published paper after uncovering spurious experimental data.
exampleZh: 在揭發出偽造虛假的實驗數據後，該科學期刊撤回了已發表的論文。

zh: 一絲不苟的、過分挑剔講究的
tip: 【GRE 孿生同義詞】：fastidious = meticulous = punctilious (嚴謹挑剔)。
example: The master watchmaker was famously fastidious, examining each microscopic gear under high magnification.
exampleZh: 鐘錶大師以極度一絲不苟聞名，在高倍放大鏡下一一檢視每顆微型齒輪。

zh: 極其嚴謹細緻的、一絲不苟的
tip: 【GRE 孿生同義詞】：meticulous = fastidious。正向表「一絲不苟」，負向表「過分挑剔」。
example: The conservator restored the Renaissance fresco with meticulous precision and immense patience.
exampleZh: 古蹟修復專家以無比細緻嚴謹的精準度與無窮耐心，修復了文藝復興時期的濕壁畫。

zh: 沉默寡言的、不願吐露的
tip: 【GRE 孿生同義詞】：reticent = taciturn。tacit (心照不宣/安靜)。
example: The witness remained reticent, answering the prosecutor's inquiries only with brief nods.
exampleZh: 證人始終保持沉默寡言，僅以微弱的點頭回應檢察官的訊問。

zh: 不苟言笑的、生性孤僻寡言的
tip: 【GRE 孿生同義詞】：taciturn = reticent。修飾性格習慣性不講話。
example: Growing up on a solitary mountain homestead made the woodsman notoriously taciturn.
exampleZh: 在偏僻孤絕的高山農莊長大，讓這位伐木工人變得極其寡言孤僻。

tip: 【GRE 孿生同義詞】：apathy = indifference。a- (無) + pathy (情感) ➔ 毫無感情。
example: Widespread civic apathy poses a grave danger to the vitality of democratic self-governance.
exampleZh: 普遍的公民冷漠對民主自治的蓬勃生機構成了嚴重威脅。

tip: 【GRE 孿生同義詞】：indifference = apathy。in- (無) + difference (差別) ➔ 覺得都無所謂。
example: The monarch met the peasant petitions with callous indifference and increased levies.
exampleZh: 君主對農民的請願書表現出冷酷的漠不關心，反而加重了賦稅徵收。

tip: 【GRE 孿生同義詞】：veneration = reverence = deification。Venus (愛與美之神) ➔ 崇拜膜拜。
example: The indigenous community preserves deep veneration for the sacred cedar grove.
exampleZh: 該原住民族社群對這片神聖的雪松林懷抱著無比深沉的崇敬與景仰。

tip: 【GRE 孿生同義詞】：reverence = veneration。revere (敬畏) ➔ 名詞 reverence。
example: The pilgrims entered the sanctuary in hushed reverence, lighting ceremonial candles.
exampleZh: 朝聖者滿懷虔敬的敬畏之情踏入聖所，點燃儀式專用的蠟燭。

tip: 【GRE 孿生同義詞】：bellicose = pugnacious = truculent。bell (戰爭，如 rebel 反叛)。
example: The dictator delivered a bellicose speech threatening military invasion across the border.
exampleZh: 該獨裁者發表了一場好戰的演說，揚言將對邊境彼端發動軍事入侵。

zh: 好鬥好吵架的、尋釁滋事的
tip: 【GRE 孿生同義詞】：pugnacious = bellicose。pugn (拳頭，同 pugilist 拳擊手)。
example: Known for his pugnacious posture during committee debates, he rarely conceded a point.
exampleZh: 因在委員會辯論中咄咄逼人、好鬥善辯聞名，他幾乎從不向對手做出讓步。

zh: 無害的、良性的、無傷大雅的
tip: 【GRE 孿生同義詞】：innocuous = benign = inoffensive。in- (無) + noc (傷害，同 noxious 有毒)。
example: What seemed like an innocuous question provoked unexpected outrage from the witness.
exampleZh: 一句看似無傷大雅的隨興提問，卻引發了證人出乎意料的強烈憤怒。

zh: 溫和善良的、良性無害的 (反義詞 malignant 惡性的)
tip: 【GRE 孿生同義詞】：benign = innocuous。bene- (好/善，同 benefit)。
example: The biopsy confirmed that the detected tissue lump was completely benign.
exampleZh: 組織切片檢查證實偵測到的組織腫塊完全是良性的。

tip: 【GRE 孿生同義詞】：obviate = preclude。ob- (反對) + via (道路) ➔ 阻擋在半路免去麻煩。
example: Early diagnostic detection often obviates the need for invasive chemotherapy treatments.
exampleZh: 早期診斷發現往往能免除病患進行侵入性化學治療的需要。

zh: 話多的、滔滔不絕的、喋喋不休的
tip: 【GRE 孿生同義詞】：loquacious = garrulous。loqu (說話，同 eloquent 雄辯的)。
example: A few glasses of vintage wine turned the normally reserved scholar into a loquacious conversationalist.
exampleZh: 幾杯陳年佳釀讓原本矜持沉靜的學者頓時化身為滔滔不絕的健談者。

zh: 嘮叨絮聒的、多嘴多舌的
tip: 【GRE 孿生同義詞】：garrulous = loquacious。garr- (喉嚨發聲，同 gargle 漱口)。
example: The driver proved so garrulous that passengers could scarcely read their newspapers in quiet.
exampleZh: 司機是如此喋喋不休、熱衷嘮叨，乘客幾乎無法在安靜中閱讀報紙。

zh: 平淡無奇的、乏味的、散文般的
tip: 【GRE 孿生同義詞】：prosaic = pedestrian = mundane。prose (散文) ➔ 毫無詩意 ➔ 平淡無奇。
example: Beyond the dazzling glamour of cinema lies the prosaic labor of logistical scheduling.
exampleZh: 在電影耀眼炫目的光環背後，其實充斥著調度後勤排程等平淡乏味繁瑣的勞動。

zh: 平淡沉悶的、乏味的；行人
tip: 【GRE 孿生同義詞】：pedestrian = prosaic。ped (腳步) ➔ 像走路般尋常平庸 ➔ 乏味的。
example: Critics condemned the television series for its pedestrian dialogue and cliché characters.
exampleZh: 影評人斥責該電視影集對白平淡沉悶、角色設定落入俗套陳腐。

zh: 萬靈丹、百病良藥、萬全之策
tip: 【GRE 孿生同義詞】：panacea = cure-all。pan- (全/所有) + akos (治療) ➔ 包治百病之神藥。
example: Technological innovation is beneficial, but it is not a panacea for deep structural poverty.
exampleZh: 科技創新大有裨益，但絕非根除深層結構性貧困問題的萬靈妙藥。

zh: 敏銳善變的、活潑易變的
tip: 水星 Mercury 的水銀滑來滑去抓不住，像情緒善變的人
example: The mercurial director could be charming at breakfast and furious by noon, leaving the crew guessing.
exampleZh: 這位導演性情多變，早餐時風度翩翩，中午就怒氣沖沖，讓劇組團隊摸不著頭緒。

tip: 酒精一打開就揮發飛走，局勢也像這樣一碰就變
example: Oil prices remained volatile throughout the crisis, rising and falling sharply from one week to the next.
exampleZh: 危機期間油價一直動盪不安，每週都大起大落。

tip: err 是犯錯，路線走錯又亂繞，行蹤飄忽不定
example: His erratic attendance, present for a week and then absent for months, made the course impossible to plan.
exampleZh: 他出席時有時無，來一週又缺席數月，使課程無法規劃。

tip: 想像天秤晃來晃去，拿不定主意
example: She vacillated between taking the job abroad and staying near her family until the deadline passed.
exampleZh: 她在出國工作與留在家人身邊之間猶豫不決，直到期限已過。

tip: wave 揮動，旗子隨風揮來揮去，決心也晃動
example: Her confidence wavered when the judges began asking sharper questions.
exampleZh: 評審開始提出更尖銳的問題時，她的信心動搖了。

tip: 想像電風扇搖頭，左右來回擺盪
example: Public opinion oscillated between hope and despair as the negotiations dragged on.
exampleZh: 隨著談判一再拖延，民意在希望與絕望之間來回擺盪。

zh: 優柔寡斷的、未下定決心的
tip: ir 不 + resolute 堅決 = 不堅決，拿不定主意
