zh: 令人信服論述嚴密強有力的
tip: co 一起 + gent 推動：把大家一起推向同意
example: Her cogent argument persuaded even the most skeptical members of the board.
exampleZh: 她令人信服的論述，連最持懷疑態度的董事也被說服了。

zh: 共謀串通勾結暗中勾當
tip: col 一起 + lus 玩（illusion 幻覺）：一起玩把戲
example: Regulators found evidence of collusion between the airlines to keep ticket prices high.
exampleZh: 監管機構發現航空公司之間串通以維持高票價的證據。

tip: 跟 collusion 同家族：想像兩人躲在桌下偷偷擊掌
example: Two bidders were suspected of colluding to drive down the price of the contract.
exampleZh: 兩名投標者被懷疑串通，以壓低合約價格。

zh: 相當相稱等比例對應的
tip: com 一起 + mensur 測量（measure）：量起來一樣大
example: Salary will be commensurate with experience, so senior applicants can expect higher offers.
exampleZh: 薪資將與經驗相稱，因此資深的應徵者可期待更高的待遇。

tip: proportion 比例 + ate：比例剛剛好
example: The punishment should be proportionate to the offense, not harsher than necessary.
exampleZh: 處罰應與過錯相稱，不該比必要的更嚴厲。

zh: 良心不安內疚悔恨歉意
tip: com 加強 + punct 刺（puncture 戳破）：良心被針扎
example: He felt no compunction about charging tourists triple the normal price.
exampleZh: 他向觀光客收取三倍價格，內心毫無愧疚。

zh: 顧慮道德疑慮良心不安
tip: 原指鞋裡的小尖石子：硌在腳上，良心也跟著不安
example: She had scruples about accepting an expensive gift from a client.
exampleZh: 她對收下客戶送的昂貴禮物有所顧慮。

zh: 相伴伴隨隨之而來的；伴隨物
tip: con 一起 + comit 陪伴：一路相伴的跟班
example: Rapid growth brought a concomitant rise in traffic and noise.
exampleZh: 快速成長隨之帶來交通量與噪音的增加。

zh: 和諧一致公約友好條約
tip: con 一起 + cord 心（cordial 熱誠）：心在一起
example: The treaty restored concord between the two neighboring nations.
exampleZh: 這項條約恢復了兩個鄰國之間的和睦。

zh: 一致相符吻合幾何全等的
tip: con 一起 + gru 相合：疊在一起剛好完全重合
example: The two triangles are congruent because all their sides and angles match exactly.
exampleZh: 這兩個三角形全等，因為所有的邊和角都完全吻合。

tip: 諧音「康娜瘦」：看，那位 sir 是行家，一聞就知道
example: A true connoisseur of tea, she could name a leaf's region by its smell alone.
exampleZh: 她是真正的茶葉鑑賞家，光憑氣味就能說出茶葉的產地。

zh: 認真負責盡職盡責本著良心的
tip: conscience 良心 + ious：憑良心把事情做好
example: A conscientious nurse, she double-checked every dose before going to the patient's bed.
exampleZh: 她是認真負責的護理師，到病床前都會再三核對每一劑藥量。

zh: 引人注目顯眼的卓越突出的
tip: con 全 + spic 看（inspect 檢查）：一眼就看見
example: A bright red umbrella was conspicuous in the gray crowd.
exampleZh: 一把鮮紅色的雨傘在灰色的人群中格外醒目。

zh: 驚惶失措大為震驚恐慌
tip: 想像突然看到怪事，整個人僵在原地不知所措
example: To the teacher's consternation, the whole class had forgotten the exam date.
exampleZh: 令老師大為震驚的是，全班都忘了考試日期。

zh: 圓滿技藝高超精湛的；使圓滿
tip: con 全 + summ 頂點（summit 山頂）：爬到頂峰了
example: A consummate chef, she turned plain eggs into a dish that silenced the dining room.
exampleZh: 她是技藝精湛的主廚，把普通雞蛋變成讓整間餐廳安靜下來的一道菜。

zh: 蔑視鄙視輕蔑法庭蔑視
tip: 想像抬高下巴，用鼻孔看人，一臉瞧不起
example: He looked at the cheater with open contempt and walked out of the room.
exampleZh: 他以毫不掩飾的蔑視看著作弊的人，然後走出房間。

tip: contempt 蔑視 + uous 充滿：滿臉都是不屑
example: She gave a contemptuous laugh when he claimed to be the best singer in town.
exampleZh: 當他自稱是全鎮最會唱歌的人，她發出不屑的笑聲。

tip: con 一起 + tig 碰觸（contact 接觸）：邊挨著邊
example: Alaska is not part of the contiguous United States.
exampleZh: 阿拉斯加不屬於美國本土相連的各州。

zh: 抗命頑固不服從權威的
tip: 想像面對權威雙手抱胸，頭一偏就是不聽
example: The contumacious defendant ignored the judge's order and refused to stand.
exampleZh: 抗命的被告無視法官的命令，拒絕起立。

zh: 難題謎語令人困惑的謎題
tip: 諧音「肯那轉」：腦袋轉了又轉，還是解不開的謎
example: How to feed a growing city with shrinking farmland remains a conundrum for planners.
exampleZh: 如何用日漸減少的農地養活成長中的城市，對規畫者仍是個難題。

zh: 費解的人事物神祕謎團
tip: 諧音「一泥個馬」：這到底是什麼馬？完全解不開
example: The painter remained an enigma; nobody knew where he lived or how he worked.
exampleZh: 這位畫家始終是個謎；沒人知道他住在哪裡，或如何創作。

zh: 腐蝕性損害破壞消磨的
tip: cor 全 + rod 啃咬（rodent 齧齒動物）：一點一點啃壞
example: Constant criticism can be corrosive to a team's trust.
exampleZh: 不斷的批評會侵蝕團隊之間的信任。

zh: 小圈子文人志同道合小團體
tip: 想像幾個好友圍成小圈圈，外人擠不進來
example: She was admitted to a small coterie of poets who met every Thursday.
exampleZh: 她被接納進入一個每週四聚會的小詩人圈子。

zh: 面容神情；贊同支持容忍
tip: countenance 本是臉：肯給好臉色，就是贊同、容忍
example: The school will not countenance bullying in any form.
exampleZh: 學校不容許任何形式的霸凌。

tip: counter 反 + mand 命令（command）：反過來下命令
example: The general countermanded the retreat order moments before the troops began to move.
exampleZh: 將軍在部隊開始移動前一刻，撤銷了撤退命令。

tip: cover 蓋起來：蓋住不讓人看見
example: The agency ran a covert operation that was kept secret from Congress.
exampleZh: 該機構執行了一項對國會保密的祕密行動。

zh: 貪婪覬覦他人之物的貪求的
tip: 想像眼睛直盯著別人的東西，口水快流下來
example: Covetous neighbors eyed the old man's orchard and wondered how to get it.
exampleZh: 貪婪的鄰居盯著老人的果園，盤算著怎麼弄到手。

tip: cred 相信（credit 信用）：太容易就相信別人
example: The scam relied on the credulity of lonely retirees who trusted every caller.
exampleZh: 這場詐騙仰賴孤單退休者的輕信，他們什麼來電都相信。

zh: 罪魁禍首犯人肇事端者
tip: 諧音「抗不利」：證據一出，犯人抗不過
example: The culprit behind the blackout turned out to be a squirrel chewing on a cable.
exampleZh: 造成停電的元兇，原來是一隻啃電纜的松鼠。

zh: 縮減削減剝奪限制長度
tip: 想像把 tail 尾巴剪短：長的東西被縮短
example: Budget cuts forced the library to curtail its weekend hours.
exampleZh: 預算刪減迫使圖書館縮減週末的開放時間。

zh: 公開譴責、強烈反對、貶低價值
tip: de 向下 + cry 喊：大聲喊話把它貶低
example: Environmental groups decried the plan to drain the wetland for a parking lot.
exampleZh: 環保團體公開譴責把濕地排乾蓋停車場的計畫。

zh: 提出異議反對、遲疑不前；異議
tip: de 離開 + mur 拖延（拉丁 morari）：遲疑著不肯動
example: When asked to work another weekend, three engineers demurred, citing exhaustion.
exampleZh: 被要求再加班一個週末時，三名工程師以疲憊為由表示異議。

zh: 使乾涸枯竭、使失去生機乾燥
tip: de 完全 + sicc 乾（拉丁 siccus）：水分被抽得精光
example: The desert wind desiccated the fruit left on the cart until it was hard as stone.
exampleZh: 沙漠的風把留在推車上的水果吹到乾透，硬得像石頭。

zh: 二分法、截然對立的兩分
tip: di 二 + tom 切（atom 原子本指不可切）：一刀切成兩半
example: Critics reject the dichotomy between work and play, arguing that good teaching blends the two.
exampleZh: 批評者拒絕工作與遊戲的二分法，主張好的教學是兩者的融合。

zh: 拖延緩慢的、拖拉磨蹭的
tip: 長得像 delay 延遲：一直拖、慢吞吞
example: The dilatory contractor kept promising to finish the roof but never brought his tools.
exampleZh: 拖拉的承包商一直保證會完成屋頂，卻連工具都沒帶來過。

zh: 半吊子、淺嚐輒止業餘愛好者
tip: 源自義大利文「玩得開心」：樣樣淺嚐，不求精通
example: A dilettante in every field, he dabbled in painting, then violin, then pottery, finishing nothing.
exampleZh: 他在每個領域都只是玩票，先畫畫、再拉小提琴、再做陶藝，卻什麼都沒完成。

zh: 糾正錯誤觀念、使醒悟還原真相
tip: dis 去除 + abuse 欺騙：把被騙的想法去掉
example: The mentor gently disabused her of the notion that talent alone guarantees success.
exampleZh: 導師溫和地糾正她認為光靠天分就能保證成功的想法。

zh: 有洞察力的、眼光敏銳有鑑賞力的
tip: dis 分開 + cern 篩（concern）：把好壞篩得清清楚楚
example: A discerning collector, she could tell a genuine antique from a clever copy in seconds.
exampleZh: 她是眼光敏銳的收藏家，幾秒內就能分辨真古董與巧妙的仿品。

zh: 使狼狽使難堪、挫敗使尷尬
tip: dis 不 + comfort 舒適：讓人坐立難安、尷尬
example: The tough question visibly discomfited the candidate, who stammered and glanced at his notes.
exampleZh: 這個棘手的問題明顯讓候選人狼狽不堪，他結結巴巴地瞄向筆記。

zh: 不和諧不一致的、刺耳刺骨的
tip: dis 分開 + cord 弦、心：各彈各的，聲音合不攏
example: The violin sounded discordant against the piano, as if the two were in different keys.
exampleZh: 小提琴和鋼琴聽起來不和諧，彷彿兩者的調子不同。

zh: 使懷疑、敗壞名譽；名譽掃地
tip: dis 不 + credit 信用：讓人不再信任
example: The leaked emails were meant to discredit the mayor before the election.
exampleZh: 洩漏的電子郵件意在選舉前讓市長名譽掃地。

zh: 個別分離的、各自獨立不連續的
tip: 別和 discreet 謹慎混淆：discrete 的兩個 e 被 t 隔開
example: The survey divides respondents into five discrete groups that do not overlap.
exampleZh: 這項調查把受訪者分成五個互不重疊的獨立群組。

zh: 謹慎周詳思考、決定權自由裁量
tip: discreet 謹慎的名詞：謹慎判斷後，自己拿主意
example: The manager has the discretion to approve small refunds without asking headquarters.
exampleZh: 經理有權自行決定批准小額退款，不必請示總部。

zh: 脫節零碎的、雜亂無章的
tip: dis 分開 + joint 關節：關節脫開，接不起來
example: His disjointed answer jumped from topic to topic and left the panel confused.
exampleZh: 他支離破碎的回答在各個主題之間跳來跳去，讓評審團一頭霧水。

zh: 輕視不屑一顧的、輕蔑拒絕的
tip: dismiss 打發走 + ive：習慣揮揮手把人趕開
example: She was dismissive of the intern's idea and waved it away without reading it.
exampleZh: 她對實習生的想法不屑一顧，連看都沒看就揮手打發。

zh: 冷靜客觀的、不動感情不帶偏見的
tip: dis 無 + passion 熱情：把情緒放一邊
example: A dispassionate judge, she weighed the facts without letting sympathy sway her.
exampleZh: 她是冷靜客觀的法官，衡量事實，不讓同情左右判斷。

zh: 性情性格、內在傾向佈局配置
tip: dispose 安排：天生被安排好的個性傾向
example: Her cheerful disposition made her popular with patients and staff alike.
exampleZh: 她開朗的性情，讓她同時受到病患與同事的喜愛。

zh: 聲名狼藉、名譽掃地受損之狀態
tip: dis 不 + repute 名聲：好名聲不見了
example: The scandal brought the once-proud club into disrepute.
exampleZh: 這樁醜聞使這個曾經風光的俱樂部名譽掃地。

zh: 掩飾假裝、隱藏真實情緒意圖
tip: dis + semble（resemble 相似）：裝成另一個樣子
example: He dissembled his disappointment behind a polite smile when the prize went to another.
exampleZh: 獎項被別人拿走時，他在禮貌的微笑後掩飾了失望。

zh: 傳播散佈、散發思想學說廣為流傳
tip: dis 四處 + semin 種子（seminar）：像四處撒種子
example: Volunteers disseminate flu-prevention leaflets in subway stations every autumn.
exampleZh: 志工每年秋天都在捷運站發送預防流感的傳單。

zh: 持異議反對；不同意見裁定
tip: dis 分開 + sent 感覺（consent 同意）：感覺不一樣
example: Two justices dissented from the ruling and wrote their own opinion.
exampleZh: 兩名大法官對這項裁決持異議，並另寫自己的意見書。

zh: 不和諧音、矛盾衝突失調感
tip: dis 不 + son 聲音（sonic）：聲音不合，刺耳又矛盾
example: The dissonance between his words and his actions made voters doubt him.
exampleZh: 他言行之間的矛盾，讓選民對他起了疑心。

zh: 膨脹腫脹、擴張擴大體積
tip: dis 向外 + tend 伸（extend）：向外撐開
example: Gas from the fermenting dough caused the bag to distend like a balloon.
exampleZh: 發酵麵糰產生的氣體，使袋子像氣球般膨脹起來。

zh: 提煉蒸餾、吸取本質精華
tip: 想像蒸餾器一滴一滴落下，只留最純的精華
example: The author distilled ten years of research into a single clear essay.
exampleZh: 作者把十年的研究精煉成一篇清晰的文章。

zh: 引起分歧的、挑撥離間分裂的
tip: divide 分開 + ive：專把人分成兩邊
example: The divisive debate over school uniforms split parents into two angry camps.
exampleZh: 關於校服的爭議性辯論，把家長分成兩個憤怒的陣營。

zh: 洩漏透露、披露機密情報
tip: di 散開 + vulg 大眾（vulgar）：讓祕密流到大眾耳裡
example: The lawyer refused to divulge what her client had told her in confidence.
exampleZh: 律師拒絕透露當事人私下告訴她的內容。

zh: 廢料浮渣、糟粕無價值殘餘
tip: 想像煉金屬時，浮在表面的黑渣要撈掉
example: After the speech was edited, the dross was gone and only the key arguments remained.
exampleZh: 講稿經過編修後，糟粕全消失了，只剩關鍵論點。

zh: 兼收並蓄折衷的；折衷博採者
tip: ec 出 + lect 選（select 挑選）：從各家挑出精華
example: Her eclectic playlist mixes jazz, folk, opera, and electronic dance music.
exampleZh: 她兼收並蓄的歌單混合了爵士、民謠、歌劇與電子舞曲。

zh: 功效療效、具體有效性功用
tip: effic 做出（effect 效果、efficient 有效率）：真的做得出效果
example: Clinical trials confirmed the efficacy of the new vaccine against severe illness.
exampleZh: 臨床試驗證實了這款新疫苗預防重症的功效。

zh: 厚顏無恥、放肆大膽厚臉皮
tip: ef 出 + front 額頭（forehead）：把臉皮大剌剌亮出來
example: He had the effrontery to ask for a raise on the day he was caught napping.
exampleZh: 他在被抓到打瞌睡的那天，居然還厚著臉皮要求加薪。

zh: 引出探出、誘出真實反應
tip: e 出 + lic 引誘（lure）：把答案誘出來
example: The teacher's open question elicited a surprising range of answers from the quiet class.
exampleZh: 老師的開放式問題，從安靜的班上引出了出乎意料的各種答案。

zh: 緩和柔軟的；潤膚劑舒緩物
tip: e 出 + moll 軟（mollify 安撫）：讓硬邦邦的變軟
example: She spoke in an emollient tone that eased the tension in the meeting.
exampleZh: 她用安撫的語氣說話，緩和了會議上的緊繃氣氛。

zh: 產生引起、釀成導致紛爭
tip: en 使 + gender 生出（generate 產生）：讓它誕生
example: Unfair grading can engender resentment among students.
exampleZh: 不公平的評分可能在學生之間引發怨恨。

zh: 平靜平穩心境、鎮定自若處變不驚
tip: equ 平（equal）+ anim 心（animal）：心像水面一樣平
example: She accepted the bad news with equanimity and calmly began to plan the next step.
exampleZh: 她平靜地接受了壞消息，並冷靜地開始規劃下一步。

zh: 委婉說法、委婉詞替換手法
tip: eu 好 + phem 說話：把難聽的事說得好聽
example: Calling a layoff "a workforce adjustment" is a classic euphemism.
exampleZh: 把裁員稱為「人力調整」是典型的委婉說法。

zh: 極壞糟糕的、該受咒詛可憎的
tip: ex 像打叉 X：壞到要被畫叉叉、人人嫌棄
example: The restaurant's execrable service drove away even its most loyal customers.
exampleZh: 這家餐廳糟透了的服務，連最忠實的老顧客都被趕跑。

zh: 緊急迫切的、苛求急迫處理的
tip: ex 出 + ig 驅動（agent）：事情逼著人立刻行動
example: Exigent circumstances allowed the officers to enter the burning building without a warrant.
exampleZh: 緊急情況讓警員得以不經令狀進入起火的建築物。

zh: 詳述細說、漫步暢談長文論述
tip: ex 出 + spati 空間（space）：話鋪展到很大的空間，滔滔不絕
example: The professor expatiated on the history of the telescope for nearly an hour.
exampleZh: 教授花了將近一小時詳細闡述望遠鏡的歷史。

zh: 逐出國外；僑民流亡海外人士
tip: ex 外 + patri 祖國（patriot 愛國者）：離開祖國的人
example: The expatriate teacher missed her family but loved her new life in Taipei.
exampleZh: 這位旅居海外的老師想念家人，卻愛上她在台北的新生活。

zh: 倡導者、代表人物典型指數
tip: ex 出 + pon 放（position 位置）：把主張擺出來宣傳
example: She is a leading exponent of renewable energy and speaks at conferences worldwide.
exampleZh: 她是再生能源的主要倡導者，在世界各地的研討會演講。

zh: 刪去不當內容、淨化出版品
tip: ex 出 + purg 清洗（purify 淨化）：把不乾淨的洗掉
example: Censors expurgated the novel, cutting every passage they judged unsuitable for schools.
exampleZh: 審查人員刪改了這本小說，刪去所有他們認為不適合學校的段落。

zh: 現存尚存的、保留至今之古文獻
tip: ex 外 + st 站（stand）：別人都倒了，只有它還站著留到現在
example: Only three copies of the medieval manuscript are extant, all kept in European libraries.
exampleZh: 這部中世紀手稿僅存三份，全都收藏在歐洲的圖書館。

zh: 即席即興的、無準備口發的
tip: ex 出 + tempor 時間（temporary 暫時）：當下就脫口而出
example: Her extemporaneous toast, delivered without notes, moved the whole wedding party.
exampleZh: 她不看稿的即席祝酒詞，感動了整場婚宴的賓客。

zh: 根除根絕、徹底消滅消弭殆盡
tip: ex 出 + stirp 樹根：連根拔起，不留一點
example: Public health workers hoped to extirpate the disease from the region within a decade.
exampleZh: 公共衛生人員希望在十年內把這種疾病從該地區根除。

zh: 愛開玩笑的、滑稽輕浮不莊重的
tip: facetious 依序含有 a e i o u 五個母音，像愛開玩笑的字謎
example: Her facetious remark about the broken printer made everyone laugh, though the boss was not amused.
exampleZh: 她對壞掉印表機的玩笑話逗笑了大家，老闆卻笑不出來。

zh: 恰當妥貼的、得體令人愉悅舒暢的
tip: felic 快樂（felicity 幸福）：用詞剛好，讓人舒服愉快
example: Her felicitous phrase, "a library is a city of quiet," won warm applause.
exampleZh: 她那句恰如其分的「圖書館是安靜的城市」贏得熱烈掌聲。

zh: 熱烈狂熱的、激情澎湃激烈的
tip: ferv 沸騰（fervent 熱切）：熱得像水煮開
example: The fervid crowd chanted the team's name until the stadium shook.
exampleZh: 狂熱的群眾高喊球隊名字，直到整座球場都在震動。

zh: 阻撓議事阻礙法案；冗長發言阻撓
tip: fill + buster：用長篇大論 fill 滿時間，把法案 bust 掉
example: The senator launched a filibuster, reading cookbooks aloud for hours to delay the vote.
exampleZh: 參議員發動冗長發言阻撓議事，連續數小時朗讀食譜以拖延表決。

zh: 初出茅廬剛起步的；幼鳥生手
tip: fledge 羽毛長齊 + ling 小東西：剛學飛的小鳥
example: The fledgling company had only five employees but bold plans for expansion.
exampleZh: 這家剛起步的公司只有五名員工，卻有大膽的擴張計畫。

zh: 公然藐視無視、嘲弄違抗法規規定
tip: 長得像 flaunt 炫耀：大搖大擺踩著規則走過去
example: Drivers who flout the speed limit near schools risk heavy fines.
exampleZh: 在學校附近無視速限的駕駛，有被重罰的風險。

zh: 煽動助長、挑起動亂事端叛亂
tip: 拉丁文 fomentum 是熱敷：不停加熱，火越燒越旺
example: Rumors spread online can foment panic and unrest in a small town.
exampleZh: 在網路上散布的謠言可能在小鎮煽動恐慌與動亂。

zh: 先發制人預防、預先阻止阻撓
tip: fore 前面 + stall 擋住：在前面先攔下來
example: She forestalled complaints by sending customers a clear apology and a refund.
exampleZh: 她寄給顧客明確的道歉與退款，預先阻止了抱怨。

zh: 節儉儉約、量入為出節省開銷
tip: frug 像 fruit 果實：珍惜每一顆果實，不浪費
example: Her frugality showed in her habit of mending clothes instead of buying new ones.
exampleZh: 她習慣縫補衣服而不買新的，顯示出她的節儉。

zh: 嚴厲譴責、大聲痛斥咆哮爆炸
tip: fulmin 是拉丁文閃電：怒罵像雷電劈下來
example: The editor fulminated against the new policy in a furious column.
exampleZh: 編輯在一篇怒氣沖沖的專欄裡猛烈抨擊新政策。

zh: 過分諂媚的、令人生厭虛偽做作的
tip: full 滿 + some：滿到過頭，膩得讓人不舒服
example: Fulsome praise from the boss made the young analyst suspicious rather than flattered.
exampleZh: 老闆過分諂媚的稱讚，讓年輕分析師起疑，而非受寵若驚。

zh: 否認反駁、反對質疑對抗真相
tip: gain 是古英文「反對」+ say 說：開口說反話
example: No one could gainsay the evidence that the river had risen a full meter.
exampleZh: 沒有人能否認河水已上升整整一公尺的證據。

zh: 激勵刺激驅使；刺棒激勵催逼物
tip: 諧音「夠的」：牧人用尖棒一直戳，牛才會往前走
example: His rivals goaded him into answering the insult, which was exactly what they wanted.
exampleZh: 對手激得他回應侮辱，這正是他們想要的。

zh: 敲竹槓勒索、哄抬暴利價格鑿孔
tip: gouge 是鑿子：從荷包裡一鑿一大塊錢
example: Some shops gouge tourists by tripling prices once the festival begins.
exampleZh: 有些商店在慶典一開始就把價格漲三倍，向觀光客敲竹槓。

zh: 好交際群居的、喜愛社交聚會的
tip: greg 群體（congregate 聚集）：喜歡成群結隊
example: A gregarious host, she introduced every guest to at least three other people.
exampleZh: 她是好交際的主人，把每位客人都介紹給至少三個人。

zh: 誠實純真的、老實毫無狡詐心機的
tip: guile 狡詐 + less 無：心裡沒有一點小心機
example: Guileless and trusting, the boy believed every promise the salesman made.
exampleZh: 天真又信任人的男孩，相信推銷員說的每一個承諾。

zh: 異端非正統的、不符合傳統權威的
tip: hetero 不同 + dox 意見（orthodox 正統）：意見與主流不同
example: The heterodox economist questioned assumptions that most of her colleagues had never examined.
exampleZh: 這位非主流的經濟學家質疑多數同事從未檢驗過的假設。

zh: 盲目崇拜、偶像崇拜過度崇信
tip: idol 偶像 + latry 崇拜：把偶像當成神
example: Critics called the fans' idolatry of the singer unhealthy, since they copied his every move.
exampleZh: 評論者認為粉絲對這位歌手的盲目崇拜不健康，因為他們模仿他的一舉一動。

zh: 損害削弱、損壞機能導致退化
tip: repair 是修理，im 的 impair 反過來：把功能弄壞
example: Loud noise over many years can impair hearing permanently.
exampleZh: 長年的巨大噪音可能永久損害聽力。

zh: 面無表情冷靜的、無動於衷冷肅的
tip: im 無 + pass 感受（passion 熱情）：臉上沒有任何感覺
example: He listened to the verdict with an impassive face, showing no sign of relief or fear.
exampleZh: 他面無表情地聽完判決，沒有流露出鬆了口氣或恐懼。

zh: 沉著鎮定自若的、不易激動動搖的
tip: im 不 + perturb 擾亂 + able：怎麼擾都擾不亂
example: Imperturbable even in a storm, the pilot kept his voice calm while the plane shook.
exampleZh: 即使在暴風雨中也從容不迫，飛行員在機身搖晃時聲音依然平穩。

zh: 魯莽衝動的、急躁不計後果暴烈急進的
tip: pet 衝撞（impetus 推動力）：沒多想就一頭衝出去
example: Impetuous as ever, he quit his job on Monday and booked a flight on Tuesday.
exampleZh: 他一如往常地衝動，週一辭職，週二就訂了機票。

zh: 無法平息的、難以和解冷酷無情的
tip: im 不 + placate 安撫 + able：怎麼安撫都沒用
example: The implacable critic refused every apology and kept attacking the company for years.
exampleZh: 這位難以平息怒氣的批評者拒絕所有道歉，多年來不斷抨擊那家公司。

zh: 內爆內部崩塌、劇烈自體瓦解崩析
tip: im 向內 + plode 爆（explode 向外爆）：向內垮掉
example: The failing startup imploded within a year, torn apart by arguments among its founders.
exampleZh: 這間營運不善的新創公司，在一年內因創辦人之間的爭執而內部崩潰。

zh: 無意疏忽的、不經意非故意的疏失
tip: in 不 + advert 注意（advertise 引人注意）：沒注意到
example: An inadvertent click deleted the file, and the whole team lost a day's work.
exampleZh: 一次不經意的點擊刪掉了檔案，全組損失一天的工作。

zh: 微不足道不重要的、無足輕重的
tip: in 無 + consequence 後果：不會造成任何後果
example: Compared with the main risk, the delay was inconsequential and not worth a meeting.
exampleZh: 與主要風險相比，這次延誤微不足道，不值得開會討論。

zh: 不確定未明確的、模糊未定的
tip: in 不 + determine 決定 + ate：還沒決定下來
example: The indeterminate length of the project made it hard to hire contractors.
exampleZh: 專案期限不確定，使得僱用外包人員很困難。

zh: 貧困貧乏赤貧、極端匱乏狀態
tip: indigent 窮的名詞版：連基本需要都缺
example: Born into indigence, she worked her way through night school and became a surgeon.
exampleZh: 她生於赤貧，靠半工半讀念夜校，後來成為外科醫師。

zh: 無知覺無意識的、麻木不仁不敏感的
tip: in 無 + sense 感覺 + ible：沒有感覺，別和 insensitive 混淆
example: Insensible to the cold after hours of climbing, he did not notice his frozen fingers.
exampleZh: 爬了幾小時後對寒冷已沒有知覺，他沒發現自己的手指都凍僵了。

zh: 枯燥乏味的、索然無味淡而無趣的
tip: in 無 + sip 啜飲：喝一口什麼味道都沒有
example: The insipid soup needed salt, herbs, and a good deal of imagination.
exampleZh: 那碗索然無味的湯需要鹽、香草，和不少想像力。

zh: 偏狹孤立心態、島國思想視野受限
tip: insula 是拉丁文「島」（isolate 孤立）：像困在孤島上
example: The insularity of the small village meant that outside ideas rarely reached its council.
exampleZh: 這個小村莊的偏狹閉塞，使外界的想法很少傳到村議會。

zh: 不妥協不讓步、頑固固執己見立場
tip: in 不 + trans 越過：一步也不肯跨過去讓步
example: The union's intransigence over wages ended the talks after only one day.
exampleZh: 工會在薪資問題上毫不讓步，談判只進行一天就破局。

zh: 淹沒氾濫、席捲使應接不暇大量湧入
tip: 拉丁 unda 是波浪：一波接一波打來，把你淹掉
example: After the ad aired, the shop was inundated with orders it could not fill.
exampleZh: 廣告播出後，這家店被大量無法應付的訂單淹沒。

zh: 習慣於苦痛的、適應習慣了困苦的
tip: 想像身體經過一次次磨練，皮變厚就不怕了
example: Years of night shifts had inured the nurses to sleeping in daylight.
exampleZh: 多年的夜班讓護理師習慣了在白天睡覺。

zh: 猛烈痛斥漫罵、惡毒辱罵譴責之言
tip: in 向 + vect 帶（vehicle 載具）：把惡言一車車載過去
example: He unleashed a stream of invective at the referee after the unfair call.
exampleZh: 在不公平的判決之後，他對裁判劈頭痛罵了一長串。

zh: 巡迴流動巡遊的；巡迴流動從業者
tip: iter 路程（itinerary 行程表）：走過來走過去
example: The itinerant storyteller traveled from village to village, trading tales for food and a bed.
exampleZh: 巡迴的說書人穿梭於各村之間，以故事換取食物與床鋪。

zh: 疲倦倦怠無力、無精打采身心疲憊
tip: 諧音「懶西吐」：懶洋洋，連話都吐不出來
example: A heavy lassitude settled over the town during the humid August afternoons.
exampleZh: 潮濕的八月午後，一股沉重的倦怠籠罩了全鎮。

zh: 防洪堤防河堤、石堤保護性護岸
tip: levee 和 level 長得像：水位 level 升高，就靠 levee 擋住
example: Residents piled sandbags along the levee as the river rose past midnight.
exampleZh: 河水在午夜後持續上漲，居民沿著堤防堆起沙包。

zh: 輕浮輕率言行、不莊重嬉鬧欠嚴肅
tip: lev 是輕（像 elevate 抬起）：心情輕飄飄，開玩笑不夠莊重
example: His joke about the budget added a moment of levity to the tense meeting.
exampleZh: 他拿預算開的玩笑，為緊繃的會議增添了片刻輕鬆。

zh: 寬宏大量、無私氣度心胸寬廣之美德
tip: magn 大 + anim 心：心胸大，才能原諒別人
example: She showed great magnanimity by forgiving the rival who had spread rumors about her.
exampleZh: 她寬恕了散播自己謠言的對手，展現了極大的氣度。

zh: 裝病逃避工作責任者、裝病怠工者
tip: mal 壞 + linger 賴著不走：賴在原地假裝生病不做事
example: The foreman suspected the new worker was a malingerer who faked a sore back to avoid lifting.
exampleZh: 領班懷疑那位新工人是裝病逃避工作的人，假裝背痛以免搬重物。

zh: 陰鬱孤僻悶悶不樂的、愁眉苦臉孤僻的
tip: 諧音「魔肉絲」：魔肉絲被搶走了，整天愁眉苦臉不說話
example: After losing the final, he sat morose and silent in the locker room.
exampleZh: 輸掉決賽後，他悶悶不樂、沉默地坐在更衣室裡。

zh: 新手初學者、新信徒入門初學者
tip: neo 新 + phyte 植物：剛種下的小苗，就是新手
example: As a neophyte in the chess club, she lost her first ten games.
exampleZh: 身為西洋棋社的新手，她輸掉了前十盤棋。

zh: 阻塞遮蔽切斷、使封閉不通阻擋光線
tip: oc 擋在前面 + clude 關閉（像 close）：把光擋住關起來
example: Thick smoke occluded the sun, and the valley fell into early dusk.
exampleZh: 濃煙遮住了太陽，山谷提早陷入黃昏般的昏暗。

zh: 好管閒事愛指手畫腳的、過度干預的
tip: office 辦公室裡總有人什麼都要插手、指揮別人
example: An officious clerk kept correcting how visitors filled out forms nobody had asked him to check.
exampleZh: 一位多管閒事的職員不斷糾正訪客填表的方式，而沒人要他檢查。

zh: 恥辱辱罵聲討、名譽掃地公開譴責
tip: 諧音「噢！破布」：被大家指指點點，丟臉丟到像破布
example: The mayor faced public opprobrium after the secret deal came to light.
exampleZh: 秘密交易曝光後，市長遭到公開的譴責。

zh: 炫耀賣弄排場的、誇張鋪張炫富的
tip: 字根 ostend 是展示：愛把財富擺出來給大家看
example: Her ostentatious diamond necklace drew stares at the quiet village wedding.
exampleZh: 她那條炫耀的鑽石項鍊在安靜的村莊婚禮上引來側目。

zh: 完美典範模範、卓越楷模極致代表
tip: 諧音「趴啦棍」：大家趴下來膜拜的完美模範
example: Teachers held her up as a paragon of patience and fairness.
exampleZh: 老師們把她視為耐心與公平的典範。

zh: 病態無法自拔的、病理學異常的
tip: path 是病痛或感受（像 sympathy）+ log 學：病理學上的異常
example: His pathological fear of failure kept him from submitting any work at all.
exampleZh: 他對失敗有病態的恐懼，以致一件作品都交不出去。

zh: 赤貧極度貧窮、一貧如洗生活匱乏
tip: pen 是筆：窮到只剩一支筆（pen），什麼都買不起
example: After the factory closed, the family lived in penury for years.
exampleZh: 工廠關閉後，這家人過了好幾年赤貧的生活。

zh: 背信棄義不忠誠的、陰險背叛出賣人的
tip: per 違背 + fid 信任（像 fidelity 忠誠）：違背信任
example: The perfidious ally secretly sold the king's battle plans to the enemy.
exampleZh: 那個背信棄義的盟友暗中把國王的作戰計畫賣給敵人。

zh: 冷靜沉著不易衝動的、淡漠冷靜自若的
tip: 古人以為痰（phlegm）多的人個性冷靜、慢條斯理
example: While everyone else panicked, the phlegmatic captain calmly checked the map again.
exampleZh: 其他人都慌了，沉著冷靜的船長卻平靜地再看一次地圖。

zh: 可塑性延展性、適應形變調整能力
tip: plastic 塑膠能捏成各種形狀，加 ity 就是可塑性
example: The plasticity of a child's brain lets it rewire quickly after injury.
exampleZh: 孩子大腦的可塑性使它在受傷後能迅速重新連結。

zh: 垂直驟降暴跌、急速下墜直線下挫
tip: plum 李子 met 地面：李子從樹上直直掉到地上
example: Share prices plummeted by half within an hour of the announcement.
exampleZh: 消息公布後一小時內，股價暴跌了一半。

zh: 危險不穩的、搖搖欲墜命懸一線的
tip: 把 car 停在懸崖邊，隨時會掉下去，真危險
example: The hiker rested on a precarious ledge barely wide enough for two boots.
exampleZh: 登山客在一塊窄得只容兩隻靴子的危險岩架上休息。

zh: 促成加速引爆；魯莽倉促輕率的
tip: 字根 cap 是頭：頭朝下往前栽，一下子加速又倉促
example: The sudden ban precipitated a crisis among small farmers.
exampleZh: 突然的禁令引發了小農之間的危機。

zh: 專橫冒昧自以為是的、傲慢越權放肆的
tip: pre 先 + sume 拿：沒被允許就先拿，太放肆
example: It was presumptuous of the intern to rewrite the director's speech without asking.
exampleZh: 實習生沒問過就改寫主任的演講稿，實在太自以為是。

zh: 原始純淨未受污染的、嶄新無瑕未動的
tip: prist 與 prime 同源，是最初的樣子：像剛下的第一場雪
example: Hikers were amazed by the pristine lake, untouched by roads or litter.
exampleZh: 健行者對那座沒有道路或垃圾打擾的原始純淨湖泊驚嘆不已。

zh: 成問題存疑有爭議的、不易解決疑點重的
tip: problem 問題加上 atic：變成形容詞，就是有問題的
example: Critics found the study's sample size problematic, since only twelve people took part.
exampleZh: 評論者認為這項研究的樣本數有問題，因為只有十二人參加。

zh: 得體適當合宜之禮數、正當禮貌規矩
tip: proper 是合宜的，ety 變名詞：行為合宜的規矩
example: She dressed with careful propriety for the formal court ceremony.
exampleZh: 她為了正式的宮廷典禮，穿著得體、謹守禮數。

zh: 正式法律禁止、宣告非法剝奪權益取締
tip: pro 在前 + scribe 寫：公告上寫明禁止；和 prescribe 開處方別搞混
example: The new law proscribes the sale of fireworks near schools.
exampleZh: 新法律禁止在學校附近販售煙火。

zh: 刺鼻辛辣的、尖銳一針見血刻薄的
tip: 字根 pung 是刺（像 puncture 刺破）：辛辣得像被針戳到鼻子
example: The pungent smell of garlic filled the whole kitchen.
exampleZh: 大蒜刺鼻的氣味充滿了整間廚房。

zh: 有保留有限制的、合格具備資質的
tip: qualified 除了有資格，也像附但書的通行證：有條件才算數
example: The board gave only qualified support to the plan, demanding several changes first.
exampleZh: 董事會只對這項計畫給予有保留的支持，要求先做幾項修改。

zh: 吹毛求疵為細節狡辯；雙關巧妙辯辭
tip: 諧音「虧波」：為了小細節虧來虧去，吹毛求疵
example: Let's not quibble over a few cents when the whole project is at stake.
exampleZh: 整個專案都在危急關頭，我們別再為幾分錢斤斤計較了。

zh: 稀薄精妙純化的、深奧高雅超俗脫凡的
tip: rare 稀少 + fy 使變成：高山空氣稀薄，高深圈子也少人能到
example: He spent his career in the rarefied air of theoretical physics, far from everyday concerns.
exampleZh: 他整個職涯都待在遠離日常煩惱、曲高和寡的理論物理圈裡。

zh: 正式公開撤回放棄、撤銷信仰誓言聲明
tip: re 回 + cant 唱（像 chant）：把唱過的歌收回來
example: Under pressure, the scientist refused to recant his findings.
exampleZh: 在壓力之下，這位科學家拒絕撤回他的研究發現。

zh: 貶黜降級流放、移交下層次要單位處置
tip: re 退回 + leg 派遣：被派到後面去，位置降級
example: After the scandal, the manager was relegated to a small office in the basement.
exampleZh: 醜聞過後，經理被貶到地下室的一間小辦公室。

zh: 墮落狂徒惡棍罪人；放蕩墮落不齒的
tip: re 反 + prove 證明：被證明不及格、被眾人唾棄的壞蛋
example: The villagers shunned the old reprobate who gambled away his family's farm.
exampleZh: 村民們迴避那個把全家農場賭光的老無賴。

zh: 下定決心解決爭端；不拔堅定毅力
tip: re 再三 + solve 解：再三想清楚，決心解決問題
example: She resolved to practice every morning until she could play the piece perfectly.
exampleZh: 她下定決心每天早上練習，直到能完美演奏這首曲子。

zh: 智者賢達宗師；明智精闢深奧大智的
tip: sage 也是鼠尾草：白鬍子智者在花園裡給你好建議
example: The village sage was consulted whenever a dispute seemed impossible to settle.
exampleZh: 每當紛爭似乎無法解決，村民就會請教村裡的智者。

zh: 使充分飽足、過飽滿足使厭膩生厭
tip: sat 同 satisfy 的 sat（足夠）：吃到飽，甚至吃膩了
example: Children satiated with sweets turned away from the cake they had begged for.
exampleZh: 吃糖吃到膩的孩子，不再理會剛才吵著要吃的蛋糕。

zh: 品味品嚐細細享受；特殊滋味氣味
tip: 諧音「沙發」：窩在沙發上慢慢品嚐美食
example: She savored every bite of the warm bread on the cold morning.
exampleZh: 在寒冷的早晨，她細細品味每一口溫熱的麵包。

zh: 分泌排出生理液體；隱匿藏匿物品
tip: secret 秘密：身體偷偷從裡面分泌出液體；也可指藏起來
example: Bees secrete wax to build the walls of their honeycomb.
exampleZh: 蜜蜂分泌蜂蠟來建造蜂巢的牆壁。

zh: 破片碎片殘骸、碎陶片斷瓦殘片
tip: shard 像 sharp：碎片邊緣又尖又利，別用手去摸
example: Archaeologists pieced together the vase from hundreds of tiny pottery shards.
exampleZh: 考古學家用數百片細小的陶器碎片拼回了那只花瓶。

zh: 關懷掛念體貼熱切的、殷切操心懸念的
tip: sol 全部 + cit 驅動：整顆心被牽動，處處為你操心
example: The solicitous nurse kept asking whether the little boy needed another blanket.
exampleZh: 體貼的護理師不停詢問小男孩是否還需要一條毯子。

zh: 恥辱污名烙印、道德負面社會標籤
tip: 原意是烙印的記號：被貼上標籤，很難撕下來
example: Many patients avoid treatment because of the stigma attached to mental illness.
exampleZh: 許多病人因為精神疾病所帶的污名而不願接受治療。

zh: 節省克扣限制；定額工作期局限
example: After a two-year stint abroad, she returned home with fluent French.
exampleZh: 在國外待了兩年的工作期後，她帶著流利的法語回到家鄉。

zh: 明確約定規定、約定必備先決條件
tip: 合約上把條件一條條寫明白，白紙黑字改不了
example: The contract stipulates that all repairs must be finished before the first of June.
exampleZh: 合約明訂所有維修必須在六月一日前完成。

zh: 冷淡麻木不動感情的、遲鈍麻木不仁的
tip: stolid 像 solid 實心的：像石頭一樣不動聲色
example: The stolid guard did not so much as blink when the crowd began shouting.
exampleZh: 人群開始大喊時，那名神情木然的守衛連眼睛都沒眨一下。

zh: 有條紋斑紋條痕的、具平行溝紋線條的
tip: stri 像 stripe 條紋：岩壁上一條一條平行的紋路
example: The cliff face was striated with bands of red and gray rock.
exampleZh: 懸崖壁面佈滿了紅色與灰色岩層交疊的條紋。

zh: 大搖大擺昂首闊步；支撐柱頂木支柱
tip: 公雞挺胸大搖大擺；同一個字也是撐住屋頂的支柱
example: The rooster strutted across the yard as if it owned the farm.
exampleZh: 那隻公雞在院子裡大搖大擺地走，好像整座農場都是牠的。

zh: 法院傳票傳喚令；傳喚出庭作證提供
tip: sub 在下 + poena 處罰：不到場就要受罰的傳票
example: The court issued a subpoena requiring the accountant to testify next Monday.
exampleZh: 法院發出傳票，要求那位會計師下週一出庭作證。

zh: 取代替代淘汰接替、取而代之廢棄舊制
tip: super 在上 + sede 坐：新的坐到舊的位子上，取而代之
example: Digital cameras gradually superseded film cameras in almost every household.
exampleZh: 數位相機逐漸取代了幾乎每個家庭裡的底片相機。

zh: 猜想假設假定、推測設想之前提
tip: suppose 假設的名詞：只是想當然，還沒被證實
example: Her theory rests on the supposition that the ancient river once changed course.
exampleZh: 她的理論建立在古河道曾經改道的假設之上。

zh: 纖細薄弱空洞的、站不住腳脆弱微弱的
tip: ten 拉長變細（像 extend）：細得像蜘蛛絲，一扯就斷
example: The link between the two events is tenuous at best, so the claim fails.
exampleZh: 這兩件事之間的關聯至多只是薄弱，所以這個主張站不住腳。

zh: 麻木遲鈍無精打采、冬眠狀態怠惰麻木
tip: 諧音「拖破」：拖著破破的身體，一點力氣也沒有
example: A heavy lunch left the whole class in a warm torpor.
exampleZh: 豐盛的午餐讓全班陷入昏昏沉沉、懶洋洋的狀態。

zh: 彎曲蜿蜒曲折複雜的、轉彎抹角複雜的
tip: tort 是扭（像 contort）：路扭來扭去；別和 torturous 折磨人搞混
example: The tortuous mountain road twisted back on itself a dozen times before the summit.
exampleZh: 那條蜿蜒曲折的山路在抵達山頂前迴旋了十幾次。

zh: 違法越軌犯規、逾越道德法律邊界之行
tip: trans 越過 + gress 走（像 progress）：走過了界線
example: Cheating on the exam was a serious transgression of the school's honor code.
exampleZh: 考試作弊是嚴重違反校規誠信準則的行為。

zh: 兇狠殘暴好鬥挑釁、兇暴霸凌氣焰
tip: truck 卡車橫衝直撞：氣勢洶洶，一副要吵架的樣子
example: The coach was shocked by the truculence of players who snarled at every referee call.
exampleZh: 教練對球員們面對每個裁判判決都咆哮頂撞的好鬥態度感到震驚。

zh: 黏稠黏滯黏性高阻力大的
tip: 想像蜂蜜在湯匙上慢慢拉絲、流不動，就是 viscous
example: Cold honey is so viscous that it barely slides off the spoon.
exampleZh: 冷掉的蜂蜜非常黏稠，幾乎無法從湯匙上滑下來。

zh: 辱罵漫罵刻薄苛責的、尖酸攻訐責罵的
tip: 諧音「威圖拍」：氣勢威威、拍桌子大聲責罵
example: The senator's vituperative speech attacked his rivals with insults rather than arguments.
exampleZh: 那位參議員尖酸刻薄的演說用辱罵而非論點來攻擊對手。

zh: 正當合理有依據保證的、事出有因必然的
tip: warrant 是保證書：有憑有據，所以這麼做站得住腳
example: Given the evidence, the inspector's suspicion was fully warranted.
exampleZh: 有了這些證據，檢查員的懷疑完全有其依據。

zh: 警惕提防小心謹慎的、敏銳防範風險的
tip: wary 藏著 ware（留意），和 beware 同家族：小心提防
example: Burned once by a bad deal, she grew wary of strangers offering easy profits.
exampleZh: 吃過一次劣質交易的虧後，她對提供輕鬆獲利的陌生人變得提防。

zh: 混亂雜亂無章大混雜；翻滾沉溺混亂中
tip: 想像洗衣機裡衣服翻來滾去、一大團亂糟糟，就是 welter
example: A welter of conflicting rumors made it hard to know what had really happened.
exampleZh: 一大堆互相矛盾的謠言讓人難以知道到底發生了什麼事。

zh: 異想天開反覆無常古怪的、隨興突發奇想的
tip: whim 是一時興起：想到什麼就做什麼，異想天開
example: Her whimsical garden had a tiny door, a teapot fountain, and crooked purple fences.
exampleZh: 她那座異想天開的花園有一扇迷你門、一座茶壺噴泉，還有歪歪的紫色圍籬。

zh: 減弱減退緩和、風暴平息勢頭衰減
tip: a bit 一點點：風雨一點一點變少、變弱
example: The storm finally abated, and the fishermen carried their nets back to the boats.
exampleZh: 暴風雨終於減弱，漁夫們把漁網搬回船上。

zh: 暫時擱置中止中斷、暫停生效延後行使
tip: 諧音「啊背安」：先背在身上放著，暫時不動
example: The rule has been held in abeyance until the committee finishes its review.
exampleZh: 在委員會完成審查之前，這項規定暫時擱置。

zh: 痛恨深惡痛絕厭惡、極端排斥絕不苟同
tip: ab 遠離 + hor 發抖（像 horror）：嚇得想離得遠遠的
example: She abhors cruelty to animals and refuses to visit any circus.
exampleZh: 她痛恨虐待動物，所以不肯去任何馬戲團。

zh: 赦免免除罪過、宣告無罪寬恕
tip: ab 離開 + solve 鬆開：把罪過的繩結鬆開解除
example: After confessing, the young man received absolution and felt the guilt finally lift.
exampleZh: 坦白之後，那名年輕人得到了寬恕，罪惡感終於消散。

zh: 同意應允要求、登基就任王位
tip: ac 向 + cede 走：朝對方的要求走過去，讓步答應
example: After weeks of protest, the company acceded to the workers' demands.
exampleZh: 經過數週抗議，公司終於答應了工人的要求。

zh: 協定協議給予調和；相符一致
tip: ac 向 + cord 心：心朝同一方向，意見相符
example: The two nations signed a peace accord after years of talks.
exampleZh: 經過多年談判，兩國簽署了和平協議。

zh: 逐漸增大吸積、共生共長擴大
tip: ac 向 + cret 增長（像 increase）：一層一層慢慢長大
example: Over centuries, silt accreted along the riverbank until a small island appeared.
exampleZh: 數百年間，泥沙沿著河岸逐漸堆積，直到出現一座小島。

zh: 未言明的前提假設 (若否定之，結論必崩潰)
tip: 【GMAT 命題密鑰】：否定測試法 (Negation Test)——若將該選項否定後，題幹結論直接崩解，則此選項必為 Necessary Assumption！
example: The marketing argument relies on the implicit assumption that consumer disposable income will not fall.
exampleZh: 該行銷論證仰賴於一個潛在未言明的前提假設：消費者的可支配所得不會下滑。

zh: 削弱 (論證說服力、打破因果鏈)
tip: 【GMAT 削弱三大途徑】：1. 引入他因 (Alternative Cause)；2. 因果倒置 (Reverse Causality)；3. 割裂論據與結論之必然關聯。
example: Which of the following findings, if true, most seriously weakens the mayor's municipal economic claim?
exampleZh: 下列何項調查發現若為真，最嚴重削弱了市長對市政經濟前景的主張？

zh: 加強、支持 (結論成立的機率)
tip: 【GMAT 加強三大途徑】：1. 排除反因/干擾變數；2. 證明無因則無果；3. 證實數據樣本具代表性。
example: The economic consultant presented competitor cost data to strengthen the viability of the joint venture.
exampleZh: 經濟顧問出示了競爭對手的成本數據，以加強該合資計畫的可行性。

zh: 評估 (論證有效性之關鍵資訊)
tip: 【GMAT 評估密鑰】：變異測試法 (Variance Test)——對選項回答 Yes 能加強結論，回答 No 則能削弱結論，即為正確 Evaluate 答案！
example: Determining whether regional rivals can replicate the patented technology is critical to evaluate the proposal.
exampleZh: 查明區域競爭對手是否能複製這項專利技術，對於評估該提案而言至關重要。

tip: re- (反向) + fut (倒/擊碎，同 futile) ➔ 擊碎對方論點 ➔ 駁斥
example: The corporate treasurer presented audited financial statements to refute claims of imminent bankruptcy.
exampleZh: 財務長出示經獨立審計的財務報表，駁斥了公司瀕臨破產的傳言。

zh: 論據、前提 (題幹中明確陳述為事實的事實依據)
tip: 【GMAT CR 結構分析】：Premise (已知客觀事實) + Assumption (隱含未言明前提) ➔ Conclusion (主觀推導結論)。
example: The entire strategic plan is constructed upon the questionable premise that raw material prices will remain flat.
exampleZh: 整個策略計畫皆建立在一個令人質疑的論據前提之上：原料價格將保持平穩不變。

tip: fall (欺騙/錯誤，同 false) + -acy ➔ 看似有理實則荒謬 ➔ 邏輯謬誤
example: Confusing correlation with causation is a classic logical fallacy often tested in GMAT reasoning.
exampleZh: 將相關性誤認為因果關係，是 GMAT 邏輯批判推理中經常考查的經典邏輯謬誤。

zh: 因果關係的 (非純粹相關)
tip: 【GMAT 因果論證核心】：Correlation (相關) ≠ Causation (因果)！常考「倒果為因」或「第三外在因素干擾 (Confounding)」。
example: Epidemiologists must establish a rigorous causal mechanism before asserting that chemical exposure triggers illness.
exampleZh: 流行病學家在斷定化學物質暴露會引發疾病之前，必須先確立嚴謹的因果機制。

zh: 看似矛盾的現象、悖論 (題幹要求解釋矛盾)
tip: 【GMAT 解題密鑰】：Explain/Resolve the Paradox 題型——尋求一個「新資訊」，能同時合理解釋 Fact A 與 Fact B 兩者何以同時並存！
example: The report presented a paradox: although average incomes rose, overall consumer discretionary spending fell.
exampleZh: 該報告揭示了一項看似矛盾的現象：儘管平均所得提升，但整體消費者的非必要支出卻下滑了。

zh: 外推、推斷 (根據已知趨勢預測未知領域)
tip: extra- (向外) + pol (樞紐/軸心) + -ate ➔ 向外延伸推測 ➔ 外推推斷 (GMAT 常作為過度概括之錯誤邏輯選項)。
example: The executive warned that one cannot blindly extrapolate regional trial success to nationwide commercial viability.
exampleZh: 執行長警告，絕不能盲目地將單一區域試辦的成功，直接外推為在全國商業推廣的可行性。

zh: 伴隨發生的、相伴而生的 (非因果之伴生現象)
tip: con- (共同) + comit (伴侶/隨行) + -ant ➔ 只是結伴同行，並非起因！
example: The reduction in operational expenses was a concomitant benefit, not the primary driver of the software overhaul.
exampleZh: 營運支出的減少只是一項伴隨而來的附帶好處，並非該軟體系統大改版的主要推動動機。

zh: 黑體字 (GMAT 句子角色劃分題型)
tip: 【GMAT CR 黑體字經典解法】：判斷每一段黑體字是「Premise (客觀論據)」還是「Conclusion (主觀推論)」？立場是站在作者方還是反對作者？
example: The first boldface statement introduces evidence supporting the conclusion that the second boldface statement refutes.
exampleZh: 第一段黑體字陳述引入了支持某結論的證據，而第二段黑體字陳述則旨在駁斥該結論。

zh: 中間次要結論 (既是上一層推論的結果，又是終極結論的前提)
tip: 【GMAT CR 經典角色】：Sub-conclusion / Intermediate Conclusion——銜接基礎論據與主結論之樞紐！
example: The analyst inferred that revenue would drop, which served as an intermediate conclusion supporting the budget cut.
exampleZh: 分析師推斷營收將會下滑，這項中間結論進一步支持了最終削減預算的決策。

zh: 對立反駁論點、反面主張
tip: counter (反對) + argument (論點) ➔ 對立方的論點
example: The proposal anticipated industry counterarguments by providing verified safety audit certifications.
exampleZh: 該提案透過提供經認證的安全審計證明，預先回應了業界可能提出的反駁主張。

zh: 毫無根據的、缺乏正當理由的
tip: un- (無) + warrant (正當授權/保證) + -ed ➔ 缺乏保證的 ➔ 毫無根據的
example: Critics pointed out that assuming all users would upgrade immediately was an unwarranted inference.
exampleZh: 評論家指出，逕自假設所有使用者都會立即升級，是一項毫無客觀根據的推論。

zh: 混淆、使混亂；干擾混入因果變數
tip: con- (共同) + found (倒/融化) ➔ 倒在一起分不清 ➔ 混淆干擾變數
example: Uncontrolled socioeconomic disparities confound the correlation between diet and cardiac health.
exampleZh: 未受控制的社會經濟差距干擾混淆了飲食與心臟健康之間的相關性判定。

zh: 邊際的、微不足道的、極微小的
tip: margin (頁邊空白) ➔ 處在最邊緣的 ➔ 微小的/邊際的
example: The marketing upgrade produced only marginal sales improvements despite enormous capital expenditure.
exampleZh: 儘管耗費了龐大的資本支出，該行銷升級僅帶來了微不足道的業績提升。

zh: 迫切緊急的、勢在必行的；當務之急
tip: imper (統治/命令，同 empire 帝國) ➔ 如帝王軍令般十萬火急 ➔ 勢在必行的
example: Diversifying the semiconductor supplier network has become a national strategic imperative.
exampleZh: 半導體供應商網絡的多元化分散已成為國家層級勢在必行的策略當務之急。

zh: 威懾阻止、使打消念頭 (搭配 from)
tip: de- (離開) + ter (恐懼，同 terror) ➔ 因恐懼代價而退縮 ➔ 威懾阻止
example: Stiff regulatory financial penalties are instituted to deter corporations from dumping industrial pollutants.
exampleZh: 制定高額監管罰款旨在威懾阻止企業傾倒工業廢棄物。

zh: 權衡取捨、妥協折衷 (兩難之間的選擇)
tip: trade (交換) + off ➔ 放棄 A 以換取 B ➔ 權衡取捨
example: Engineers face an inevitable trade-off between lighter battery weight and extended driving range.
exampleZh: 工程師面臨著電池輕量化與更長續航里程之間不可避免的權衡取捨。

zh: (價格或費用) 高昂得令人望而卻步的
tip: prohibit (禁止) + -ive ➔ 價格高到形同禁止購買 ➔ 昂貴得令人卻步的
example: The cost of licensing the patented manufacturing process proved entirely prohibitive for the small startup.
exampleZh: 這項專利製造製程的授權費用過於高昂，這家小型新創公司完全負擔不起。

tip: dis- (分開) + crep (劈啪聲/裂痕) ➔ 數據出現裂痕對不上 ➔ 矛盾不一致
example: Auditors noticed a significant discrepancy between logged warehouse shipments and ledger receipts.
exampleZh: 審計員察覺到了倉庫出貨登記紀錄與總帳收據之間存在重大不符與矛盾之處。

tip: 【GMAT 批判】音節 as - su - me。常見於商業決策與因果推理題目，考查假設前提與邏輯嚴密性。
example: Let's assume that'll happen.
exampleZh: 讓我們假定那會發生。

tip: un 沒有 + assumed 假設：不靠猜、直接量到的真數字
example: Unlike the forecast, the unassumed revenue figures came straight from audited sales records.
exampleZh: 和預測不同，這些未經假設的營收數字直接來自查核過的銷售紀錄。

tip: 【GMAT 批判】音節 con - clu - sion。常見於商業決策與因果推理題目，考查假設前提與邏輯嚴密性。
example: Tom came to the conclusion that no matter what he did, Mary wouldn't like it.
exampleZh: 湯姆得出無論他做什麼，瑪麗都不會喜歡的結論。

tip: con 全部 + clude 關上：把討論關門收尾，得出結論
example: After comparing three pilot markets, the team concluded that free shipping drove most of the growth.
exampleZh: 比較三個試辦市場後，團隊斷定免運費帶動了大部分成長。

tip: conclude 的形容詞，證據一錘定音，沒有爭議
example: Only conclusive proof of the supplier's fraud would justify ending the ten-year contract.
exampleZh: 只有確鑿證明供應商詐欺，才有理由終止這份十年合約。

zh: 非決定性的、尚無定論的
tip: in 不 + conclusive 確定：證據不夠，還是霧煞煞
example: The survey was inconclusive, so the board postponed its decision until more data arrived.
exampleZh: 調查結果尚無定論，所以董事會延後決定，等待更多數據。

tip: counter 反 + premise 前提：對方回丟過來的另一個前提
example: Her counterpremise, that customers buy for price alone, forced the team to rethink its brand plan.
exampleZh: 她提出的反向前提，即顧客只看價格購買，迫使團隊重新思考品牌計畫。

tip: inter 之間 + mediate 中間：夾在起點與終點的中途站
example: An intermediate target of fifty new clients keeps the sales team on track toward the annual goal.
exampleZh: 五十位新客戶的階段性目標，讓業務團隊穩穩朝年度目標前進。

tip: 第二位證人點點頭附和，你的說法就站得更穩
example: A second independent audit corroborated the claim that the warehouse had been losing stock for months.
exampleZh: 第二次獨立稽核證實了倉庫數月來持續短少庫存的說法。

tip: corroborate 的名詞，旁邊多一份證據幫你撐腰
example: Without corroboration from other stores, one manager's complaint cannot prove a chain-wide problem.
exampleZh: 沒有其他分店的佐證，單一經理的抱怨無法證明整個連鎖體系有問題。

tip: sub 底下 + stance 站：替說法打好地基才站得住
example: Management must substantiate its cost-saving claim with invoices, not just optimistic estimates.
exampleZh: 管理階層必須用發票而不是樂觀的估計，來充實其節省成本的主張。

tip: un 沒有 + substantiate 打地基：說法懸空，沒根據
example: Regulators dismissed the unsubstantiated rumor that the merger would eliminate half the jobs.
exampleZh: 監管機關駁回了合併將裁掉一半職位這項沒有憑據的謠言。

tip: re 反 + fute 敲打：把對方論點一一敲掉
example: The critic's refutation relied on a single chart showing that sales rose after the price increase.
exampleZh: 評論者的反駁只靠一張圖表，顯示漲價後銷售反而上升。

tip: re 退回：把指控整個推回去，說我不認帳
example: The CEO repudiated the report's conclusion and insisted that the company had never missed a delivery deadline.
exampleZh: 執行長否認報告的結論，堅稱公司從未延誤過交貨期限。

tip: under 底下 + mine 挖礦：偷偷在地基下面挖洞
example: Frequent price cuts may undermine a brand's image of quality even while they lift short-term sales.
exampleZh: 頻繁降價雖能提振短期銷售，卻可能削弱品牌的品質形象。

tip: in 不 + valid 有效：蓋上無效章，整個論證作廢
example: One overlooked clause could invalidate the whole contract and leave both firms without legal protection.
exampleZh: 一條被忽略的條款就可能使整份合約無效，讓兩家公司失去法律保障。

tip: val 價值：蓋章確認這個結果真的有價值
example: Test results from the second factory helped validate the engineers' original design assumptions.
exampleZh: 第二間工廠的測試結果有助於驗證工程師原先的設計假設。

tip: valid 有效 + ity 名詞：論證站不站得住腳的程度
example: Critics questioned the validity of a study that surveyed only the company's own employees.
exampleZh: 批評者質疑一項只調查公司自家員工的研究是否有效。

tip: in 不 + validity 有效：推理一碰就破，不成立
example: The invalidity of the argument became clear once the analyst noticed its circular reasoning.
exampleZh: 分析師一發現論證在繞圈子後，其謬誤就變得很明顯。

tip: e 出來 + value 價值：把價值量出來寫成報告
example: A thorough evaluation of the pilot program showed that training costs outweighed the productivity gains.
exampleZh: 對試辦方案的全面評估顯示，訓練成本超過了生產力的增益。

tip: evaluate 的形容詞：帶有好壞評分的味道
example: Words like "excellent" make the review evaluative, whereas the figures in the table are purely descriptive.
exampleZh: 像「出色」這類字眼讓評論帶有價值判斷，而表格中的數字則純屬描述。

tip: paradox 悖論 + ical：聽起來怪，細想卻通
example: It seems paradoxical that the cheapest supplier raised total costs, yet late deliveries explain the puzzle.
exampleZh: 最便宜的供應商反而推高總成本，看似矛盾，但交貨延遲解釋了這個謎團。

tip: re 再 + conciliate 和好：讓吵架的兩個數據重新和好
example: The author tries to reconcile rising profits with falling sales by pointing to higher prices.
exampleZh: 作者試圖以價格上漲來調和利潤上升與銷售下滑的矛盾。

tip: reconcile 的名詞，讓兩邊說法終於對上
example: Reconciliation of the two reports required noticing that they measured revenue in different currencies.
exampleZh: 要調和兩份報告，得先發現它們是用不同貨幣來計算營收。

tip: in 不 + consist 站在一起：前後兩句站不在一起
example: An inconsistency between the memo's budget and the invoice totals alerted the auditor to possible errors.
exampleZh: 備忘錄預算與發票總額之間的不一致，讓稽核員察覺可能有錯誤。

tip: con 一起 + sist 站：大家站在同一邊，口徑一致
example: The new data are consistent with the theory that customers prefer subscriptions over one-time purchases.
exampleZh: 新數據與顧客偏好訂閱制而非單次購買的理論相符。

tip: in 不 + consistent 一致：說的跟做的對不起來
example: His claim that costs fell is inconsistent with the invoices, which show steady increases every quarter.
exampleZh: 他聲稱成本下降，與顯示每季穩定上升的發票互相矛盾。

tip: in 進入 + fer 帶：把線索帶進腦中，推得結論
example: One reasonable inference from the sales dip is that competitors launched a cheaper alternative.
exampleZh: 從銷售下滑可以得到的一項合理推論是，競爭對手推出了更便宜的替代品。

tip: in 進去 + fer 帶：由眼前證據往裡推出結論
example: From the empty parking lot, an analyst might infer that the store has been struggling for months.
exampleZh: 從空蕩蕩的停車場，分析師可能推斷這家店已經苦撐了好幾個月。

tip: infer 推論 + able 可以：線索夠，就能自己推出來
example: Only conclusions that are inferable from the passage should be chosen as answers.
exampleZh: 只有能從文章中推知的結論，才應該被選為答案。

tip: 【GMAT 批判】音節 im - ply。常見於商業決策與因果推理題目，考查假設前提與邏輯嚴密性。
example: I didn't mean to imply otherwise.
exampleZh: 我沒想要暗示其他事。

tip: im 裡面 + plic 折：把意思折在話裡面沒明說
example: The study's implication is that raising wages may actually reduce long-term turnover costs.
exampleZh: 這項研究的含意是，調高薪資實際上可能降低長期的人員流動成本。

tip: de 往下 + duce 引導：從大原則一路往下導出結果
example: If every branch reported losses in December, we can deduce that seasonal demand was weak.
exampleZh: 如果每間分店十二月都虧損，我們可以推導出季節性需求疲弱。

tip: deduce 的名詞，從大前提一步步導出必然結果
example: Her deduction that the leak came from inside the firm rested on who had access to the files.
exampleZh: 她推論洩密來自公司內部，依據是誰能接觸到那些檔案。

tip: deduce 的形容詞，大原則往下推，一步一步不出錯
example: Deductive reasoning guarantees the conclusion if the premises are true and the logic is valid.
exampleZh: 只要前提為真且邏輯有效，演繹推理就保證結論成立。

tip: in 進 + duce 引導：把許多例子引進來導出一條規則
example: Skilled marketers can induce a general rule about shopping habits from hundreds of individual receipts.
exampleZh: 熟練的行銷人員能從數百張收據歸納出購物習慣的通則。

tip: induce 的名詞，從很多例子歸納出規律
example: By induction, the manager reasoned that every earlier campaign with discounts had raised foot traffic.
exampleZh: 經理以歸納法推斷，先前每一次折扣活動都提升了來客量。

tip: induce 的形容詞，由多個例子堆出可能的結論
example: An inductive argument based on five stores cannot prove that the pattern holds for all hundred.
exampleZh: 以五間店為基礎的歸納式論證，無法證明這個模式適用於全部一百間。

tip: syl 一起 + logism 推理：兩個前提湊成一個結論
example: In a classic syllogism, two true premises about all managers and all planners force one conclusion.
exampleZh: 在經典的三段論中，關於所有經理與所有規劃者的兩個真前提會推出唯一結論。

zh: 存在邏輯漏洞的、荒謬的
tip: fallacy 謬誤 + ous：一聽就有洞的說法
example: The fallacious claim that every successful firm advertises heavily ignores companies that thrive by word of mouth.
exampleZh: 「所有成功的公司都大量打廣告」這個有漏洞的說法，忽略了靠口碑成功的公司。

tip: flaw 像 floor 地板的裂縫：一條縫讓整個論證垮掉
example: The fatal flaw in the plan was its assumption that demand would stay constant despite higher prices.
exampleZh: 這項計畫的致命缺陷，在於假設漲價後需求仍會維持不變。

tip: flaw 加 ed：帶著裂縫的論證，一推就垮
example: Because the survey design was flawed, its headline finding told the board almost nothing reliable.
exampleZh: 由於調查設計有瑕疵，其主要發現幾乎無法給董事會提供可靠資訊。

tip: vul 傷口 + nerable：露出傷口的地方，一打就中
example: A company that relies on one customer for most of its revenue is vulnerable to sudden losses.
exampleZh: 營收大多依賴單一客戶的公司，容易受到突如其來的損失衝擊。

tip: vulnerable 的名詞：盔甲上露出傷口的那個小洞
example: A single supplier's late shipments exposed a vulnerability in the retailer's entire holiday plan.
exampleZh: 單一供應商的延遲出貨，暴露出這家零售商整個假期計畫的脆弱點。

tip: negate 的名詞，把句子加上 not 看論證會不會垮
example: To test the assumption, apply negation: if the opposite were true, would the argument still work?
exampleZh: 要檢驗這個假設，就做取非測試：如果相反情況為真，論證還成立嗎？

tip: neg 像 no：對結論說 no，讓它落空
example: A single reliable counterexample is enough to negate a sweeping claim about all customers.
exampleZh: 一個可靠的反例，就足以否定關於所有顧客的籠統主張。

zh: 看似合理的、貌似可信的
tip: plaus 像 applause 掌聲：聽起來讓人想鼓掌的說法
example: It is plausible that shoppers spend more when music plays, though no one has tested it yet.
exampleZh: 顧客在有音樂時花更多錢，聽起來合理，不過還沒有人檢驗過。

zh: 難以置信的、不合邏輯的
tip: im 不 + plausible 可信：聽了只想搖頭
example: Few investors found the CEO's story implausible enough to doubt, yet the numbers never added up.
exampleZh: 沒有幾位投資人覺得執行長的說法不可信到值得起疑，然而數字始終對不起來。

zh: 條理連貫的、邏輯清晰的
tip: co 一起 + here 黏住：每句話都黏在一起，不散掉
example: A coherent business case links market size, pricing, and costs into one clear line of argument.
exampleZh: 條理連貫的商業論證，會把市場規模、定價與成本串成一條清楚的論述主線。

zh: 語無倫次的、支離破碎的
tip: in 不 + coherent 黏住：句子散成一地，拼不起來
example: The incoherent proposal jumped between three strategies without ever explaining how they fit together.
exampleZh: 這份語無倫次的提案在三種策略間跳來跳去，卻從未說明它們如何相互配合。

zh: 根本邏輯依據、理性基礎
tip: ration 像 reason 理由：做這件事的道理在哪裡
example: The rationale behind the price cut was to clear old stock before the new model arrived.
exampleZh: 降價背後的理由，是想在新機型到貨前清掉舊庫存。

tip: ration 像 reason：照道理想，不被情緒牽著走
example: A rational buyer compares total costs over five years instead of looking only at the sticker price.
exampleZh: 理性的買家會比較五年的總成本，而不只是看標價。

tip: ir 不 + rational 理性：腦袋沒開機，只剩情緒
example: Panic selling during a mild dip struck many analysts as irrational, since the fundamentals had not changed.
exampleZh: 輕微下跌時恐慌拋售，讓許多分析師覺得非理性，因為基本面並沒有改變。

zh: 證明正當性、辯護合理性
tip: just 公正 + ify 使：讓事情站得住，講得出道理
example: Rising wages alone cannot justify a price hike if productivity has stayed flat.
exampleZh: 如果生產力一直沒變，光憑薪資上漲不足以證明漲價是正當的。

tip: justify 的名詞，給大家一個說得通的理由
example: The manager offered no justification for skipping the safety review before launching the product.
exampleZh: 經理沒有為推出產品前略過安全審查提出任何正當理由。

tip: justify 加 able：講得出理由，別人點頭同意
example: Spending extra on security is justifiable when the data being protected is worth millions.
exampleZh: 當被保護的資料價值數百萬時，多花錢加強安全是說得過去的。

tip: un 沒有 + justified 理由：講不出道理的決定
example: Investors called the executive bonuses unjustified given that the firm had missed every target that year.
exampleZh: 投資人認為，既然公司那年所有目標都沒達成，高階主管的獎金毫無依據。

tip: as 向 + sert 插入：把旗子用力插下去，大聲宣布
example: The founder asserted that the startup would break even within a year, though she showed no forecast.
exampleZh: 創辦人斷言這家新創公司一年內就會損益兩平，不過她沒有拿出任何預測。

tip: assert 的名詞，一句斷言，沒附上證明
example: His assertion that remote work lowers output was backed by a single, poorly designed survey.
exampleZh: 他認為遠距工作會降低產出的主張，只有一份設計不佳的問卷作為支持。

tip: cause 原因 + ality：A 真的造成 B 的那種關係
example: Economists warn that causality is hard to prove from sales data that simply rise and fall together.
exampleZh: 經濟學家警告，單憑一起起伏的銷售數據，很難證明其中有因果關係。

tip: cause 原因 + ation：A 推了 B 一把的那股力量
example: Careful experiments, not casual observation, are needed to demonstrate causation between advertising and purchases.
exampleZh: 要證明廣告與購買之間的因果作用，需要嚴謹的實驗，而不是隨意的觀察。

zh: 統計相關性 (不等於因果)
tip: co 一起 + relation 關係：兩個數字一起變，但不一定有因果
example: A strong correlation between ice cream sales and sunburns does not mean one causes the other.
exampleZh: 冰淇淋銷量與曬傷之間的高度相關，並不代表其中一個導致另一個。

tip: co 一起 + relate 關聯：兩條曲線手牽手一起升降
example: Employee satisfaction tends to correlate with lower turnover, though the direction of influence is unclear.
exampleZh: 員工滿意度往往與較低的離職率相關，但影響的方向尚不清楚。

tip: con 一起 + found 倒入：把兩種原因混在一鍋，分不開
example: A confounding factor, such as seasonal weather, may explain both the discount and the rise in sales.
exampleZh: 季節性天氣之類的干擾因素，可能同時解釋折扣與銷售上升。

tip: vary 變 + able：會變來變去的那個東西
example: Researchers changed only one variable, the price, so that any difference in demand could be traced to it.
exampleZh: 研究人員只改變價格這一個變數，因此需求上的任何差異都能追溯到它。

zh: 巧合、純屬偶然同時發生
tip: 【GMAT 批判】音節 coin - cid - ence。常見於商業決策與因果推理題目，考查假設前提與邏輯嚴密性。
example: Tom doesn't think this is a coincidence.
exampleZh: 湯姆不認為這是一個巧合。

tip: co 同時 + incident 事件：兩件事湊巧同時發生
example: The match between the ad launch and the sales jump looked coincidental, since rivals closed stores that same week.
exampleZh: 廣告上線與銷售大增的吻合看起來只是巧合，因為競爭對手同一週關閉了門市。

tip: alter 另一個：換成備用的那個解釋
example: An alternate explanation for the drop in sales is that a major competitor ran a promotion.
exampleZh: 對銷售下降的另一種解釋，是一家主要競爭對手舉辦了促銷。

tip: alter 另一個 + native：除了原本的，還有別條路
example: Before approving the merger, the board asked staff to present at least one realistic alternative.
exampleZh: 批准合併前，董事會要求員工至少提出一個可行的替代方案。

tip: extra 外面 + neous：從外面闖進來的不速之客
example: Extraneous noise in the data, such as one-time holiday orders, made the underlying trend hard to see.
exampleZh: 資料中的無關干擾，例如一次性的節慶訂單，讓潛在趨勢難以看清。

tip: bias 像「拜亞斯」：天秤被人偷偷壓住一邊
example: Because only loyal customers were surveyed, the results carried a built-in bias toward positive reviews.
exampleZh: 因為只調查了忠實顧客，結果天生就偏向正面評價。

zh: 有樣本偏差的、不客觀的
tip: bias 加 ed：天秤被壓歪了，結果不公平
example: A biased sample made up entirely of gym members would exaggerate how many people exercise daily.
exampleZh: 完全由健身房會員組成的偏差樣本，會誇大每天運動的人數。

tip: un 沒有 + biased 偏：天秤擺得水平，不偏袒
example: To give an unbiased picture, the consultant gathered opinions from every department rather than only from managers.
exampleZh: 為了提供公正無偏的全貌，顧問蒐集了每個部門的意見，而不只是經理們的。

tip: sample 像 example 去掉 ex：從全部中拿出的小小代表
example: A random sample of two hundred customers is usually enough to estimate the preferences of thousands.
exampleZh: 隨機抽出兩百位顧客作為樣本，通常足以估計數千人的偏好。

tip: sample 加 ing：動手從大鍋湯裡舀一小勺試味道
example: Poor sampling, such as surveying shoppers only on weekday mornings, can distort the entire study.
exampleZh: 不良的抽樣方式，例如只在平日早晨訪問購物者，可能扭曲整份研究。

tip: represent 代表 + ative：小小的縮影，像全班選出的班代
example: The conclusion is only reliable if the group studied is representative of the whole customer base.
exampleZh: 只有當被研究的群體能代表整個客群時，這個結論才可靠。

tip: un 不 + representative：選出的班代跟全班完全不像
example: Surveying only online shoppers gave an unrepresentative picture of a market where most sales happen in stores.
exampleZh: 只訪問網路購物者，對一個多數銷售發生在實體店的市場，只會得到不具代表性的圖像。

tip: general 一般 + ize 使：把一個例子套到所有人身上
example: It is risky to generalize from one successful store to the performance of the whole chain.
exampleZh: 從一間成功的門市推論整個連鎖店的表現，是有風險的。

zh: 通則推論、以偏概全謬誤
tip: general 一般 + ization：用少數例子貼上全體標籤
example: The generalization that all younger buyers prefer apps overlooked the many who still shop in person.
exampleZh: 「所有年輕買家都偏好使用應用程式」這個以偏概全的說法，忽略了許多仍親自去店裡購物的人。

tip: hasty 像「黑絲帶」快：腳步太快，沒看清就下結論
example: Cancelling the product after one bad review would be a hasty decision, so wait for more feedback.
exampleZh: 只因一則負評就取消產品會是倉促的決定，所以請等更多回饋。

tip: statistic 統計 + ally：從數字角度看，才算數
example: The gap between the two groups was statistically meaningful, not merely the result of chance.
exampleZh: 兩組之間的差距在統計上具有意義，並非只是機率造成的結果。

tip: sign 記號 + ficance：這個記號夠大，不可能只是巧合
example: The statistical significance of the result meant there was less than a five percent chance it was random.
exampleZh: 結果的統計顯著性意味著，它是隨機造成的機率低於百分之五。

tip: sign 記號 + ficant：明顯到不能忽略的記號
example: The difference in conversion rates between the two web pages was significant at the one percent level.
exampleZh: 兩個網頁的轉換率差異在百分之一的水準上達到顯著。

tip: in 不 + significant 顯著：小到可以不管的小螞蟻
example: A two-cent change in price had an insignificant effect on demand, so the team ignored it.
exampleZh: 價格變動兩分錢對需求的影響微不足道，所以團隊忽略了它。

tip: anecdote 像「俺可得」：俺可得講個小故事，卻不是證據
example: The manager's anecdote about one delighted customer made a nice story but proved nothing about overall satisfaction.
exampleZh: 經理講的那位滿意顧客的軼事是個好故事，卻無法證明整體滿意度。

zh: 基於傳聞軼事的 (非科學證據)
tip: anecdote 加 al：只靠一兩個故事，不是正式數據
example: Anecdotal reports of faster delivery are encouraging, but the company has not measured delivery times.
exampleZh: 關於送貨變快的傳聞式回報令人鼓舞，但公司並未實際測量送貨時間。

zh: 經驗實證的、實地觀察的
tip: em 在裡面 + peiria 試驗：親自下場做實驗才算數
example: Empirical studies of retail pricing rely on real transaction records rather than on theoretical models alone.
exampleZh: 零售定價的實證研究依賴真實交易紀錄，而不是只靠理論模型。

zh: 經驗主義地、以實證方式
tip: 【GMAT 批判】音節 em - pi - ri - cal - ly。常見於商業決策與因果推理題目，考查假設前提與邏輯嚴密性。
example: He answered the judge's questions empirically and without hesitation.
exampleZh: 他毫不猶豫且經驗主義地回答了法官的提問。

tip: quant 像 quantity 數量：用數字說話
example: Quantitative analysis of two thousand receipts revealed that most customers bought only one item per visit.
exampleZh: 對兩千張收據的量化分析顯示，多數顧客每次只買一件商品。

tip: quality 品質 + ative：看的是感受與品質，不是數字
example: Qualitative interviews with ten shoppers uncovered feelings about the brand that no spreadsheet could capture.
exampleZh: 對十位購物者的質性訪談，揭露了試算表無法捕捉的品牌感受。

tip: pre 之前 + cede 走：先走過的那個腳印
example: The court's ruling set a precedent that later disputes over exclusive supplier contracts would follow.
exampleZh: 法院的判決樹立了先例，日後關於獨家供應商合約的爭議都會依循。

zh: 史無前例的前所未有的
tip: un 沒有 + precedent 先例：前面沒有人走過
example: The pandemic caused an unprecedented drop in air travel, with no earlier crisis coming close.
exampleZh: 疫情造成航空旅運史無前例的下滑，先前沒有任何危機能與之相比。

tip: ana 對照 + logy 說法：拿熟悉的事來說明陌生的事
example: The consultant drew an analogy between a firm's cash flow and blood circulating through a body.
exampleZh: 顧問把公司的現金流比作在身體中循環的血液。

tip: analogy 的形容詞：兩件事像一對雙胞胎
example: Launching a phone in a new country is analogous to opening a franchise in an unfamiliar city.
exampleZh: 在新的國家推出手機，類似於在陌生城市開設加盟店。

tip: extra 外面 + polate：把線往外多畫延長
example: Extrapolation from three quarters of rapid growth to a decade of the same is a risky forecast.
exampleZh: 把三個季度的快速成長外推成十年的相同成長，是一種冒險的預測。

tip: chrono 像 clock 時鐘：照時鐘先後順序排好
example: Arrange the product launches in chronological order, beginning with the oldest model released in 1998.
exampleZh: 請依時間先後排列產品發表，從一九九八年發行的最舊款式開始。

tip: chrono 時間 + logy 記錄：把事情按時間記錄成表
example: The auditor built a chronology of every transaction made between March and June to find the error.
exampleZh: 稽核員建立了三月至六月間每筆交易的年代順序紀錄，以找出錯誤。

zh: 時間維度的、時間順序的
tip: temp 像 tempo 節拍：和時間先後有關的
example: The temporal order of events matters: the price cut came first, and only afterward did sales rise.
exampleZh: 事件的時間順序很重要：先降價，之後銷售才上升。

tip: spurious 像「是不是歐斯」：看起來有關，其實是假的
example: The apparent link between umbrella sales and traffic jams is spurious; heavy rain causes both.
exampleZh: 雨傘銷量與塞車之間表面上的關聯是虛假的，因為大雨同時造成兩者。

tip: confound 搞混 + er：把兩種原因攪成一團的攪局者
example: Age is a confounder in the study, since older patients both take the drug and recover more slowly.
exampleZh: 年齡是這項研究中的混雜因素，因為年紀較大的患者既服用該藥，恢復也較慢。

tip: pro 對 + portion 份：一份對一份，成比例
example: Bonus payments should be proportional to sales, so that a manager earns twice as much for doubling results.
exampleZh: 獎金應與銷售額成正比，使經理的成績加倍時獎金也加倍。

tip: dis 不 + proportionate：蹺蹺板一邊太重，比例歪掉
example: A disproportionate share of the profit came from a few products, while hundreds of others lost money.
exampleZh: 利潤中有不成比例的大部分來自少數產品，而數百種其他產品都在虧錢。

tip: in 向內 + verse 轉：一邊升，另一邊就倒過來降
example: Demand and price share an inverse relationship: as the price climbs, the quantity bought tends to fall.
exampleZh: 需求與價格呈反向關係：價格上漲，購買量往往下降。

tip: 【GMAT 批判】音節 in - ver - se - ly。常見於商業決策與因果推理題目，考查假設前提與邏輯嚴密性。
example: The rescue team acted inversely to reach the stranded hikers before nightfall.
exampleZh: 搜救隊反比例地展開行動，在天黑前趕到受困登山客身邊。

tip: line 直線 + ar：畫成圖是一條筆直的線
example: In a linear model, each extra hour of training adds exactly the same increase in output.
exampleZh: 在線性模型中，每多一小時訓練，產出就增加完全相同的量。

tip: non 不 + linear 直線：畫出來彎彎曲曲的曲線
example: Growth that starts slowly and then explodes is nonlinear, so a straight-line forecast would badly underestimate it.
exampleZh: 起初緩慢而後爆發的成長是非線性的，所以直線預測會嚴重低估。

tip: probable 很可能 + ity：事情發生的可能有多大
example: The probability of rain tomorrow is eighty percent, so the outdoor sale will probably be cancelled.
exampleZh: 明天下雨的機率是百分之八十，所以戶外特賣會大概會取消。

tip: probability 機率 + istic：說的是可能性，不是保證
example: Insurers use probabilistic models, which estimate chances rather than promise exact outcomes for any single customer.
exampleZh: 保險公司使用機率模型，估計可能性，而不是為任何單一客戶保證確切結果。

tip: determine 決定 + ant：那個一錘定音的決定者
example: Location is the main determinant of a restaurant's success, outweighing menu quality and price.
exampleZh: 地點是餐廳成功的關鍵決定因素，比菜單品質與價格更重要。

tip: de 完全 + termin 界線：把界線劃清楚，事情就定了
example: A pilot test will determine whether customers actually prefer the new packaging to the old design.
exampleZh: 一項試辦測試將查明顧客是否真的偏好新包裝勝過舊設計。

tip: attribute 歸因 + able：責任可以掛在某個原因頭上
example: About half of the revenue drop is attributable to the factory closure in the spring.
exampleZh: 營收下降大約有一半可歸因於春季的工廠關閉。

tip: at 向 + tribute 給：把功勞或責任遞給某個原因
example: Analysts attribute the company's recovery to a leaner supply chain rather than to any new product.
exampleZh: 分析師將公司的復甦歸因於更精簡的供應鏈，而非任何新產品。

tip: a 向 + scribe 寫：把原因寫在某人名字底下
example: Historians ascribe the firm's early success to cheap labor, though other factors probably mattered too.
exampleZh: 歷史學家將該公司早期的成功歸因於廉價勞工，不過其他因素可能也很重要。

tip: plausible 的名詞：聽起來有多讓人想相信
example: The plausibility of the theory improved once a second independent study produced similar results.
exampleZh: 當第二項獨立研究得出相似結果後，這個理論的可信度提高了。

tip: pre 先 + sume 取：還沒證明，先拿來當真
example: The auditor's working presumption was that every receipt was genuine until something suggested otherwise.
exampleZh: 稽核員的工作推定是，除非出現相反的跡象，否則每張收據都是真的。

tip: pre 先 + sume 取：先假設是真的，再往下走
example: Investors presume that audited accounts are accurate, which is why a hidden error shocks the market.
exampleZh: 投資人假定經過查核的帳目是準確的，所以隱藏的錯誤才會震驚市場。

tip: presume 假定 + ive：先當作是真的來處理
example: Under the presumptive rule, a new product is assumed profitable until the sales data show otherwise.
exampleZh: 依據推定性規則，新產品在銷售數據證明相反之前，都被假定為有獲利。

tip: con 一起 + tingent 接觸：事情碰在一起才成立
example: The bonus is contingent on meeting the annual sales target, so a poor year means no payment.
exampleZh: 獎金取決於是否達成年度銷售目標，所以業績差的一年就沒有獎金。

zh: 突發偶發狀況、意外事故
tip: contingent 取決於 + cy：萬一出事的備胎計畫
example: A good project manager keeps a contingency fund in case an unexpected delay raises costs.
exampleZh: 好的專案經理會備有應急基金，以防意外延誤推高成本。

tip: feasible 可行 + ity：這件事做不做得成的程度
example: A feasibility study found that opening a branch in the new district would be too costly to justify.
exampleZh: 可行性研究發現，在新區開分店成本過高，不值得。

tip: feas 像 feast 盛宴：這道菜真的端得上桌，做得成
example: Hiring fifty engineers in one month is hardly feasible given the current shortage of qualified candidates.
exampleZh: 鑑於目前合格求職者短缺，一個月內聘到五十位工程師幾乎行不通。

tip: un 不 + feasible 可行：菜單上有，但廚房端不出來
example: The board rejected the proposal as unfeasible, since it required technology that does not yet exist.
exampleZh: 董事會以不可行為由拒絕了這項提案，因為它需要尚不存在的技術。

tip: profit 利潤 + ability：賺錢的本事有多強
example: The cafe's profitability improved after it replaced expensive imported beans with a cheaper local supplier.
exampleZh: 這家咖啡館改用較便宜的本地供應商取代昂貴的進口咖啡豆後，獲利能力提升了。

tip: profit 利潤 + able：能把錢留進口袋的生意
example: A profitable business earns more from its sales than it spends on running the company.
exampleZh: 有利可圖的企業，從銷售賺到的錢比經營公司的花費更多。

tip: un 不 + profitable：錢包只出不進
example: After three years of rising rent, the downtown shop became unprofitable and was finally closed.
exampleZh: 租金連漲三年之後，這間市中心商店變得無利可圖，最後被關閉。

tip: break 打破 + even 平：收入剛好打平成本的那一刻
example: The startup needs to sell ten thousand units a month to reach break-even and stop losing money.
exampleZh: 這家新創公司每月須賣出一萬件才能達到損益兩平，停止虧損。

zh: 產品自我侵蝕、互搶市占
tip: cannibal 食人族的字根：自己吃自己的產品，別嚇到小朋友
example: Launching a cheaper version of its flagship phone may cannibalize sales of the original model.
exampleZh: 推出旗艦手機的平價版本，可能會蠶食原款機型的銷量。

zh: 自家產品互蝕銷量現象
tip: cannibalize 加 tion：自家商品互搶客人的現象
example: Cannibalization explained why the new yogurt flavor did not raise total revenue; it simply replaced the old one.
exampleZh: 自家產品互蝕解釋了為何新口味優格沒有提高總營收：它只是取代了舊款。

tip: penetrate 的名詞：產品像水滲進海綿裡有多深
example: Mobile payment penetration in the region has reached ninety percent of adults in only five years.
exampleZh: 該地區的行動支付滲透率在短短五年內就達到成年人口的百分之九十。

tip: pen 像筆尖：筆尖戳進紙裡，產品鑽進市場
example: The brewer hopes to penetrate the Asian market by partnering with local convenience store chains.
exampleZh: 這家啤酒商希望藉由與當地便利商店連鎖合作，打入亞洲市場。

tip: compete 競爭 + itive：拿出來能跟別人比一比的實力
example: Competitive pricing helped the small airline win customers away from its much larger rivals.
exampleZh: 有競爭力的定價幫助這家小型航空公司把客人從大得多的對手那裡搶過來。

tip: competitive 加 ness：在賽跑中跑得多快的能力
example: Rising labor costs have weakened the competitiveness of our factories compared with those overseas.
exampleZh: 勞動成本上升，削弱了我們工廠相對於海外工廠的競爭力。

tip: bar 横桿：橫著擋在入口的柵欄
example: High licensing fees create a barrier that keeps small firms from entering the telecommunications market.
exampleZh: 高額的執照費用形成一道障礙，使小公司無法進入電信市場。

tip: mono 單一 + poly 賣：整個市場只有一個賣家
example: The railway held a monopoly on freight until the government allowed private companies to compete.
exampleZh: 鐵路公司壟斷貨運，直到政府允許民間公司加入競爭。

tip: monopoly 加 ize 使：把整個市場一個人包下來
example: Regulators feared that the merged firm would monopolize the market for hospital software.
exampleZh: 監管機關擔心合併後的公司會壟斷醫院軟體市場。

tip: oligo 少數 + poly 賣：只有少數幾家賣家
example: An oligopoly of three carriers controls most mobile service, so prices rarely fall much.
exampleZh: 由三家業者組成的寡占掌控了多數行動通訊服務，因此價格很少大幅下跌。

tip: over 超過 + run 跑：花費一路跑過預算的終點線
example: A cost overrun of forty percent forced the city to scale back the stadium project.
exampleZh: 百分之四十的成本超支，迫使市政府縮減體育場計畫。

tip: ex 出去 + pend 花費：錢從口袋飛出去的那筆錢
example: Capital expenditure on new machines rose sharply this year, while daily operating spending stayed flat.
exampleZh: 今年新機器的資本支出大幅上升，而日常營運開銷則維持不變。

tip: cap 像 captain 頭：企業最重要的頭號本錢
example: Raising enough capital to buy the first fleet of delivery vans took the founders nearly a year.
exampleZh: 籌到足夠的資本來購買第一批送貨車，創辦人花了將近一年。

tip: re 回 + venue：錢從門口流回公司的總收入
example: Total revenue fell last quarter even though the number of customers stayed roughly the same.
exampleZh: 儘管顧客人數大致維持不變，上一季的總營收仍下降了。

tip: turn 轉 + over：貨物在倉庫轉一圈進出的速度
example: The grocery chain's inventory turnover is high, since fresh produce rarely stays on the shelves for long.
exampleZh: 這家連鎖雜貨店的存貨週轉率很高，因為新鮮蔬果很少在貨架上待很久。

tip: a 向 + mort 死：成本一年一年慢慢減少到零
example: Amortization of the patent spreads its purchase price evenly across the twenty years it is protected.
exampleZh: 專利的攤銷是把其購買價格平均分攤到受保護的二十年中。

tip: amortization 的動詞：把大筆費用切成小塊分次吃掉
example: The firm will amortize the software license over five years instead of deducting the full cost at once.
exampleZh: 公司將在五年內攤銷軟體授權費，而不是一次扣除全部成本。

tip: de 下降 + preci 價格：車子越開價格越往下掉
example: Depreciation of the delivery trucks reduced the company's reported profit by two million dollars.
exampleZh: 送貨卡車的折舊使公司的帳面利潤減少了兩百萬美元。

tip: de 下降 + preciate 價格：價格往下滑的溜滑梯
example: Most laptops depreciate quickly, losing nearly half their value within two years of purchase.
exampleZh: 大多數筆電貶值很快，購買後兩年內就損失近一半的價值。

tip: liquid 液體 + ity：錢像水一樣能馬上流動使用
example: Despite strong profits, the firm faced a liquidity crisis because most of its money was tied up in unsold stock.
exampleZh: 儘管利潤強勁，公司仍面臨流動性危機，因為大部分資金困在賣不掉的存貨裡。

tip: liquid 是液體：像水一樣說換就換成現金
example: Cash and bank deposits are liquid assets, while a factory building cannot be sold quickly.
exampleZh: 現金與銀行存款是高流動性資產，而工廠廠房無法迅速賣出。

tip: solv 像 solve 解決：債務能解決還清的實力
example: Rating agencies assess a bank's solvency by checking whether its assets exceed everything it owes.
exampleZh: 評等機構透過檢查銀行資產是否超過所有負債，來評估其償債能力。

tip: in 不 + solvent：債務解不開，還不起錢
example: The retailer was declared insolvent after it failed to repay loans that had come due.
exampleZh: 這家零售商在無法償還到期貸款之後，被宣告無力償債。

tip: in 不 + solvency 償債：欠的錢多過手上有的
example: Insolvency forced the family business to sell its building and negotiate with its creditors.
exampleZh: 無力償債迫使這家家族企業賣掉大樓，並與債權人協商。

tip: re 再 + structure 結構：把積木拆開重新搭一遍
example: To survive, the airline had to restructure its debt and cut several unprofitable routes.
exampleZh: 為了生存，這家航空公司必須重組債務並砍掉幾條不賺錢的航線。

tip: restructure 加 ing：公司積木拆開重搭的這個過程
example: Following the restructuring, three divisions were merged and the head office moved to a smaller building.
exampleZh: 重整之後，三個部門被合併，總公司也搬進較小的大樓。

zh: 綜效、一加一大於二效應
tip: syn 一起 + ergy 工作：一加一大於二的團隊合作
example: The synergy between the two firms meant their combined sales exceeded the total of their separate results.
exampleZh: 兩家公司之間的綜效，意味著合併後的銷售超過各自單獨成績的總和。

tip: synergy 加 istic：一起工作時力量變得更大
example: Designing the app and the speaker together was synergistic, since each product made the other more useful.
exampleZh: 把應用程式與喇叭一起設計具有協同效應，因為每個產品都讓另一個更有用。

tip: diverse 多樣 + ification：雞蛋別放同一個籃子
example: Diversification into mobile games protected the publisher when sales of its older console titles declined.
exampleZh: 當舊款遊戲主機產品銷量下滑時，跨足手機遊戲的多角化經營保護了這家發行商。

tip: diverse 多樣 + ify 使：讓籃子裡的蛋有各種樣子
example: Smart investors diversify their holdings across stocks, bonds, and property rather than betting on one sector.
exampleZh: 聰明的投資人會把持有的資產分散到股票、債券與不動產，而不是押注單一產業。

tip: ac 向 + quis 尋求：向外把別家公司拿到手
example: The acquisition of a smaller rival gave the software giant access to its patents and customers.
exampleZh: 對一家較小對手的收購，讓這家軟體巨頭取得了其專利與客戶。

tip: ac 向 + quire 尋求：伸手把東西抓回來變自己的
example: The retailer plans to acquire two regional chains, which would double the number of its stores.
exampleZh: 這家零售商計畫收購兩家區域連鎖店，這將使其門市數量翻倍。

tip: merge 的名詞：兩家公司像兩條河匯成一條
example: Shareholders approved the merger of the two banks, which created the nation's third-largest lender.
exampleZh: 股東批准了兩家銀行的合併，這創造出全國第三大的放款機構。

tip: 像汽車匯流道 merge：兩條車道合成一條
example: The two rival airlines will merge next spring and operate under a single brand name.
exampleZh: 這兩家敵對的航空公司將在明年春天合併，並以單一品牌營運。

tip: di 離開 + vest 衣服：把不想要的衣服脫掉丟開
example: The conglomerate decided to divest its hotel business so it could focus on its core manufacturing operations.
exampleZh: 這家大型企業集團決定剝離旅館事業，以便專注於核心製造業務。

tip: divest 脫掉 + ment：把包袱脫掉賣出去的這個行動
example: The divestment of the struggling toy division raised enough cash to pay off the company's short-term debt.
exampleZh: 出售經營不善的玩具部門所得的撤資款項，足以還清公司的短期債務。

tip: bench 長凳 + mark 記號：在長凳上刻刻度當標準
example: The firm used the industry leader's delivery times as a benchmark when setting its own targets.
exampleZh: 公司設定自己的目標時，以業界領導者的送貨時間作為基準。

tip: benchmark 加 ing：拿最強的對手當尺，量自己差多少
example: Through benchmarking against the best hotels, the chain discovered that its check-in process was twice as slow.
exampleZh: 透過與最佳飯店對標，該連鎖飯店發現自己的入住流程慢了一倍。

tip: pro 為了 + cure 照料：為公司張羅所需的東西
example: Centralizing procurement lets the hospital negotiate lower prices by ordering supplies for all its clinics at once.
exampleZh: 集中採購讓醫院能一次替所有診所訂購用品，進而談到更低的價格。

tip: pro 為了 + cure 照料：想辦法把原料弄到手
example: The factory struggled to procure enough steel after the main supplier shut down its plant.
exampleZh: 主要供應商關閉工廠後，這間工廠很難籌集到足夠的鋼材。

zh: 供應鏈物流與倉儲運輸
tip: logis 像 lodge 住宿：貨物住哪、怎麼搬到目的地
example: Efficient logistics allowed the online store to deliver orders from its regional warehouses within twenty-four hours.
exampleZh: 高效率的物流讓網路商店能在二十四小時內從區域倉庫送出訂單。

tip: con 一起 + strain 拉緊：繩子被拉緊，動彈不得
example: A shortage of skilled welders is the main constraint on how many ships the yard can build.
exampleZh: 熟練焊接工人短缺，是限制這座造船廠能造多少艘船的主要因素。

tip: con 一起 + strain 拉緊：把繩子拉緊，不讓它再長
example: Strict regulations constrain how much banks can lend, which slows growth in the housing market.
exampleZh: 嚴格的法規限制了銀行能放貸的金額，使房市成長放緩。

tip: bottle 瓶子 + neck 脖子：瓶口窄窄，水流得慢
example: The packaging line is the bottleneck: every other stage can finish faster than boxes get sealed.
exampleZh: 包裝線就是瓶頸：其他每個階段完成的速度都比箱子封好的速度還快。

tip: through 通過 + put 放：單位時間內放過去的量
example: Adding a second scanner doubled the throughput of the airport security line from sixty to one hundred twenty travelers an hour.
exampleZh: 增設第二台掃描儀，使機場安檢線的處理量從每小時六十人倍增為一百二十人。

tip: elastic 彈性 + ity：價格拉一下，需求會彈多遠
example: The elasticity of demand for luxury watches is high, so a small price rise sharply cuts the number sold.
exampleZh: 奢華手錶的需求彈性很高，所以小幅漲價就會使銷量大減。

tip: 像橡皮筋 elastic：一拉價格，需求就彈走
example: Demand for fashion items is elastic: shoppers quickly look elsewhere whenever the price goes up even slightly.
exampleZh: 時尚商品的需求是有彈性的：只要價格稍微上漲，購物者很快就會另尋他處。

tip: in 不 + elastic 彈性：橡皮筋拉不動，價格怎漲都得買
example: Demand for insulin is inelastic, since patients must keep buying it however high the price becomes.
exampleZh: 胰島素的需求缺乏彈性，因為不管價格多高，患者都必須繼續購買。

tip: in 裡 + cent 錢：口袋裡多幾分錢，就更有動力
example: A small cash bonus gave workers a real incentive to finish the project ahead of schedule.
exampleZh: 一筆小額現金獎金給了員工提早完成專案的實質誘因。

zh: 遏制阻礙因素、負向誘因
tip: dis 反 + incentive 誘因：反過來把人往後拉的力
example: High taxes on extra income can act as a disincentive for employees to work overtime.
exampleZh: 對額外收入課徵高稅，可能成為員工加班的負向誘因。

tip: premium 像「普利米恩」：付比別人多的錢買頂級
example: Customers will pay a premium for coffee that is certified as fair trade and locally roasted.
exampleZh: 顧客願意為經公平貿易認證且在地烘焙的咖啡支付額外的溢價。

tip: dis 去掉 + count 計算：把價錢算少一點
example: Retailers offer a discount of twenty percent on last season's coats to clear the racks quickly.
exampleZh: 零售商將上一季外套打八折，以便快速清空貨架。

tip: volatile 加 ity：價格像坐雲霄飛車上下跳
example: The volatility of oil prices makes it hard for airlines to plan their fuel budgets a year ahead.
exampleZh: 油價的波動性，使航空公司很難提前一年規劃燃料預算。

tip: vol 飛：價格像鳥一樣忽高忽低亂飛
example: Cryptocurrency is a volatile asset, with prices that can double or collapse within a few days.
exampleZh: 加密貨幣是波動劇烈的資產，價格可能在幾天內翻倍或崩跌。

tip: comply 照做 + ance：老老實實照規則走
example: Compliance with new data privacy rules cost the company millions, but it avoided heavy fines.
exampleZh: 遵循新的資料隱私規定讓公司花了數百萬，但避免了鉅額罰款。

tip: comply 照做 + ant：乖乖遵守規則的好學生
example: The new software is compliant with international safety standards, so it can be sold in Europe.
exampleZh: 這套新軟體符合國際安全標準，因此可以在歐洲銷售。

zh: 財務槓桿、利用槓桿優勢
tip: lever 槓桿：小小一根棒子就能撬動大石頭
example: The start-up used its patent portfolio as leverage when negotiating a better deal with the manufacturer.
exampleZh: 新創公司在與製造商協商更優惠條件時，把專利組合當作籌碼。

tip: proxy 像 pro-xy：找個替身代你出場
example: Since happiness is hard to measure, researchers use income as a proxy, though it is an imperfect one.
exampleZh: 由於幸福感難以衡量，研究人員用收入作為代理指標，儘管它並不完美。

tip: cave 像 care：小心喔，這裡有個要留意的條件
example: The report's one caveat is that the sample included only urban households, so rural areas may differ.
exampleZh: 這份報告唯一的但書是樣本只包含都市家庭，因此鄉村地區可能不同。

tip: short 短 + fall 掉：錢少了一截，掉在目標下面
example: A shortfall in tax revenue left the city unable to fund its planned repairs to the bridge.
exampleZh: 稅收短缺使市政府無法為預定的橋梁修繕籌到經費。

zh: 清算變現、拍賣清償債務
tip: liquid 液體：把東西化成水一樣的現金
example: Creditors forced the failing retailer to liquidate its stock at deep discounts to repay its debts.
exampleZh: 債權人迫使經營不善的零售商以大幅折扣清算存貨，以償還債務。

tip: liquidate 加 ion：公司資產一件件換成現金還債
example: During the liquidation of the bankrupt airline, its aircraft were sold to rival carriers.
exampleZh: 在破產航空公司的清算過程中，其飛機被賣給了對手業者。

zh: 負債融資的高槓桿操作的
tip: lever 槓桿 + ed：借錢當長桿，撬動超大的石頭
example: A highly leveraged buyout left the company with debt payments that consumed nearly all of its earnings.
exampleZh: 一場高槓桿的收購，使公司的債務還款幾乎吃掉了它所有的盈餘。

zh: 去槓桿化、降低債務負擔
tip: de 去掉 + leverage 槓桿：把借來的長桿收起來
example: After the crisis, many banks began to deleverage by selling assets and paying down their loans.
exampleZh: 危機過後，許多銀行開始透過出售資產與償還貸款來去槓桿化。

zh: 避險對沖風險；避險合約
tip: hedge 是籬笆：圍起一圈籬笆，擋住價格亂跑
example: Airlines often hedge against rising fuel prices by signing contracts that lock in today's rate.
exampleZh: 航空公司常藉由簽訂鎖定今日價格的合約，來對沖燃料價格上漲的風險。

tip: hedge 籬笆 + ing：架起籬笆擋住匯率亂跳的操作
example: Currency hedging protects an exporter from losing money when the exchange rate suddenly moves.
exampleZh: 貨幣避險能保護出口商在匯率突然變動時不致虧損。

zh: 給予誘因激勵、獎勵驅動
tip: incentive 誘因 + ize 使：用獎勵把人的動力點亮
example: The company plans to incentivize sales staff with commissions rather than relying on higher base salaries.
exampleZh: 公司打算以佣金來激勵業務人員，而不是依賴調高底薪。

zh: 人員自然流失、員工消耗耗損
tip: at 向 + trit 磨：員工一個個被磨掉、慢慢變少
example: Natural attrition, as older staff retire, allowed the bank to shrink its workforce without any layoffs.
exampleZh: 隨著年長員工退休而發生的自然流失，使銀行不必裁員就能縮減人力。

zh: 冗餘裁員、過剩人力配置
tip: re 再 + undant 波浪：多得滿出來，不再需要
example: Merging the two offices created redundancy in accounting, and about forty positions were eliminated.
exampleZh: 合併兩間辦公室造成會計部門人力冗餘，約有四十個職位被裁撤。

tip: re 再 + undant 波浪：多得滿出來，不再需要
example: Once the new system arrived, many clerks found their roles redundant and were offered severance pay.
exampleZh: 新系統上線後，許多職員發現自己的職位已多餘，並獲得資遣費。

tip: saturate 加 ion：海綿吸滿水，再也吸不下
example: Market saturation in smartphones means most potential buyers already own one, so growth is slowing.
exampleZh: 智慧型手機的市場飽和，意味著多數潛在買家已經擁有一支，所以成長正在放緩。

tip: sat 滿足：把海綿吸滿，吃飽喝足
example: Coffee chains risk saturating a neighborhood when they open three shops on a single block.
exampleZh: 咖啡連鎖店在同一個街區開三家店時，有使該社區市場飽和的風險。

zh: 套利交易、利用差價獲利
tip: arbitrage 像「啊比搭居」：搭車兩地買賣賺差價
example: Traders practiced arbitrage by buying gold in one city and selling it for more in another.
exampleZh: 交易員在一座城市買進黃金，再於另一座城市以更高價賣出，藉此進行套利。

zh: 平價等價性購買力平價
tip: par 同等：天秤兩邊一樣重，價格相等
example: Economists compare prices of the same burger worldwide to test whether currencies are at purchasing power parity.
exampleZh: 經濟學家比較全球同一款漢堡的價格，來檢驗各國貨幣是否處於購買力平價。

tip: dis 分開 + par 等：兩邊不再相等，差一大截
example: The disparity in income between the top and bottom tenth of households widened over the past decade.
exampleZh: 過去十年間，最高與最低十分之一家庭之間的收入差距擴大了。

tip: anti 反對 + trust 托拉斯：專門反對大公司聯手壟斷
example: Antitrust laws prevent dominant firms from crushing smaller rivals or secretly fixing prices together.
exampleZh: 反托拉斯法禁止主導企業壓垮較小的對手，或私下聯手操縱價格。

zh: 卡特爾壟斷聯盟企業同盟
tip: cartel 像「卡特」：幾家公司串通起來操縱價格
example: Members of the oil cartel agreed to limit production in order to keep world prices high.
exampleZh: 這個石油卡特爾的成員同意限制產量，以維持世界價格居高不下。

tip: monopoly 獨占 + istic：做法帶有一人獨吞的味道
example: Regulators accused the company of monopolistic practices after it bought every rival that entered the market.
exampleZh: 該公司買下每一個進入市場的對手後，監管機關指控其有壟斷性的行為。

zh: 信託受託人義務的；信託受託人
tip: fiduci 信任：別人把錢交給你，你要對得起信任
example: A fiduciary duty requires a trustee to act in the best interest of the beneficiaries, never for personal gain.
exampleZh: 受託人義務要求受託人以受益人的最大利益行事，絕不為個人利益。

zh: 財務審計查帳；稽核查驗
tip: audit 像 audio 聽：古時候是聽帳目被唸出來核對
example: An outside accounting firm will audit the charity's books to confirm that donations were spent as promised.
exampleZh: 一家外部會計事務所將審計這家慈善機構的帳簿，確認捐款是否如承諾般使用。

tip: pro 向前 + ject 投擲，把數字往未來丟出去
example: Sales projections for next year assume that demand will grow by five percent.
exampleZh: 明年的銷售預測假設需求會成長百分之五。

tip: project 是向前丟，丟到未來的數字就是預估的
example: The projected shortfall forced the board to freeze hiring until revenue improved.
exampleZh: 預估的缺口迫使董事會在營收好轉前凍結招聘。

zh: 統計變異數變動差異量
tip: vary 變化 + ance，數字變動得有多大
example: A large variance between budgeted and actual costs prompted an internal audit.
exampleZh: 預算與實際成本之間的巨大差異促使公司進行內部稽核。

tip: out 在外 + lie 躺，躺在隊伍外面的那筆數據
example: One outlier, a single enormous order, distorted the average sale price.
exampleZh: 一個離群值，也就是一筆巨額訂單，扭曲了平均售價。

zh: 專有的獨家專利擁有的
tip: proprietary 長得像 property 財產，是自家獨有的
example: The firm refused to license its proprietary algorithm to any competitor.
exampleZh: 這家公司拒絕把其專有演算法授權給任何競爭對手。

tip: di 分開 + vest 衣服，把一塊事業脫下來
example: The divestiture of its shipping unit raised cash for the retailer's core business.
exampleZh: 剝離航運部門為這家零售商的核心業務籌得了現金。

zh: 子公司附屬機構；輔助從屬的
tip: sub 在下 + sid 坐，坐在母公司底下的小公司
example: The parent company owns the subsidiary outright and appoints its entire board.
exampleZh: 母公司完全擁有這家子公司，並指派其全體董事。

zh: 跨行業大型綜合企業集團
tip: con 一起 + glomer 球，各行各業滾成一個大球
example: The conglomerate sells everything from insurance to instant noodles, so a slump in one sector hurts little.
exampleZh: 這家企業集團從保險賣到泡麵，所以單一行業低迷影響不大。

zh: 股票股利分紅年度配息
tip: divide 分開，把利潤分一份給股東
example: Shareholders received a quarterly dividend of forty cents per share after record profits.
exampleZh: 在創紀錄的獲利之後，股東每股領到四十美分的季度股利。

zh: 股東權益自有資本資產淨值
tip: equi 相等，資產扣掉債務後平分給股東的那份
example: After all debts were paid, the owners' equity was only a small fraction of the firm's value.
exampleZh: 還清所有債務後，業主權益只佔公司價值的一小部分。

zh: 資產負債責任法律義務
tip: liability 諧音「賴不掉的債」，非負責不可
example: The unpaid lawsuit settlement became a major liability on the firm's balance sheet.
exampleZh: 未支付的訴訟和解金成為公司資產負債表上的一大負債。

tip: asset 諧音「愛塞」，把值錢的東西愛塞進保險箱
example: Its skilled workforce is the company's most valuable asset, worth more than its factories.
exampleZh: 熟練的員工是公司最寶貴的資產，比工廠更有價值。

zh: 投資報酬率殖利率；產出產生
tip: yield 像果樹結出果實，投資結出的就是報酬
example: The bond's yield of six percent attracted investors seeking steady income.
exampleZh: 這檔債券百分之六的殖利率吸引了尋求穩定收入的投資人。

zh: 規模經濟大量生產降低均本
tip: 量越大每件越便宜，就像批發買得越多越划算
example: Economies of scale let the brewery cut its cost per bottle as output doubled.
exampleZh: 隨著產量加倍，規模經濟讓這家啤酒廠降低了每瓶成本。

zh: 比較優勢相對生產優勢
tip: 不是比誰最強，而是比誰放棄得最少，機會成本最低
example: Brazil's comparative advantage lies in coffee, since growing it costs less there than any other crop.
exampleZh: 巴西的比較優勢在咖啡，因為在當地種咖啡比種其他作物便宜。

zh: 市場進入門檻准入壁壘
tip: barrier 柵欄擋在門口，新廠商進不來
example: High startup costs act as a barrier to entry, shielding established airlines from newcomers.
exampleZh: 高昂的創業成本形成進入門檻，保護既有航空公司不受新進者威脅。

zh: 掠奪性定價毀滅對手的
tip: predator 是掠食者，像獵食者壓低價格吃掉對手
example: Critics called the deep discounts predatory pricing meant to drive smaller rivals out of business.
exampleZh: 批評者稱這些大幅折扣是意在逼走小對手的掠奪性定價。

zh: 解除政府法規管制鬆綁
tip: de 去除 + regulation 規定，把規定拿掉
example: Airline deregulation in the 1970s opened routes to new carriers and pushed fares down.
exampleZh: 1970年代的航空業解除管制讓新業者進入航線，票價也隨之下降。

tip: de 去除 + regulate 管制，解開管制的繩子
example: Lawmakers voted to deregulate the power market, hoping competition would lower household bills.
exampleZh: 議員投票決定放寬電力市場管制，期望競爭能降低家庭電費。

zh: 政府財政的預算稅收的
tip: fiscal 管政府的錢包：預算與稅收
example: The government's fiscal policy shifted toward tax cuts to revive consumer spending.
exampleZh: 政府的財政政策轉向減稅，以重振消費者支出。

zh: 央行貨幣政策的金融貨幣的
tip: money 錢 → monetary，管利率與貨幣供給
example: The central bank tightened monetary policy by raising interest rates to curb inflation.
exampleZh: 中央銀行調高利率以抑制通膨，收緊了貨幣政策。

tip: ag 向 + greg 羊群，把大家趕成一群加總
example: Aggregate demand fell sharply when households across the country cut spending at once.
exampleZh: 當全國家庭同時削減開銷，總體需求急遽下滑。

zh: 總體經濟學大局觀點的
tip: macro 大，從高處俯瞰整個國家的經濟
example: A macroeconomic shock such as a currency crash can sink firms that were otherwise well run.
exampleZh: 像貨幣崩跌這樣的總體經濟衝擊，可能拖垮原本經營良好的公司。

zh: 個體經濟廠商消費者層次的
tip: micro 小，用顯微鏡看單一廠商與消費者
example: Microeconomic analysis asks how a single bakery responds when the price of flour rises.
exampleZh: 個體經濟分析探討單一麵包店在麵粉漲價時如何反應。

zh: 供需平衡市場出清均衡點
tip: equi 相等 + libr 天平，天平兩端剛好平衡
example: Prices settle at the equilibrium where the quantity buyers want exactly matches what sellers offer.
exampleZh: 價格會落在均衡點，此時買方想要的數量恰好等於賣方供給的數量。

zh: 邊際成本增加一產出之成本
tip: margin 邊緣，多做最後一件所增加的成本
example: The marginal cost of printing one more book is small once the plates are made.
exampleZh: 製版完成後，多印一本書的邊際成本很小。

zh: 邊際收益增產增加之營收
tip: margin 邊緣，多賣最後一件多進帳的錢
example: Marginal revenue drops below price when a seller must cut prices to move extra units.
exampleZh: 當賣方必須降價才能多賣幾件時，邊際收益會低於價格。

zh: 消費者效用滿足度實用性
tip: use 使用，用起來有多滿足、多有用
example: Economists measure a snack's utility by how much satisfaction it gives the person eating it.
exampleZh: 經濟學家用零食帶給食用者多少滿足感來衡量它的效用。

tip: sub 在下 + sid 坐，坐在下面托住你的錢
example: A government subsidy helped farmers survive the year when crop prices collapsed.
exampleZh: 作物價格崩盤時，政府補貼幫助農民撐過了這一年。

tip: subsidy 補貼 + ize 變動詞，就是給補貼
example: Taxpayers effectively subsidize the railway, which covers barely half its operating costs from ticket sales.
exampleZh: 納稅人實際上補貼了這條鐵路，因為票房收入只夠支付一半左右的營運成本。

example: The new tariff raised the price of imported steel by twenty-five percent.
exampleZh: 新關稅使進口鋼材的價格上漲了百分之二十五。

zh: 配額進口限額生產限額
tip: 每人限領兩個的名額，就是 quota 配額
example: Each country received a quota limiting how many tons of sugar it could export.
exampleZh: 每個國家都分到一份配額，限制可出口的糖的噸數。

zh: 貿易保護主義關稅壁壘
tip: protect 保護 + ism 主義，築高牆保護本國產業
example: Protectionism may save local jobs in the short run but invites retaliation from trading partners.
exampleZh: 保護主義短期內或許能保住本地工作，但會招來貿易夥伴的報復。

zh: 貿易逆差進口大於出口
